recipes.name: SWEET VEGAN CRÊPES
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender. Let batter sit for 30 minutes in refrigerator.

recipes.name: POLENTA

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons white balsamic vinegar or 1 1/2 teaspoons sherry vinegar

instructions: Optional: toast polenta in sauté pan over medium flame, stirring constantly until it has nut-like fragrance, about 3 to 4 minutes. Remove polenta from pan and let cool to room temperature.
In 3-quart saucepan, mix polenta, salt, pepper, and water, whisking until smooth. Place pan over heat, bring mixture to boil, stirring constantly, until thickened, using medium-high flame.
Simmer 20 to 30 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough so wooden spoon can stand in it.
Season with flavoring options of choice.

recipes.name: PEANUT SAUCE
instructions: Puree peanuts and water in VitaMix to paste consistency. Add garlic, tamari, oil, sugar, lime juice, cayenne, coconut milk, and maple syrup. Puree until smooth. Add salt to taste.

recipes.name: HONEY-MUSTARD YOGURT
instructions: In small bowl, whisk all ingredients together.

recipes.name: CREAM OF ASPARAGUS SOUP

ingredients.name: bouquet garni
ingredients.notes: 2 sprigs parsley, 1 sprig thyme and 1 bay leaf

instructions: Trim tips of asparagus spears and set aside. Cut remainder of stems into 1-inch pieces. Prepare ice bath.

In small saucepan, bring 2 1/2 cups of salted water to boil. Blanch asparagus tips until tender (1-2 minutes); shock tips in ice water. Reserve cooking liquid (about 2 cups). Set aside tips for garnish.

Warm oil in 1-gallon sauce pan. Add leeks with pinch of salt and sweat over medium-low heat for 7 to 10 minutes or until soft but not brown. Add oats, asparagus stems, reserved cooking liquid with enough water or stock to equal 4 cups. Add bouquet garni and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer, partially covered for about 30 minutes or until oats are soft.
Remove bouquet garni and discard. Puree soup in blender until very smooth.
Return soup to pot; thin if desired with water or stock. Adjust seasonings with salt, pepper and lemon juice. Add butter if desired for richer consistency.
Pour soup into bowls and garnish with chopped parsley and reserved tips.

recipes.name: COUS-COUS

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive or melted coconut oil

instructions: In small sauté pan, roast cous-cous in oil until there is a nutty aroma (2 to 3 minutes).
Pour water over cous-cous. Cover cous-cous with lid and steam for 5-10 minutes until all liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with fork and serve.

recipes.name: CEVICHE

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes
ingredients.notes: seeded and cut into small dice

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 16 slices and tossed with lemon juice

instructions: In large bowl, combine scallops, jalapeno, red pepper, onion, tomato, garlic, rice syrup, cilantro, parsley, salt, pepper and citrus juices. Toss gently but thoroughly, being certain scallops are well coated with citrus juices.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30-60 minutes, or until scallops lose their translucent appearance. Stir occasionally.
Serve in individual chilled bowls or glasses garnished with avocado slices and parsley.

recipes.name: VEGAN BAKLAVA
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F.
For phyllo: In bowl, mix nuts and cinnamon. Set aside.
In half-sheet pan lined with parchment paper, individually oil and layer 6-7 sheets of phyllo. Edges of phyllo sheets will overhang bottom of sheet pan slightly, but they will be trimmed later.

Spread portion of nut mixture (approximately 1/3-1/2 cups) over top of phyllo, enough to cover surface. Add another sheet of brushed phyllo and cover with more nuts; repeat this process until all nuts are gone.
Top baklava with 6 more layers of oil-brushed phyllo. Trim excess phyllo from sides of pan, so phyllo fits pan exactly.
Cut baklava into eighths lengthwise. Then make diagonal crosswise cuts, at 2-inch intervals.
Bake baklava 30 minutes at 300°F in standard oven (fan in convection oven causes phyllo to blow away). Bake additional 30 minutes at 350°F, until golden brown.
For syrup: While baklava bakes, bring all syrup ingredients to simmer in 2-quart saucepan. Cook syrup uncovered until reduced to 2 cups.
Remove baklava from oven. Pour hot syrup over warm phyllo and let sit at least 30 minutes.

recipes.name: RICE PUDDING
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, bring water, vanilla pulp and pod, cinnamon stick, and sea salt to boil. Add rice and cover. Reduce heat to low simmer and slowly cook, covered, until rice absorbs all water, about 30 minutes. Remove rice from heat and let rest, covered, without stirring, for 15 minutes. Rice should not be fully cooked, as it will continue to cook in almond milk mixture.

Add almond milk, maple crystals, maple syrup, and rice syrup. Simmer, uncovered, over medium heat about 30-40 minutes. Stir mixture often to release starch from rice. This will allow pudding to become thick and creamy. Occasionally taste for doneness and continue to cook accordingly.
Add currants, zest, and juice. Remove cinnamon stick, and transfer pudding to bowl to cool.
Chill pudding in refrigerator. Garnish with walnuts and cinnamon just before serving.

recipes.name: RISOTTO
instructions: In pressure cooker, heat oil over medium flame. Sauté onion, then garlic in oil until translucent.
Add rice and sauté few minutes more.
Add stock and bring pot to pressure. Pressure cook risotto for 35 minutes.
While rice is cooking, prepare an ice bath, bring 1 quart water to boil, and add 1/2 teaspoon salt. Blanch asparagus for 1 minute, and shock in ice water. Drain and set asparagus aside.

Remove pressure cooker from heat, and allow pressure to come down. Open pressure cooker and add saffron, wine, and salt. Cook uncovered for 5-10 minutes more, stirring often, and adding stock if necessary.
Add blanched asparagus just before serving.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE MINI PIZZAS
instructions: Line 2 half-sheet trays with Silpats or parchment generously brushed with olive oil.
In small bowl, dissolve maple crystals in water and add yeast. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside.
In separate small bowl, whisk together rice flour, tapioca flour, xanthan gum, fennel, and salt. Set aside.
In stand mixer, blend egg, 1 tablespoon of oil, and yeast-maple crystal water. Add flour mix and beat on high for 2 minutes.
Using tablespoon, spoon batter onto cookie sheet, making 6-8 pizzas per sheet. With circular motion, spread each circle out with spoon to about 2 inches in diameter.
Cover with inverted baking sheet, and let rise 40-45 minutes. Preheat oven to 375° F.
Bake each mini pizza 10 minutes without toppings.
Remove trays from oven, and garnish pizzas with toppings of choice. Dribble remaining oil over each mini pizza. Bake another 10 minutes to cook fillings and melt cheese, if using.

recipes.name: FISH CONGEE

ingredients.name: white fish fillet
ingredients.notes: sole, flounder, sea bass OR red snapper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine water, white basmati rice, long grain brown rice, and salt. Bring to boil for 2-3 minutes. Add burdock, carrot, and onion. Lower flame, cover and allow to simmer, stirring frequently, until rice is creamy and lightly thickened (1 to 1 1/2 hours).
Cut fillet in 2-inch pieces. Add to soup 3 minutes before end of cooking, or until just tender.
Turn off flame; add toasted sesame oil, tamari, and scallions.
Ladle into bowls; garnish with nori strips.
Note: Scissors work best for cutting the nori.

recipes.name: BLACKENING SPICE MIX
instructions: Combine all ingredients.

recipes.name: MUHAMMARA
instructions: Combine peppers, garlic, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, and walnuts in bowl of food processor and puree.
Add breadcrumbs, black pepper, olive oil, vegetable stock, and sherry vinegar. Puree until smooth. Serve with Mediterranean Roasted Black Cod.

recipes.name: VEGAN "MORNAY" SAUCE

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly white pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon sauce pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat shallots with salt until translucent.
Add flour and cook over low heat, stirring constantly for about 5 minutes.
Slowly whisk in 4 cups of almond milk. Add thyme, bay leaf, and nutmeg.
Simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring often.
In blender, combine miso, umeboshi paste, mustard, and water and blend until creamy. Add this mixture to sauce and slowly whisk to combine.
Simmer until sauce is nappé consistency, about 15 minutes.
Strain sauce through chinois. Add lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce. Season to taste.

recipes.name: BLACK BEAN SALAD
instructions: Combine beans, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, cumin, fennel, and bay leaf in 1-gallon pot and bring to boil over high heat.
Lower heat and simmer for 25-30 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove bay leaf and drain beans in colander.
Whisk together lime juice, remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, and olive oil. Pour over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with radish, scallions, and tarragon.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: TOMATO "CREAM" SAUCE (FOR VEGETABLE-POLENTA NAPOLEONS)

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.notes: 6 ounces; peeled and cut in 1/4-inch dice

instructions: Preheat broiler for 5-10 minutes. Adjust rack to highest position.
Broil tomatoes on sheet tray or sizzle platter, turning them often until their skins blister. Reserve tomato liquid collected in broiler pan.
Put tomatoes through food mill to remove skins and seeds. Combine tomato pulp and reserved liquid and set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, "sauté" onion, carrot, and garlic in 1/2 cup vegetable stock, stirring often. When all liquid has evaporated, ladle in another 1/2 cup stock. Repeat this procedure until vegetables are soft and just beginning to caramelize.
In blender, process tomatoes with their liquid and carrot-onion mixture until very smooth and creamy, about 2 to 3 minutes.
Transfer sauce to covered saucepan, and simmer sauce for 25 minutes. If sauce is too thick, thin with some vegetable stock. Stir in olive oil and fresh herbs. Simmer 5 minutes longer.

recipes.name: CREAMY SWEET POTATO BISQUE WITH CASHEW CRÈME FRAICHE AND CANDIED PECANS

ingredients.name: cashews
ingredients.notes: soaked 4 hours to overnight (discard soaking liquid)

instructions: For sweet potato bisque: In 1-gallon pot, heat coconut oil over medium flame. Add onion, salt, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and cumin. Sweat until onions are translucent. Add sweet potatoes and stock to pot. Raise heat bring and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar until potatoes are tender.
Puree soup in blender until creamy. Return soup to pot. Re-heat and whisk in coconut milk. Season to taste, adding in vinegar.
For cashew crème fraiche: Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.
For candied pecans: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line half sheet tray with parchment paper.
In small saucepan, heat syrup and maple crystals. Add salt, smoked paprika, and cayenne.
Combine nuts with syrup in small bowl. Transfer to sheet tray and bake 5 to 7 minutes. Cool in refrigerator until cold enough to crack.

recipes.name: CREAM CHEESE FROSTING

ingredients.name: eight-ounce packages of organic cream cheese

instructions: In stand mixer, on low speed, beat cream cheese with butter until smooth.
Gradually beat in maple crystals, vanilla extract, and salt until well blended.
Chill to set up.

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection oven). Line 2 sheet trays with parchment paper.
Cream together butter, brown sugar, and white sugar in stand mixer, until sugars are completed incorporated and mixture is light and fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla. Mix to incorporate.
In separate bowl, sift together flour, baking soda and salt.
Add flour mixture to butter/sugar/egg mixture in 1/2 cup increments until flour is completely incorporated. Fold in chocolate chips.
Using 1-ounce scoop, drop cookies onto baking sheet at 2-inch intervals.
Cook 10-12 minutes or until golden at edges. Let cool.

recipes.name: TOMATO VINAIGRETTE

ingredients.name: vine-ripe tomatoes
ingredients.notes: 12 ounces; seeded, cored, and cut into quarters

instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender and puree until smooth.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE CHOCOLATE CAKE

ingredients.name: stick unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: melted + 1 tablespoon solid butter for greasing Bundt pan

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Grease 9 1/2-inch Bundt pan with butter and dust with cocoa powder.
In food processor, blend dates with maple syrup.
When dates are thoroughly blended, add vanilla, eggs and melted butter. Mix to combine.
In medium bowl, sift together flours, cocoa powder, baking powder and salt. Whisk well to incorporate. Add to date-syrup mixture in food processor. Mix to combine.
Pour batter into baking pan, filling no more than 2/3 up side of cake pan. Any extra cake batter can be used for muffins. Do not overfill pan. Bake for 30-35 minutes. Allow cake to cool completely.
Double-melt chocolate and drizzle over cake. Sprinkle with walnuts.

recipes.name: COBB SALAD

ingredients.name: duck bacon
ingredients.notes: 5 slices; roasted at 375° F for 10 minutes

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.notes: medium dice (drizzled with juice of 1/2 lemon)

instructions: In blender, combine all dressing ingredients until creamy. Season to taste and set aside.
Sear bacon in 10-inch sauté pan on medium-low heat until crisp on both sides. Transfer to paper towels to drain excess fat. Cool, crumble, and set bacon aside.

Combine chicken stock, salt, bay leaf, and thyme in 2 1/2 quart saucepan and bring to boil. Add chicken, lower heat, and poach until tender and flesh is opaque. Transfer chicken to plate and cool to room temperature. Cut into medium dice. Set aside.

Combine eggs in 2 1/2 quart pot, cover with 1 inch of water, cover pot, and bring to boil. Turn off heat and allow eggs to remain in hot water for about 8 minutes. Shock eggs in cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and chop eggs into medium dice.
Combine romaine and arugula. Arrange bacon, chicken, eggs, avocado, and tomatoes over greens. Drizzle with dressing and serve.

recipes.name: CHECKERBOARD COOKIES
instructions: For vanilla dough: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line 2 half-sheet trays with parchment paper.
In stand mixer, beat together butter, maple crystals, and salt until light and fluffy with paddle attachment. Add egg and vanilla and continue to mix until well combined.

Whisk together flour and baking powder in separate small bowl. Add flour mixture to butter mixture in mixer until combined. Wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate 10 minutes to firm up while making chocolate dough.
For chocolate dough: In stand mixer, beat together butter, maple crystals, and salt until well combined. Add egg, baking powder, and almond extract. Continue to mix until smooth.

Whisk together flour and cocoa powder in separate small bowl. Gradually sift flour/cocoa mixture into butter mixture and mix just until combined. Wrap dough in plastic and refrigerate at least 10 minutes until firm.
For assembly: Divide vanilla dough into 5 equal pieces. Divide chocolate dough into 4 equal pieces.

On parchment, using flour as necessary for dusting, roll out each piece dough to 1/4 inch. Make 3 stacks of rolled dough, brushing each layer with egg white: 1) vanilla/chocolate/vanilla; 2) chocolate/vanilla/chocolate; 3) vanilla/chocolate/vanilla.

Using bench scraper, square off sides of each stack of dough. Freeze 3 stacks of dough until hard. Using sharp knife, cut lengthwise rectangles of each dough, brush them with egg white, and stack rectangles in same order as listed above. Cut crosswise at 1/4 inch intervals across rectangle stacks to form cookies. Trimmed scraps of dough can be bundled together and re-rolled, frozen and stamped with cookie cutter shapes to make marbleized cookies.
Transfer to sheet trays. Brush tops with egg white. Bake 6-10 minutes or until golden at edges. Remove from pans to racks to cool.

recipes.name: FRITTATA

ingredients.name: filling of choice
ingredients.notes: 2-3; e.g., onions, garlic, peppers, tomato, cheese, mushrooms, etc.

instructions: In medium bowl whisk together filling(s), salt, and pepper with eggs.
Heat oil in sauté pan.
Pour in egg mixture.
Cook over medium-low heat until bottom is set.
Slide pan under preheated broiler for 1 or 2 minutes until lightly browned and set or, in alternative, transfer pan to 400°F oven for approximately 5 minutes.

recipes.name: BORSCHT

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onion with salt until translucent.
Add garlic, carrot, celery, red cabbage, and vinegar. Continue sweating until cabbage wilts.
Add beets and stock. Simmer partially covered, 30 minutes, or until all vegetables are tender.
Add apple juice and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with dill and Tofu Sour Cream (recipe below).

recipes.name: CASSOULET

ingredients.name: whole wheat bread crumbs mixed with 3 tablespoons olive oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F.
Combine beans in pot with salt, kombu, Brown Stock, and sachet. Cover and cook at simmer until beans are soft (approximately 45 minutes).
Toss carrots and parsnips in bowl with 3 tablespoons olive oil, transfer to parchment-lined sheet tray, and roast until browned (about 20 to 25 minutes). Sprinkle with salt and set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, caramelize onions with 2 tablespoons of oil. When softened and browned, add garlic and cook few minutes more. Add tomatoes and remaining oil. Sauté until tomatoes are soft. Set aside.

When beans are tender, add tomatoes and onions to pot. Simmer 5 minutes more. Strain bean mixture, reserving bean liquid. Reduce liquid over heat until nappé consistency is achieved (should lightly coat back of spoon). Add reduction back into bean/tomato mixture and season with salt and pepper.
In small bowl, combine parsley, thyme, and marjoram with breadcrumbs and olive oil.
In 2-quart casserole dish, layer alternately beans and roasted vegetables. Top with breadcrumb mixture. Bake uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes until browned.

recipes.name: GNOCCHI
instructions: Note: For lightest possible gnocchi, potatoes must be baked.
Preheat oven to 400° F.
Prick flesh of potatoes with fork and bake until tender, about 1 hour.

Peel potatoes while still warm and put in medium bowl. Mash potatoes and add egg and salt. Add flour in increments, working it in to bind potato mixture. Add just enough flour to hold dough together. Roll out a few test gnocchi.

Bring pot of salted water to simmer. Add gnocchi. When gnocchi rise to top, count to ten before removing and testing for consistency. If gnocchi are fragile and fall apart, add more flour and make another test batch. When you have right consistency, finish rolling out gnocchi.

Cook gnocchi as described above. You can sauce gnocchi or cook gnocchi and then sauté them in clarified butter for delicious variation. You can cook gnocchi and toss with olive oil and hold them in refrigerator up to overnight before sautéing them.
Variations: Add one of the below with the potatoes: diced herbs; chopped garlic; cooked and chopped Swiss chard.

recipes.name: BERRY-GRAPE KANTEN
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine grape juice and agar flakes. Soak agar for 5 minutes.
Bring agar-juice mixture to boil over medium heat, whisking frequently. Lower flame and simmer 5 minutes or until agar is completely dissolved.
Add ginger juice, lemon zest, and agave syrup to juice mixture. Simmer 2 minutes more.
Divide and arrange grapes and strawberries equally among individual ramekins.
Slowly pour juice mixture over grapes and strawberries in ramekins. Let mixture stand until no more steam rises. Transfer kanten to refrigerator until firmed up, about 30 minutes.
Serve kanten as is from ramekins.

recipes.name: FOCACCIA

ingredients.name: unbleached white flour or 1/2 white and 1/2 whole wheat bread flour

instructions: For the sponge: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients (yeast, rice syrup or honey, lukewarm water, and hi gluten flour) with whisk. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 20-30 minutes in warm place.
For the crust: Add potato, water, oil and salt to bowl with sponge. Add flour in 1/2 cup increments.
Remove dough from bowl, form dough into ball and knead on a floured work surface. Dough should be soft and a little sticky. Knead 8-10 minutes.

Place dough in lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic, and place in warm place until doubled in size - about 1 hour. Punch down, transfer to parchment-lined sheet pan and let rise 15 to 20 minutes more.
Preheat oven to 475° F.
Transfer focaccia to pan. Dimple surface of focaccia with fingers before adding toppings.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.name: CASHEW CREAM

ingredients.name: cashews
ingredients.notes: soaked 4 hours to overnight (discard soaking liquid)

instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: BABA GHANOUSH
instructions: Cook eggplant on top of stove over medium-low flame, turning often with tongs until skin is completely charred and flesh is fork tender (about 15 minutes).
Transfer eggplant to covered bowl and let sweat for 15 minutes.
Let eggplant cool, cut in half, and scoop out flesh or peel off charred skin.
In food processor, blend flesh with tahini, garlic, lemon juice, and salt. Adjust seasonings for desired taste.

recipes.name: HIGH-PROTEIN GLUTEN-FREE FLOUR MIX
instructions: Note: for this recipe use 1 3/4 cups flour (discard extra tablespoon).

recipes.name: CREAM OF CARROT SOUP WITH ARBORIO RICE
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened (about 5-8 minutes). Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot, and sweat over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and rice to pot. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar, 25 minutes, or until carrots and rice are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with lemon and ginger juices.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE AND VEGAN WAFFLES

ingredients.name: small amount of oil to brush or spray onto waffle iron

instructions: Pre-heat waffle iron.
In large bowl whisk together flours, baking powder, salt, maple crystals, and cinnamon.
In separate bowl, whisk oil, vanilla extract, and almond milk.
Make well in center of dry ingredients. Pour in liquid ingredients and whisk to combine.
In stand mixer, beat aqua faba until stiff peaks are achieved; fold into batter until barely blended.
Lightly grease waffle iron. For each waffle pour about 1/2-3/4 cup batter onto griddle.
Cook about 5-6 minutes per batch (longer cooking than egg waffles).

recipes.name: CASHEW MILK (FOR SWEET VEGAN CRÊPES)
instructions: Puree mixture in VitaMix or blender. Strain through chinois or strainer lined with wet cheesecloth.

recipes.name: PAN-FRIED MILLET CROQUETTES
recipes.description: Dry-roasted millet simmers until tender, then gets squeezed sticky with breadcrumbs, scallions, parsley, and shoyu, shaped into croquettes, and pan-fried in a cornmeal crust until crisp.
instructions: In sauce pot, dry roast millet over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add water and salt, cover, and bring to boil. Simmer 40 minutes or until water is absorbed.
Transfer millet to large bowl with breadcrumbs and let cool. Squeeze grain until sticky.
Add scallions, parsley, and shoyu to millet.
Using 1/4 cup measure, form croquettes. Mold croquettes with wet hands. Dredge in cornmeal.
Heat 1/2 inch of oil in large sauté pan. Prepare plate lined with paper towel for draining.
Fry croquettes until golden brown on each side. Flip once during cooking.

recipes.name: Lemon-Dill Mayonnaise (for Poached Salmon)
recipes.description: Fall/Winter
instructions: Whisk together egg yolk, mustard, lemon juice, water and salt in bowl.

Drop by drop add oil, whisking constantly. When half the oil is used up, mayonnaise will be thick enough to add remainder about one tablespoon at a time, until it’s all used up. Add lemon zest. Refrigerate.

recipes.name: Master Cleanse
recipes.description: Popularized by Stanley Burroughs (From Elson M. Haas, MD, The Detox Diet)
instructions: Mix and drink 8-12 glasses throughout day.
Eat or drink nothing else except water, laxative herb tea, and peppermint or chamomile teas.
Keep master cleanse in glass jar, not in plastic.
Rinse your mouth with water after each glass to prevent lemon juice from damaging enamel of your teeth.

recipes.name: TABOULI
recipes.description: Warm bulgur drinks in lemon juice and olive oil as it cools, then gets folded with plum tomatoes, heaps of parsley and mint, scallions, and crisp celery for a bright, herb-packed salad.

ingredients.name: plum tomatoes
ingredients.notes: seeded and cut into small dice

instructions: In large bowl, toss warm bulgur with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt. Let sit until it reaches room temperature.
Combine bulgur with tomatoes, parsley, scallions, celery, and mint, mixing thoroughly. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: WHOLE WHEAT BREAD
recipes.description: Rising begins with a yeast sponge of whole wheat flour sweetened with honey or maple syrup; olive oil and more flour work in during a long fifteen-minute knead toward a smooth, supple dough.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In large bowl, combine yeast, water, whole wheat bread flour, 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour, and honey or maple syrup. Stir until thick batter is achieved. Cover sponge with plastic and set aside in warm place for 30-45 minutes.
Add olive oil, salt, and just enough of remaining pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough about 10-15 minutes, adding remaining pastry flour as necessary, until smooth dough is formed.
Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans by lining with parchment paper.
Fold/turn dough. Rise one more time.

Divide dough into two, form into loaves, and transfer to loaf pans or on sheet tray for final rise. Cover dough with damp towel and set aside in warm place. Rise until dough has doubled in size, about 10-15 minutes.
Transfer bread to oven and bake approximately 30-45 minutes or until golden and firm to touch. Internal dough temperature should register between 190° and 205° F.

recipes.name: SWEET CORN SAUCE WITH BUTTER
recipes.description: Fresh corn kernels are blended until silky, then squeezed through cheesecloth to capture pure corn milk—the base of a delicate sauce enriched with butter, brightened with lemon juice, and seasoned with white pepper.
instructions: Remove corn kernels from cob.
Puree corn kernels in VitaMix until smooth.
Transfer puree to strainer lined with moistened double layer of cheesecloth. Squeeze 'corn milk' through cheesecloth.
Transfer 'corn milk' to 2 1/2 quart pot, and simmer for 5-10 minutes, stirring constantly, until mixture begins to thicken. Whisk in butter. Sauce should have nappé consistency.
Whisk in lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: WHITE WINE MARINADE
recipes.description: White wine and olive oil come together with lemon or orange zest, fresh herbs, parsley sprigs, and black pepper in a simple stir-together marinade suited to most vegetables — halve the oil for fruit.

ingredients.name: fresh lemon sliced or zest of 1 orange
heaping tablespoon chopped fresh herbs or 1 teaspoon dried herbs

instructions: Combine ingredients. This marinade can be used for most vegetables (use half amount of oil if using for fruit).

recipes.name: SAUTÉED SWISS CHARD
recipes.description: Swiss chard wilts in nothing but the water clinging to its leaves, then gets squeezed, chopped, and tossed through garlic-scented olive oil, with fresh rosemary stirred in off the heat.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: Remove stems from chard and discard or save for another dish. Roughly chop leaves and wash. In 1-gallon pot, cook chard over medium heat, stirring frequently until wilted but still bright green. You don’t have to add water to pot; water clinging to leaves from washing is enough to cook them.
Remove chard from pot and squeeze out any excess liquid. Finely chop.
Warm oil with garlic in 10-inch sauté pan. When garlic just begins to color, add chard and stir to warm through. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Remove from heat and stir in rosemary.

recipes.name: Basil Ice Cream
recipes.description: Blanched and shocked basil holds its vivid green as it blends into coconut milk sweetened with maple and rice syrups, lemon zest and vanilla rounding out a strikingly herbal frozen scoop.
instructions: Prepare ice bath. Bring water to boil. Add salt. Blanch basil for 2-3 seconds then shock in ice bath. Drain basil and completely wring water from it.
Combine coconut milk, maple syrup, rice syrup, vanilla extract, lemon zest, salt and basil in blender.
Process mixture until well emulsified.
Pour mixture into ice cream machine and churn until creamy and somewhat firm.

recipes.name: SESAME-CRUSTED TUNA
recipes.description: Tuna gets fully crusted in white and black sesame seeds, then hits a sauté pan slicked with hot canola oil, the seeds toasting into a crunchy shell while wasabi powder stands by for sharp heat.

ingredients.name: wasabi powder
ingredients.notes: mixed with water to form smooth paste

instructions: Season tuna with salt and pepper.
Combine sesame seeds and completely crust tuna.
Heat canola oil in sauté pan over medium heat.
Sear tuna on all sides, approximately 1-2 minutes each side.
Let tuna rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with wasabi and dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Challah
recipes.description: Honeyed water wakes the yeast before eggs and melted butter enrich this dough, which comes together one cup of flour at a time and kneads for a full ten minutes into a smooth, pliable challah.
instructions: Combine water and honey. Sprinkle yeast on top of mixture. Set aside until foamy.
Add eggs, butter, and salt. Add flour, one cup at a time, stirring until dough comes together.
Turn dough out onto lightly floured surface and knead to form smooth, pliable dough (about 10 minutes), adding flour as necessary.
Transfer dough to large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm area until doubled in size (about 1 hour).
Turn and fold dough. Cover and rise again (about 1/2 hour).
Divide dough into two large balls. Divide each ball evenly into equal portions for braiding. Roll divided dough into long strips of equal length.

To braid, pinch strips together at top. Braid both breads, transferring each to separate parchment-lined sheet tray. Cover breads with damp towels, and rise one more time (15-20 minutes), until doubled in size.
While bread is rising, pre-heat oven to 350°F.
Glaze bread with egg wash and bake until golden brown and fully cooked (inner temp about 190°F).
Transfer breads to cooling racks and fully cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Beet Chips
recipes.description: Slices of beet tossed with olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper bake low and slow at 200 degrees for about two hours, drying into shatteringly crisp, jewel-toned chips.

ingredients.name: beet
ingredients.notes: 1 small; peeled, sliced into 1/8 inch thick rounds with mandolin

instructions: Heat oven to 200°F.
Combine beets in small bowl with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Transfer beets to Silpat and bake until crispy, about 2 hours.

recipes.name: YELLOW PEPPER COULIS WITH OLIVE OIL
recipes.description: Shallots and yellow peppers sweat slowly in olive oil before brown rice vinegar reduces to nearly dry, leaving a bright, tangy coulis loosened with vegetable stock and seasoned simply.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat shallots until translucent.
Add peppers and sweat until softened.
Add vinegar and reduce until almost dry (au sec).
Add stock and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
Puree in blender until creamy and return to pan. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CARROT SOUP WITH POTATO
recipes.description: Sweated onions and carrots simmer with potato in stock until meltingly tender, and the finished soup is brightened with lemon juice, ginger juice, and a shower of chopped dill.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened (about 5-8 minutes). Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot, and sweat over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and potatoes to pot. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar, 25 minutes, or until carrots and potatoes are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with lemon and ginger juices.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: AMARANTH PORRIDGE
recipes.description: Homemade almond milk—blended from soaked almonds and strained through a chinois—anchors this amaranth porridge, sweetened with maple syrup and raw honey and warmed with cinnamon and toasted almonds.

ingredients.name: amaranth
ingredients.notes: soaked 6 hours in water to cover with 2 tablespoons of lemon juice

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Place 1 cup of the almonds on a half-sheet pan. Toast. Cool, roughly chop and set aside.
Bring 4 cups of water to a boil. Pour in remaining 2 cups almonds, cover and set aside for 15 minutes.

Using a high-speed blender, process almonds and their water in batches. Strain almond mixture through chinois and set milky liquid aside covered in the refrigerator until needed. Discard solids or save for another use.
Drain amaranth and combine with sea salt and 3 cups of water in 4-quart pot.

Bring amaranth to boil, reduce to simmer, and cover pot. Stir amaranth frequently, adding water in 1-2 cup increments until grains are cooked and no starchy aftertaste remains. Grain should still be chewy.
Remove pot from heat and stir in freshly ground flax seeds. Add additional salt, if desired.
Serve alongside toppings including fresh nut milk, toasted almonds, sweeteners, cinnamon, butter, and/or Apricot-Papaya Puree to taste.

recipes.name: BAGELS
recipes.description: Yeast proofed with rice syrup leavens a dough of high-gluten and whole wheat pastry flours, kneaded a full ten to fifteen minutes until smooth and finished with a scatter of poppy seeds.

ingredients.name: toppings: poppy seeds
ingredients.notes: garlic, sesame seeds, Kosher salt, minced onion

instructions: In large bowl, combine water, rice syrup, and yeast. Proof for 10 minutes or until mixture is foamy.
Add olive oil and salt to yeast mixture. Stir together bread and pastry flour. Add enough flour to yeast mixture to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough using remaining flour as necessary, about 10-15 minutes, or until dough is smooth.
Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare 2 sheet pans lined with oiled parchment. Bring 1 gallon water to boil and preheat oven to 400° F.
Fold/turn dough. Rise again.
Divide dough into 16 equal-sized balls (3 ounces each by weight).
Form dough into bagel shapes by rolling to 8-inch strips and overlapping and rolling ends or poking hole through center and spreading dough apart.

Place toppings in bowls. Boil 3-4 bagels at a time for 30 seconds, flipping once or twice. Remove from pot with spider and turn bagel face side down into toppings. Gently lift bagels out of topping and transfer to prepared baking sheets. Repeat process until all bagels have been boiled.
Transfer bagels to oven and bake approximately 20-25 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch.

recipes.name: CARROT-CELERY-GINGER JUICE
recipes.description: Sweet carrots and celery run through the juicer alternating with parsley, lemon, and fresh ginger, then the foam is skimmed away for a clean, peppery-bright glass best poured and enjoyed immediately.
instructions: Cut produce to fit juicer feed tube. Juice produce alternating ingredients (parsley, celery, lemon, ginger, carrots, parsley, etc.).
Skim foam and serve immediately.

recipes.name: GREAT NORTHERN BEAN AND ROASTED GARLIC PURÉE
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked great northern beans, simmered with thyme and bay leaf, purée with lemon juice, roasted garlic, and olive oil into a smooth, thick spread for slices of whole wheat baguette.
instructions: Combine beans in pressure cooker with salt, thyme, and bay leaf. Add enough water to cover by 1 inch. Cover and bring to full pressure. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid and drain beans, reserving cooking liquid.
Discard thyme stems and bay leaf and transfer beans to food processor.
Add lemon, garlic, and olive oil. Puree until smooth, adding bean liquid as necessary to form smooth, thick purée.
Transfer to bowl season to taste and fold in parsley, dill, salt, and pepper. Serve on toasted baguette.

recipes.name: AIRLINE CHICKEN BREASTS WITH COMPOUND BUTTER
recipes.description: Brined in salted water for a full hour, these airline chicken breasts are matched with a compound butter processed from garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, and fresh basil, with ghee for the pan.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Combine chicken breasts in medium bowl with water and salt to brine. Refrigerate one hour. Remove breasts from water and dry well.
Combine butter, garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, and basil in food processor. Process until ingredients are well incorporated and butter is smooth.
Remove compound butter mixture from processor and divide into 4 equal portions. Set aside.
Preheat convection oven to 400°F.
Gently separate skin from breast, taking care not to tear it. Spread compound butter evenly between skin and breast. Season skin with salt and pepper.
Heat ghee in 12-inch sauté pan. Place breasts skin side down in pan. Sear over medium-high heat to caramelize skin.
Transfer pan to oven and roast breasts for 15-20 minutes or until juices run clear. Do not turn chicken over while cooking. Serve skin side up.

recipes.name: SESAME ANISE BISCOTTI
recipes.description: Ground almonds, sesame seeds, and anise seeds form the fragrant base of these biscotti, bound with melted coconut oil and maple syrup and perfumed twice over with vanilla and anise extracts.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line half-sheet tray with parchment paper.
In food processor, grind almonds to fine meal. In spice grinder, grind sesame seeds and anise seeds into fine powder. Add sesame seeds, anise, and baking powder to food processor and process.
In separate small bowl, whisk together oil, syrup, extracts, and sea salt.

Add wet ingredients to dry in food processor. Pulse until dough comes together. Separate dough into 2 equal parts. Pour sesame seeds on plate. Gently press and roll logs in sesame seeds to cover all sides.
On cutting board, shape both doughs into perfectly matching rectangles (approximately 3 inches wide by 6 inches long) using 2 dough scrapers. Freeze dough before slicing.
Using sharp chef’s knife, slice each log into ¼ inch thick slices.
Transfer slices on sheet tray to oven and cook approximately 7 minutes each side or until thoroughly golden and crisp.

recipes.name: SHERRY VINAIGRETTE
recipes.description: Garlic, dijon mustard, and sherry vinegar whisk together with a touch of maple syrup before extra virgin olive oil streams in gradually, building a balanced, gently sweet emulsion.
instructions: In medium mixing bowl, combine garlic, mustard, vinegar, salt, and maple syrup. Gradually whisk in olive oil.

recipes.name: CASHEW SOUR CREAM
recipes.description: Cashews whirl in the food processor with lime juice, rice vinegar, and scallions until utterly smooth and creamy, making a tangy, dairy-free stand-in for sour cream that needs only a pinch of sea salt to finish.

ingredients.name: cashews
ingredients.notes: soaked 4 hours to overnight (discard soaking water)

instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth and creamy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: BANANA CUPCAKES
recipes.description: Butter and sugar cream to a light, fluffy base before egg and mashed ripe bananas fold in, and the vanilla-scented batter bakes in miniature tins with a splash of milk soured by apple cider vinegar.

ingredients.name: banana
ingredients.notes: cut in thin rounds for topping

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection oven). Prepare miniature muffin tins with cupcake liners.
Cream butter and sugar together in stand mixer until light and fluffy. Add egg and mashed banana, mixing thoroughly.
Sift and whisk dry ingredients together in bowl; add to butter and egg mixture in mixer.
Whisk to combine milk, vinegar, and vanilla; add mixture to batter in mixer.
Fill cupcake liners using ice cream scoop, filling 2/3 full. Top with slice of banana.
Cook for 15-20 minutes. Check doneness by with toothpick in center (should come out clean).

recipes.name: Wild and Long Grain Rice Salad
recipes.description: Long grain and wild rice mingle with crisp celery, radishes, sweet currants, and walnuts, all brought together by a blender dressing of brown rice vinegar, lime juice, stone-ground mustard, and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In medium bowl, combine rice, celery, radishes, currants and walnuts.
In blender, combine dressing ingredients.
Add dressing to rice-vegetable mixture.
Add parsley and season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: HERB MARINADE
recipes.description: Dried thyme, basil, and oregano bloom with garlic and freshly ground black pepper in gently warmed olive oil, then cool into a deeply infused marinade that comes together in a single saucepan.
instructions: In small saucepan, warm all ingredients in oil and remove from heat. Cool marinade before use.

recipes.name: HANDMADE GARLIC MAYONNAISE
recipes.description: Garlic smashed to a paste with sea salt whisks into egg yolks and mustard, then olive oil trickles in no more than a teaspoon at a time, slowly building a thick, glossy mayonnaise entirely by hand.

ingredients.name: extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.notes: 1/3-1/2; Troy brand Turkish olive oil OR Spectrum brand Californian olive oil

instructions: Smash garlic with salt to paste on cutting board.
Put garlic paste in bowl together with egg yolks and mustard; whisk until smooth.
Slowly add oil (no more than one teaspoon at a time) to egg yolk mixture, whisking until well incorporated before adding more oil.
As mixture begins to thicken, oil can be added somewhat more rapidly (no more than one tablespoon at a time).
When all oil has been incorporated, whisk in lemon juice.

Note: If using extra virgin oil, use mild-flavored oil. Most Italian olive oils have too robust a flavor and leave bitter aftertaste on tongue. It is also helpful to use relatively small proportion of oil to egg yolk.

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE-PEANUT BUTTER FROSTING
recipes.description: Peanut butter and coconut cream blend to a smooth base with cocoa powder and maple crystals, while agar bloomed in coconut milk lends this deep, chocolate-rich frosting its set, spreadable body.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk and agar powder. Set aside for at least 5 minutes.
Prepare ice bath.
In food processor, combine coconut cream, peanut butter, maple crystals, cocoa powder, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Bring coconut milk-agar mixture to boil. Simmer until agar powder has dissolved, stirring constantly to avoid scorching.
Slowly and carefully add coconut milk-agar mixture and melted chocolate to processor with other ingredients and process to combine.
Using spatula, transfer contents from food processor to small bowl over ice bath until chilled.

recipes.name: Cucumber Agua Fresca
recipes.description: A deeply refreshing, cooling elixir that harnesses the watery essence of cucumber and the bright, volatile acidity of lime to soothe the spirit. Perfect for intense summer heat, this beverage restores thermodynamic equilibrium through its cooling properties.

ingredients.name: english cucumbers with skin
ingredients.notes: 12 ounces each; seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Combine cucumbers, lime juice, mint, water, and agave in blender and puree until smooth.
Strain puree through sieve and serve in glasses with slice of lime.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper and Mushrooms
recipes.description: Red pepper, mushrooms, and zucchini roast alongside garlic and olive oil in a hot oven for a full thirty minutes, concentrating their juices into deep, tender, caramelized sweetness.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F-400°F.
Combine vegetables, garlic, and olive oil in large roasting pan.
Roast for 30 minutes. Drain and cool.

recipes.name: Flax Seed Drink
recipes.description: This drink contains phytoestrogens, omega-3 fatty acids, and is high in soluble fiber.
instructions: Grind flax seeds in spice grinder and mix with water. Drink immediately.

recipes.name: POMEGRANATE REDUCTION
recipes.description: Pomegranate juice simmers with agave syrup and a pinch of sea salt until it thickens to a glossy nappé consistency, an intensely fruity reduction that clings to the back of a spoon.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2 quart pot. Simmer until thickened to nappé consistency.

recipes.name: GREENS WITH CUCUMBER ICE AND LIME VINAIGRETTE
recipes.description: Cucumber blends with lime juice, rice syrup, and mint, then freezes in an ice cream maker into a savory ice that tops hydroponic lettuce, grape tomatoes, and avocado under a bright lime vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: english cucumber
ingredients.notes: 7 ounces; seeded and cut into chunks

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.notes: 8 slices; drizzled with 1 tablespoon lime juice (1 lime)

instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, heat lime juice and rice syrup over medium heat until syrup has dissolved.
Puree cucumber in Vitamix with rice syrup-lime juice mixture, salt, and mint. Blend until smooth.
Transfer mixture to ice cream maker and process until frozen. Set aside in freezer.
In small bowl, combine dressing ingredients – lime juice, rice syrup, salt, and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until dressing emulsifies.
Arrange salad greens on plate. Scoop cucumber ice into center. Drizzle with dressing. Garnish with tomatoes, avocado, cilantro, and mint leaves.

recipes.name: Meringue Frosting
recipes.description: Egg whites whisk with agave, cider vinegar, sea salt, and cream of tartar over rapidly boiling water for about ten minutes until white and billowing, then finish off the heat with vanilla extract.
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk egg whites, agave, vinegar, salt, and cream of tartar. Place bowl over 2 1/2 quart pot of boiling water. Make sure water underneath bowl is rapidly boiling.
Whisk mixture for about 10 minutes (mixture will become white and frothy).
Remove from heat and add vanilla extract.
Using hand mixer, whip at medium-high speed until light and fluffy, about 4-5 minutes.
Note: If doubling recipe, frosting can be whipped in stand mixer.

recipes.name: Ravioli with Beet Stuffing
recipes.description: Simmered beets are pureed and folded with toasted ground fennel, buttery sautéed shallots, golden breadcrumbs, and ginger, then bound with egg yolk into a vivid crimson filling for ravioli.
instructions: Cover beets with water and simmer until tender. Peel and puree in food processor.
Toast fennel seeds in sauté pan. Remove to spice grinder or mortar and pestle and grind.

Heat butter in 8-inch sauté pan, and sauté shallots until translucent. Add breadcrumbs and sauté until golden, stirring constantly. Add shallot-breadcrumb mixture to beet puree and stir in fennel, ginger, salt and pepper. Stir in egg yolk.

Form ravioli: Roll out pasta dough thinly and cut out disks about 2 1/4 inches in diameter. Put a little stuffing in middle of each dish and brush edge with egg white or water. Fold each disc over into half-moon shape and press edges firmly together to seal. Cook ravioli in boiling salted water until they rise to the surface.

recipes.name: BLACK AND WHITE COOKIES
recipes.description: Lemon zest brightens a soft dough of all-purpose and cake flours beaten with eggs, sugar, milk, and butter, finished with the signature two-tone glaze of confectioner's sugar and dark chocolate.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection). Line 2 half-sheet pans with parchment paper.
Whisk together flours, baking powder, salt and lemon zest in bowl and set aside.
Beat eggs and sugar in bowl until smoothly blended. Add milk, butter, and vanilla extract.
Slowly add egg/sugar mixture into flour mixture, blending until smooth.
Using 1-ounce scoop, drop cookies 2 inches apart on sheet tray. Bake for about 15 minutes, until lightly golden and tops feel firm to touch.
Remove cookies to wire racks and cool at room temperature before frosting.
Whisk confectioner's sugar in bowl with 2-3 tablespoons boiling water until thick but smooth.

Remove frosting from heat and reserve 3 tablespoons of frosting to make 'black' frosting; use remainder to frost half of each cookie (if frosting becomes too thick, add drops of boiling water again until it is spreadable).
Melt chocolate in small bowl over simmering water. Stir in corn syrup.

Add reserved white frosting to chocolate and stir to spreadable consistency (adding more hot water, if necessary, to thin). Spread bare half of each cookie with chocolate frosting. Set cookies aside until frostings set.

recipes.name: CLASSIC BUTTER AND SAGE SAUCE
recipes.description: Butter browns just to the edge of nutty before fresh sage leaves hit the pan; spooned hot over just-cooked ravioli, this two-ingredient sauce delivers maximum aroma with minimal effort.
instructions: Heat butter until it browns slightly and add sage leaves.
As soon as ravioli are cooked, remove them with slotted spoon, arrange on plates, pour sage butter over.

recipes.name: RAW "CHEESECAKE"
recipes.description: Dates and pecans process into a crust that presses into a spring-form pan, while cashews, coconut milk, agave nectar, lemon juice, and vanilla bean promise a lush, no-bake filling.
instructions: Line 9-inch spring-form pan with parchment paper.
In food processor combine dates, pecans, coconut oil, and sea salt. Process until dough binds when pressed with fingers. Do not over-blend.
Press dough evenly into bottom of spring-form pan.
Freeze until crust is set, about 15 minutes.
Drain and rinse cashews, discarding soaking water.
In high-powered blender, puree cashews, coconut milk, agave nectar, coconut oil, lemon juice, vanilla bean, and salt. Blend until very smooth.
Decorate surface of cheesecake with droplets or lines of puree.
Using skewer or dinner knife, swirl mixture to create marbled effect.
Freeze cheesecake until solid.

recipes.name: NIÇOISE SALAD
recipes.description: Anchovy and dijon blend into a creamy dressing that coats roasted redskin potatoes and blanched haricots verts, layered with tuna, eggs, romaine, grape tomatoes, niçoise olives, and briny capers.
instructions: In blender, combine all dressing ingredients until creamy. Season to taste. Set aside.

Heat oven to 350°F. Combine potatoes in medium bowl and toss with 1 teaspoon of salt and olive oil. Transfer to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast until golden and tender. Toss with 2-3 tablespoons of the dressing. Set aside.

In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring 6 cups of water to boil. Add haricots verts and remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt and blanch until tender crisp, about 3 minutes. Shock in ice cold water. Drain for a few minutes in colander. Cut haricots verts in half lengthwise and toss with 2-3 tablespoons of the dressing. Set aside.

Combine eggs in 2 1/2 quart pot with water to cover by one inch. Cover pot, bring to boil, and remove pot from heat. Allow eggs to remain in hot water for 10 minutes. Shock eggs in cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and slice each egg into 4 wedges. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of the dressing. Set aside.

Heat cast iron grill pan. Drizzle fish with olive oil and season with salt. Grill fish on each side for about 1-2 minutes, depending on thickness of fish. Remove fish from grill. Let fish rest about 7-10 minutes before slicing into 1/4-inch slices.
Pour remaining 1/4 cup of dressing over lettuce and mix to combine. Arrange potatoes, haricots verts, eggs, sliced fish, tomatoes, and olives on mound of dressed greens. Garnish with capers.

recipes.name: CURRANT SCONES
recipes.description: Cold butter is cut into maple-sweetened flour for a coarse crumb, then egg, heavy cream, citrus zest, and currants bring these scones together before a gentle 350-degree bake.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350° F.
Sift and whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and maple crystals.
Cut butter into dry mix to form coarse crumbs.
In another bowl, beat egg, heavy cream, zest and currants together.
Add wet to dry until just combined.
Fold out onto table and form semi-flattened log.
Cut log into triangles and bake on parchment for 10 minutes.
Serve warm.
Note: If using rice flour add more liquid (about 2 tablespoons).

recipes.name: GINGERBREAD MUFFINS
recipes.description: Butter melts with molasses and corn syrup over a low flame, brightened with ginger juice, then folds into flour sifted with brown sugar, ground ginger, cinnamon, and baking soda for miniature spiced muffins.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection oven). Prepare miniature muffin tins with muffin papers. Place muffin tins on sheet pan and set aside.
In small saucepan, on low flame, heat and whisk together butter, molasses, and corn syrup until mixed and butter is melted. Add ginger juice and set aside.
In medium bowl, sift together flour, sugars, ground ginger, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt. Use whisk to incorporate ingredients.
Pour melted butter, molasses, corn syrup, and ginger juice into bowl with sifted dry ingredients. Stir to combine.
Pour batter into electric mixer, add eggs, and beat at medium speed for 1 1/2-2 minutes.
Using small ice cream scoop, fill muffin papers half way. Bake 10-12 minutes. Gently remove from pan. Cool completely.

recipes.name: CELERIAC WITH GRILLED ASPARAGUS AND EGGS
recipes.description: Celeriac simmers with brown rice vinegar and rice syrup until just tender, its cooking liquid reduced to a syrupy lemon-olive oil dressing, then it meets asparagus, grated egg, baby spinach, and hazelnuts.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, bring water to boil with salt. Add celeriac, vinegar, and rice syrup. Lower heat and simmer until celeriac is just tender. Transfer celeriac with slotted spoon to medium bowl.

Add lemon juice and 6 tablespoons olive oil to pot with cooking liquids. Increase heat to medium-high and reduce liquid until syrupy in texture. Season with salt and pepper and pour half of reduced cooking liquid over celeriac. Set aside.

Combine egg with one-inch water to cover in 2 1/2 quart pot. Cover pot and bring to boil. Remove pot from heat and allow egg to remain in hot water for about 8 minutes. Shock egg in cold water. When cool enough to handle, peel and grate egg through a grater or sieve. Set aside.
Combine asparagus in bowl with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper. Mix to combine.
Heat cast iron griddle grill until hot. Grill asparagus until slightly charred but still firm in texture. Toss with remaining half of reduced cooking liquid and set aside.
Arrange spinach on plate. Arrange bundle of celeriac next to bundle of asparagus. Garnish with grated eggs and hazelnuts.

recipes.name: Blueberry Muffins
recipes.description: Fresh blueberries fold gently into a maple-sweetened batter of whole wheat pastry flour, oat milk, and melted coconut oil, warmed with cinnamon and freshly ground nutmeg for a tender muffin crumb.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350°F. Line muffin pans with paper liners and set aside.
In medium bowl, sift flours, baking powder, baking soda, and spices together and whisk to combine.
In separate bowl, whisk together oat milk, kuzu, melted coconut oil, maple syrup, vinegar, and salt. Pour wet mixture into dry ingredients bowl. Whisk to combine. Gently stir in blueberries.

With 1-ounce scoop, pour batter into muffin papers to fill almost to top (about 3/4 full). Transfer muffin tins to half sheet pans. Bake 5-6 minutes, rotate pans, and continue to bake (about 6-8 minutes more) until top of muffins bounces back when touched and toothpick comes out clean.
Remove muffins from pans immediately and cool completely before serving.

recipes.name: TEMPEH “BOLOGNESE”
recipes.description: Browned tempeh anchors this bolognese-style sauce, built on soft onions, garlic, oregano, and basil, deglazed with red wine and simmered with tomato puree to cloak pasta cooked al dente.

ingredients.name: rice syrup
ingredients.notes: if tomatoes seem too acidic; optional

instructions: Sauté tempeh in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until browned.
Add remaining olive oil and onion with 1 teaspoon of salt. Keep cooking until onions are soft.
Add garlic, oregano and basil (if using fresh oregano and basil, then add in last 10 minutes of cooking). Cook for few minutes longer. Add 1 cup of red wine and reduce until almost dry.
Pour in tomato puree and cook covered for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper and rice syrup (if needed).
Have large pot set up with boiling, salted water and strainer or basket that can be easily lifted out.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat approximately 1/2 cup of Bolognese sauce.
Drop one serving pasta (about 4 ounces) in strainer or basket and place in boiling water. Heat through about one minute. Drain pasta.
Combine pasta with sauce and toss to coat. Plate pasta and pour over any sauce left in pan. Garnish plate and serve.
Note: Broccoli should be used as garnish: about 2-3 pieces depending on size.

recipes.name: Vegan Pastry Crust
recipes.description: Coconut oil is cut into cinnamon-scented whole wheat and all-purpose flours until sandy, then bound with vanilla, maple syrup, and ice water for a tender vegan crust ready for rolling.
instructions: In medium bowl, sift together dry ingredients. Use whisk to fully combine ingredients.
Add oil to bowl. Using pastry cutter, blend oil into flour. Dough should have coarse, sand-like consistency.
Add vanilla and maple syrup to dough with wooden spoon. Mix to combine.
Slowly add water to dough one tablespoon at a time. Dough should just hold together and be moist (but not wet).
Place dough in plastic wrap, twisting so it holds together. Flatten to disc shape and refrigerate 10-15 minutes.
Remove dough from refrigerator; rest it until workable and can be rolled without cracking.

Lightly dust a sheet of parchment with all-purpose flour. Lay dough atop parchment and lightly dust surface of dough. Place second piece of parchment paper on top of dough, and roll out, flipping halfway. Remove second piece of parchment and continue rolling until dough is 1/8 inch thick.

Invert 9-inch pie plate over center of rolled out dough. Using sharp knife, cut a circle using cake pan as a guide. If dough is too soft, refrigerate briefly until it is firm enough to work with but not so firm that is cracks when assembling the galette.

recipes.name: COFFEE GRANITA
recipes.description: Bold instant coffee dissolves with maple crystals and a pour of Kahlua, then the mixture freezes in a shallow pan and gets fork-scraped every half hour into glittering, icy crystals.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, bring water to boil. Add instant coffee and maple crystals and stir until coffee and maple crystals are dissolved. Add Kahlua and salt. Whisk to combine and remove from heat.
Pour mixture into half hotel pan (mixture should be about 1/4 inch up side of pan) and transfer to freezer for about 1 hour.
Remove pan from freezer and use fork to scrape any ice crystals that have formed on side or bottom of pan. Return to freezer and repeat scraping every 30 minutes for 3-4 hours.
Once mixture is thoroughly frozen, scrape once more with fork, returning granita to “dry” in freezer for another half hour before serving.

recipes.name: MUSHROOMS A LA GRECQUE
recipes.description: Cremini mushrooms simmer briefly in white wine with lemon peel, fennel seeds, garlic, and thyme, then rest atop mesclun greens with chopped tarragon and a drizzle of the cooled cooking liquid.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine mushrooms, wine, lemon peel, lemon juice, olive oil, fennel seeds, garlic, thyme sprigs, salt, pepper, and water.
Bring mixture to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for about 5-7 minutes.

Remove lemon peel, thyme sprigs, and smashed garlic. Remove mushrooms from pot with slotted spoon. Serve mushrooms atop mesclun, garnished with tarragon. Drizzle small amount of cooled cooking liquid over salad just before serving.

recipes.name: Coleslaw
recipes.description: Soaked blanched almonds blend with dijon, agave, apple cider vinegar, and lemon juice into a mayonnaise-like dressing that coats crisp green and red cabbage, yellow pepper, carrot, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Combine almonds in 2 1/2 quart pot with water and salt. Bring to boil, cover, and remove pot from heat. Let almonds soak for 20 minutes.

In blender, combine almonds, soaking water, garlic paste, mustard, agave syrup, vinegar, lemon juice, canola oil, salt, and pepper. Blend until creamy, adding water a little at a time until consistency is similar to mayonnaise. Set aside.
In large bowl, combine cabbage (green and red) with yellow pepper and carrots.
Toss dressing with vegetables. Fold in parsley and dill.

recipes.name: VEGAN CAESAR SALAD
recipes.description: Golden baked croutons of whole grain bread top crisp romaine in this caesar, dressed with a creamy blend of silken tofu, garlic, lemon juice, chickpea miso, and umeboshi, plus nori for briny depth.

ingredients.name: whole grain bread
ingredients.notes: 1/2 loaf; crust removed and medium dice

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.
Toss bread cubes in medium bowl with oil, salt, and pepper. Transfer to half sheet pan and bake about ten minutes or until golden and crisp.
In blender, combine dressing ingredients until mixture is creamy.
Combine romaine in medium-size bowl with dressing and toss.
Mix croutons into salad just before service. Garnish with nori strips.

recipes.name: SWEET CORN SAUCE
recipes.description: Fresh corn kernels are cut from the cob and pureed until smooth, then squeezed through cheesecloth to extract silky corn milk, brightened with lemon juice and a pinch of white pepper.
instructions: Remove corn kernels from cob.
Puree corn kernels in VitaMix until smooth.
Transfer puree to strainer lined with moistened double layer of cheesecloth. Squeeze 'corn milk' through cheesecloth.
Transfer 'corn milk' to 2 1/2 quart pot, and simmer for 5-10 minutes, stirring constantly, until desired nappé consistency is achieved.
Whisk in lemon juice, and season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: FRESH BERRY TART WITH NUT CRUST
recipes.description: Pecans are ground to a fine meal with gluten-free flour and maple crystals for a toasty pressed crust, ready to cradle blueberries and raspberries under an agar-and-kuzu-set fruit glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Oil 9-inch tart pan or use 5-6 four-inch, non-stick paper tart pans.
In food processor, grind pecans to fine meal with flour, maple crystals, baking powder, and salt.
In separate small bowl, whisk together oil and maple syrup.
Add oil and syrup to dry ingredients in processor. Pulse lightly until dough comes together.
Press crust mixture into tart pan(s). Refrigerate 15-20 minutes, then bake 20-25 minutes. Let cool completely.
In small pot, simmer agar flakes in apple juice until agar completely dissolves. Add kuzu/juice slurry. Whisk until mixture thickens. Add maple syrup, pinch of salt, and berries.
Cook 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat and let mixture cool partially. Pour filling into cooled crust.
Let set completely. Garnish with mint before serving. There may be filling left over. Puree in food processor to make pudding.

recipes.name: Kasha with Egg
recipes.description: Kasha stirs together with egg until every grain is coated, then toasts in a hot sauté pan before meeting boiling mushroom or onion stock — four humble ingredients transformed into deep toasted flavor.
instructions: In saucepot, bring stock to boil.
In medium bowl combine kasha with egg, stirring well to combine.
Heat 10-inch sauté pan over medium-high flame and add kasha.
Using wooden spoon, stir constantly, toasting until buckwheat is dry.
Turn off heat under pan and add stock. Quickly cover to avoid sputtering.
Bring back to boil and reduce to simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until all water is absorbed.
Note: The above kasha recipe is ideal for side dish yielding a light fluffy texture. Do not use for kasha potato loaf.

recipes.name: QUICK SHIITAKE MUSHROOM STOCK
recipes.description: Dried shiitake mushrooms soak for half an hour, then simmer briefly with kombu before the pot strains through a fine chinois, pressed firmly to extract every drop of this quick, deeply savory stock.
instructions: In small stockpot, soak mushrooms in 2 quarts water for 30 minutes.
Add kombu and bring to boil. Lower flame and simmer 5 minutes.
Strain stock through fine chinois, pressing firmly to extract as much liquid as possible.
Note: Strained mushrooms and kombu can be sliced and used in soup, and other dishes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Biscotti
recipes.description: Melted chocolate folds into a cocoa-dark dough studded with pistachios, sweetened with maple crystals, and lightened with whisked egg whites for crisp, deeply chocolatey biscotti.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line one half-sheet tray with parchment paper.
In small double boiler, melt chocolate chips. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.
In bowl whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda and salt. Set aside.
Using stand mixer, mix butter, maple crystals, and melted chocolate. Add egg whites. Blend one minute more. Scrape sides of bowl with spatula and blend another thirty seconds.
Add dry ingredients (flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt) to mixer to combine. Dough will very sticky. Divide dough in two.
Roll each dough in chopped nuts and then form each into log shape on sheet tray (6 inches apart). Flatten logs into length of about 8 1/2 inches and width of 3 inches.
Bake 20 minutes or until firm to touch. Remove from oven, lower heat to 300° F, let logs cool 10-12 minutes.
Using bread knife, slice logs into 1/4 inch to 1/2 inch diagonal slices.
Cook slices 7-10 minutes more on each side. Cool and serve. (These get crunchier as they sit.)

recipes.name: Black Quinoa with Capers and Rapini (for Broiled Arctic Char)
recipes.description: Black quinoa simmers in vegetable stock until each grain is tender, then meets blanched rapini, briny capers, basil, and fresh lemon zest—a savory bed built to accompany broiled arctic char.

ingredients.name: bunch rapini
ingredients.notes: 1 pound; washed and trimmed (2 inches of stem removed)

instructions: Combine quinoa with vegetable stock and salt in small saucepan. Bring to boil, reduce to simmer, and cook covered approximately 15 to 20 minutes or until stock is absorbed. Remove from heat, uncover pot and allow quinoa to rest 10 minutes.
In separate pot, bring 2 quarts of salted water to boil. Prepare ice bath. Blanch rapini for 3 minutes, shock in ice water, and drain. Squeeze out excess liquid.
Roughly chop rapini and set aside.
Heat oil in small sauté pan over low flame, add garlic, cooking briefly until just golden. Do not let garlic brown.
Transfer garlic and one tablespoon oil from pan to food processor. Add rapini. Pulse mixture until very finely chopped. Add basil and pulse again.
Transfer rapini mixture to bowl and thoroughly mix with quinoa, capers, black pepper, and lemon zest.
Divide quinoa-rapini mixture among four plates, placing Arctic Char filet atop each portion.

recipes.name: CREAMY FRESH HORSERADISH DRESSING
recipes.description: Fresh horseradish blends with silken tofu, chickpea miso, and soymilk into a creamy, pourable dressing, sharpened with lemon, brown rice vinegar, dijon mustard, and a dash of hot sauce.
instructions: In blender, combine horseradish, tofu, oil, miso, soymilk, garlic, lemon, vinegar, and mustard. Process until creamy and smooth. Add pepper and Tabasco to taste, blending until incorporated.

recipes.name: Mornay Sauce
recipes.description: Milk infused with an onion piqué forms the base of this sauce, thickened with a patiently stirred roux of flour and clarified butter and finished with gruyere cheese and a pinch of nutmeg.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, over low flame, add onion piqué to milk. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid scorching.
Remove piqué onion from pot. Set milk aside to cool.
In 10-inch sauté pan, combine flour and butter. Stir with wooden spoon for 2-3 minutes. Let roux cool.
Slowly and gradually whisk cooled milk into warm roux.
Simmer sauce for approximately 20-30 minutes until thickened and reduced to nappé consistency.
Strain sauce through fine chinois.
Add cheese and whisk until cheese is totally melted and incorporated into sauce.
Note: Piqué is a bay leaf tacked with whole clove to peeled halved onion.

recipes.name: ALMOND PASTRY CREAM
recipes.description: Agar flakes simmer with water and maple syrup until fully dissolved, then rich almond milk and vanilla are whisked in, with kuzu lending body to a silky, gently sweet pastry cream.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine agar, water, and maple syrup. Let mixture sit for 10 minutes.

Bring agar mixture to boil. Lower heat and simmer uncovered or with pan lid slightly ajar until agar is dissolved, about 15 minutes. Stir often, scraping agar from sides and bottom of saucepan with spoon. Whisk mixture as necessary to break up bits of un-dissolved agar.
Stir almond milk, salt, and vanilla extract into agar mixture. Bring to boil, whisking often.
Lower heat and add kuzu slurry, whisking vigorously until mixture comes back to simmer. Cook a few minutes longer.
Pour mixture into hotel pan and chill in freezer or refrigerator until set.

In food processor, puree chilled mixture until very smooth and creamy. Halfway through processing, stop machine and scrape sides of work bowl with rubber spatula. If sweeter cream is desired, add additional maple syrup to taste.
Chill almond cream thoroughly, if thicker texture is desired.

recipes.name: Deviled Eggs with Beet Chips
recipes.description: Hard-cooked eggs steep in a vivid brine of fresh beet juice and apple cider vinegar, then are filled with a creamy blend of greek yogurt, dijon mustard, and chives, each crowned with a crisp beet chip.
instructions: Prepare ice bath.
In 2 ½ quart saucepan, bring water and beet juice to boil. Add vinegar and salt. Set aside.
In 1-gallon pot, combine eggs with enough water to cover by one inch. Cover pot and bring water to boil. Immediately remove pot from the heat and allow eggs to sit covered for 8-9 minutes.
Transfer eggs to ice bath, allowing them to cool for 1 full minute. Remove eggs ice bath, crack shells on hard surface, and peel eggs carefully.
Transfer eggs to pot with beet juice for about 1 hour. Remove eggs from pot and gently dry them.
Slice eggs in half and remove yolks. Transfer yolks to food processor with yogurt, mustard, salt, and pepper. Blend to creamy, pipe-able consistency. Season to taste.
Place seasoned yolk mixture in pastry bag with star tip and pipe about 1 tablespoon into each dyed egg white half. Garnish with chives and beet chips (recipe below).

recipes.name: Bernaise
recipes.description: Wine vinegar, shallots, dried tarragon, and crushed white peppercorns simmer down to a scant spoonful of intense reduction, strained and ready to whisk into yolks for the finished sauce.
instructions: Reduce all ingredients at simmer to 1-2 tablespoons.
Cool reduction and strain before adding to yolks in Hollandaise recipe (above).

recipes.name: NORI CONDIMENT
recipes.description: Toasted nori sheets simmer with shoyu, brown rice syrup, and water, stirred often until every drop of liquid absorbs into a deeply savory-sweet condiment for spooning over grains or beans.
instructions: In 2-quart saucepan, add nori, water, shoyu, and rice syrup.
Bring to boil, reduce to simmer, and stir often. Let simmer until all the liquid is absorbed.
Serve as condiment on grains or beans.

recipes.name: FRENCH WALNUT TART
recipes.description: Maple, rice, and barley malt syrups boil together with almond milk and walnuts to fill this double-crusted French walnut tart, deepened with cashew butter, brandy, and a whisper of orange extract.

ingredients.name: arrowroot dissolved in 2 tablespoons cold water

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Roll out first dough and transfer to tart pan; chill for 15 minutes. Trim edges of rolled dough, allowing 1-inch overhang. Cover and chill for 30 minutes more. Roll out other half of dough and transfer to sheet pan. Cover and chill until ready to use.
In one-gallon pot, combine sweeteners. Bring to boil, lower heat and add lemon juice, salt, almond milk, and walnuts.
Whisk in nut butter, extracts, and brandy. Add arrowroot slurry. Mix on medium low heat until mixture thickens slightly. Remove from heat and cool.
Pour walnut mixture into tart shell. Place top dough over filling, trim and seal edges. Cut a few steam vents.
Bake for 30-40 minutes until crust is firm and golden.
Cool before serving (about 25 minutes).
Note: If cashew butter is very thick, loosen it up with 1-2 tablespoons of water or nut milk.

recipes.name: Vegetable-Polenta Napoleons
recipes.description: Layers stack with intent here: rosemary-simmered cannellini beans mashed with roasted garlic, sun-dried tomato and basil polenta cut into firm rounds, and balsamic-brushed portobello mushrooms under tomato cream sauce.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: soaked until soft and coarsely chopped

instructions: In small saucepan, simmer beans in water with rosemary until beans are soft. Drain beans, discarding rosemary. In small bowl, combine beans, roasted garlic paste, oil and salt to taste. Using fork, mash bean mixture to chunky-smooth consistency and set aside.

In small saucepan, combine water, polenta, and salt, stirring until smooth. Simmer for 15 minutes. Stir oil, sun-dried tomatoes and basil into polenta and spread polenta onto lightly oiled sheet tray to 1/2-inch thickness. Chill polenta until firmly set. Using 3 1/2-inch ring mold, cut out 4 circles.
In small bowl, whisk together oil and vinegar. Using pastry brush, brush tops of mushrooms with oil-vinegar mixture and sprinkle with salt.

Coat non-stick pan with thin film of oil. Sear mushrooms covered (top side down), over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Flip mushrooms, brush “gill” side with remaining oil/vinegar, sprinkle with salt, and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Cool mushrooms and cut out 4 circles using 3 1/2-inch ring mold.
Steam spinach in covered pot until wilted, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain and wring well, chop coarsely and season to taste with salt.
Stack Napoleon elements in layers on sizzle platter and reheat in oven. Serve atop Tomato Cream Sauce garnished with basil.

recipes.name: 3-BEAN CHILI WITH CASHEW SOUR CREAM
recipes.description: Pinto, black, and kidney beans pressure-cook with chili powder, cumin, and avocado leaves, then simmer uncovered with tomatoes and corn until thick, served with lime, cilantro, scallions, and cashew sour cream.

ingredients.name: frozen corn or 1-2 ears fresh corn in season

instructions: In tall, 2-gallon pressure cooker, heat oil over medium flame. Add onion, salt, chili powder, cumin, oregano, tomato paste, and garlic. When ingredients start to sizzle, immediately add carrots and avocado leaves. Sweat vegetables for 10-15 minutes, with pressure cooker lid slightly ajar, stirring occasionally.
Add pinto beans, black beans, kidney beans, and vegetable stock. Secure lid of pressure cooker, bring cooker to pressure, reduce heat, and cook for about 30 minutes.

Bring pressure down by running cold water on lid of cooker. Open pressure cooker and add tomatoes, reserved tomato juice, and corn. Simmer uncovered until chili thickens to desired consistency. Remove avocado leaves.
Add lime juice to taste. Garnish with lime rounds, cilantro, scallions, and Cashew Sour Cream.

recipes.name: Vanilla Cake
recipes.description: Whole wheat pastry flour and vanilla beans anchor this simple cake: melted coconut oil, maple syrup, and apple cider vinegar whisk together and pour straight into the sifted dry mix before baking.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection oven). Oil and flour one 8-inch cake pan. Line bottom of pan with parchment.
Sift together dry ingredients in medium bowl and whisk together to combine. Set aside.
In separate bowl, whisk together wet ingredients and pour into dry. Mix well.
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake 30-40 minutes until cake is springy to touch and pulls away from sides of pan.
Cool in pan on wire rack for 10-15 minutes. Remove from pan and completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: BROILED AND/OR BAKED POLENTA
recipes.description: Hot polenta gets spread thin on a parchment-lined tray and left to set until firm, then dressed with garlicky olive oil and finished under the broiler or in the oven until golden.
instructions: Preheat broiler or preheat oven to 350° F.
Pour hot polenta onto parchment-lined half-sheet tray, and spread with lightly oiled spatula to 1/2 inch thickness. Let set until firm, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Combine garlic, olive oil, and salt. Set aside.
Cut polenta into desired shapes using cookie cutters.
Transfer cut polenta to parchment-lined sheet tray for baking or lightly oiled sheet tray (no parchment) for broiling. Brush top side with garlic oil.
Broil or bake polenta until golden and crisp (approximately 2 minutes in broiler or 10-15 minutes in the oven). Flip over with spatula, brush other side with oil, and broil.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Cashew Milk
recipes.description: Two ingredients and serious blending power: cashews and water puree at full speed until completely pulverized, then strain through a chinois into a smooth, pourable, dairy-free milk.
instructions: Puree cashews and water in Vitamix until cashews are completely pulverized. Strain milk through chinois.

recipes.name: NORI ROLLS
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked short grain brown rice, seasoned while still hot, gets spread across nori sheets and rolled around avocado, carrot, and scallions, sharpened with wasabi and umeboshi paste.

ingredients.name: wasabi powder
ingredients.notes: mixed with water to make spreadable paste
