instructions: Combine rice, water, and pinch of salt in small pressure cooker. Bring pot to full pressure, reduce heat, and cook at low pressure for 35 minutes. Turn off heat, remove pressure cooker from stove, and steam rice, covered, for 15 minutes.
Transfer rice from pot to large bowl. While rice is still hot, add seasoning mixture and stir with spatula. Cover bowl with damp towel and allow rice to rest for 10 minutes.

Place nori sheet on near edge of sushi mat, shiny side down. Have small bowl of water nearby to moisten fingers. Transfer 3/4 cup of rice to nori sheet and spread evenly with wet fingertips, leaving two-inch strip at far edge of nori bare.

Using chopstick or spoon, spread separate, thin, horizontal lines of wasabi and umeboshi paste across the rice at near end of nori sheet. Arrange slices of avocado, carrot, and scallions lengthwise on top of paste.

Bring near edge of nori and mat up and snugly over arranged vegetables, in rolling motion. Continue rolling forward, withdrawing mat as you go. Moisten strip of nori at far end of roll with wet fingertips. Continue to roll forward to seal roll.

recipes.name: BEET PASTA
recipes.description: Fresh egg pasta stained a deep crimson: a whole beet is boiled tender, milled to a fine puree, and pressed dry in a sieve before being worked into unbleached flour and eggs for a supple, vividly colored dough.

ingredients.name: small beet
ingredients.notes: all but last inch of stem trimmed

instructions: Place beet in medium saucepan and cover with water. Boil until tender, about 1 hour. Drain and cool beet.
Slip skin off beet, puree, put beet through food mill or potato ricer. (Do not put into food processor or it will be too wet.)
Transfer beet puree to fine sieve over bowl or sink, pressing down occasionally with back of large spoon, until most of water has drained off.
Reserve 1 tablespoon of puree for pasta; discard remaining puree or save for another use.
Follow either method below.
Method - Food Processor:

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs and beet puree, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Method - By Hand:
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow and add beet puree. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED CHICKEN LIVERS WITH ONION, APPLE, AND FRISÉE
recipes.description: Chicken livers sauté hot and fast, about two minutes per side, finished with a swirl of brandy and served against cider-caramelized red onions, apples, and frisée in a dijon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons oil in large sauté pan over medium heat. Sweat onions until translucent. Add vinegar and raise heat slightly. Continue to cook until onions begin to brown and caramelize, adding a bit of water if onions begin to stick to pan. When onions are tender and browned, add salt and pepper. Remove onions from pan and set aside.

Season livers with salt and pepper. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to same pan and heat over medium-high flame. Add livers, making sure not to crowd pan. Sauté livers about 2 minutes on each side. When livers are done, add brandy to pan, and swirl to combine.
Transfer cooked livers to paper-lined sheet tray to drain.
Add onions back to pan, followed by livers.
Toss lemon juice in bowl with apples, salt, and pepper. Add frisée and set aside.
In separate small bowl, combine vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until dressing has emulsified.
Toss salad with dressing. Serve with caramelized onions and liver.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE CRÊPES
recipes.description: Everything goes into the blender at once here: eggs, whole milk, butter, maple crystals, vanilla extract, and a gluten-free flour blend emulsify into a silky, pourable crepe batter that comes out perfectly smooth.
instructions: Emulsify all ingredients in blender until smooth.

recipes.name: Spelt Pizza Dough
recipes.description: Built on a quick yeast sponge sweetened with rice syrup, this pizza dough rises in a warm spot before spelt flour is worked in half a cup at a time along with olive oil and sea salt, yielding a supple, stretchable crust.

ingredients.name: rice syrup or honey or maple syrup

instructions: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients with whisk.
Cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 20 to 30 minutes in warm place.
Add water, salt, and oil to sponge, and mix together with wooden spoon. Add flour in 1/2 cup increments.
Remove dough from bowl, form dough into ball and knead on floured work surface. Dough should be soft and a little sticky. Knead for about 10 minutes.
Place dough in lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic and place in warm spot until doubled in size, about 40 minutes. Punch down, shape dough and bake.
Preheat oven to 475°F. Place pizza stone in oven to heat up at least 30-40 minutes before baking.
Transfer pizza to peel before adding sauce and toppings.
Bake on baking stone 8-10 minutes, turning once at half-way point.

recipes.name: MONKFISH WITH LEMON-CAPER BUTTER
recipes.description: Flour-dredged monkfish filets sizzle in olive oil over medium heat before finishing in the oven, then get napped with a quick pan butter studded with briny capers and sharpened by a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

ingredients.name: salt and pepper to season fish

instructions: Heat conventional oven to 375°F.
Dredge filets in flour. Shake off excess.
Heat olive oil in 10-inch sauté pan over medium heat.
Brown filets on both sides.
Transfer fish to sizzle platter, and complete cooking in oven, approximately 10 minutes. Set sauté pan for next step.
Add butter to pan over low heat, melt, and cook until butter achieves light brown color.
Add capers and lemon juice to browned butter.
Transfer fish from oven to plate and garnish with browned butter. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Flaky Biscuits
recipes.description: Chilled butter cuts into whole wheat pastry and white flours until pea-sized crumbles form—the key to genuinely flaky layers—before milk gathers the dough together for a hot 375-degree bake.

ingredients.name: chilled unsalted butter or 7 tablespoons chilled coconut oil
melted butter
ingredients.notes: optional, for non-vegan biscuits; for brushing on top

instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F and line half-sheet tray with parchment paper.
Sift flours, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon (if using) in medium sized bowl. Whisk to combine.
Cut fat into flour mixture until fat is crumbly and coated in flour. Crumbles should be about size of small peas or smaller.
Pour in milk or almond milk and gently mix with rubber spatula just until combined, being careful to not over-mix.

Transfer dough to lightly floured table and gently roll out to shape of rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick. With long edge facing you, fold in both short ends to meet in middle. Fold dough forward in half and very gently roll together to 3/4 inch or no thinner than 1/2-inch square. This folding technique will provide flaky layers if not over-worked and too flat.
Cut biscuits with lightly floured cookie cutter or sharp knife and transfer to sheet tray. If desired, brush tops with melted butter.
Bake for about 6 minutes and rotate pan in oven to ensure even browning. Continue baking for about another 10 minutes or until golden brown on top and slightly firm to touch.
Transfer to rack and cool.
Note: Brushing with coconut oil in place of butter is not recommended.

recipes.name: YELLOW PEPPER COULIS WITH BUTTER
recipes.description: Shallots and yellow peppers sweat slowly in unsalted butter until soft and translucent, then brown rice vinegar reduces to nearly dry before vegetable stock loosens everything into a silky, sunshine-colored coulis.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat butter over medium-low flame. Sweat shallots until translucent.
Add peppers and sweat until softened.
Add vinegar and reduce until almost dry (au sec).
Add stock and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes.
Puree in blender until creamy and return to pan. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: RICH ALMOND MILK (FOR ALMOND-FRUIT TART)
recipes.description: Blanched almonds blend with boiling water into a smooth, homogenized base, then get wrung batch by batch through cheesecloth until every drop of rich, vanilla-scented milk is coaxed from the pulp.
instructions: Combine almonds and water in blender or Vitamix. Process for a few minutes until well-homogenized.
Rinse piece of cheesecloth (double thickness) with cold water and wring thoroughly.

Pour small amount of almond mixture through sieve or chinois lined with prepared cheesecloth, wringing and squeezing cheesecloth to extract as much liquid from pulp as possible. Discard each batch of almond pulp when no more liquid can be extracted. Rinse cheesecloth well in cold water and proceed with next batch, repeating this process until all of almond mixture has been 'milked.'
Strain almond milk through sieve. Add vanilla.
Note: For even richer milk, soak blanched almonds in water for 20-30 minutes before blending.

recipes.name: HAZELNUT-MOCHA AND ALMOND PARFAIT
recipes.description: Instant coffee and almond milk simmer with agar flakes until fully dissolved, then whisk with maple syrup and bittersweet chocolate into a silky mocha layer for parfaits of hazelnut butter, almond pastry cream, and roasted hazelnuts.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine water, espresso, almond milk, and agar flakes. Let mixture sit 10 minutes or more. Over high heat, bring mixture to boil. Lower heat and simmer uncovered or with pan lid slightly ajar until agar is dissolved, scraping sides and bottom of pan often with spoon.
Add maple syrup, salt, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips, whisking until smooth. Simmer a few minutes longer.
Pour mixture into hotel pan and transfer to freezer or refrigerator until set.
Puree mixture with hazelnut butter in food processor until very smooth. Stop machine several times and scrape sides of work bowl with rubber spatula. Chill puree thoroughly.
To serve, spoon into glasses, alternating with Almond Pastry Cream (recipe preceding) and garnish with hazelnuts.

recipes.name: Fresh Ketchup (for Red Lentil and Toasted Sunflower Burger)
recipes.description: Red onion simmers down in vegetable stock until soft and concentrated, then tomato paste, agave syrup, apple cider vinegar, and chili powder join the pot for a fresh ketchup with a gentle, warming kick.
instructions: Combine onion and vegetable stock in 2-quart sauce pot. Bring mixture to boil, reduce to simmer, and cook for 15 minutes or until onion mixture is soft and reduced to 1/3 cup.
Add remaining ingredients to pot and simmer for 10 minutes more. Refrigerate.

recipes.name: WALNUT TEA COOKIES
recipes.description: Cold butter creams with powdered maple crystals until fluffy, then a trio of flours sifts in slowly before walnuts fold through, the dough chilled briefly so these tea cookies hold their tender crumb.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line 2 half-sheet trays with parchment paper.
Cream butter and maple crystals in stand mixer until fluffy and well combined, about 5 minutes. Add vanilla and salt until mixed.

In separate smaller bowl, whisk together flours. Slowly sift flours into butter mixture in stand mixer, until all flour is incorporated. Add in walnuts. Divide dough in 2 and wrap each in plastic. Refrigerate 10-15 minutes.
Remove 1 dough from refrigerator. Roll between parchment paper to 1/4" thickness. Freeze dough until hard. Cut shapes from dough using cookie cutters. Repeat process with second dough.
Bake about 6 minutes. Rotate baking pans and continue to bake about 5-6 more minutes or until lightly golden. Remove cookies from pans to racks to cool.

recipes.name: Cocktail Sauce
recipes.description: Freshly grated horseradish gives this cocktail sauce its sinus-clearing lift, stirred together with ketchup, chili sauce, lemon juice, and dashes of Worcestershire and hot sauce, made for poached shrimp.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl, and serve with poached shrimp.

recipes.name: Short Grain Brown Rice
recipes.description: Short grain brown rice cooks under pressure with just water and salt for twenty minutes, then rests off the heat until the pressure falls completely on its own, yielding plump, evenly cooked grains.
instructions: Combine rice, water and salt in small pressure cooker.
Place top on pressure cooker and bring up to pressure.
Lower heat and cook 20 minutes. Remove pressure cooker from stove. Let pressure come down completely before attempting to open it.

recipes.name: Chimichurri Sauce
recipes.description: Fresh parsley pulses with garlic, red onion, red wine vinegar, and oregano in the food processor, olive oil streaming in just until the chimichurri comes together while still keeping some rustic texture.
instructions: Roughly chop parsley and transfer to food processor.
Add garlic, onion, vinegar, lemon juice, and oregano to food processor with parsley and pulse to combine.
Add olive oil through feed tube and continue to process for 30 seconds or until sauce is blended, but still retains some texture. Season to taste.

recipes.name: APPLE RING
recipes.description: Yeasted dough raised on a warm apple juice and rice syrup sponge kneads smooth before wrapping around apples, dried apricots, and raisins spiced with cinnamon, cardamom, and nutmeg for a walnut-studded baked ring.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.notes: peeled, cored, and cut into medium dice

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In large bowl, combine yeast, water, apple juice, rice syrup, and 2 cups all-purpose flour; stir until smooth. Cover sponge and set aside in warm place for 30-45 minutes.
Add melted oil, salt, and maple crystals. Mix together all-purpose and whole wheat pastry flours. Add flour, cup-by-cup until dough is formed that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough on table about 10-15 minutes, using remaining flour until smooth dough forms.

Transfer dough to large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size. While dough is proofing, prepare two half-sheet trays with parchment paper.
Turn/fold dough. Rise one more time.

Divide into two equal portions. Roll out first dough into rectangle about 1/4” thick. Pull edges of dough to create a rectangular shape. Spread half of apple filling across near end of dough horizontally. Fold dough over filling and roll log forward until seam is on bottom. Attach ends of dough to create ring. Move ring to prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough and filling.

Loosely cover rings with damp towel and set aside in warm place. Rise until dough has doubled in size, about 15-20 minutes. Cut 5-6 slits (steam vents) in top of each ring. Glaze each ring with maple syrup.
Transfer bread to oven and bake approximately 30-45 minutes or until dough is thoroughly browned. Cool rings completely before serving.

recipes.name: SEMOLINA BREAD
recipes.description: Yeast blooms in warm water sweetened with rice syrup before olive oil, fresh rosemary, and garlic scent a dough of whole wheat, semolina, and all-purpose flours, kneaded up to fifteen minutes until smooth.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In medium bowl, combine water, rice syrup, and yeast. Proof for 10 minutes or until mixture is foamy.
Add oil, rosemary, garlic, and salt. Add whole wheat bread flour, then semolina flour, and finally all-purpose flour in sufficient quantity to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough about 10-15 minutes, adding additional all-purpose flour as needed, until smooth dough has been created.
Transfer dough to large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans with parchment.
Turn/fold dough. Rise one more time.
Divide dough into two equal-sized balls. Form dough into loaves and place in prepared loaf pans or sheet pans for final rise.
Loosely cover dough with damp towel and set aside in warm place. Rise for about 30 minutes or until dough has doubled again in size.
Bake bread approximately 30 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch. Internal dough temperature should register approximately 190° to 205°F.

recipes.name: KABOCHA SQUASH PIE
recipes.description: Kabocha squash roasts cut-side down until fork tender, then joins organic milk, heavy cream, and eggs in a custard warmed with ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves for a partially blind-baked crust.
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Place squash cut side down on parchment-lined half sheet pan and bake until fork tender, approximately 1 hour.
Discard squash seeds and pulp (or save seeds for toasting). Scoop and reserve 2 cups of squash from its skin for this recipe.
Prepare an ice bath.

Puree squash, maple crystals, spices, and salt in food processor until smooth. Transfer mixture to 2 1/2 quart pot and slowly whisk in milk and cream. Simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens, about 3-5 minutes. Remove pot from heat and place in ice bath for 10 minutes before slowly whisking in eggs.
Pour filling into pie shell and bake for 30-40 minutes or until filling is lightly cracked around edges and center jiggles slightly. Cool for 1 hour before slicing.

recipes.name: GENOISE
recipes.description: Eggs, coconut sugar, and vanilla whip until tripled in volume and foamy, then sifted whole wheat pastry flour folds in gently by the batch — the entire lift of this genoise rides on that airy egg base.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil and flour two 8-inch cake pans and line bottoms with lightly buttered or oiled parchment.

Add eggs, coconut sugar, and vanilla to stand mixer bowl and beat at high speed for about 6-10 minutes until mixture has tripled in volume and has become light in color and foamy. Mixture should be almost consistency of stiff peaks.
Gently transfer egg mixture into clean large bowl. Sift flour in small batches (3 times) into egg mixture while folding batter with large rubber spatula.
Divide batter into 2 prepared pans.
Bake for about 15-20 minutes or until cake is golden brown and springy to touch.
Using paring knife, cut cake away from sides of pan immediately, leaving cake in pans to cool for 10 minutes.
Remove cakes from pans, remove parchment from bottoms of cakes, and cool completely on wire racks. Use cakes as two layers or split each of them and use as four layers.

recipes.name: JAM DOT COOKIES
recipes.description: Ground almonds, rolled oats, and whole wheat pastry flour come together in the food processor with a whisper of cinnamon, bound by maple syrup and oil, each cookie finished with a glistening dot of apricot jam.

ingredients.name: extra virgin canola oil
ingredients.notes: olive oil, melted butter OR 6 tablespoons melted coconut oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 2 half-sheet trays with parchment paper.
Grind almonds, flour, oats, and cinnamon in food processor to fine meal.
In separate small bowl, whisk together oil, maple syrup, and sea salt. Add liquid to dry mixture in food processor and mix until well combined.

Form cookies using level 1-ounce scoop. Round them into walnut sized balls. Place on baking sheet and form indentation in middle of cookie using floured ¼ teaspoon measure. Fill indentation with about ½ teaspoon of jam and bake 15-20 minutes or until golden.

recipes.name: Beet Terrine
recipes.description: Beet, grapefruit, and orange juices simmer with agave and agar until they set into jewel-toned molds, each terrine unmolded and finished with sour cream, chives, and delicate micro-greens.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine grapefruit, orange, and beet juices with agave. Cover pan and bring to boil.
Reduce heat to simmer and add agar powder, stirring continuously for 5-10 minutes or until agar is dissolved. Add salt and stir to combine.
Pour 1/2 cup of mixture into each ramekin. Refrigerate until mixture sets, about 20 minutes. Using small offset spatula, carefully remove terrine from ramekin mold.
Top each terrine with dollop of sour cream, chives and micro-greens.

recipes.name: HASHED BRUSSEL SPROUTS WITH CARROTS AND POPPY SEEDS
recipes.description: Lemon-tossed brussels sprouts hit a hot sauté pan with barely tender carrots, garlic, and toasted poppy seeds, splashes of white wine steaming everything to just-crisp doneness in a matter of minutes.
instructions: In large bowl toss Brussels sprouts with lemon juice.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add carrots and sauté for about 2 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon of wine, lower heat and continue to cook until carrots are bright orange but still crunchy.
Add Brussels sprouts, garlic, poppy seeds and remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. Add remaining 3 tablespoons of wine. Cook until Brussels sprouts are tender (about 3-4 minutes).
Warm right before service and add salt and pepper. Add parsley just before service.

recipes.name: GINGER CAKE
recipes.description: Butter creamed with maple crystals anchors a whole wheat cake spiced with ground ginger, cinnamon, and cloves, then moistened with maple syrup, orange juice, and almond milk before baking in two parchment-lined layers.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection). Oil and flour two 8-inch cake pans and line bottoms with parchment.
Sift together flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves in medium bowl and whisk together to combine. Set aside.
Place softened butter in bowl of stand mixer. On low speed, mix just until butter is fluffy. Add sea salt and maple crystals; mix until creamy and well combined, about 2 minutes.

Add one egg at a time. Slowly add in maple syrup, orange juice, milk, and extracts. Combine on medium speed until well incorporated (mixture may look curdled, but will come back together once remaining ingredients are added).
Spoon combined dry ingredients into mixer a little at a time and mix until completely incorporated into butter mixture, scraping down sides of bowl as necessary.
Pour batter into 2 prepared pans. Bake about 20 minutes or until tops are golden brown and springy to touch.
Cool on wire rack for 10-15 minutes. Remove from pans and completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: Tofu Scramble
recipes.description: Crumbled firm tofu simmers briefly with ripe tomato and lime juice after onion, garlic, pine nuts, cumin, and turmeric sizzle in olive oil — a golden, gently spiced sauté ready in minutes.
instructions: In 12-inch sauté pan over medium heat, warm oil. Add onion and sauté for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in garlic, pine nuts, cumin, red pepper flakes and turmeric; sauté 2 minutes more.
Add mashed tofu, tomato, salt and lime juice to pan. Raise heat and simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes to heat through.

recipes.name: STRAWBERRY SORBET
recipes.description: Strawberries puree with maple syrup, agave, and a splash of balsamic vinegar before chopped basil and a grind of black pepper get whisked in, then the mixture churns and freezes to a scoopable sorbet.
instructions: In blender, puree strawberries, maple syrup, agave syrup, and balsamic vinegar until smooth. Transfer mixture to medium bowl and whisk in salt, pepper, and basil.

Transfer mixture to ice cream machine and freeze according to directions. Remove sorbet from canister and transfer to 9-pan. Freeze forty minutes to one hour or until sorbet firms to scoop-able consistency.

recipes.name: GHIRARDELLI AWARD WINNING CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
recipes.description: Eggs whisked with sugar and vanilla meet melted butter before sweet ground cocoa gets folded through the batter, with chopped walnuts studding every square of these dense, parchment-baked brownies.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F (325° F in convection oven). Grease and flour 8 x 8-inch square baking pan and line with parchment paper.
Whisk eggs with sugar and vanilla; add melted butter.
Whisk together dry ingredients (cocoa, flour, baking powder, and salt) and fold into egg mixture. Add nuts.
Bake for 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in middle of brownie comes out clean.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free, Egg-Free Mini Pizzas
recipes.description: Rice and tapioca flours bind with xanthan gum and a boiling-water flaxseed slurry to build these yeast-risen mini pizza bases, seasoned throughout with fennel seeds and baked on generously oiled trays.
instructions: Line 2 half-sheet trays with Silpats or parchment generously brushed with olive oil.
In medium bowl, dissolve maple crystals in water and add yeast. Set aside.
In another medium bowl, sift and whisk together rice flour, tapioca flour, and xanthan gum. Add fennel seeds and salt, and mix together. Set aside.

In small pot, add flax seed to boiling water and simmer for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until water reaches consistency of egg white. Strain mixture through fine-meshed sieve, and retrieve 2 tablespoons of seedless extract. Set aside.
In stand mixer, blend flaxseed extract, 1 tablespoon olive oil and yeast-maple crystal water. Add flour mixture and beat on high for 2 minutes.
Using tablespoon, dollop batter onto baking sheets, making 6-8 mini pizzas per sheet tray. With circular motion, spread each circle out with spoon to about 2 inches in diameter.
Cover with inverted baking sheet, and let rise 40-45 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°F.
Bake each mini pizza 10 minutes without toppings.
Remove trays from oven, and garnish pizzas with toppings of choice. Dribble remaining oil over each mini pizza. Bake another 10 minutes to cook fillings and melt cheese, if using.

recipes.name: WILTED GREENS WITH SPRING ONIONS
recipes.description: Spring onions marinate in balsamic vinegar and olive oil before hitting the grill, then crown a bowl of baby spinach, chicory, and radicchio studded with sun-dried tomatoes and pine nuts.

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.notes: 2 bunches; trimmed and halved lengthwise (leave about 1-inch stem intact)

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: Combine onions in medium bowl with oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Toss to combine. Marinate 15-20 minutes.
Heat grill. Grill onions on both sides until grill marks form and onions are softened. Set aside.
Combine spinach, chicory, and radicchio in medium bowl.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil over low heat, sweat garlic and salt until garlic begins to turn golden.
In small bowl, whisk together vinegar and syrup until well combined.
Add spinach, chicory, and radicchio to pan and sauté until just barely wilted. Add balsamic-rice syrup mixture and toss to combine.
Transfer greens to plate and garnish with grilled spring onions, sun-dried tomatoes, and pine nuts.

recipes.name: SHAVED FENNEL & ORANGE SALAD W/ PISTACHIO COATED 'CHEESE' MEDALLIONS
recipes.description: Shaved fennel and cut oranges meet crisp arugula, romaine, and radicchio under a dressing whisked to a smooth emulsion with orange juice, maple syrup, shallot, and Dijon, plus pistachio-coated cashew medallions.

ingredients.name: oranges
ingredients.notes: pith removed and cut into rounds

instructions: Toss arugula, romaine, and radicchio in bowl and refrigerate until ready to serve.
In separate bowl, combine shaved fennel and cut citrus to prevent oxidation.
Add zest, orange juice, salt, maple syrup, minced shallot and Dijon into medium bowl. Whisk to combine. Slowly pour in oil while whisking constantly to emulsify dressing.

Preheat oven to 300°F. Line baking tray with Silpat. Toss pistachios with maple syrup, paprika, and cayenne. Spread mixture onto tray and bake for 10 to 15 minutes, or until syrup crystalizes, stirring once. Cool slightly, and chop pistachios into small pieces.

Combine soaked cashews, lemon juice, miso, salt, melted coconut oil, and boiling water in food processor. Process for 1 minute, or until smooth, scraping down sides occasionally. Add pectin powder and pulse until combined. Stream in calcium water while engine is running. Transfer mixture to bowl and refrigerate for 10 to 20 minutes, or until slightly firm. Scoop into medallions using retractable ice cream scoop. Roll sides in crushed pistachios.
Toss greens with citrus dressing. Top with orange rounds and fennel. Garnish with nut 'cheese' medallions and fennel fronds.

recipes.name: Caramelized Apples
recipes.description: Apples sauté slowly in butter with cinnamon, dried ginger, and a pinch of salt until deeply caramelized, then a pour of maple syrup thickens everything into a glossy, spiced glaze over twenty patient minutes.
instructions: Melt butter or oil in large 12-inch pan over medium heat. Add apples to the pan with cinnamon, ginger, and salt.
Sauté apples until caramelized, stirring only occasionally, approximately 15 minutes.
Add maple syrup to pan. Sauté apples another 5-10 minutes until mixture thickens.

recipes.name: Fresh Herb Pasta
recipes.description: Eggs and minced fresh parsley work into all-purpose flour — pulsed in a food processor or mixed by hand from a classic flour well — then the dough is kneaded smooth and rested until supple.

ingredients.name: minced fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: basil, mint, cilantro, sage, thyme, oregano, or marjoram

instructions: Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs and herbs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow and add minced herbs. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED MUSHROOMS WITH HERBS
recipes.description: Shiitake and cremini mushrooms sauté with shallots and garlic until deeply caramelized, then white wine reduces away and stock simmers with oat flour into a thickened, parmesan-ready pan sauce.
instructions: In large pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add shallots and garlic, lower heat, and sauté for 1-2 minutes. Add mushrooms with salt to pan and sauté until well caramelized, stirring only occasionally, 10-15 minutes.
Add wine to pan, turn up heat, and simmer until wine has evaporated.
All flour to pan. Stir until incorporated. Add stock and simmer until sauce is thickened, about 10 minutes.
Season with additional salt and pepper, if needed.
Add cheese to taste, if using.

recipes.name: Chicken Liver Pâté
recipes.description: Chicken livers sauté in butter until browned outside and still pink within, then join onions caramelized for twenty minutes with garlic, bay leaves, and thyme, all deepened by a cognac deglaze for a silky pâté.
instructions: Prepare an ice bath. In 12-inch sauté pan, melt 2 ounces butter over medium-high heat. Add chicken livers and sauté until brown on outside and still very pink on inside. Transfer livers from pan to bowl and chill over ice bath.

Using same pan, lower heat and add onions. Sweat with salt until translucent. Lower heat, and continue to cook until onions soften and color, stirring often to prevent burning. Continue until onions are caramelized, about 15-20 minutes.

Add garlic along with bay leaves, thyme, and pepper and sweat until fragrant, about 1 minute more. Remove onions from pan and deglaze with Cognac or brandy. Add onions back to fond and stir to combine.
Discard bay leaves. Transfer onion mixture to bowl and cool over ice bath to room temperature.
Puree chicken livers and onion mixture in food processor, adding remaining 2 ounces of chilled butter in pieces while pulsing to blend. Adjust seasoning, to taste.
Pack and smooth pâté into 3 individual ramekins or small molds (about 4 ounces each). Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.name: TEMPEH VEGETABLE KEBOBS
recipes.description: Tempeh simmers forty-five minutes in a shoyu, apple juice, and dijon marinade while cremini mushrooms, zucchini, yellow pepper, and cherry tomatoes take their own citrus soak before everything is threaded onto skewers.

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.notes: cut in half lengthwise, then into 1/2" slices

instructions: Whisk together tempeh marinade ingredients in bowl; pour into 1-gallon pot.

Cut each package of tempeh in two. Bring marinade to boil, add tempeh, lower heat, and simmer covered for 45 minutes. Drain tempeh and pat dry, reserving marinade (there should be 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons).

Whisk together vegetable marinade ingredients in mixing bowl. Add all vegetables to marinade and let sit for 20-30 minutes, stirring often. Remove vegetables with slotted spoon (set aside marinade for later use).

Cut tempeh into 24 cubes and toss with oil. Preheat grill while preparing kebobs. Use one piece of each vegetable and two pieces of tempeh for each skewer. Grill kebobs few minutes on each side until grill marks form and vegetables are tender.
Bring reserved tempeh marinade to boil in 2 1/2 quart saucepan; whisk in dissolved arrowroot, stirring constantly until sauce comes back to boil and becomes clear. Use sauce for kebobs.
Note: Kebobs can be baked in 450° F. oven for 20-30 minutes as an alternative to grilling. Brush them occasionally with vegetable marinade as they cook.

recipes.name: RED WINE MARINADE
recipes.description: Red wine, olive oil, and lemon juice whirl in the blender with garlic, fresh thyme, salt, and black pepper, coming together in moments as a bold, tangy marinade with real backbone.
instructions: In blender, combine wine, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper and thyme.

recipes.name: SAFFRON PASTA
recipes.description: Saffron threads crumble straight into beaten eggs, staining them deep gold before the mixture meets flour in a food processor and comes together into a smooth, supple fresh pasta dough.
instructions: Crumble saffron into eggs and stir to dissolve.
Follow one of the below methods.

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add saffron-egg mixture, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Pour saffron-egg mixture into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE SOUFFLÉ
recipes.description: Semi-sweet chocolate and egg yolks meet whites whipped with cream of tartar and maple crystals, then bake at 375°F in a buttered, cocoa-dusted dish built to send this soufflé skyward.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: 1 tablespoon softened, remaining 4 tablespoons cut into 1/2-inch chunks

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Butter inside of soufflé dish (or dishes) with the one tablespoon of softened butter.
Dust inside of each dish with cocoa powder.
Refrigerate dishes until ready to fill.
Melt chocolate and remaining 4 tablespoons butter in medium bowl set over pot of simmering water. Turn off heat, stir in salt and vanilla and set aside.
In separate medium bowl, beat egg yolks and maple crystals with whisk or hand mixer until thick and yellow (about 3 minutes). Pour into chocolate mixture.
In separate medium bowl or electric stand mixer, combine egg whites and cream of tartar. By hand or mixer, whip egg whites until stiff, moist peaks are formed.
Vigorously stir one-quarter of whites into chocolate-egg yolk mixture.
Gently fold in remaining egg whites in 4 equal increments.
Transfer to ramekins and bake as follows: 1/2 cup dishes: 12 to 14 minutes, 2 cup dishes: 20 to 25 minutes, 1 quart dishes: 30 - 35 minutes, 2 quart dishes: 50 to 55 minutes.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: CORN PASTA
recipes.description: Yellow cornmeal joins unbleached white flour and eggs in the food processor, pulsing into a rough ball that kneads to smoothness and rests up to two hours — a golden, sturdy take on fresh pasta dough.
instructions: Pulse flour and cornmeal in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flour and cornmeal onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: Baked Custard (Crème Caramel)
recipes.description: Scalded milk gets whisked slowly into eggs beaten with maple crystals and vanilla, then the custard bakes gently at a low 325 degrees until just set, delivering a crème caramel of silky sweetness.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F.
In large bowl, combine eggs, maple crystals, salt and vanilla.
In small saucepan, scald milk (heat to just below simmering), then slowly whisk into egg mixture.
Strain mixture through chinois and skim foam from surface.
Set 6 ramekins in water bath reaching halfway up their sides. Add enough caramel* to cover bottom of ramekin. Carefully pour in custard.
Bake approximately 60-90 minutes. Water should be almost simmering as custard cooks. Do not let it boil as this makes the custard grainy.

To test for doneness, insert thin-bladed knife about an inch or two from the center. Custard is done if knife comes out clean. Center may not be completely set, but it will continue to cook in its own heat after removal from the oven.
Chill completely and un-mold right before service.

Crème Caramel: In small saucepan, simmer 1 cup maple crystals and 1/4 cup water, swirling to dissolve sugar until mixture caramelizes. Cover pan and boil over medium heat until bubbles are thick. Line bottoms of ramekins with hot caramel, tilting to spread evenly.

recipes.name: SOFRITO TOPPING
recipes.description: Red pepper and ripe tomatoes cook low and slow in olive oil with smoked paprika for twenty minutes, stirred often until they soften into a sweet, smoky topping meant to be served hot.
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Add red pepper, tomatoes, salt, and paprika. Stir well and cook, uncovered, over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Tomato Sauce
recipes.description: Onion and garlic sweat slowly in olive oil before peeled tomatoes, red wine, and dried rosemary, thyme, and basil join the pot for a long, gentle simmer that deepens the sauce over the better part of an hour.
instructions: Heat oil in 1-gallon pot over low heat. Add onion, garlic and salt. Sweat onion and garlic for 5-10 minutes, covered, stirring occasionally.
Add rosemary, thyme, basil, tomatoes, and wine. Bring sauce to simmer.
Simmer sauce until flavors are well developed, approximately 40 minutes to 1 hour.
Add salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Vegan and Gluten-Free Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Chocolate and coconut oil melt together over simmering water, then whisk with coconut sugar, coconut milk, and a kuzu slurry before meeting almond, sorghum, and tapioca flours for fudgy, walnut-flecked brownies.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (convection oven to 300°F). Oil and flour 9-inch square pan and line with parchment.
In bowl, whisk together almond flour, sorghum flour, tapioca flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder. Process to combine. Transfer dry ingredients to bowl.

In separate bowl set over simmering water, melt 1 cup of chocolate and coconut oil. Remove from heat and whisk chocolate and coconut oil together. Stir in kuzu-water mixture, coconut sugar, coconut milk, and vanilla. Whisk wet ingredients to emulsify.
Pour wet mixture into dry and stir well. The batter should be stiff. Fold in walnuts and remaining 1/4 cup chocolate.
Transfer batter to pan, place parchment atop brownie. Smooth surface with hands until even.
Bake 30 minutes. Cool in pan for about 1 hour (otherwise brownie will crack when cut). Cut edges of brownie away from sides of pan before removing from pan.

recipes.name: SEAFOOD SAUSAGE
recipes.description: Delicate sole is pureed with egg whites and sauteed shallots and leeks, then folded with scallops, shrimp, and minced chives into plump portions, paired with a yogurt, dijon, and honey sauce.

ingredients.name: large leek
ingredients.notes: 4 ounces; white portion small-diced, green portion discarded

ingredients.name: baby bok choy and red cabbage slaw

instructions: In small sauté pan, heat oil, and add shallots and leeks. Sauté for 2 minutes or until translucent. Transfer to food processor.
Add sole to shallots and leeks in food processor and puree 30 seconds. Add egg whites, and process 15 seconds more. Scrape down bowl and process 15 seconds more.
Transfer mixture to bowl. Fold in chives, salt, and pepper scallops and shrimp. Divide mixture into eight 1/3-cup portions.

Form sausages 4 inches long and 1 1/2 inch thick. Roll each tightly first in parchment (8-inch x 6-inch sheets) and then in foil (8-inch x 6-inch sheets), twisting ends, and poach in simmering water for 9-10 minutes.
Unwrap sausage and cool slightly. Slice each sausage once on bias in middle.

Lightly brush non-stick pan with olive oil. Arrange sausages in pan so as not to crowd them. Brown them lightly on all sides. Serve with dollop of Honey-Mustard Yogurt and side of Baby Bok Choy and Red Cabbage Slaw (recipes following).

recipes.name: Whole Poached Norwegian Salmon
recipes.description: Year-Round
instructions: Combine ingredients for court bouillon in deep hotel pan large enough to hold salmon. Bring to poach temperature.
Wrap salmon in double layer of cheesecloth leaving about 6 - 8 inches at each end of fish.
Twist and knot ends of cheesecloth. Cheesecloth is used to lift salmon out of pan when cooking is completed.
Lower salmon into court bouillon. For accurate cooking time, measure fish at its thickest point. Allow 10 minutes to the inch. At completion, internal temperature of fish should be 140°F.
Remove hotel pan from heat, and let fish cool in bouillon. Drain.
When totally cooled remove skin with paring knife. Decorate surface of fish with thinly sliced cucumbers.
Finish garnishing plate with watercress, lemon slices, cherry tomatoes, radishes, etc.

recipes.name: VEGETARIAN BORDELAISE
recipes.description: Shallots, carrots, and celery sweat in olive oil with peppercorns and thyme before red wine reduces nearly dry; sauce espagnole then rounds this meat-free bordelaise into something deep and winey.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat shallots, carrots, celery, and onions until vegetables are softened.
Add peppercorns, thyme sprig, and red wine. Increase heat to medium-high and reduce wine until almost dry (au sec).
Add parsley sprigs and Sauce Espagnole.
Bring sauce to boil and skim. Reduce heat, and simmer, uncovered, for 20 to 25 minutes, or until flavor has rounded and nappé consistency is achieved.
Strain sauce through chinois. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: TUNA CEVICHE
recipes.description: Tuna cures in lime juice and coconut milk with serrano chili, ginger, red onion, and cilantro, everything combined in one bowl, covered, and chilled for 30 to 45 minutes before serving.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in large bowl.
Cover with plastic wrap and transfer to refrigerator for 30-45 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Fried Shrimp with Wasabi Garnish
recipes.description: Shrimp are processed to a smooth paste with garlic, miso, tamari, and curry powder, then scooped into balls, rolled in panko breadcrumbs, chilled, and fried crisp, ready for lemon and a punchy wasabi garnish.
instructions: In food processor, combine shrimp, garlic, miso, tamari, curry powder, and salt. Process to smooth paste. Add 1 tablespoon of chives and pulse once or twice until incorporated into mixture. Transfer mixture from processor to small bowl.
Using 1-ounce scoop, portion shrimp balls and roll in breadcrumbs.
Refrigerate breaded shrimp for 20-30 minutes.
Heat oil in wok to 350°F. Deep fry shrimp until golden. Drain shrimp on paper towels.
In small bowl, mix wasabi powder with water and juice. Add enough liquid to achieve smooth, pipe-able consistency. Transfer mixture to small pastry bag with small round tip.
Sprinkle shrimp with salt and a squeeze of lemon juice. Skewer shrimp with toothpick and garnish with small dab of wasabi paste and remaining 1 tablespoon of chives. Garnish tray with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Bulgur
recipes.description: Dry-roasting the bulgur in a sauté pan deepens its flavor before a single rolling-boil minute in salted water; the pot then steams off the heat, covered, for forty-five minutes.
instructions: Dry roast bulgur in small sauté pan.
Bring water and salt to boil in small saucepot, add bulgur, cover and bring back to a rolling boil for 1 minute.
Remove pot from heat. Let steam, covered, 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Brown Basmati Rice Variation #2
recipes.description: Brown basmati rice dry-roasts in the oven, gets stirred with coconut oil, then bakes tightly covered with boiling water, salt, and kaffir lime leaves perfuming every grain.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In small baking dish, dry roast rice in oven until dry. Stir oil into rice and bake few minutes more, stirring occasionally.
Add water, salt, and kaffir lime leaves; cover dish tightly with tin foil.
Cook covered, about 50 to 60 minutes, or until all water is absorbed.

recipes.name: WHOLE WHEAT PASTA
recipes.description: Just three ingredients — whole wheat bread flour, unbleached flour, and eggs — pulse together in the food processor, then knead smooth and rest under plastic wrap into a supple, from-scratch pasta dough.
instructions: Pulse flours in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flours onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato and Pesto
recipes.description: Fresh basil, walnuts, sun-dried tomatoes, and garlic purée in a food processor with olive oil and white miso, yielding an intensely savory pesto seasoned to taste with sea salt.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor until puréed. Taste and adjust seasoning.

recipes.name: KASHA (for loaf)
recipes.description: Kasha meets salt and boiling water or stock in a small pot, comes just to a boil, then steams off the heat under a tight lid until every drop is absorbed and the grains are ready to fold into a loaf.
instructions: In small pot, combine kasha, salt and water.
Bring to boil, immediately turn off heat, and let sit (with lid on) until all water is absorbed (approximately 10 minutes).

recipes.name: CURRIED CHICKPEA CRÊPE FILLING
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked chickpeas join onions slowly softened in coconut oil and bloomed with curry powder, then cook down with carrots, potato, coconut milk, and spinach into a fragrant, spoonable filling built for crepes.

ingredients.name: medium carrots
ingredients.notes: about 12 ounces; cut into 1/4-inch wide quarter moon slices

ingredients.name: medium potato
ingredients.notes: about 1/2 pound; peeled and cut into small dice

ingredients.name: vegetable stock or bean liquid from cooked chickpeas
spinach
ingredients.notes: about 1 1/2 pounds; stemmed, washed, and chopped

instructions: In pressure cooker, combine chickpeas, water, cumin, salt, and bay leaves.
Bring pot to pressure, lower heat, and cook 30 minutes. Drain beans, set aside, and reserve bean liquid if using in place of stock.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Add onions. Lower heat and cook until onions begin to soften and become translucent. Add curry. Cook 2-3 minutes more.
Add carrots and potatoes, stirring often to prevent sticking. Cook 5-6 minutes. Add garlic and salt. Cook 2-3 minutes more. Add stock or bean liquid reserved from chickpeas.

Add coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer 3-4 minutes more. Add spinach. Cook until spinach becomes tender (about 1-2 minutes). Adjust seasonings. If mixture looks too thick, add bit more stock or bean liquid.

recipes.name: Flounder Roulades
recipes.description: Delicate flounder filets roll around a savory filling of sweated onions, zucchini, capers, and roma tomatoes bound with gluten-free breadcrumbs, then bake at 375 degrees with white wine, butter, and thyme.
instructions: Preheat conventional oven to 375°F.
Heat 2 tablespoons oil in 12-inch sauté pan. Add onions and sweat until tender. Add zucchini and cook for 1-2 more minutes.
Transfer onion/zucchini mixture to bowl and stir in breadcrumbs, capers, and tomatoes.
Place fish filets on cutting board presentation side down. Divide filling mixture into even portions among filets.
Roll filets and transfer to baking dish drizzled with remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil (seam side down).
Sprinkle butter and wine in pan along with sprigs of thyme.
Bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: WAKAME CUCUMBER SALAD WITH ORANGE
recipes.description: Salt-pressed cucumbers keep their crunch alongside briny wakame, juicy orange, and fresh cilantro, all tossed in a bright dressing of rice vinegar, mirin, shoyu, and a touch of maple syrup.

ingredients.name: wakame
ingredients.notes: loosely packed; soaked 10 minutes in water to cover and drained

ingredients.name: juice oranges
ingredients.notes: supremed (plus juice extracted from squeezing membrane after supreme)

instructions: In strainer set over bowl, mix cucumber with sea salt. Press with weighted plate until liquid is expressed.
Chop wakame coarsely and combine with cucumbers, oranges, and cilantro in medium bowl.
In separate small bowl, combine dressing: rice vinegar, mirin, shoyu, and maple syrup.
Toss salad with dressing. Chill 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon and Maple-Flavored Yogurt
recipes.description: Thick Greek yogurt gets a quick whisk with fragrant lemon zest and maple syrup, turning three simple ingredients into a tangy-sweet spoonful that comes together in a single bowl within moments.
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients in small bowl.

recipes.name: Wild Rice
recipes.description: Simmered covered for 45 to 50 minutes until the grains butterfly and turn tender, wild rice asks for nothing but water, salt, and patience before a final drain in the colander.

ingredients.name: wild rice
ingredients.notes: soaked in 2 cups water for 8 hours and drained

instructions: Wash and drain rice.
In small saucepot, add rice to water. Add salt. Bring to a boil, covered, lower heat and simmer about 45 to 50 minutes or until rice is tender (rice should butterfly slightly).
Place rice in colander and drain excess water.

recipes.name: Chocolate Bark
recipes.description: Bittersweet chocolate melts gently over simmering water and is held below 125 degrees for a careful temper, then meets sliced almonds, dried cranberries, cacao nibs, and a sprinkle of coarse sea salt.

ingredients.name: ground bittersweet chocolate
ingredients.notes: 10 oz chocolate ground in food processor = about 2 cups

ingredients.name: sprinkle of coarsely ground sea salt

instructions: Line half-sheet pan with parchment paper. Prepare ice bath in small bowl. Have offset spatula and candy thermometer at the ready.
Bring 4 cups water to simmer in 2-quart pot.

Pour 1 1/2 cups ground chocolate in small bowl. Set bowl over simmering water and whisk chocolate until completely melted. Remove bowl from heat and take temperature of melted chocolate. Temperature should not exceed 125°F. Between 110 and 125°F is best.
When chocolate is in 110 and 125°F range, whisk in remaining 1/2 cup of ground chocolate. Cool chocolate to 85°F, transferring bowl to ice bath, if necessary.

Transfer bowl atop simmering water again, and whisk chocolate until it reaches temperature between 87 and 91°F degrees (be careful as temperature rises quickly). If temperature goes too high, again use ice bath to cool it quickly.
Pour chocolate on parchment-lined half-sheet pan. Spread with offset spatula to 1/8-inch thickness.
Sprinkle nuts, dried fruit, cacao nibs, and salt over surface.
Cool bark in refrigerator and break into pieces.

recipes.name: STIR-FRIED ARAME AND GINGER WITH SOBA NOODLES
recipes.description: Golden ginger and garlic scent a sesame-oiled wok before arame, red pepper, and cabbage tumble in, the stir-fry tossed with cold-rinsed soba noodles and seasoned with tamari, umeboshi vinegar, and maple syrup.

ingredients.name: arame
ingredients.notes: loosely packed (.05 ounces), soaked 10 minutes in water to cover, drained

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.notes: 1/2 bunch; trimmed, thinly sliced on the diagonal

instructions: Boil soba until tender, about 8-10 minutes. Drain, rinse in cold water, and set aside.
Coarsely chop arame. Set aside.
Heat wok with both sesame oils. Add ginger and stir well. Add garlic. Cook until ginger and garlic are lightly golden, but avoid burning.
Stir in arame, peppers, and Chinese cabbage. Once cabbage wilts, add soba.
Mix water, tamari, umeboshi vinegar, and maple syrup in small bowl. Pour over vegetables and noodles. Stir until liquid has evaporated.
Add scallions and stir to combine.

recipes.name: Massaged Kale Salad with Roasted Chickpeas and Pickled Red Onion
recipes.description: Lacinato kale gets worked with lemon and olive oil until tender, then piled with chickpeas roasted crisp in smoked paprika, cumin, and fennel, plus quick-pickled red onion and briny kalamata olives.
instructions: Combine chickpeas in pressure cooker with salt, bay leaf, and thyme sprigs. Add water to cover by 2 inches. Bring pot to pressure, lower heat, and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid. Drain beans.
Heat oven to 350°F. Combine and toss chickpeas in medium bowl with olive oil, fennel, cumin, paprika, pepper flakes, and additional salt to taste.
Transfer chickpeas to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast until crispy, around 15 minutes. Set aside.
Combine red onions in medium bowl with boiling water and let sit 5-10 minutes. Drain. Add vinegar, salt, and agave. Mix to combine.
Combine kale in medium bowl with salt, lemon zest and lemon juice. Massage with gloved hands until moisture is released and kale begins to soften in texture.
Mix kale with chickpeas and olives. Garnish with pickled onions.

recipes.name: CABBAGE SALAD WITH PEANUT DRESSING
recipes.description: Tofu simmered in coconut milk, tamari, and lime crowns blanched cabbage, steeped rice noodles, snow peas, and cucumber, the whole salad bound in a peanut butter dressing sharpened with lime zest and chili powder.
instructions: Combine tofu in 12-inch sauté pan with coconut milk, 1/4 cup of the tamari, lime juice, and rice syrup. Simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes or until mixture thickens. Set aside.

Prepare an ice bath. Bring 3 quarts water to boil. Add 1 tablespoon salt. Blanch cabbage in for 2 minutes. Transfer cabbage with slotted spoon to ice bath. Drain cabbage in colander for about 5 minutes. Squeeze out any excess moisture from cabbage and set aside.

Bring water back to boil. Transfer noodles to large bowl. When water comes to boil, pour water over noodles and let noodles steep for 10-15 minutes or until tender. Drain and rinse under cold water. Toss noodles with remaining 1/4 cup of tamari.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, heat oil on medium flame. Sweat onion, garlic, salt, and chili powder until onions are translucent. Add lime zest, lime juice, coconut sugar, and tamari.
In a small bowl, whisk coconut milk and peanut butter, stirring until smooth. Add to onion-garlic mixture and simmer gently 2-3 minutes or until sauce thickens to desired consistency.
Remove sauce from heat and cool to room temperature. Toss half the peanut sauce with noodles.
Pool remaining peanut sauce on bottom of plate. Arrange plate with tofu, noodles, cabbage, snow peas, cucumbers, and peanuts.

recipes.name: GREEN LENTIL TERRINE
recipes.description: Green lentils simmer tender in vegetable stock with bay leaves, then meet browned onions, thyme, coriander, breadcrumbs, white miso, and tahini before baking in a parchment-lined terrine mold.

ingredients.name: white miso dissolved in 2 tablespoons warm water
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line terrine mold with parchment.

In 1-gallon pot, combine lentils, salt, vegetable stock, and bay leaves. Cover pot and bring to boil. Lower heat, and simmer for 30-40 minutes or until lentils are tender. Drain lentils in colander for 10 minutes.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onions until browned. Add thyme, coriander, and nutmeg. Sauté 2 minutes more. Set aside.
Transfer lentils to food processor and pulse to form thick paste.

Transfer lentils to medium-size bowl. Add onions, 1 cup bread crumbs, parsley, miso, and tahini. Mixture should be thick but moist. If mixture is too loose, add more bread crumbs. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Pour mixture into terrine mold and bake until firm, about 20 to 25 minutes. Chill terrine until it reaches room temperature, about 1 hour.

recipes.name: CHERMOULA SAUCE
recipes.description: Everything goes into the blender at once: minced garlic, lemon zest and juice, ground cumin, and sweet paprika whirled with extra virgin olive oil and a pinch of red pepper flakes into a bright, punchy chermoula.
instructions: In VitaMix, combine all ingredients until well blended.

recipes.name: CARAMEL
recipes.description: Brown rice syrup and maple syrup simmer with unsweetened almond milk, vanilla, and a splash of apple cider vinegar for 10 to 12 minutes, reducing to a caramel just thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in sauté pan. Bring sauce to simmer and cook uncovered for 10-12 minutes until sauce is reduced and thick enough to coat back of spoon. Remove from heat and let cool completely.

recipes.name: RAW JERUSALEM ARTICHOKE SALAD
recipes.description: Crisp Jerusalem artichokes and radishes marinate for 30 minutes in a creamy blended dressing of lemon juice, dijon mustard, rice syrup, and olive oil, then join chicory tossed in the remaining dressing.
instructions: Combine all dressing ingredients in blender until creamy.
Combine Jerusalem artichokes and radishes in small bowl with half the dressing. Marinate 30 minutes.
Dress chicory with remaining dressing.
Toss chicory with Jerusalem artichokes and radishes.

recipes.name: HIZIKI WITH FRESH LEMON
recipes.description: Sautéed onions mingle with hiziki in sesame oil before a slow simmer in shoyu-seasoned water; the pan cooks nearly dry to concentrate flavor, ready for a bright finish of fresh lemon juice and scallions.
instructions: Drain off any remaining soaking water from hiziki and discard.
In 10-inch pan, sauté onion in oil for 3 to 5 minutes. Add hiziki, mixing well.
Add enough water to just barely cover hiziki. Add shoyu. Bring to boil. Cover, lower flame, and cook until most of liquid has evaporated – about 30 minutes.
Gently stir in scallions and lemon juice until well mixed. Serve.

recipes.name: Morning Glory Muffins
recipes.description: Shredded carrot, raisins, pecans, and Granny Smith apple crowd a cinnamon-spiced whole wheat batter sweetened with coconut sugar, folded together and baked into hearty, fruit-studded muffins.

ingredients.name: raisins
ingredients.notes: soaked for 5 minutes in hot water and drained

instructions: Heat oven to 350° F (325° F in convection). Prepare muffin tins with paper liners.
Sift flour, sugar, baking soda, and cinnamon into bowl. Whisk ingredients together and set aside.
Combine carrot, raisins, pecans, coconut, and apple in bowl. Mix into the dry ingredients.
Whisk together the flax mixture, kuzu mixture, oil, and vanilla.
Add the liquid ingredients to batter. Stir to combine. Let batter sit for 2-3 minutes to allow moisture from the fruit to loosen batter, stir again.
Line muffin tin with cupcake liners. Portion batter with 1/4 cup ice cream scoop (yellow handle).
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until skewer or toothpick inserted in center of muffin comes out clean. Cool muffins completely on cooling rack before serving.

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Sauce
recipes.description: Orange marmalade brings body and sweetness to a quick whisked sauce with rice vinegar, shoyu, and fresh ginger — no cooking required, just a half-hour chill in the refrigerator to let it all come together.
instructions: In bowl, whisk all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour.

recipes.name: CAULIFLOWER TERRINE
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked navy beans meet a fresh-blended almond milk set with agar, while cauliflower florets sweat slowly with onion and garlic until tender — all folded together for a delicate, sliceable terrine finished with chives.

ingredients.name: cauliflower - 1 pound cored and cut into florets
ingredients.notes: 1/2 pound cut into florets and sliced 1/4-inch thick for garnish

instructions: In pressure cooker, combine beans with 1 cup stock, thyme, and salt. Bring cooker to pressure and cook beans 20 minutes. Lower pressure, drain beans, and remove thyme stems. Reserve for step 2.

Blend remaining 1 1/2 cups vegetable stock and blanched almonds in VitaMix until smooth. Strain milk through nut bag or chinois into 2 1/2 quart pot. Add agar powder and bring to milk to simmer. Stir constantly until agar dissolves, about 10 minutes. Add beans to pot and set aside. Rinse out Vitamix for use in step 5.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Turn heat down, and sweat onions, garlic, 1 pound cauliflower florets, and salt, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is tender. Transfer vegetables to large bowl, and add bean-almond milk mixture. Set aside.
In same sauté pan, heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Sear sliced cauliflower on each side until golden. Drain on paper towels. Set aside.
In VitaMix, combine almond milk-bean mixture and vegetables (minus the sliced/seared cauliflower). Blend until smooth. Fold chives into mixture. Adjust seasonings.
Line terrine mold with parchment. Arrange seared cauliflower slices on bottom of mold. Pour puree into mold. Refrigerate and set until firm, about 2 hours.

recipes.name: Almond Fruit Torte
recipes.description: Ground blanched almonds blend with eggs, maple syrup, and almond extract into a smooth batter, baked in a springform pan until firm and browned, then paired with strawberries, kiwis, and oranges.
instructions: Oil and flour 8 1/2 inch spring form pan.
Powder almonds in food processor. Add eggs, 1/2 cup maple syrup, and almond extract. Process until smooth. Pour batter into pan.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes. Top should be firm to touch and brown. Do not remove cake from pan.
In one-quart saucepan, soften agar flakes in water for 10 minutes. Cook covered, stirring often until agar is dissolved.
In separate pot, combine strawberries with 1/4 cup maple syrup and cook over medium flame, covered, until soft. Puree in blender, and put through sieve to remove seeds.
Add strawberry puree to agar mixture, stirring well. Add dissolved kuzu to pot stirring constantly until thick and clear and mixture comes to boil.
Adjust sweetness with remaining maple syrup, if desired.
Let strawberry mixture cool slightly. Pour over cake before removing sides of spring-form pan.
Let mixture set, then remove sides of spring-form pan.
Garnish with kiwis and oranges and serve.

recipes.name: OLIVE TAPENADE
recipes.description: Pitted black olives and briny capers blend with garlic, fresh lemon juice, and grated orange zest into a smooth, intensely savory tapenade, processed until silky in the food processor.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor and blend until smooth. Stop now and again to scrape down sides with spoon or spatula.

recipes.name: Beurre Blanc
recipes.description: White wine vinegar reduces with shallots until nearly dry, a splash of heavy cream steadies the pan, and unsalted butter whisks in a few pieces at a time to build a glossy, tangy emulsion.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: 2 sticks; chilled, cut into 1/2 inch cubes

instructions: In 8-inch sauté pan over medium flame, reduce vinegar with shallots until almost dry (au sec).
Add heavy cream to pan and reduce until mixture thickens slightly. Reduce heat to low.
Add butter, whisking in a few pieces at a time.
When all butter is incorporated, season to taste.
Strain sauce through chinois. Re-heat carefully over very low flame.

recipes.name: Crème Anglaise (Stirred Custard)
recipes.description: Vanilla-scented cream is scalded, then whisked slowly into egg yolks beaten with maple crystals; the custard is stirred patiently over a double boiler until it just coats the back of a spoon.
instructions: Heat cream or milk and vanilla to scalding (just below simmering) in double boiler.

In medium bowl, beat together egg yolks and maple crystals. Slowly pour hot cream/milk into egg mixture while whisking constantly (this raises the temperature of the eggs gradually and helps prevent curdling).

Heat mixture slowly in double boiler, stirring constantly to prevent curdling. Sauce is cooked when it lightly coats the back of a spoon instead of running off like milk, or when it reaches 185°F. Never let the temperatures go above 190°F.
When done, remove sauce from heat. Cool sauce by setting pan or bowl in ice water. Stir occasionally to cool evenly.
Note: If sauce accidentally curdles, it is sometimes possible to save it. Immediately stir in 1-2 tablespoons cold milk, transfer sauce to blender, and process at high speed.

recipes.name: TOASTED WALNUT CRUST (FOR LIGHT LEMON TART)
recipes.description: Walnuts are ground to a fine meal with a gluten-free flour blend and maple crystals, then bound with maple syrup and melted coconut oil in quick pulses — a nutty, toasty dough destined for tart pans and a light lemon filling.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Oil and parchment 8 or 9-inch tart pan. Alternatively, use 5-6 four-inch, non-stick paper tart pans.
Combine nuts, flour, maple crystals, and salt in food processor. Grind to fine meal.
Add syrup and oil to processor. Pulse to form dough.
Place dough in middle of tart pan. Using your fingertips, press dough out so that bottom and sides are evenly covered. Trim crust and discard any excess. Blot excess oil from crust with paper towel.
Transfer tart pan(s) to refrigerator for 10-15 minutes to chill.
Transfer tart pan(s) to sheet tray and bake about 20 minutes. Cool completely before filling.

recipes.name: Baked Tofu
recipes.description: Cubes of firm tofu are tossed with ground cumin, paprika, and garlic powder, then bathed in apple juice, tamari, and olive oil and baked at 350°F — built to pair with a batch of romesco sauce.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: 1 block; cut into 4 slabs, pressed for 30 minutes

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.
Slice each slab of tofu into 16 cubes.
In a small baking vessel, combine tofu with cumin, paprika, garlic powder, apple juice, tamari, and oil.
Transfer to oven and bake 15 - 20 minutes. Remove from oven and serve with Romesco Sauce.

recipes.name: Basic Marinade
recipes.description: Whisked together in minutes, this marinade layers dijon mustard, garlic, shoyu, and balsamic vinegar into olive oil, with lemon juice and a dash of hot sauce to wake up vegetables headed for the grill.
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients.
Marinate vegetables and grill.

recipes.name: WILD RICE PANCAKES
recipes.description: Chopped wild rice gives these pancakes a nutty chew, folded through a batter of lemon-soured milk, maple crystals, and egg whites before frying to a golden finish in butter or oil.
instructions: In large bowl, whisk together flour, maple crystals, baking powder, soda and salt.
Roughly chop cooked rice (needs to be dry, fluffy before adding to batter) and mix with dry ingredients.
In separate bowl, whisk together milk and lemon juice. Let stand 15 minutes. Add 2 tablespoons of oil or butter.
Gradually add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and stir to combine. Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into combined ingredients.
Heat griddle or large non-stick pan over medium heat. Brush little of remaining tablespoon of oil over surface of pan.
Using 1-ounce ladle, pour batter onto griddle. Cook cakes until bubbles in batter break on surface; flip and cook until browned.

recipes.name: Chocolate Coating (for Truffles)
recipes.description: Semisweet chocolate melts with coconut oil over a double boiler, then more chopped chocolate is stirred in off the heat for a smooth, glossy coating that clings to each dipped truffle.
instructions: Create double boiler: Fill 1-gallon pot with 4 cups water. Bring water to simmer. Cover pot with heatproof bowl. Combine 1 1/3 cups chocolate and coconut oil in bowl and stir until chocolate is completely melted and smooth.
Immediately remove bowl from pot and wipe moisture from bottom of bowl with dry towel. Stir in remaining 2/3 cup chocolate until chocolate is again smooth.
Using slotted spoon, dip truffles one by one into melted chocolate. Let excess chocolate drip off.
Transfer covered truffle to parchment-lined sheet pan. Sprinkle with garnish (crushed pistachios, toasted coconut, or lime zest/sea salt).
Repeat process with remaining truffles. Refrigerate until chocolate coating has set.

recipes.name: Blueberry Sauce
recipes.description: Blueberries simmer uncovered in apple juice and maple syrup until they pop and the sauce thickens, about fifteen minutes, then lemon zest and vanilla stir in for a bright, glossy finish.
instructions: Combine blueberries, apple juice, and maple syrup in pot. Bring mixture to simmer.
Simmer sauce uncovered until blueberries begin to pop open and sauce begins to thicken, approximately 15 minutes.
Stir in lemon zest and vanilla. Simmer another minute.

recipes.name: PUMPKIN, SAGE, AND PECAN RAVIOLI
recipes.description: Roasted winter squash is mashed and folded into caramelized onions with sauteed pecans and minced fresh sage, building a sweet-savory ravioli filling seasoned simply with salt and black pepper.

ingredients.name: winter squash
ingredients.notes: 2 to 2 1/2 pounds; e.g., kabocha or butternut (about 2 cups cooked)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Cut squash in half from stem to bottom and place cut side down on parchment-covered sheet pan. Bake about 45 minutes, until fork tender. Let cool a few minutes, then remove and discard seeds. Scoop flesh into bowl and mash with fork. Measure out 2 cups of mashed squash, reserving any extra.

Warm oil in 10-inch sauté pan. Add onions and sauté until caramelized, about 10 minutes. Add pecans and sauté few minutes more. Add squash, mixing until heated through. Stir in sage leaves, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat.
Roll out dough; fill and form raviolis.
Bring 12-inch sauté pan filled with 2 inches of water to simmer. Add raviolis and cook 3 to 5 minutes, depending on dryness of pasta and whether or not they were frozen.
Use slotted spoon to gently lift raviolis out of water. Drain briefly for a moment, then serve immediately.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CURRIED SWEET POTATO SOUP
recipes.description: Onions sweat in coconut oil with curry powder before sweet potatoes simmer tender in vegetable stock; blended until creamy and enriched with coconut milk and lime juice, the soup turns silky and warming.

ingredients.name: limes
ingredients.notes: sliced into 7 thin rounds, for garnish

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat coconut oil over medium flame. Add onion, salt, and curry powder. Sweat until onions are translucent.
Add sweet potatoes and stock to pot. Raise heat bring and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar until potatoes are tender.
Puree soup in blender until creamy.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and whisk in coconut milk. Season to taste with salt and lime juice.
Garnish with lime rounds.

recipes.name: Long Grain Brown Rice
recipes.description: Dry-roasting the long grain brown rice until slightly aromatic builds nutty flavor before boiling water and salt go in; a thirty-minute simmer and a covered off-heat steam finish every fluffy grain.
instructions: Dry roast until rice in small pot until dry and slightly aromatic.
Add boiling water and salt to rice. Cover. Bring back to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer for 30 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Remove pot from heat and let steam 10 to 15 minutes covered.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE SWEET POTATO PECAN TART
recipes.description: Ground pecans and maple crystals press into a crust with tapioca and sorghum flours, partially baked before a filling of mashed garnet yams, maple syrup, heavy cream, cinnamon, and ginger takes its place.

ingredients.name: gluten free breadcrumbs mixed with 2 tablespoons maple crystals
whole pecans or 1 cup thick coconut flakes

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly grease tart pan with small amount of softened butter or oil.

Grind pecans and maple crystals to fine meal in food processor. Add flours and pulse to combine about 30 seconds more. Transfer mixture from food processor to bowl. In separate bowl, whisk together melted butter, water and, salt. Pour wet mixture into dry and mix to combine. If mixture is too moist, refrigerate for 5-10 minutes before pressing out crust.
Press crust mixture into tart pan. Refrigerate 15-20 minutes or until crust is firm to touch. Pierce crust with fork and partially bake for 15-20 minutes. Cool before filling.
Before filling tart shell, sprinkle breadcrumbs and maple crystals over crust (this prevents crust from getting soggy).
In food processor, puree yams. Add syrup, eggs, cream, vanilla, ginger juice, ground spices, and salt. Blend until mixture is creamy and smooth. Transfer puree to partially baked pie shell.
Decorate top of tart with pecans and brush nuts with maple syrup or top with coconut (omitting maple syrup wash).
Bake tart 30-35 minutes until filling is just firm. Allow to cool completely before slicing.

recipes.name: Chocolate Sauce
recipes.description: Melted semisweet chocolate loosens with slowly whisked-in simmered almond milk until it becomes a smooth, pourable sauce, with vanilla rounding out its deep, glossy sweetness.
instructions: In double boiler (bowl set over simmering water), melt chocolate.
In separate pot, bring almond milk to simmer, and turn off heat.
Slowly whisk just enough almond milk into melted chocolate to create a smooth and pourable sauce.

recipes.name: SEITAN STEW
recipes.description: Burdock, daikon, and shiitake mushrooms sweat in olive oil before butternut squash, seitan, and tamari simmer into a hearty stew, thickened with kuzu and finished with ginger juice and scallions.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper
