instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat olive oil over medium flame and sweat onion until softened. Add celery, burdock, carrots, and daikon. Sweat until vegetables begin to soften, about 5-7 minutes. Add mushrooms and sweat until tender, about 1 minute.

Add squash and stock to just cover vegetables, about 6 cups. Cover pot and bring to boil. Lower heat and add bay leaves, seitan, and tamari. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until all vegetables are tender and squash has started to break down. Add green beans and simmer until beans are just tender.
Add kuzu slurry and simmer until mixture slightly thickens. Stir in ginger juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with scallions.
Seasonal variation: In Spring/Summer replace green beans with 1 small zucchini (7 ounces), cut into 1-inch roll cut.

recipes.name: MISO-GLAZED WHITE FISH
recipes.description: White fish filets soak for a full hour in a whisked marinade of sake, mirin, white miso, and rice syrup, then broil until the sweet-savory glaze caramelizes over the flesh.

ingredients.name: white fish filets
ingredients.notes: skin on, divided into eight 4-ounce portions

instructions: Combine sake, mirin, miso, rice syrup, and shoyu in small pot. Whisk to emulsify. Transfer to ice bath to quickly cool.
Place filets in shallow hotel pan and pour marinade over them. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Heat broiler. Lightly oil half sheet tray. Arrange filets skin side down on tray. Broil 5-7 minutes.

recipes.name: Hemp Seed Milk
recipes.description: Hemp hearts, medjool dates, and vanilla whirl with filtered water in a high-speed blender until completely smooth, making a naturally sweet milk to pour chilled or gently warmed.
instructions: Put all ingredients into high-speed blender and blend until smooth.
Serve milk chilled or warmed.

recipes.name: BASIC CHICKEN STOCK
recipes.description: Chicken bones, yellow onion, carrot, and celery come to a boil, get carefully skimmed, then settle into a gentle three-to-four-hour uncovered simmer for a clean, deeply savory stock.

ingredients.name: sachet of 2 bay leaves
ingredients.notes: 4 sprigs thyme, 2 teaspoons black peppercorns, 1/2 ounce parsley stems

instructions: Combine bones, onion, carrot, celery, sachet, and water in large stock pot.
Cover pot and bring to boil. Remove cover and skim any foam off top.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 3-4 hours.
Strain stock immediately, first through china cap, then chinois.
Cool stock in ice bath and refrigerate.

recipes.name: Red Cabbage-Caraway Sauerkraut
recipes.description: Red cabbage is massaged with sea salt until it releases its own briny liquid, then packed tight with whole caraway seeds into a jar to ferment slowly beneath its deep purple brine.

ingredients.name: red cabbage
ingredients.notes: about 2 pounds; quartered, core removed and thinly sliced

instructions: Place cabbage in large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Squeeze and massage cabbage to release water. Continue to massage and squeeze until enough liquid has been released to create salty brine that covers cabbage by 1/4 inch. Add caraway seeds.

Pack tightly into 2 quart wide-mouthed glass jar or ceramic crock (liquid brine must be above cabbage for healthy successful fermentation). If cabbage has not released enough juices to cover, add salted water to jar/crock in a ratio of 1 teaspoon sea salt per 1 cup water.

Place plate or discover cabbage and press down to squeeze more brine to surface. Cover mouth of vessel with cheesecloth and secure to rim of lid with kitchen twine, rubber band, OR if using airlock lid, fill airlock and secure lid.

Store sauerkraut in dry place for 2 - 4 weeks at room temperature. Be sure to check water level, adding more salt water as needed to ensure the mixture is covered throughout fermentation process. Taste every few days and eat or refrigerate when desired tangy flavor is achieved.
Note: A cooler fermentation area will result in a slower fermentation with complex flavor notes. A warmer area will result in a faster fermentation that may lead to off flavors and cloudy brine.

recipes.name: RED LENTIL TERRINE
recipes.description: Red lentils simmered in vegetable stock with bay leaf get folded with slow-sweated onions, walnuts, umeboshi paste, and white miso, then baked in a parchment-lined mold into a sliceable savory terrine.

ingredients.name: white miso dissolved in 3 tablespoons warm water
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line terrine mold with parchment paper and set aside.

In 1-gallon pot, combine lentils, stock, salt, and bay leaf. Cover pot and bring to boil. Lower heat and simmer until lentils are tender, about half an hour. Drain lentils in colander for 10 minutes, transfer to medium bowl, and set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame and sweat onions and garlic until translucent. Continue to sweat, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and uniformly browned, about 15 minutes.
Deglaze pan with mirin. Combine onions with lentils. Add walnuts, umeboshi paste, miso, salt, pepper, cilantro, and parsley. Mix to combine. Season to taste.
Fold mixture into terrine mold. Bake until firm, about 20 to 30 minutes.
Refrigerate terrine until it sets, about 1 hour.

recipes.name: Vegan Cashew Cream
recipes.description: Cashews blend with vanilla, brown rice vinegar, and maple syrup, water loosening the mix as the blender climbs to its highest speed, yielding a thick, pipe-able cream with pure vegan richness.
instructions: Combine cashews, vanilla, brown rice vinegar, salt, and maple syrup in Vitamix with wand attachment. Start blending on low speed, and slowly raise speed while stirring with wand.
When mixture is starting to smooth, add water, and continue processing. When mixture is almost smooth, turn Vitamix up to highest setting. Finished cream should be thick and pipe-able.

recipes.name: WHITE BEAN AND GARLIC SAUCE
recipes.description: Navy beans emerge creamy from the pressure cooker and join slow-browned onions and fragrant garlic, simmering with a tied bundle of sage and thyme before lemon juice brightens the finished sauce.

ingredients.name: navy beans or great northern beans

instructions: Drain soaked beans. Cover with 6 cups water and pressure cook about 8 minutes for navy beans, or 10 minutes for Great Northern beans. Season with salt to taste. Let beans sit in cooking liquid a few minutes to absorb salt. Drain beans, reserving cooking liquid. Alternately, on stove top, simmer partially covered about an hour and a half, until beans are soft. Season with salt to taste. Let beans sit in cooking liquid a few minutes to absorb salt. Drain beans, reserving cooking liquid.

Warm olive oil in 12-inch sauté pan. Add onions and cook over medium-low heat for about 7 minutes, until onions soften and start to brown. Add garlic and cook a few more minutes until fragrant. Add cooked beans and 2 1/2 cups of bean cooking liquid. (If using canned beans, add 2 1/2 cups water.)

Tie herbs together with string and add to pot along with bay leaf. Cover, bring to boil over medium heat, reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for 15 minutes to allow flavors to marry. Add lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste. Remove bay leaf and tied herbs.

recipes.name: WILD RICE SALAD
recipes.description: Chewy wild rice absorbs a blender-emulsified dressing of orange juice, balsamic vinegar, dijon mustard, and maple syrup while still warm, then tosses with dried cranberries, walnuts, carrots, and scallions over radicchio and baby arugula.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Combine rice in 2 1/2 quart pot with water and salt. Bring rice to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, until grains are tender but still chewy (about 20-25 minutes). Drain rice.
Combine all dressing ingredients except for oil in blender. Slowly drizzle oil into blender until emulsified. Pour half of dressing over still warm rice.
When rice is completely cooled, combine with cranberries, walnuts, carrots, radishes, scallions, chives, and parsley. Season with salt and pepper, if needed.
Toss radicchio and arugula with remaining dressing, arrange on plate, and top with rice salad.
Seasonal variation: In Spring/Summer, replace dried cranberries with 1/4 cup rehydrated, drained, and chopped sun-dried tomatoes.

recipes.name: ALMOND-FRUIT TART WITH ALMOND CRUST
recipes.description: Agar and kuzu set an almond milk pastry cream perfumed with vanilla and almond extract, simmered and whisked smooth to fill an almond-oat crust beneath oranges, strawberries, banana, and kiwi.

ingredients.name: agar flakes
ingredients.notes: processed in coffee grinder until fine

ingredients.name: ripe banana
ingredients.notes: sliced and sprinkled with lemon juice

instructions: For pastry cream: Combine agar, water and maple syrup in 2 1/2 quart saucepan. Soak agar 10 minutes.
Bring agar mixture to boil, lower heat and simmer with lid slightly ajar until agar is dissolved, about 15 minutes. Whisk or stir often, scraping agar from sides and bottom of saucepan.
Stir almond milk, salt, and extracts into agar mixture. Bring to boil, whisking often.
Add kuzu slurry, whisking vigorously, until mixture comes back to boil. Cook few minutes longer.
Pour mixture into shallow pan and chill in freezer or refrigerator until set.
In food processor, whip chilled mixture until very smooth and creamy. Halfway through processing, stop machine and scrape sides of work bowl with spatula.
For tart assembly: Fill tart crusts with Almond Pastry Cream. Arrange fruit on top of cream.

recipes.name: Tofu Ricotta
recipes.description: Garlic sizzles briefly in olive oil to mellow before joining tofu, rice vinegar, lemon juice, and white miso in the food processor, pulsed just until the mixture mimics ricotta's texture.
instructions: In small sauté pan, combine olive oil and garlic. Bring oil to heat over medium flame. When garlic starts to sizzle, remove pan from heat. Let garlic and oil cool.
Combine oil, garlic, tofu, rice vinegar, lemon juice, and white miso in food processor. Pulse mixture until it resembles texture of ricotta. Season to taste with salt, as needed.

recipes.name: Kasha-Potato Loaf
recipes.description: Nutty kasha steeped in boiling water joins coarsely mashed potatoes, onions, celery, caraway seeds, and shoyu in a hearty baked loaf seasoned with thyme and sage.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In small pot, combine kasha with boiling water with salt; cover pot. Bring back to a rolling boil; turn off heat and let sit (with lid on) for 15 minutes.

In medium pot, cover potatoes with enough water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to boil, covered. Lower heat and simmer until tender, but not mushy, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash potatoes coarsely; set aside.
In 10-inch sauté pan, caramelize onions in olive oil until dark brown, adding celery in last few minutes of cooking along with salt, thyme and sage.
Roast caraway seeds over medium heat in small sauté pan, until fragrant, about 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In medium bowl, mix kasha with potatoes, onion mixture, caraway seeds and shoyu. Season to taste with pepper and more salt (or shoyu) if desired.
Line a loaf pan with parchment paper and fill with kasha-potato mixture, packing tightly.
Bake until warmed through, about 20 minutes.
Let cool to room temperature before removing from pan. Slice and serve.

recipes.name: Almond Torte
recipes.description: Blanched almonds are powdered fine in the food processor, then whirled with eggs, maple syrup, and almond extract into a smooth batter that bakes into a simple, intensely nutty torte.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Oil and flour 8-inch spring form pan.
Powder almonds in food processor. Add eggs, maple syrup and almond extract. Process until smooth.
Pour batter into pan.
Bake for 40 minutes. Top should be firm to touch and golden brown.

recipes.name: CHICKEN UNDER A BRICK
recipes.description: Seasoned simply with sea salt and black pepper, this chicken sears skin side down beneath a foil-wrapped brick, the weight pressing it flat and crisp before finishing in a hot convection oven.
instructions: Heat convection oven to 400°F.
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in 10-inch sauté pan over high flame. When oil is hot but not yet smoking, add chicken, skin side down. Place foil covered brick on top of chicken. Sear for 5 minutes.
Transfer pan to oven and cook for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and remove brick.
Turn chicken skin side up, and carefully pour off excess fat.
Transfer pan back to oven for additional 5-10 minutes, with fan turned to high.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: BASIC BROILED CHICKEN
recipes.description: Rubbed inside and out with olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper, the chicken starts skin-side down in a hot, dry sauté pan before heading under a well-preheated broiler to brown.
instructions: Preheat broiler 20 minutes prior to using. Adjust rack to lowest setting.
Rub both skin side and inside of chicken with olive oil, salt, and fresh ground black pepper.
Heat 10-inch sauté pan over medium flame and place chicken, skin side down, in pan. Do not add any extra oil to pan. Transfer chicken to broiler.

Broil chicken skin side down for 15 minutes. Carefully flip chicken skin side up, and continue to broil for another 20 minutes. Depending on size of chicken, full cooking may need to be completed in preheated convection oven at 400°F for another 10-15 minutes.

recipes.name: CHICKEN POT PIE FILLING WITH TOASTED BREADCRUMBS
recipes.description: Roasted chicken thighs get diced into a velvety filling built on a slow butter-and-onion roux, loosened with chicken stock and joined by carrots, celery, peas, and fresh thyme beneath toasted panko breadcrumbs.
instructions: Heat convection oven to 400°F.

Combine thighs and oil in bowl. Coat thighs with 1/4 cup olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer chicken to parchment-lined half sheet pan, skin side up, and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through but still moist. After chicken has cooled enough to handle, remove and discard skin and bones. Cut chicken into large dice and set aside.

In 1-gallon pot, melt butter over medium flame. Add onion and sweat until translucent (about 10 minutes). Stir in flour and continue to cook over low heat about 7-8 minutes, stirring constantly. Add chicken stock and simmer over low heat for another 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Bring 1 gallon water to boil and add 1 tablespoon salt. Prepare ice bath. Blanch carrots and celery for 5 minutes in boiling, salted water. Shock in ice water, drain, and set aside.
Add chicken, carrots, celery, peas, and fresh thyme to pot with chicken stock and continue to cook over low heat for an additional 5 minutes. Check seasoning and adjust if necessary.

Heat 10-inch sauté pan over low heat. Add Panko and remaining 2 tablespoons of oil. Carefully sauté Panko until golden brown. Add parsley and season lightly with salt and pepper, continuing to toast 2 minutes more.
Divide pot pie mixture equally between 8 bowls and top with breadcrumb mixture.

recipes.name: Mussels Simmered in White Wine
recipes.description: Live mussels steam open over high heat in a covered pot of dry white wine, red onion, garlic, parsley, and bay leaf, then arrive ladled with their own settled cooking broth.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter or 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions: In 1-gallon pot or 12-inch sauté pan, combine wine, onion, garlic, parsley, bay leaf, and butter OR oil. Cover and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 2-3 minutes. Add mussels, cover and cook for 3-5 minutes over high heat until mussels open. Season with salt and pepper.
Using slotted spoon, remove mussels from pot or pan. Allow cooking liquid to settle in case of sand, and then ladle liquid over mussels. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Flourless Coconut Cake
recipes.description: Egg yolks whip with coconut sugar until ribbons form, dried coconut folds in, and stiffly beaten whites lighten the batter — no flour at all, just a delicate cake baked in a parchment-lined pan.

ingredients.name: dried coconut
ingredients.notes: ground to fine meal, toasted, and cooled

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Brush 8-inch cake pan with oil and line with parchment.

In Kitchen Aid, whip coconut sugar and egg yolks about 5 minutes or until ribbons form. Add dried coconut and salt and carefully mix to combine. Remove bowl with egg yolks and coconut sugar from Kitchen Aid and set aside.
Fit Kitchen Aid with new, clean bowl. Whip egg whites until stiff peaks form. Using rubber spatula, carefully fold egg whites into other bowl with sugar and egg yolks. Transfer batter to cake pan.
Bake about 30 minutes or until cake is golden and set in middle.

recipes.name: Miso Marinade
recipes.description: White miso, garlic, and ginger juice whirl in the blender with brown rice vinegar, lemon juice, rice syrup, and water until smooth, a salty-sweet marinade made in a single step.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in blender until smooth and well mixed.

recipes.name: Blueberry Syrup
recipes.description: Frozen blueberries simmer with maple syrup and vanilla for fifteen minutes, then get pressed through a chinois so every drop of deep purple juice makes it into the finished syrup.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in 2 1/2 quart pot. Bring syrup to boil, reduce heat, and simmer mixture uncovered for 15 minutes.
Strain syrup through chinois, pressing any remaining juice from blueberries. Discard blueberries, and transfer syrup to syrup containers.

recipes.name: BUTTERMILK-STYLE WAFFLES
recipes.description: Almond milk soured with apple cider vinegar stands in for buttermilk here, whisked into a coconut oil batter lightened with aquafaba and crisped in a hot waffle iron.

ingredients.name: aquafaba strained from 2 cans of chickpeas

instructions: Heat waffle iron. In bowl, whisk together almond milk and vinegar. Set aside and let stand 15 minutes.
In medium bowl, whisk together to combine flour, baking soda and cream of tartar.
In separate bowl, whisk yolk with milk mixture and oil.
Beat egg white to stiff peak.

Add milk mixture to dry ingredients in thin, steady stream, while gently mixing with rubber spatula; be careful not to add liquid faster than it can be incorporated. Toward end of mixing, use folding motion to incorporate aqua faba.
Spread appropriate amount of batter onto waffle iron. Following manufacturer's instructions, cook waffle until golden brown, at least 5 minutes.

recipes.name: COCONUT-LIME CREAM TART
recipes.description: Macadamia-coconut shortbread crust cradles a lime-spiked coconut cream, set by simmering coconut milk with agar, rum, and maple syrup until silken, then finished with toasted coconut and lime zest.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Oil 9-inch tart pan with removable bottom.

Using your fingertips, blend together flour, macadamias, shredded coconut, maple crystals, salt and coconut oil until mixture resembles coarse meal. Press mixture into tart pan. Refrigerate for 15-20 minutes. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown. Set aside to cool.

Combine coconut milk into 2 1/2 quart saucepan with agar flakes, rum, maple syrup, brown rice syrup and salt. Bring to boil over medium heat, lower heat and simmer (whisking occasionally) about 30 minutes or until agar is completely dissolved.

In second 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine semolina flour and cold water. Over high flame, whisk constantly until mixture thickens (consistency should resemble thick cream of wheat). Turn off heat and whisk into coconut milk mixture. Add lime juice and zest. Whisk to combine.
Pour filling into large bowl to cool, stirring constantly, to prevent mixture from setting up. When filling is warm (not hot), pour into cooled tart shell. Garnish with toasted coconut and lime zest.

recipes.name: BLACK PEPPER PASTA
recipes.description: Three ingredients—flour, eggs, and plenty of coarsely ground black pepper—come together in the food processor into a smooth, supple pasta dough, kneaded briefly and rested before rolling.
instructions: Method - Food Processor:

Pulse flour and black pepper in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Method - By Hand:
Sift flour and pepper onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: "CHEESE" MEDALLIONS (FOR SPINACH-SHIITAKE SALAD)
recipes.description: Cashews blend with lemon juice, white miso, and coconut oil into a smooth base, set with pectin and calcium water, chilled until firm, then scooped into medallions and rolled in crushed pistachios.
instructions: Combine cashews, lemon juice, miso, salt, coconut oil, and boiling water in food processor. Process for 1 minute, or until smooth, scraping down sides occasionally. Add pectin powder and pulse until combined. Stream in calcium water as engine is running.
Transfer mixture to bowl and refrigerate for 10 to 20 minutes, or until slightly firm. Scoop into medallions using retractable ice cream scoop. Roll sides in crushed pistachios.

recipes.name: BULGUR RAISIN BREAD
recipes.description: Proofed yeast and maple crystals anchor this loaf, kneaded a full ten to fifteen minutes with bulgur wheat, plump raisins, cinnamon, and allspice until the dough turns smooth and ready for two pans.

ingredients.name: bulgur wheat
ingredients.notes: soaked in water until soft and drained

ingredients.name: raisins
ingredients.notes: soaked in hot water until soft and drained

instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F. Prepare two 5 x 9 loaf pans with parchment. In medium bowl, combine water, maple crystals, and yeast. Proof for 10 minutes or until mixture is foamy.

Add salt, oil, cinnamon, allspice, vanilla, bulgur wheat, raisins, white high-gluten flour, and all-purpose flour. Then add just enough whole wheat pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough adding remaining pastry flour as needed for about 10-15 minutes or until smooth dough has been created.
Transfer dough to large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans with parchment.
Fold/turn dough. Rise again.

Divide dough into two equally sized balls. Roll each dough to a long rectangle, about 1/2-inch thick. Spread maple crystals and cinnamon over surface of dough. Roll dough lengthwise, jelly-roll style and transfer to loaf pans, seam side down.
Cover dough with wet towels and set aside in warm place. Rise until dough has doubled in size.
Bake approximately 30 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch. Internal dough temperature should be approximately 190°-205° F.
Cool bread on racks (out of pan) before serving.

recipes.name: BLACK SESAME SEED ICE CREAM
recipes.description: Black sesame seeds simmer briefly in coconut milk sweetened with maple and rice syrups; chilled over an ice bath, the mixture churns into a creamy, dramatically speckled ice cream.
instructions: Prepare ice bath. Combine coconut milk, maple syrup, rice syrup, salt, and sesame seeds in pot over high heat. When mixture boils, turn heat down and whisk for 1-2 minutes. Remove mixture from heat, and transfer pot to ice bath to cool mixture to room temperature.
Pour mixture into ice cream machine and churn until creamy and somewhat firm.

recipes.name: Hemp Coconut 'Milk' (for Golden Turmeric 'Panna Cotta')
recipes.description: Hemp seeds and full-fat coconut milk whirl together in a high-speed blender with filtered water and a pinch of sea salt, then strain through fine mesh for a rich, silky milk to sip warm or cold.
instructions: Add hemp seeds, coconut milk, water, and salt to a high-speed blender.
Blend mixture until smooth, and strain through fine mesh strainer (or nut milk bag), if finer texture is desired.
Serve warm or cold, or use in your favorite recipes. Store in refrigerator in an airtight container for 3 to 5 days.

recipes.name: FRESH ALMOND MILK
recipes.description: Just-boiled water pours over blanched almonds to steep, then everything blends until completely homogenized before a patient squeeze through cheesecloth wrings every drop of rich, creamy milk from the pulp.
instructions: In 2-gallon pot, bring water to boil, pour over blanched almonds and let sit covered for 20-30 minutes.
Transfer almonds and water to Vitamix. Blend until well homogenized.
Pour almond mixture in batches through sieve or chinois lined with double layer of rinsed cheesecloth, wringing and squeezing cheesecloth to extract as much liquid from pulp as possible.

recipes.name: CORNMEAL CRUST
recipes.description: Cornmeal, pecans, and oats grind to a fine meal, then bind with maple syrup and oil into a cookie-like dough that presses into a tart pan and bakes until firm and lightly browned.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Combine cornmeal, pecans, and oats in food processor. Grind to fine meal.

Whisk together oil, maple syrup, and sea salt. Add wet ingredients to dry in processor until cookie-like dough is formed. Press dough into lightly oiled tart pan. Bake tart 12-15 minutes or until firm and lightly browned. Cool.

recipes.name: SCRAMBLED EGGS
recipes.description: Eggs beaten until well blended and seasoned with salt and white pepper take on a small splash of milk or cream before hitting a buttered sauté pan—just enough to enrich without turning watery.
instructions: Collect equipment and food items: stainless steel bowl, whisk, spatula, sauté pan, eggs, salt, pepper, milk or cream, and butter.
Break eggs into stainless steel bowl and beat until well blended. Season with salt and white pepper. Do not use aluminum, which may discolor eggs.

If desired, add small amount of milk or cream, about 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons for 2 eggs, or 8 to 12 ounces per quart of eggs. Too much liquid may make cooked eggs watery and dilutes flavor. Heavy cream adds richness.
Heat butter in small sauté pan.
When fat is just hot enough to make drop of water sizzle, pour in eggs.

Cook over low heat, stirring gently with spatula from time to time as eggs coagulate. Lift portions of coagulated egg so that uncooked egg can run underneath. Too much stirring breaks up eggs into very small particles. Do not let eggs brown. Keep heat low.
When eggs are set but still soft and moist, remove from heat. Turn out onto plate or into steam table pan.

Additions to scrambled eggs: Flavor variations may be created by adding any of the following ingredients to scrambled eggs before serving: chopped parsley and/or other herbs; organic grated cheese (Cheddar, Swiss, parmesan); sautéed, diced onion and/or green pepper; diced smoked salmon.

recipes.name: Fresh Herb Dressing
recipes.description: An aromatic, emulsified suspension that merges the earthy groundedness of mustard and shallots with the bright, elevating airiness of fresh basil, tarragon, and dill. This versatile dressing transforms raw vegetables by aligning their elemental profiles.
instructions: In small sauce pan, reduce stock to 6 tablespoons and set aside to cool.
Combine stock with shallots, olive oil, mustard, orange juice, rice syrup and herbs in blender and puree until emulsified.

recipes.name: BROWN BEEF STOCK
recipes.description: Beef bones and mirepoix roast at 450°F until deeply browned, then simmer six to eight hours with tomatoes and a splash of wine or balsamic vinegar, concentrating into a rich, dark stock.

ingredients.name: water or enough to cover by 2 inches
white or red wine or 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar

instructions: Brown bones and vegetables by roasting first in 450° F oven. Simmer 6 to 8 hours.

recipes.name: FOCACCIA WITH HERBS
recipes.description: Built on a yeasted sponge left to double in a warm spot, this focaccia bakes on a preheated pizza stone at fierce heat, brushed with olive oil and strewn with mixed fresh herbs, sea salt, and cracked pepper.

ingredients.name: small cooked
ingredients.notes: peeled and mashed potato, room temperature

instructions: For sponge: Make sponge by mixing yeast, sweetener, water, and high-gluten flour together.
Cover sponge with plastic, transfer to warm place until doubled in size (20-30 minutes).
For dough: Preheat oven to 475°F. Place pizza stone in oven to heat up.
Incorporate into sponge mixture: potato, warm water, olive oil, salt, semolina flour, fresh herbs, and enough whole wheat bread flour to form knead-able dough.
Transfer dough to floured work surface and knead. Dough should be soft and a little sticky. Knead for about 10 minutes.
Transfer dough to oiled bowl, cover with plastic. Rise until doubled in size (30-45 minutes).
Fold and turn dough. Flatten and form focaccia on parchment-lined pizza peel. Cover with damp towel and let rise again 15-20 minutes more, or until doubled in size again.
Brush top of focaccia with olive oil and sprinkle with mixture of fresh herbs, sea salt, and fresh cracked pepper. Dimple surface with fingertips, and transfer to pizza stone. Bake 20-25 minutes.

recipes.name: SHEPHERD’S PIE
recipes.description: Browned seitan deglazed with red wine and reduced mushroom stock joins sautéed carrots, parsnips, and thyme in a blind-baked crust, all crowned with yukon gold potatoes mashed with soy milk.

ingredients.name: arrowroot dissolved in 3 teaspoons cold water

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Partially 'blind bake' pie shell (about 10 minutes) and set aside.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat olive oil. Add onion, garlic, carrots, parsnips, and fresh thyme. Sauté until slightly tender. Add couple tablespoons water to deglaze pan.
Mix together sesame oil, tamari, and mustard; stir into vegetable mixture in sauté pan. Continue to cook another 10 minutes, and transfer mixture to bowl.
In separate 10-inch sauté pan, heat olive oil, add seitan and cook until seitan is slightly browned. Add wine and continue cooking until wine is absorbed. Add seitan to bowl with cooked vegetables.

Thicken reduced stock by adding arrowroot slurry and simmering until mixture thickens. Add this mixture to bowl containing vegetables and seitan. Season mixture with salt and pepper to taste. Set aside to cool.
In 1-gallon pot, boil potatoes until tender. Drain. Process potatoes through ricer or food mill. Season with soy milk, butter or olive oil, salt and pepper. Cover and set aside.
Fill partially baked pie shell with vegetable/seitan mixture. Using pastry bag fitted with tip, pipe potato mixture onto top of pie.
Bake for about 20-25 minutes or until vegetables are fork tender and crust is fully baked. Remove from oven and garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: ASIAN SLAW
recipes.description: Crisp napa cabbage tumbles with snow peas, carrots, jalapeno, and cilantro under a creamy blended ginger dressing spiked with toasted sesame oil and brown rice vinegar, then gets a scatter of black sesame seeds.
instructions: Combine cabbage, snow peas, carrots, jalapeno, and cilantro in a medium/large bowl.
Combine dressing ingredients in blender until creamy.
Pour dressing over vegetables and mix well.
Garnish with black sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Sauce Supreme
recipes.description: Velouté sauce warms gently over a low flame before heavy cream is whisked in slowly, transforming the base into a plush, ivory finishing sauce that needs only a final adjustment of seasoning.
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat Velouté Sauce over low flame and simmer 2-3 minutes or until warmed through.
Slowly whisk in heavy cream, and mix until incorporated.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: PINE NUT RICOTTA ON TREVISO LEAVES
recipes.description: Pine nuts puree with garlic, miso, lemon juice, and umeboshi paste into a creamy ricotta-style filling, piped into crisp Treviso leaves and finished with chives, sweet peppers, and toasted pine nuts.

ingredients.name: pine nuts
ingredients.notes: soaked overnight in 2 cups water, and drained

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In food processor, puree pine nuts, garlic paste, oil, miso, lemon juice, and umeboshi paste. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer mixture to medium bowl or pastry bag with round tip.
Dollop or pipe 1 heaping tablespoon of nut filling in each Treviso leaf and garnish with chives, yellow and red peppers, and pine nuts.

recipes.name: SWEET ROOT VEGETABLE STOCK
recipes.description: Onions, carrots, parsnips, and turnips simmer with celery and a bay leaf bouquet garni for forty-five minutes, then strain into a clear, naturally sweet stock that lends gentle depth wherever it lands.

ingredients.name: bouquet garni: 2 bay leaves
ingredients.notes: 8 parsley stems, 2 sprigs thyme, 8 black peppercorns

instructions: In medium stockpot, simmer ingredients for 45 minutes. Strain.

recipes.name: Cucumber-Citrus Salsa (for Poached Salmon)
recipes.description: Spring/Summer
instructions: Combine all ingredients and adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: CHICKPEA-ARUGULA SALAD
recipes.description: Cumin-simmered chickpeas get tossed with sesame-garlic dressing while still warm so they drink it in, then join peppery arugula, olives, and plenty of fresh basil and parsley in a hearty main-course salad.

ingredients.name: bunch arugula
ingredients.notes: cleaned and chopped into bite sized pieces (5 cups)

instructions: Combine chickpeas, water, cumin, and salt in stockpot.
Bring beans to simmer, lower heat, and cook 45-60 minutes, adding water as needed, until beans are tender. Drain beans.
While beans are still warm, toss with dressing. (recipe below).
Let beans cool to room temperature and, right before service, add arugula, olives, parsley, and basil. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: SESAME-GARLIC DRESSING
recipes.description: Tahini, garlic, and lemon juice whirl with apple juice and extra virgin olive oil into a creamy blender dressing, finished with a measured hit of sea salt.
instructions: Combine all ingredients (except salt) in blender. Blend to creamy consistency. Season with sea salt.

recipes.name: POACHED PEAR TART WITH CORNMEAL CRUST
recipes.description: Pears poached in white grape juice fan out over a layer of raspberry jam in a cornmeal crust, then set beneath a glossy glaze of agar and kuzu simmered in the reserved poaching liquid.
instructions: Poach pears in grape juice until fork tender. Transfer pears to plate and chill; reserve poaching liquid.

In 2 1/2 quart pot, simmer 1 1/2 cups poaching liquid with agar flakes until agar is dissolved. Stir in kuzu slurry and cook, stirring gently, until mixture turns clear. Remove from heat, cover with lid, and set aside.
Spread layer of raspberry jam in bottom of prepared crust. Arrange sliced or fanned pears on top of jam. Top with glaze. Chill until set (about 20 minutes).
In blender, puree raspberries and maple syrup. Strain out seeds and pour into squeeze bottles. Serve with tart.

recipes.name: FISH FUMET
recipes.description: Flatfish bones sweat gently with a white mirepoix of leeks in olive oil, then simmer briefly with a bouquet garni, a splash of vinegar, and optional white wine for a delicate, clean-tasting fumet.

ingredients.name: 'white mirepoix'
ingredients.notes: 2 ounces each: white portion of leeks, celery, and parsnips

ingredients.name: brown rice or apple cider vinegar

instructions: In medium stockpot, heat oil. Add bones and mirepoix and sweat for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add 2 1/2 quarts water, bouquet garni, vinegar and wine, if using.
Bring to boil, lower heat, and simmer for 30-40 minutes.
Strain stock, pressing firmly to extract as much liquid as possible, though fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth-lined chinois.
Note: Bouquet garni is 1 bay leaf, 3 or 4 parsley stems, 1 sprig fresh thyme, 8 peppercorns.

recipes.name: SPINACH-SHIITAKE SALAD
recipes.description: Shiitake mushrooms saute until crispy and golden brown, then toss with fresh spinach, toasted pine nuts, and finely minced red onion in a sherry vinaigrette, topped with cheese medallions.
instructions: Heat oil over medium flame in 12-inch sauté pan. Add mushrooms and salt, and sauté until mushrooms are crispy and golden brown, stirring often to prevent sticking. There should be approximately 1 1/2 cups of cooked mushrooms.
Wash and dry spinach thoroughly. Transfer to large bowl and toss with mushrooms, pine nuts and onion.
Mix salad with dressing and top with 'Cheese Medallions.' Serve immediately.

recipes.name: MANGO PUREE
recipes.description: Ripe mango whirls in the blender with fresh lime juice and a drizzle of agave nectar until perfectly smooth, yielding a bright, three-ingredient puree that comes together in moments and pours like silk.
instructions: Puree mango, lime juice, and agave nectar in blender until smooth.

recipes.name: Fudgy Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: Cocoa powder and bittersweet chocolate drive this fudgy crumb, sweetened with maple syrup and maple crystals, with a splash of balsamic vinegar whisked into the almond milk batter before it bakes in a cocoa-dusted pan.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection). Oil one 8-inch cake pan. Dust pan with 2 teaspoons of cocoa powder. Line bottom of pan with parchment paper.
Sift together dry ingredients in medium bowl and whisk to combine. Set aside.
In separate bowl, whisk together wet ingredients and pour into dry. Mix well.
Add finely chopped chocolate and mix to combine. Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake 35-40 minutes until cake is springy to touch and pulls away from sides.
Cool in pan on wire rack 10-15 minutes. Remove from pan and completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: CREAM OF MUSHROOM SOUP WITH ROUX
recipes.description: Cremini mushrooms and shallots sweat until tender, deglazed with sherry reduced nearly dry, then oat flour and stock build a silky body that simmers thirty minutes before the soup purees until creamy.

ingredients.name: salt and pinch freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil on medium flame. Sweat shallots and mushrooms with salt until tender, about 10-12 minutes. Add sherry, reducing until almost dry. Add flour, and stir 5 to 7 minutes.
Add stock, 1 cup at a time, whisking to blend. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat, and simmer, with lid ajar, for 30 minutes.
Puree soup in blender until creamy.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE PEAR-CARDAMOM QUICK BREAD
recipes.description: Ripe pear and walnuts fold into a batter fragrant with ground cardamom and cinnamon, sweetened with maple crystals and whisked together in minutes before baking into a tender gluten-free quick bread.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and cardamom.
In separate bowl, whisk together egg, maple crystals, canola oil, and vanilla extract. Add wet ingredients to dry and stir to combine. Add pears and walnuts and divide batter between muffin molds.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
Let bread cool in pan for 10 minutes before removing to wire rack to finish cooling.

recipes.name: SWEET POTATO PECAN PIE
recipes.description: Yams blend velvety in the food processor with maple crystals, kuzu, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves, then fill a chilled pie crust destined for a pecan topping bound with maple and rice syrups.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Roll out pie dough and line pie plate. After dough has rested in refrigerator for 15 minutes, trim and form edges, cover and chill for another 30 minutes.
In bowl of food processor, combine yams, maple crystals, kuzu and soymilk, oil, spices, and extracts. Process until well blended, scraping sides of bowl often.

In 2 1/2 quart pot, over medium heat, bring agar and water to boil. Reduce heat, cover, and cook until agar is dissolved. Add agar mixture to yam mixture in food processor and blend for 1-2 minutes. Set aside.
Combine maple syrup and rice syrup and set aside.
Pour filling into pie shell. Arrange pecans on top of filling and drizzle syrup mixture over top of pie.
Loosely cover crust with tented foil to keep edges from browning too quickly.
Bake for 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean and crust is firm. Remove foil from edges 10 minutes before removing from oven.
Cool pie to set filling before serving (about 30 minutes).

recipes.name: CHICKPEA CRÊPES
recipes.description: Vegan

ingredients.name: olive oil or coconut oil
ingredients.notes: or infused oil; plus more for pan

instructions: In bowl, whisk together flours with salt and pepper.
Add water, herbs and oil to flour mixture and beat with whisk until smooth. (May also be processed in blender.)
Let batter rest at least 30 minutes.

Prepare crêpe pan by oiling lightly. Pour 1/4 cup of batter into pan, tipping pan so batter thins to about 6-inch circle. Cook 30 seconds, until crêpe is golden brown on bottom. Flip, cook another 30 seconds.
If necessary, thin batter with more water to maintain consistency of light cream.

recipes.name: SAUCE ESPAGNOLE (BROWN SAUCE)
recipes.description: Onions, carrots, and celery sauté until golden, tomatoes caramelize alongside them, and brown stock simmers it all into a classic sauce espagnole, thickened with brown roux and seasoned with sea salt and pepper.

ingredients.name: brown roux
ingredients.notes: 2 ounces flour + 1.5 ounces olive oil; cooled

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onions, carrots, and celery until golden.
Add tomatoes and sauté for few minutes longer or until slightly caramelized.
Add 7 cups stock and bring to boil. Lower heat to simmer.
Slowly whisk remaining cup of warmed stock with cooled roux.
Slowly add roux-stock mixture back into sauce.
Simmer uncovered about 30 minutes or until reduced by half and nappé is achieved.
Strain through chinois. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: HOT WINGS WITH STILTON-YOGURT DRESSING
recipes.description: Chicken wings shake through a spiced flour of paprika, cayenne, and thyme before roasting hot at 400 degrees, then meet a buttery maple-hot sauce glaze and a cooling dressing of strained yogurt and crumbled Stilton.
instructions: Preheat convection oven to 400°F.
In medium bowl, combine flour, paprika, garlic powder, thyme, pepper, cayenne, and salt.
Toss wings in canola oil, then flour-spice mixture, and shake off excess.
Transfer wings to baker’s rack atop half sheet tray and roast for 15 minutes. Flip wings and roast an additional 15 minutes.
Melt butter and combine with Tabasco and maple syrup in medium bowl.
Add cooked wings to hot sauce-butter mixture and toss to coat.
Combine strained yogurt and cheese. Mix thoroughly. Serve with wings.

recipes.name: Green Cabbage Sauerkraut with Ginger and Turmeric
recipes.description: Green cabbage massaged with sea salt releases its own briny liquid, then packs tightly into a jar with ginger and turmeric to ferment beneath the brine into a golden, tangy sauerkraut.

ingredients.name: green cabbage
ingredients.notes: about 2 pounds; quartered, core removed and thinly sliced

instructions: Place cabbage in large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Squeeze and massage cabbage to release water. Continue to massage and squeeze until enough liquid has been released to create salty brine that covers cabbage by 1/4 inch. Add ginger and turmeric.

Pack tightly into 2 quart wide-mouthed glass jar or ceramic crock (liquid brine must be above cabbage for healthy successful fermentation). If cabbage has not released enough juices to cover, add salted water to jar/crock in a ratio of 1 teaspoon sea salt per 1 cup water.

Place plate or discover cabbage and press down to squeeze more brine to the surface. Cover mouth of vessel with cheesecloth and secure to rim of lid with kitchen twine, rubber band, OR if using airlock lid, fill airlock and secure lid.

Store sauerkraut in dry place for 2 - 4 weeks at room temperature. Be sure to check water level, adding more salt water as needed to ensure the mixture is covered throughout fermentation process. Taste every few days and eat or refrigerate when desired tangy flavor is achieved.
Note: A cooler fermentation area will result in a slower fermentation with complex flavor notes. A warmer area will result in a faster fermentation that may lead to off flavors and cloudy brine.

recipes.name: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
recipes.description: Butter and maple crystals cream together into a tender batter enriched with eggs, sour cream, and vanilla, layered with a cinnamon-pecan filling and baked in a deep Bundt mold.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Grease a deep 9-inch Bundt mold with butter and dust with flour. Set aside.
In bowl, stir together the filling mixture until well mixed and set aside.
In stand mixer, cream butter and maple crystals. Add eggs one at a time, and beat until well incorporated. Add sour cream and mix until batter is smooth. Add vanilla.
Sift together flour, salt, and baking soda. Add dry ingredients to wet in stand mixer, and mix until batter is smooth.
Pour batter in prepared cake pan. Sprinkle crumble mixture over batter. Pour remainder of batter atop filling.
Bake cake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick or skewer inserted in cake comes out smooth.
Let cake sit in pan for approximately 15 minutes before unmolding onto cooling rack. Cook cake completely before slicing.

recipes.name: GRILLED CHICKEN TENDERS WITH PEANUT SAUCE
recipes.description: Chicken tenders soak for 45 minutes in a marinade of sesame oil, tamari, and mirin spiked with red pepper flakes, then get threaded onto soaked skewers and seared on a cast iron griddle grill, ready for dipping in peanut sauce.
instructions: Soak 8 wooden skewers in bowl of water to prevent burning on grill.
In medium-size bowl, whisk together sesame oil, tamari, mirin, and red pepper flakes. Add tenders to mixture and marinate for 45 minutes.
Heat cast iron griddle grill over medium heat.
Thread tenders on skewers. Depending on size, use one or two tenders per skewer. Discard marinade.
Grill tenders each side about 4 minutes or until chicken has grill marks and is opaque in appearance. Serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.name: CUCUMBER-DULSE SALAD
recipes.description: Salted kirby cucumber rounds rest for half an hour to draw out moisture, then toss with softened, finely chopped dulse in a punchy dressing of rice vinegar, minced garlic, stone-ground mustard, and olive oil.
instructions: Score skin of cucumbers along length with peeler or zester. Slice thinly into rounds and sprinkle with salt. Set aside for 30 minutes. Rinse, if too salty.
Quickly rinse dulse in bowl of cold water, until softened. Squeeze excess liquid out. Finely chop dulse.
Combine dulse and cucumbers in medium bowl. Mix well.
In small bowl, whisk, rice vinegar, garlic, and mustard. Slowly drizzle in olive oil and whisk to combine. Pour dressing over vegetables. Let marinate 15-30 minutes.

recipes.name: CURRY STOCK
recipes.description: Carrots, onions, and celery sweat in coconut oil with cinnamon, cumin, coriander, and cardamom, then simmer in filtered water and strain into a golden, spice-perfumed stock ready to anchor any curry.
instructions: In 1-gallon stockpot, heat oil OR ghee. Add vegetables, herbs, spices, and salt.
Sweat for 15-20 minutes. Add 4 quarts filtered water.
Bring to boil, covered, lower heat and simmer 30 minutes, uncovered. Strain stock through chinois.

recipes.name: Berry Sorbet
recipes.description: Strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries are pureed with white grape juice and a splash of vodka, strained silky-smooth, sweetened with maple syrup, then churned in an ice cream machine until frozen and scoopable.
instructions: In blender, puree berries with grape juice, vodka, and lime juice.
Strain puree through fine sieve to remove seeds. Add maple syrup to taste.
Transfer berry mixture to ice cream machine and process until frozen.

recipes.name: Chocolate Fondue
recipes.description: Cocoa and maple syrup come to a gentle simmer with vanilla and orange extracts, cooked briefly and carefully so the chocolate never scorches, then finished off the heat with soy milk stirred in until the sauce reaches nappé.
instructions: In small saucepan, combine cocoa, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and orange extract, stirring until well combined.
Cover pot and gently bring to simmer. Lower heat and cook for 1-2 minutes, being careful not to burn chocolate.
Remove from heat and stir in soy milk until sauce has nappé.

recipes.name: Ginger Marinade
recipes.description: Sliced fresh ginger anchors this quick blender marinade, pureed smooth with shoyu, tomato paste, red wine vinegar, garlic, dry oregano, lemon juice, and olive oil into one punchy, deeply savory coating.
instructions: Combine ingredients in blender and puree.

recipes.name: LEMON WHIPPED COCONUT CREAM
recipes.description: Coconut milk and coconut cream simmer with agar until fully dissolved, then blend silky-smooth with agave syrup, lemon zest, and lemon juice, with coconut butter streamed in last for a rich, whippable citrus cream.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk, agar, and coconut cream. Set aside for at least 5 minutes.
Prepare ice bath. Bring coconut mixture to simmer constantly stirring until all the agar is dissolved.
In Vitamix, combine coconut mixture, agave syrup, lemon zest, lemon juice, and salt. Blend until smooth. Slowly add coconut butter and blend to combine.
Transfer to bowl and set over ice bath until chilled.
Process frosting in food processor until smooth.

recipes.name: Lemon Soy Cream Frosting
recipes.description: Firm tofu is pureed with maple crystals and melted coconut oil until utterly creamy, then a hot apple juice and agar mixture is drizzled in while the processor runs, setting up a lemon-zested frosting that holds its shape.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine juice, agar flakes, and salt. Let sit for 5 minutes. Simmer mixture until agar is fully dissolved, about 10 minutes.
In food processor, puree tofu with maple crystals until very creamy. Add maple syrup, oil, and extracts, and process until very smooth.
Slowly, with processor running, drizzle hot juice-agar mixture into tofu mixture. Fold in zest.
Transfer frosting to medium bowl and refrigerate to set up.

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE-ALMOND GANACHE
recipes.description: Boiling almond milk pours over bittersweet chocolate and is whisked vigorously until the mixture turns glossy and completely smooth, yielding a two-ingredient dairy-free ganache that cools to a rich, spreadable sheen.
instructions: Place chocolate in medium bowl.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring almond milk to boil and pour over chocolate, whisking vigorously, until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth.
Let ganache cool to room temperature.
Beat with stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment for several minutes, until ganache becomes lighter and somewhat thicker.
Chill ganache in refrigerator until it acquires spreadable consistency.
Variation: Add 1/4 to 1 teaspoon flavored extract to finished ganache.

recipes.name: HIZIKI WITH CARROTS, ONIONS, AND AGÉ TOFU
recipes.description: Golden-fried tofu joins hiziki sea vegetable in a simmer of apple juice, carrots, and onions seasoned with shoyu and toasted sesame oil, cooking down until the liquid vanishes, then topped with white sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: 1/2 block; pressed, cut into 1/2 inch slabs, then 1/2 inch strips

ingredients.name: loosely packed hiziki
ingredients.notes: .05 ounces; soaked 30 minutes in water to cover, drained, set aside

instructions: Heat oil to 375°F in 2 1/2 quart pot. Line plate with paper towel. Fry tofu in batches until golden. Drain on paper towel.
Combine hiziki in separate 2 1/2 quart pot with apple juice and water. Bring to boil. Add carrots, onion, fried tofu, toasted sesame oil, and shoyu. Simmer 30 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
Garnish with sesame seeds before serving.

recipes.name: GRAPEFRUIT-CAMPARI GRANITA
recipes.description: Grapefruit juice simmers with maple crystals until they dissolve, takes a pour of Campari, then freezes in a shallow pan, scraped with a fork every half hour into glittering, bittersweet ice crystals.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, over low flame, simmer juice with water and maple crystals until maple crystals dissolve. Add Campari and stir.
Pour mixture into half hotel pan (mixture should be 1/4 inch up side of pan) and transfer to freezer for about 1 hour.
Remove pan from freezer and use fork to scrape any ice crystals that have formed on side or bottom of pan. Return to freezer and repeat scraping every 30 minutes for 3-4 hours.
Once mixture is thoroughly frozen, scrape once more with fork, returning granita to “dry” in freezer for another half hour before serving.

recipes.name: Red Lentil and Toasted Sunflower Burger
recipes.description: Red lentils and pressure-cooked brown rice bind with ground toasted sunflower seeds and a sauté of broccoli stalks, carrot, and celery, seasoned with chili powder and cumin for hearty oven-finished burgers.

ingredients.name: sunflower seeds toasted and ground in food processor

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In pressure cooker, dry roast rice until it has nutty aroma. Add water and pinch of salt. Bring rice to pressure for 30 minutes. Bring pressure down, and drain rice in colander.

While rice cooks, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in 10-inch sauté pan on medium-low heat. Add onions and garlic; sweat for 2-3 minutes. Add sunflower seeds, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Add broccoli stalks, carrots, and celery and sauté for 3 minutes more.
Combine vegetables with rice in food processor. Pulse until mixture becomes slightly sticky and binding. Set rice-vegetable mixture aside in bowl.

Combine lentils in 2-quart pot with 4 cups water and pinch of salt. Bring to boil, reduce to simmer, and cook for 15 minutes or until lentils are soft. Drain lentils in colander for 5 minutes and transfer to bowl with rice-vegetable mixture.
When mixture is cool, add parsley and kuzu. Mix all ingredients well with gloved hands. Form patties using 1/2 cup measure.
Lightly spray or brush 10-inch non-stick pan with olive oil. Brown patties on each side over medium heat and return to parchment-lined sheet pan. Heat patties in oven for 15 more minutes.
Serve with Fresh Ketchup (recipe following).

recipes.name: CARROT ONION STOCK
recipes.description: Onions, carrots, celery, and shallots are sweated in olive oil, then simmered gently with a thyme-and-bay bouquet garni before being strained through a chinois for a clean, sweet vegetable stock.
instructions: In 3-gallon stockpot, heat oil. Add vegetables and sweat.
Add water to cover (7-8 quarts) and bouquet garni. Bring to boil and skim off foam. Simmer, partially covered, for 1 - 1 1/2 hours. Strain immediately through chinois.

recipes.name: Fresh Curry Sauce
recipes.description: Coconut milk simmers gently—never boiling—with whole cumin, coriander, cardamom, jalapeno, and turmeric until nappé-thick, then gets strained and brightened with ginger and lime juices.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk with cumin seeds, coriander seeds, cloves, cardamom pods, shallots, jalapeno, turmeric, and salt. Simmer on low flame 15-20 minutes or until sauce is thickened to nappé consistency. Do not allow sauce to boil at any time.
Strain vegetables and spices from sauce, and return sauce to pot.
Add ginger and lime juices. Season to taste.

recipes.name: Raspberry Sauce (for Almond Fruit Tart)
recipes.description: Frozen raspberries puree with a hot maple-crystal syrup, then the thick mixture presses slowly through a fine mesh strainer, emerging as a smooth, seedless sauce spiked with grand marnier.
instructions: Combine maple crystals and water in a pot and stir until dissolved.
Combine frozen raspberries and hot syrup in a food processor. Pulse a few times till pureed.

Pour puree through a fine mesh strainer set over a medium-size bowl. Stir and push on the solids with the back of a rubber spatula until all of the liquid has been extracted. This will take several minutes as the mixture will be thick.
Discard the seeds. Add the liqueur, if using, and stir to combine.

recipes.name: Apple Phyllo Roll
recipes.description: Thin-sliced Fuji apples saute in coconut oil with coconut sugar and cinnamon until tender, then roll up with walnuts in delicate phyllo sheets and bake in a hot conventional oven.

ingredients.name: coconut sugar
ingredients.notes: buzzed to powder in coffee grinder

ingredients.name: walnuts
ingredients.notes: oven-roasted and ground in food processor to breadcrumb texture

instructions: Preheat conventional oven to 400°F (convection oven will dry phyllo too much).
Prepare large bowl of water and add lemon juice. Peel, core, and thinly slice apples to 1/8-inch thickness and transfer them to lemon water to prevent browning.

Drain apples in colander. In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Add apples, coconut sugar, and cinnamon. Sauté apples on medium heat until they release most of their moisture and become tender, stirring frequently. Transfer apples to bowl to cool.

Unroll phyllo on work surface and cover with damp cloth. To assemble, lay one sheet of phyllo on parchment paper horizontally. Brush sheet with oil and sprinkle lightly with small amount of walnuts. Repeat process, stacking and brushing another 3 sheets.

Spoon apple mixture horizontally along bottom of phyllo, leaving 1-inch border on bottom and 2 inches on left and right side. Fold in left and right sides over filling, then roll phyllo from bottom to top to form log. Repeat steps 5-7 for the second phyllo roll.
Score both rolls halfway through on bias into 8 equal portions. Brush roll with remaining oil.
Transfer rolls to parchment-lined sheet tray and bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden.
Cool ten minutes, then slice all the way through pre-scored cuts. Serve with Lemon and Maple-Flavored Yogurt (recipe below).

recipes.name: Indian-Style Seitan Kebabs with Mango Coulis
recipes.description: Grilled seitan cubes roast in a bold puree of dried mango, tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, fennel, and turmeric until the sauce clings, then pair with purple pearl onions and a fresh mango-cilantro coulis.

ingredients.name: dried mango
ingredients.notes: soaked in 1 cup boiling water until soft (drain and reserve soaking liquid)

ingredients.name: chopped fresh mango
ingredients.notes: excess from mango pit and unused mango from skewers

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Heat griddle grill. Toss seitan with oil in small bowl. Grill seitan on all sides and set aside. When cool, cut seitan into 1/2-inch pieces (approximately 50). Set aside.

In food processor, puree mango, tomato paste, agave, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, smoked paprika, cumin, fennel, turmeric, and salt, adding apple juice a bit at a time. Mixture should have thick, sauce-like consistency. If more liquid is needed, use reserved mango soaking liquid.
Transfer sauce from food processor to half-hotel pan. Add seitan and roast in oven approximately 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until much of sauce is absorbed.

In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring 1 quart water to boil with 1/2 teaspoon sea salt. Prepare an ice bath. Blanch pearl onions for one minute, shock in ice water, and drain. Remove onion skins and toss onions in small bowl with vinegar. Grill pearl onions until slightly charred. Set aside.
Dice mango into 25-30 half-inch pieces. Reserve mango scraped from pit and other unused cubes for mango coulis.
Place seitan on skewer followed by red onion and mango. Repeat sequence, finishing with one more piece of seitan, mango, and pearl onion.
Transfer leftover mango meat to blender. Add pinch of sea salt and splash of hot sauce. Blend mango mixture with leftover dried mango soaking liquid until smooth consistency is achieved.
Reheat skewers on sheet tray in oven and garnish with mango coulis and cilantro.

recipes.name: Olive Bread
recipes.description: Chopped olives and olive oil enrich a yeasted dough sweetened with warm maple syrup, kneaded a full ten to fifteen minutes until smooth and baked in a blazing 475-degree oven for a sturdy, savory loaf.
instructions: Preheat oven to 475°F. In small bowl, combine water, maple syrup, and yeast. Allow mixture to sit about 10 minutes until is foamy.
Add oil, olives, salt, bread flour, and just enough pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough on table about 10-15 minutes, using remaining pastry flour, until smooth dough has been created.
Place dough in large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in a warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans with parchment.

Punch down dough. If time permits, place dough back in bowl, rise, and punch down 1 to 2 times more. Divide dough into two equal portions. Form dough into loaves and place in prepared loaf pans or on sheet trays for final rise.
Loosely cover dough with damp towel and set aside in warm place. Allow to rise for about 40 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
Bake bread approximately 30 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch. Internal dough temperature should register approximately 190° - 205°.

recipes.name: APPLE CRUMB PIE
recipes.description: Maple syrup and oil work into whole wheat and white flours for small, moist crumbs, blanketing apples tossed with lemon juice, cinnamon, and allspice inside a chilled, hand-rolled crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Roll out pie dough and line pie plate. Trim and form edges, cover, and chill for at least 30 minutes.

In small bowl, whisk together flours. In separate bowl, whisk together oil and maple syrup. Slowly drizzle oil and maple syrup mixture into flour mixture. Stir lightly to form small, moist crumbs. Cover and chill.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Add apple slices and sauté until apples are slightly softened. Set aside to partially cool.
In large bowl, combine apples, maple syrup, lemon juice, vanilla, spices, salt, and flour. Toss until apples are well coated.
Place filling in pie shell. Top with crumbs. Loosely cover crust with tented foil to keep edges from browning too quickly.
Bake pie for 40-45 minutes or until apples are tender and crust is firm. Remove foil 10 minutes before removing pie from oven.
Cool pie before serving.

recipes.name: Pan-Fried Tempeh
recipes.description: Thin diagonal slabs of tempeh soak up a shoyu marinade laced with garlic, ginger, and bay leaf before meeting a hot pan slicked with olive oil to fry into savory, deeply seasoned slices.
instructions: In sauce pan, combine marinade ingredients.
Slice tempeh into diagonal slabs about 1/4 inch thick.
Combine tempeh with marinade.
Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes.
In colander, drain marinade from tempeh.

In sauté pan, heat enough olive oil to cover bottom half of tempeh slabs. Prepare a plate with paper towels for draining. Pan-fry tempeh on both sides until golden. If broiling, brush tempeh with olive oil and broil on both sides.
Drain cooked tempeh slices before serving.

recipes.name: Seitan Bordelaise
recipes.description: Flour-dredged seitan sears to a light caramel crust, then simmers with red wine, vegetable stock, shiitake mushrooms, and caramelized shallots until the sauce reduces to a glossy nappé consistency.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Dredge seitan in flour and shake off any excess.
In 10-inch sauté pan over medium-high flame, heat oil and sear seitan until lightly caramelized on both sides. Remove seitan from pan and set aside. Add shallots to pan and sauté until caramelized.
Add seitan back to pan with stock, red wine, shiitake mushrooms, and thyme. Simmer until liquid is reduced to nappé consistency.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Note: Can replace red wine with Marsala wine.

recipes.name: CHICKPEA CRÊPES WITH CURRIED CHICKPEAS, VEGETABLES & MANGO SAUCE
recipes.description: Warm chickpea crêpes are rolled around a generous curried chickpea and vegetable filling, then finished with a bright mango sauce for a tidy, satisfying handheld main.
instructions: Chickpea Crêpe (recipe below):
In large bowl, sift flours, salt, and pepper.
Add water, herbs and oil to flour mixture and blend with whisk until smooth. (May also be processed in blender.)
Let batter rest at room temperature at least 30 minutes. If necessary, thin batter with more water to maintain consistency of light cream.

Prepare crêpe pan by oiling lightly. Pour approximately 1/4 cup of batter into pan, tipping pan so batter thins covers pan. Cook 30 seconds, until crêpe is golden brown on bottom. Flip, cook another 30 seconds.
Curried Chickpea Filling (recipe follows):
In pressure cooker, combine chickpeas, water, cumin, salt, and bay leaves.
Bring pot to pressure, lower heat, and cook 30 minutes. Drain beans, set aside, and reserve bean liquid if using in place of stock.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Add onions. Lower heat and cook until onions begin to soften and become translucent. Add curry. Cook 2-3 minutes more.
Add carrots and potatoes, stirring often to prevent sticking. Cook 5-6 minutes. Add garlic and salt. Cook 2-3 minutes more. Add stock or bean liquid reserved from chickpeas.

Add coconut milk and chickpeas. Simmer 3-4 minutes more. Add spinach. Cook until spinach becomes tender (about 1-2 minutes). Adjust seasonings. If mixture looks too thick, add bit more stock or bean liquid.
Mango Sauce, for garnish (recipe follows):
In blender, combine mango, tomatoes, tomato juices, shallot, canola oil, lime juice, and salt. Blend until creamy.
Adjust seasonings. Garnish sauce with jalapeño and cilantro.

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE GELATO
recipes.description: Milk and heavy cream heat gently with maple crystals until they dissolve, then cocoa powder and bittersweet chocolate whisk in for a deeply dark gelato base enriched with egg yolks, Kahlua, and vanilla.
instructions: Prepare ice bath.
In 1-gallon pot, heat milk, heavy cream, and 3/4 cup of maple crystals until crystals dissolve and milk starts to simmer.
Whisk in cocoa powder and bittersweet chocolate. Set aside.
Combine egg yolks and remaining 3/4 cup of maple crystals in electric mixer fitted with paddle attachment. Beat on high speed for 3-5 minutes or until mixtures lightens in color and mixture thickens.
Lower speed on mixer and slowly pour chocolate-cream mixture into egg mixture.
Transfer combined mixtures to 2 1/2 quart saucepan and simmer over low heat stirring constantly until thickened (candy thermometer should read at about 180 degrees). Do not bring mixture to boil.
Strain mixture into medium bowl through nut bag or chinois lined with double layer of moistened cheesecloth, and then stir in Kahlua, vanilla, and salt.
Transfer mixture to ice bath and cool to room temperature.
Pour mixture into ice cream machine and churn until firm and scoop-able.

recipes.name: ARAME STRUDEL
recipes.description: Arame simmers with shoyu, brown rice syrup, and mirin until glossy and nearly dry, then joins sautéed carrots and onion inside sheets of sesame-brushed phyllo, rolled snugly into logs and scored before baking.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In large sauté pan, sauté arame in 2-3 tablespoons sesame oil for 3 to 5 minutes. Add water to pan (arame should be three-quarters covered), and bring to boil. Reduce heat to simmer and cook until liquid is evaporated. Stir in shoyu, brown rice syrup, and mirin. Reduce until arame is dry. Add ginger juice. Set aside.
In another medium pan, sauté carrots, onion, and sea salt in 1 tablespoon sesame oil until carrots and onions are tender, approximately 10-12 minutes. Set aside.

On a sheet of parchment paper, stack 3 sheets of phyllo, brushing each individual layer lightly with remaining sesame oil. Spoon 1-inch wide strip of arame mixture and carrot mixture horizontally onto near end of phyllo. Using the parchment paper, firmly roll strudel forward into a log. Score rolled log diagonally at 2-inch intervals across its length. Repeat this process using remaining phyllo, arame, and carrot/onion mixture until all mixture and phyllo is used up.
Transfer strudels to sheet pan; brush their tops with sesame oil, and bake approximately 20 minutes, until deeply golden. When cool, slice strudel into individual servings.

recipes.name: ALMOND-OAT CRUST (FOR ALMOND-FRUIT TART)
recipes.description: Blanched almonds, rolled oats, and oat flour are ground to a fine meal, then bound with an emulsion of maple syrup and melted coconut oil to form a nutty press-in crust for an almond-fruit tart.

ingredients.name: melted coconut oil or melted butter

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil 9-inch tart pan and line with parchment paper or use 5-6 four-inch, non-stick paper tart pans.
In food processor, grind almonds, oats, and oat flour together until pulverized to fine meal.
In small bowl, combine maple syrup, salt, and oil or butter. Whisk until emulsified.
Pour maple-oil mixture into food processor, pulsing to form cohesive dough. If dough is too moist to work with, transfer to fridge for 5-10 minutes.
Using fingers, press dough evenly into prepared pan. Blind bake with pie weights to prevent crust from puffing up. Bake 15-20 minutes or until edges of crust are browned. Set aside to cool.

recipes.name: TOFU TERIYAKI
recipes.description: Pressed firm tofu sears in coconut oil until golden on both sides, then simmers in teriyaki sauce over high heat until the glaze turns thick and syrupy, clinging to every slab.
instructions: Slice tofu in half horizontally. Place tofu on plate between paper towels and weigh down for 20-30 minutes to extract water. Slice pressed tofu into 1/2 inch slabs.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium to medium-high heat and sear tofu slices until golden on both sides.
Drain any excess oil. Add teriyaki sauce to tofu and reduce over high heat until sauce is syrupy (about 15 minutes).

recipes.name: Stuffed Squid, Sicilian Style
recipes.description: Tender squid bodies hold a sauté of shrimp, chopped tentacles, breadcrumbs, kalamata olives, currants, capers, and mint, deglazed with white wine and destined for a bath of tomato puree and shrimp stock — a Sicilian-style showpiece.
instructions: Remove tentacles from squid, chop finely and set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high flame. When oil is hot, add peppers. Sauté until just tender, lower heat slightly, and add garlic, shrimp, and squid tentacles. Cook until shrimp is opaque. Deglaze pan with wine.
Place shrimp mixture into medium bowl. Let cool.
Add breadcrumbs, mint, olives, currants, capers and lemon juice to bowl with shrimp mixture.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Stuff squid bodies with mixture. Make sure not to overstuff as mixture expands during cooking. Use about 3 tablespoons per squid body. Secure squid body opening with one or two toothpicks. Place in pan large enough to accommodate squid in one even layer.
Add wine, stock, tomato puree, bay leaves and salt. Cover pan and turn heat to low.
Simmer until squid is tender, about 40-50 minutes. At 20-minute mark, turn squid over.
Remove from pan. Garnish with mint and lemon slices.
Note: Great served at room temperature as antipasti selection or warm with sautéed Italian bitter greens.
Note: While stuffing squid, it is good idea to dip your hands into bowl of cold water, as mixture can be sticky.

recipes.name: BASIC SEITAN RECIPE
recipes.description: Whole wheat and white bread flours are kneaded a full fifteen minutes to develop springy gluten, then the dough simmers in a savory stock of shoyu, ginger, garlic, and kombu.

ingredients.name: extra white bread flour for kneading

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine water, shoyu, ginger, garlic, bay leaf, and kombu. Bring stock to boil, reduce to simmer, and cover.
Combine flours in large mixing bowl, stirring well. Pour in water gradually, stirring to form dough that comes together in a ball. Add only enough water until dough is kneadable consistency.
Knead dough well to thoroughly and evenly develop gluten, about 15 minutes. Add extra flour if dough gets too sticky.
Cover dough with cold water in bowl and keep submerged for at least 30 minutes. Dough can be stored in refrigerator overnight and rinsed next day. As dough rests, gluten continues to develop.
Transfer dough from bowl to colander and place in sink. Under warm running water, carefully knead dough, rinsing out starch and bran. Water will become milky as starch comes out.

At a certain point, it will seem as though dough is falling apart. After several minutes of rinsing and kneading, however, gluten will start to tighten again. Continue to knead dough until it has firm, tight, and rubbery texture.
Pull pieces of gluten into small billiard-size balls. Drop gluten into stock, one piece at a time, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking.
Simmer seitan for 1 ½ to 2 hours, depending on size of pieces.
For improved flavor and firmer texture, cool seitan to room temperature in broth. Store in refrigerator, submerged in broth, or freeze.
Note: The amount of shoyu added to broth depends on how and if stock will be used in recipes. If planning to reduce broth as part of a sauce, do not make it too salty.

recipes.name: ASIAN BUCKWHEAT NOODLE SALAD
recipes.description: Shiitake mushrooms simmer in a glaze of tamari, brown rice vinegar, and rice syrup finished with toasted sesame oil, then toss with buckwheat noodles and fan out over cucumber with scallions and sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: buckwheat noodles
ingredients.notes: soba; boiled, rinsed in cold water, drained

instructions: In 2-quart saucepan, combine mushrooms, vinegar, tamari, water, and rice syrup. Bring mixture to boil; reduce heat, and simmer uncovered 3-5 minutes or until mixture slightly thickens. Add carrots and simmer another 30 seconds. Whisk in sesame oil.
Combine vegetables with pasta and toss to combine.
Fan cucumbers around plate, top with noodle salad, and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: SWEET CRANBERRY TART
recipes.description: Cranberries simmer with maple syrup and currants until every berry pops, then set glossy with agar and a kuzu-orange slurry before being poured with walnuts into a blind-baked tart shell and chilled until sliceable.

ingredients.name: kuzu dissolved in 1/3 cup orange juice

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, mix cranberries, maple syrup, and currants. Bring mixture to boil, reduce to simmer, and cook until all cranberries have popped.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring apple juice and agar to boil. Reduce heat and cook until agar is dissolved. Stir into cranberry mixture.
Mix together kuzu/orange juice slurry and orange zest. Stir kuzu slurry into cranberry mixture and cook until mixture is clear. Remove from heat and add walnuts. Chill to cool.
Spoon filling into baked tart shell and chill to set.

recipes.name: Mint-Chocolate Ganache Truffles
recipes.description: Coconut milk comes to a simmer with sea salt, melts into finely chopped semisweet chocolate with a hit of peppermint extract, then chills firm in the freezer for scooping into glossy ganache truffles.
instructions: Bring coconut milk and salt to simmer in 2-quart pot.
Remove coconut milk from heat. Add chocolate and mint extract. Stir with spatula until smooth.
Pour chocolate mixture into shallow baking pan and chill in freezer for 30 minutes, or until firm enough to scoop.
Form 1-inch diameter truffles using small half-ounce scoop or teaspoon.
Return truffles to freezer to firm.
Dip truffles in Chocolate Coating (recipe following). Serve truffles at room temperature.

recipes.name: APRICOT-PAPAYA PUREE
recipes.description: Dried unsulphured apricots and ripe papaya spin together in a high-speed blender, a splash of soaking water loosening them into a silky, concentrated puree of deep, jammy fruit flavor.

ingredients.name: dried unsulphured apricots
ingredients.notes: soaked in boiling water until soft (about 5 minutes)

instructions: In high-speed blender, blend apricots with papaya, adding a bit of soaking water if necessary to form smooth puree.

recipes.name: RICE PILAF
recipes.description: Onions sweat gently in olive oil before long grain brown rice is stirred in to coat, then vegetable stock, thyme, and bay leaves simmer everything low and slow, finishing with a covered steam for tender grains.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil and sweat onions until translucent.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil.

Add stock, salt, pepper, and thyme. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 45 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Remove from heat and keep covered to steam for at least another 15 minutes. Garnish with fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Raspberry Shortbread Linzer Cookies
recipes.description: Cold butter creamed fluffy with maple crystals binds a cashew-studded dough of all-purpose and whole wheat pastry flours, chilled until firm and destined for a jammy filling of raspberry preserves.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Line two half-sheet trays with parchment paper.
In stand mixer, cream butter and maple crystals together until fluffy.

Whisk together flours and arrowroot in separate medium bowl. Slowly sift flour mixture into butter mixture while continuing to mix until well combined. Add cashews and continue to mix until incorporated. Divide dough equally into 2 and wrap each piece in plastic. Chill in refrigerator for 15-20 minutes, until dough firms.

Roll out both doughs to about 1/8” thickness. Freeze dough until hard. Cut dough with lightly floured cookie cutters. For each cookie, cut solid bottom and mate with center cut out using smaller cutter. Continue process until all dough is used.

Place cookies on 2 sheet trays (bottoms on one tray and tops with centers cut out on other). Bake about 5-6 minutes and rotate pans. Continue to bake until edges are lightly browned. Remove from pans and cool on racks.

When cool, spread 1 tablespoon preserves on solid cookie bottom. Lightly sprinkle cookie tops (with holes) with powdered sugar, if using. Carefully press top cookie with hole on jam-topped bottom. Continue process until all cookies are assembled.

recipes.name: Homemade Tofu
