recipes.description: Made from scratch with just soybeans, water, and nigari, this tofu starts with a fresh blender puree brought to a boil while stirring constantly, then set in a cheesecloth-lined wooden mold for clean, delicate curds.

ingredients.name: nigari or 1/2 cup lemon juice or 1/2 cup vinegar

instructions: Line wooden tofu mold with 2 layers of wet cheesecloth. Set aside.
Heat 7 1/2 cups water in a 2-gallon pot over medium-high heat.
Puree soybeans in 2 batches with 6 cups cold water in blender (about 2 minutes per batch). Add puree to pot with heating water. Stirring constantly, bring contents of pot to boil.

Strain soybean-water mixture through fine chinois (or through strainer lined with double layers of cheesecloth) into a second large pot, pressing out all excess liquid. Discard soy pulp ('okara') or reserve for later use.
Bring strained soymilk to boil. Reduce heat and gently simmer, uncovered, 10 minutes. Remove pot from heat.

Dissolve nigari or other solidifier in 1 cup cold water. Add 1/3 of solidifier mixture slowly to hot soymilk, while gently stirring. Cover pot and allow to stand 3 minutes or until milk has separated into soft white curds.
Add remaining solidifier in two more batches, stirring each time and covering for 3 minutes. Soymilk should be completely separated into curds and whey.
Using slotted spoon, ladle bean curd into tofu mold; press with 2-3 pound weight for 25-30 minutes until firm and solid.

recipes.name: BUCKWHEAT PANCAKES
recipes.description: Vegan
instructions: In medium bowl, combine flours, baking powder, salt, baking soda, and maple crystals. Set aside.
In separate bowl, combine apple cider vinegar, and almond milk. Let sit for 5-10 minutes. Add banana.
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients. Beat batter only until blended.
Using 1-ounce ladle, pour batter onto griddle. Cook cakes until bubbles in batter break on t surface; flip and cook until browned.

recipes.name: HORSERADISH-CRUSTED SALMON
recipes.description: Salmon roasts in a hot convection oven under a bold crust of mayonnaise, fresh horseradish, parsley, and panko breadcrumbs, the whole topping brightened with lemon zest and a generous squeeze of lemon juice.

ingredients.name: salmon
ingredients.notes: skinned and divided into six 4-ounce portions

instructions: Heat convection oven to 375°F.
Season filet with salt and pepper.
Combine mayonnaise, parsley, horseradish, lemon zest, lemon, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper in large bowl. Stir to combine.
Spread mixture in even layer over flesh side of fish.
Transfer to half sheet tray lined with lightly oiled parchment paper.
Bake for 5-10 minutes, depending on thickness of fish filet.

recipes.name: Scallion-Ginger Sauce
recipes.description: Scallion, fresh ginger, and garlic stir together with tamari, canola oil, and maple crystals, then chill for at least half an hour so the sharp aromatics mellow into a punchy, pourable sauce.
instructions: In bowl mix all ingredients together. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1/2 hour.

recipes.name: VEGETABLE DETOX SOUP
recipes.description: Green beans, celery, and zucchini simmer briefly in a tomato-tinged stock until just tender and still bright, with parsley, dill, and scallions stirred in at the end for a clean, herb-forward finish.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.notes: cleaned and sliced on the bias to 1/8 inch

instructions: Bring stock or water and tomato paste to boil. Blend with wire whisk and skim.
Reduce heat, add garlic, beans, celery, and zucchini, and salt. Simmer until they are just tender and still green, about 10 minutes.
Stir in parsley, dill and scallions.
Serve in individual bowls with 1 teaspoon of Horseradish-Lemon condiment each.

recipes.name: BASIL-WALNUT PESTO
recipes.description: Toasted walnuts, rubbed free of their papery skins, blend with fresh basil, garlic, lemon juice, and mellow barley miso into a smooth pesto, with hand-chopped walnut pieces reserved for a crunchy garnish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Toast walnuts on sheet tray for 10 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer to strainer. Rub walnuts against strainer over bowl to loosen some of skins. Whatever readily comes off is enough.
Transfer walnuts from strainer and add 3/4 cup to food processor. Add remaining ingredients.
Process everything until smooth. Chop by hand remaining 1/2 cup of walnuts into pieces. Reserve for garnish.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE GREEN OLIVE-PARMESAN BREAD
recipes.description: Green olives and grated parmesan stud a quick bread built on a gluten-free flour blend, with egg, buttermilk, and melted butter whisked in for a rich, savory loaf baked in a moderate oven.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325° F.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda in one bowl.
In separate bowl, whisk together egg, buttermilk and melted butter.
Mix wet into dry until just combined. Add olives and parmesan.
Pour batter into muffin molds.
Bake for 30-45 minutes, or until toothpick inserted in bread comes out clean.

recipes.name: Ketchup (for Tempeh Reuben Sandwich)
recipes.description: Soaked golden raisins lend natural sweetness to this blender ketchup, where tomato puree, garlic, paprika, and a pinch of cinnamon simmer for forty minutes before Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice sharpen the finish.
instructions: In blender, combine raisins (with soaking liquid), tomato puree, garlic, water, paprika, cayenne, cinnamon, and salt. Blend until all ingredients are combined.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, on high heat, heat oil. Slowly add tomato mixture. Lower heat and simmer 40 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Simmer 5 minutes more. Adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: Almond Pulp Cookies
recipes.description: Almond pulp and chia seeds bind with melted coconut oil, maple syrup, lemon zest, and vanilla, then scoop onto a parchment-lined pan and bake ten to twelve minutes until lightly golden.

ingredients.name: almond pulp
ingredients.notes: left over from making Rich Almond Milk

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Combine all ingredients in bowl with spatula.
Form cookies on parchment-lined 1/2 sheet pan with 1-ounce scoop.
Bake cookies 10-12 minutes, or until lightly golden.

recipes.name: TERIYAKI SAUCE
recipes.description: Everything goes into the blender at once—garlic, ginger juice, shoyu, and barley malt with filtered water—processed until perfectly smooth for a glossy, salty-sweet teriyaki in seconds.
instructions: In blender, combine all ingredients and process until smooth.

recipes.name: Miso-Marinated Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon filets soak in a miso marinade for a full half hour before roasting on a parchment-lined sheet at 350°F, the savory paste and a touch of sesame oil seasoning every flake.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F degrees.
Combine salmon filets in large bowl with miso marinade. Marinate salmon for 30-40 minutes.
Remove filets from marinade and transfer to parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake salmon for 8-10 minutes or until flesh is springy to touch.

Alternatively, heat large sauté pan and add sesame oil. Sear top (presentation side) of salmon filets until caramelized, flip filets, then place sauté pan in oven. Cook 8-10 minutes or until flesh is springy to touch.

recipes.name: Watermelon Juice
recipes.description: Watermelon is cut into chunks, pureed in batches in a high-speed blender, and strained through fine mesh until only crisp, ruby juice remains, brightened with a squeeze of lemon.

ingredients.name: organic seedless watermelon
ingredients.notes: 2 pound; scrubbed and peeled up to white pith

instructions: Cut watermelon into approximately 2 inch x 4 inch pieces.
In a high-speed blender puree watermelon pieces in batches.
Using a mesh strainer set over a large bowl strain watermelon juice. Discard solids.
Stir in lemon juice and refrigerate until ready to serve.

recipes.name: CRANBERRY WALNUT SCONES
recipes.description: Butter is cut into unbleached all-purpose and whole wheat pastry flours with maple crystals until the mix resembles coarse crumbs, then dried cranberries, chopped walnuts, and grated orange zest stud the dough before baking at 375 degrees on a parchment-lined pan.

ingredients.name: almond milk soured with 1 tablespoon lemon juice

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line half-sheet pan with parchment.
In medium bowl, stir together flours, maple crystals, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
With pastry cutter, cut butter into dry ingredients until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add cranberries, nuts, and zest.
Make well in center and gradually stir in milk, ginger juice, and maple syrup just to combine. Do not over mix; dough should be sticky and difficult to work with.
On lightly floured surface, pat or roll dough to 1/2 inch thickness. Cut into shapes and place on sheet pan. Brush tops with milk and sprinkle with maple crystals.
Bake 12-15 minutes or until golden brown and firm to touch. Remove from pan to cool.

recipes.name: SWEET POTATO WAFFLES
recipes.description: Sweet potatoes are whisked with egg yolks, milk, and butter, then met by a cornmeal-flecked flour base sweetened with maple crystals before the batter hits a hot waffle iron for crisp, golden edges.
instructions: Heat waffle iron.
In large bowl, whisk together sweet potatoes, egg yolks, milk and butter.
In separate bowl, whisk together all-purpose flour, cornmeal, salt, baking powder, and maple crystals.
Mix wet ingredients into dry until batter is smooth. Set aside.
Whisk egg whites until soft peaks form. Fold egg whites into mixed batter.
Using 2 or 3-ounce ladle, pour batter onto waffle iron and cook 5-6 minutes, or until crispy.

recipes.name: Bolognese Sauce with Chicken
recipes.description: Ground chicken browns in olive oil before onion and carrot sauté to gold, building a hearty tomato sauce layered with fennel seeds, dried oregano, tomato paste, and fresh basil leaves.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat 3 tablespoons of oil over medium flame. Add ground chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring often to prevent any scorching. Remove chicken from pan.
Add remaining tablespoon of oil over medium-high flame.
Add onion and carrots. Sauté until golden.
Lower flame to medium, add garlic, salt, fennel, oregano, and tomato paste. Sweat until all vegetables are tender.
Add ground chicken back to pot and mix to incorporate. Continue to sweat few minutes longer.
In Vitamix, blend whole tomatoes and juices.
Add puree to pot and simmer until thickened to desired consistency.
Add rice syrup and basil. Simmer few minutes more. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: CAROB CAKE WITH WALNUTS
recipes.description: Carob powder deepens a whole wheat pastry flour batter sweetened with maple syrup and enriched with oil and almond milk, whisked together and baked with walnuts into a dark, tender cake.

ingredients.name: walnuts
ingredients.notes: coarsely chopped (optional for top of cake)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil and flour one 8-inch cake pan and line bottom with parchment.
Combine dry ingredients in bowl and whisk together to combine. Set aside.
In separate bowl, whisk together wet ingredients and pour into dry. Mix well.
Pour batter into prepared baking pan.
Sprinkle walnuts on top.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE IRISH SODA BREAD
recipes.description: Raisin-studded and gently sweetened with maple crystals, this gluten-free take on Irish soda bread whisks a flour blend with baking powder and soda, then folds in buttermilk, butter, and egg before baking at 375 degrees.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F.
In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and maple crystals.
In separate bowl, combine butter, eggs, and buttermilk and beat to combine well. Add raisins.
Create well in center of dry ingredients. Add buttermilk and egg mixture and mix gently to combine. Transfer dough to muffin molds.

Bake bread about 30-40 minutes, or until golden in color and toothpick inserted in quick bread comes out clean. Remove from oven, and allow bread to cool in muffin forms for 10 minutes before inverting finished bread onto cooling rack.

recipes.name: REAL BUTTERMILK WAFFLES
recipes.description: Tangy buttermilk, melted butter, and egg yolks whisk together before meeting flour sweetened with maple crystals, making a simple batter ready for a hot waffle iron and a crisp, golden finish.
instructions: Heat waffle iron.
In large bowl, mix together flour, baking powder, salt, and maple crystals.
In separate bowl whisk egg yolks, butter, and buttermilk.
Mix wet ingredients with dry until batter is smooth. Set aside.
Beat eggs whites until soft peaks form. Fold egg whites into mixed batter.
Using 2 or 3-ounce ladle, pour batter onto waffle iron and cook 5-6 minutes, or until crispy.

recipes.name: DARK ONION SOUP WITH WHOLE GRAIN CROUTONS
recipes.description: Onions cook down patiently for over half an hour until deeply caramelized, then sherry, thyme, and brown stock simmer into a dark, savory soup finished with tamari and rice vinegar and topped with whole grain croutons.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame and sweat onions with salt until translucent. Lower heat, and continue to sweat until onions begin to soften and color, stirring often to prevent burning. Continue until onions are caramelized (brown and soft), about 30-40 minutes. Add black pepper, sherry, and garlic and continue cooking until sherry reduces and garlic softens.
Add thyme sprigs, bay leaf, and brown stock. Simmer 20-25 minutes.
Season to taste with tamari and vinegar.

recipes.name: APPLE-MUSTARD SAUCE
recipes.description: Shallots, carrots, and apples sauté until lightly caramelized, then a deglaze of apple juice and cider vinegar reduces nearly dry before Dijon mustard and brown stock simmer everything into a rounded, sweet-sharp sauce.

ingredients.name: sachet d'epices
ingredients.notes: 3 bay leaves, 6 parsley stems, 5 sprigs thyme, 6 black peppercorns tied in cheesecloth

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high flame. Sauté shallots, onion, carrots, and apples until lightly caramelized.
Deglaze pan with apple juice and vinegar. Reduce liquid until almost dry (au sec). Do not remove vegetables.
Transfer vegetables to 1-gallon pot. Add mustard, 7 cups of warm brown stock, and sachet to pot. Bring to simmer.
In medium bowl, add 1 cup of remaining stock to roux. Whisk to combine.
Return stock and roux mixture to pot. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until sauce thickens and nappé consistency is achieved.
Strain sauce through chinois. Adjust seasonings to taste.

recipes.name: FRESH TOMATO SAUCE
recipes.description: Garlic, dried basil, and whole canned tomatoes cook down in olive oil for half an hour until their juices concentrate, leaving a rustic sauce you can puree until smooth or serve exactly as it is.

ingredients.name: whole tomatoes
ingredients.notes: 28-ounce; drained OR 2 pounds fresh tomatoes, concassé, 1/2-inch dice

instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan combine oil, garlic, basil and tomatoes.
Cook over medium heat 25 to 35 minutes until tomatoes have released their juices and water has cooked out.
Add salt and black pepper to taste. You can puree sauce in blender, or serve it as is.

recipes.name: PESTO (CILANTRO-PUMPKIN SEED)
recipes.description: Briefly blanched and shocked to lock in its color, cilantro purees with pumpkin seeds, garlic, umeboshi paste, and chickpea miso while extra virgin olive oil streams in slowly, building a vivid, salty-tangy pesto.
instructions: Prepare an ice bath. In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring 2 cups of water to boil. Add cilantro and pinch of salt. Blanch cilantro 2-3 seconds. Shock cilantro in ice bath, drain, and squeeze out excess moisture. Set aside.
Combine and puree pumpkin seeds, garlic, cilantro, umeboshi paste, and miso in food processor.
Through feed tube, add oil slowly and puree until well combined (20-30 seconds).

recipes.name: MUSHROOM SAUCE
recipes.description: Onions, carrots, and celery sauté to golden before tomatoes caramelize in the pot; brown stock and a brown roux then simmer with cremini mushrooms into a deep, savory sauce.

ingredients.name: brown roux
ingredients.notes: 3 ounces flour + 2 1/4 ounces olive oil; cooled

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground pepper

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onions, carrots and celery until golden.
Add tomatoes and sauté for few minutes or until slightly caramelized.
Add 6 cups stock and bring to boil. Lower heat to simmer.
Slowly whisk remaining 1 cup of stock to cooled roux.
Slowly add roux-stock mixture back into sauce.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat, add mushrooms and sweat until tender.
Add mushrooms to pot and simmer uncovered, about 30 minutes, or until reduced by half and nappé consistency is achieved.
Strain through chinois and return to pot.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: GRILLED PINEAPPLE CHUTNEY
recipes.description: Red onion sweats until translucent while a red pepper blisters over an open flame; diced and combined with jalapeño, pineapple, lime juice, and cilantro, they build a smoky-sweet chutney with real heat.
instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil and sweat onion until translucent.

While onion is cooking, roast red pepper over open flame. When skin is blackened, place in paper bag for 10 minutes. Remove from bag, let cool and remove blackened skin. Cut pepper into small dice and add to pan with red onion.
Add jalapeño to onion and pepper mixture. Cook 5 minutes more and set pan aside.
Peel and cut pineapple into 4 wedges of equal size. Grill slices and set aside. When slices are cool, cut into medium-small dice and add to onion and pepper mixture.
Season with salt and lime juice and garnish with minced cilantro.

recipes.name: ROMAINE SALAD WITH SHERRY VINAIGRETTE
recipes.description: Crisp romaine, celery, and apple toss in a sherry vinaigrette whisked with Dijon mustard and minced shallot until properly emulsified, each portion finished with a scatter of raisins and pecans.
instructions: Whisk together vinegar, mustard, shallot, and salt in bowl. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking until dressing is properly emulsified.
Toss lettuce, celery, and apple in bowl with enough dressing to coat.
Divide salad into portions, ladling on extra dressing as needed. Garnish each salad with raisins and pecans.

recipes.name: Orange-Miso Barbecue Sauce
recipes.description: Red miso, tomato paste, and rice syrup cook down with dijon mustard and fresh orange zest and juice, then a kuzu slurry is whisked in slowly over gentle heat, thickening the sauce into a glossy sweet-savory barbecue glaze.
instructions: In small pot combine rice syrup, tomato paste, mustard, miso, vinegar, zest and juice. Cook for approximately 5 minutes.
In small bowl, dissolve kuzu in 2 tablespoons of water; then add enough water to make 1 cup.
Pour kuzu mixture into saucepan and heat slowly, stirring with whisk to prevent lumping. Add salt.
Simmer 5 minutes and adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: COCONUT-LIME FLAN
recipes.description: Coconut milk simmers with agar flakes until fully dissolved, then maple syrup sweetens the base of a flan flavored with lime juice, thickened with kuzu, and finished with toasted dried coconut.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk and agar. Soak agar for 5 minutes.
Bring mixture to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 5 minutes or more, until agar is completely dissolved.
Add maple syrup and stir until combined.
Dissolve kuzu in lime juice and water until there are no lumps. Add to milk mixture and simmer until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Lightly oil ramekins and sprinkle 2 teaspoons maple crystals in bottom of each ramekin.
Pour custard into ramekins. Refrigerate to set.
When custard is set, run paring knife around the side of each ramekin to separate custard. Invert custard onto plate. Garnish with coconut.

recipes.name: RED LENTIL PÂTÉ
recipes.description: Red lentils simmer to tenderness while onions, garlic, and herbs caramelize in olive oil; layered into a breadcrumb-lined loaf pan with umeboshi vinegar and white miso, they set into a savory pâté.

ingredients.name: white miso dissolved in 1 tablespoon water

instructions: Combine lentils in 2 1/2 quart pot with water or stock, bring to boil, and simmer covered 20 minutes.
Heat oil in 8-inch sauté pan. Add onions, garlic, and herbs and cook until caramelized.
Oil and line loaf pan with parchment and sprinkle with half the breadcrumbs.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
When lentils are cooked, mash by stirring, add onion mixture, remaining breadcrumbs, and parsley. Season with black pepper, umeboshi vinegar, and white miso.
Fold pâté into pan and bake 20-30 minutes. Allow to set, cool, and slice. Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: GOLDEN TURMERIC MILK
recipes.description: Fresh turmeric and ginger blend with blanched almonds into a strained golden milk, then a gentle simmer infuses the flavors before black pepper, cinnamon, and maple syrup round out each warming cup.
instructions: In 2 batches, puree almonds, turmeric, and ginger with water in Vitamix until smooth. Strain milk through chinois.
Transfer milk to 1-gallon pot. Bring milk mixture to simmer over medium flame (to infuse flavors). Turn off heat and add pepper, cinnamon, and maple syrup to taste.

recipes.name: ORANGE, KIWI, AND RED GRAPE COMPOTE
recipes.description: Cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and allspice boil down with maple and rice syrups into a thick, fragrant syrup that folds gently through oranges, kiwis, and red grapes, brightened with lime juice and finished with sliced almonds.

ingredients.name: kiwis
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced (about 1 cup of slices)

instructions: In small saucepan, combine water, rice syrup, maple syrup, crushed cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and allspice. Whisk together and bring to boil. Reduce until mixture becomes thick and syrupy, about 3-4 minutes.
Add vanilla extract and vodka (if using) and continue to cook another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and remove cardamom pods and cinnamon stick.
In medium bowl, combine oranges, kiwis, and grapes. Combine syrup mixture with fruit and stir gently to combine. Taste and adjust seasonings, adding lime juice as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 36 hours to allow flavors to combine. When ready to serve, sprinkle with toasted almonds.

recipes.name: Mushroom-Walnut Pâté
recipes.description: Dried porcini soak to softness while onions sweat slowly with garlic and fresh sage; button mushrooms then sear in batches to build deep savor for this walnut-studded pâté touched with balsamic vinegar.

ingredients.name: walnuts
ingredients.notes: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons; well toasted and divided

instructions: Combine dried porcini mushrooms with boiling water in small bowl. Soak until mushrooms are soft and pliable, about 20 to 30 minutes. Strain mixture through chinois. Set aside mushrooms and reserve 6 tablespoons soaking liquid.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over low heat. Sweat onion until translucent. Add garlic and continue sweating, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and evenly browned, about 15 minutes. Add minced sage and cook 1 minute more. Transfer onion-garlic mixture from pan to bowl and set aside.

Add another tablespoon olive oil to same pan, raise heat, and sear mushrooms in batches, making sure that they are in one, even layer in pan. Add more oil as necessary between batches. Add seared mushrooms to bowl with onion-garlic mixture.
Deglaze pan with sherry. Reduce sherry to about 1/4 cup.

In food processor, combine garlic-onion-mushroom mixture, deglazing liquid, 1 cup of walnuts, porcini soaking liquid, and balsamic vinegar. Pulse to thick, spreadable consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

In 8-inch sauté pan, heat canola oil over medium-high flame. Toss sage leaves with arrowroot. Fry dusted sage leaves for a few seconds in oil until crisp. Transfer leaves from pan to plate lined with paper towel to drain.
Chop remaining 2 tablespoon of walnuts to use as garnish with parsley and fried sage leaves.

recipes.name: BROWN VEGETABLE STOCK
recipes.description: White beans and lentils simmer away in the stockpot while carrots, onions, shallots, celery, and parsnips roast to a deep brown, everything merging with tomatoes, garlic, and shoyu into a robust vegetable stock.

ingredients.name: bouquet garni: 6 parsley stems
ingredients.notes: 3 bay leaves, 10 peppercorns, 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 2 cloves garlic

instructions: Preheat oven to 400-425°F.
In large stockpot, combine white beans, lentils, and ten quarts water. Bring to boil, covered, skimming foam as needed. Reduce heat to simmer and continue to cook partially covered.

Mix carrots, onions, shallots, celery, and parsnips with oil. Roast on large oiled baking sheet, stirring occasionally, until browned and aromatic. Add tomatoes and garlic to vegetables in oven near end of roasting time. Add roasted vegetables to bean stockpot.
Deglaze baking sheet with white wine. Add deglaze liquid, walnuts, bouquet garni, and shoyu to bean stockpot. Simmer, partially covered, for 60-90 minutes. Strain immediately.

recipes.name: Poached Shrimp
recipes.description: Peeled, deveined shrimp poach in boiling water for a brief four to five minutes, then chill down fast in an ice bath to keep them snappy, ready to pile onto a platter with cocktail sauce.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and add shrimp. Poach for 4-5 minutes and remove with spider.
Cool shrimp in ice bath. Remove and place on serving platter with Cocktail Sauce.

recipes.name: CURRIED RED LENTIL WITH COCONUT MILK (DAIRY)
recipes.description: Onion, carrot, and garlic sweat in ghee with curry powder before red lentils simmer until they collapse; partially pureed for body, the pot finishes with coconut milk, ginger juice, and a squeeze of lime.

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.notes: 1/4 small head; cut into bit-sized florets

instructions: Heat ghee in 3-quart pot over medium-low flame; add onion, salt, garlic, carrot, and curry powder. Sweat vegetables covered, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 10 minutes.

Add lentils, stock, and bay leaf. Cover and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to simmer, and cook partially covered until lentils are broken down, approximately 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf. Add cauliflower florets and simmer until florets are tender. Remove 2 cups of soup and purée in blender until creamy. Add blended ingredients back to pot.
Add coconut milk, ginger juice, and lime juice. Stir to combine.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro and shredded coconut.

recipes.name: HIZIKI CAVIAR
recipes.description: Sautéed hiziki simmers with shoyu until every drop of liquid evaporates, then gets finely chopped and folded with golden shallots and garlic, ready to spread on toasted baguette with tofu sour cream.

ingredients.name: hiziki
ingredients.notes: loosely packed; soaked 10 minutes in water to cover and drained

ingredients.name: toasted baguette
ingredients.notes: 1/4-inch slices; pita, toast points, or crackers

instructions: Sauté hiziki in medium pan with 2 tablespoons sesame oil for 3 minutes. Add water to cover, bring to boil, add shoyu and cook uncovered until all liquid is evaporated, about 15 minutes.
Sauté shallots and garlic in separate medium sauté pan with remaining 1 tablespoon sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Finely chop the hiziki while shallots and garlic are sautéing. Combine hiziki with cooked shallot-garlic mixture in small bowl.
Season with additional sea salt, if needed. Add lemon juice and ginger juice to taste. Serve on bread, pita, toast points, or crackers. Garnish with tofu sour cream.

recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato and Sunflower Seed Pâté
recipes.description: Slow-sweated onions and garlic build deep sweetness before being pureed with plumped sun-dried tomatoes, sunflower seeds, rosemary, and a splash of balsamic vinegar into a rich, spreadable pâté.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Soak sun-dried tomatoes in small bowl with boiling water until soft and pliable, about 15 minutes. Strain tomatoes, reserving 3/4 cups soaking liquid. Set both aside.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over low flame. Sweat onion until translucent. Add garlic and continue sweating, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft and evenly browned, about 15 minutes.
In food processor, puree onions, sun-dried tomatoes, 1/2 cup sunflower seeds, rosemary, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Slowly add enough water so mixture becomes spreadable paste.
Use remaining 1/4 cup sunflower seeds for garnish.

recipes.name: Herb Ravioli with Porcini Mushroom Pesto and Tofu "Ricotta"
recipes.description: Firm tofu whipped with lemon juice, miso, garlic, and fresh rosemary plays the ricotta here, while rehydrated porcini mushrooms are processed with pine nuts and olive oil into an earthy pesto.
instructions: In food processor, combine tofu, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, garlic and miso. Process, stopping few times to scrape down sides, until tofu is smooth with slightly granular texture. Add chopped rosemary and pulse to combine. Remove from processor and set aside. Wash out food processor bowl.
Cover mushrooms in bowl with boiling water, and soak for 20 minutes. Drain mushrooms and clean thoroughly to remove all sand attached to stems. Discard soaking liquid.
Combine mushrooms, garlic, pine nuts, olive oil, salt and black pepper in food processor and process until smooth. Add chives and pulse to combine. Taste for seasoning.

Roll out dough and fill ravioli according to directions (see procedures in Pasta Lecture/Demo), spooning in 1/2 teaspoon of tofu cheese first, then adding heaping 1/2 teaspoon of mushroom pesto on top. Cover with second sheet of dough to encase filling. Ravioli can be frozen, if desired, at this point.
Cook ravioli in 12-inch sauté pan filled with 2-inches of simmering water for 3 to 5 minutes, depending on dryness of your pasta and whether or not they were frozen.
Use slotted spoon to gently lift ravioli out of water. Drain briefly for a moment, then serve immediately.

recipes.name: BUCKWHEAT PASTA
recipes.description: Buckwheat and unbleached white flours come together with whole eggs in the food processor, then the dough is kneaded until smooth and rested under plastic wrap, ready to roll into earthy, tender pasta.
instructions: Pulse flours in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add eggs, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Sift flours onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Break eggs into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: HERBED DINNER ROLLS
recipes.description: Fresh thyme scents these yeasted dinner rolls, built from a foamy sponge, kneaded until smooth, and proofed until doubled, each one brushed with olive oil and topped with sesame or poppy seeds.

ingredients.name: chopped fresh thyme or other herbs
olive oil or rice syrup diluted with water

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In large bowl, combine water, yeast, maple syrup, white high-gluten flour, and 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour. Stir until thick batter forms. Cover sponge with plastic wrap and set aside in warm place for 30-45 minutes or until foamy and doubled in size.
Add oil, salt, and thyme to sponge and stir to combine. Add remaining whole wheat pastry flour and just enough all-purpose flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.

Knead dough with remaining flour for about 10-15 minutes or until smooth dough has been created. Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
Fold and turn dough. Rise again. Divide dough into 1-ounce balls.
Form dough into dinner roll shapes (see diagrams following) and transfer rolls to parchment-lined sheet trays. Cover with damp towel and set aside to rise for 10-15 minutes more.
Lightly brush tops of rolls with olive oil or egg wash. Sprinkle sesame seeds or poppy seeds on top.
Bake 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden and firm to touch.
Remove from sheet trays and cool on racks before serving.

recipes.name: BAKED QUINOA WITH PEAS AND HERBS
recipes.description: Quinoa roasts dry in the oven until nutty, then bakes under foil in salted stock until every grain drinks up the liquid, finished with sweet peas, parsley, cilantro, chives, and lemon juice.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
Transfer quinoa to 8 x 8 baking casserole. Roast about 20 minutes or until quinoa is dry. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and stir into quinoa. Bake 5 minutes more, stirring once or twice.

Add water and 1/2 teaspoon salt to quinoa. Tightly cover with tin foil and bake 20 minutes or until all water is absorbed. Remove from oven and let sit covered 5 minutes. Remove foil and fluff with fork. Place quinoa into bowl and let cool.
Add peas, parsley, cilantro, chives, remaining 1 teaspoon oil, and lemon juice to cooked quinoa. Season with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt.

recipes.name: Vegan Mozzarella
recipes.description: Raw cashews blend with tahini, lemon juice, and coconut oil until utterly creamy, then simmered agar gets blended through and the mixture sets in silicone molds into firm, sliceable vegan mozzarella.
instructions: Place cashews, cashew milk, tahini, lemon juice, coconut oil, salt, garlic powder, dried basil and 1/4 cup water in a Vitamix and blend until smooth. Blend until very smooth and creamy.
Place agar in 1 1/2 cups water and bring to simmer. Simmer until agar dissolves. Add agar mixture to blender and blend until smooth.
Pour mixture into silicone molds and refrigerate until set.

recipes.name: Corn Muffins
recipes.description: Caramelized onions and garlic fold into a cornmeal and flour batter with red pepper, jalapeno, and fresh cilantro, sweetened with maple crystals and baked as savory mini muffins.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350°F. Line mini muffin pans with muffin papers and set aside.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Add onions and garlic. Cook, on medium-low heat, to caramelize (about 10-15 minutes). Remove from heat and stir in red pepper, jalapeno pepper, and cilantro. Set aside.
In medium bowl, sift cornmeal, flour, maple crystals, baking powder, and baking soda. Whisk to combine.
In separate medium bowl, whisk together oat milk, kuzu, salt, vinegar, and olive oil.
Pour wet mixture into flour mixture and gently stir with spatula just to combine then add onion/pepper mixture. Mix just enough to incorporate ingredients.

With 1-ounce scoop, pour batter into liner-filled muffin tins to almost the top (about 3/4 full). Transfer muffin tins to half sheet pans. Bake 5-6 minutes, rotate pans, and continue to bake (about 6-8 minutes more) until top of muffin bounces back when touched and toothpick comes out clean.
Remove muffins from pans immediately and cool completely before serving.

recipes.name: SESAME PRESSED CRUST
recipes.description: Toasted sesame seeds, rolled oats, and whole wheat pastry flour process to a fine flour-like meal, then bind with melted coconut oil and warm maple syrup for a press-in pie or tart crust.

ingredients.name: chilled juice or water to bind

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Oil 9-inch pie or tart pan.
Process together whole wheat pastry flour, oatmeal, sesame seeds and salt until mixture is uniformly flour-like.
Whisk together oil and syrup.
Add oil-syrup mixture to processor and mix until thoroughly combined. Add juice or water if more liquid is needed.
With wet fingertips, press mixture into oiled pie plate.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Vegan Dough with Water
recipes.description: Whole wheat and unbleached white flours come together with salt and hot water in the food processor, then get kneaded until smooth and elastic and rested under wrap for a supple, workable vegan dough.
instructions: Combine flours and salt in food processor. With machine running, add just enough hot water to make stiff dough that forms a ball. Make sure to add water slowly (over at least 30 seconds) to ensure you don’t add too much water. Dough should not be tacky or sticky.

Remove dough from food processor and knead on lightly floured work surface until smooth and elastic, about 1 minute. Wrap in plastic wrap and let sit at least 15 minutes. (The dough can be tightly wrapped in plastic wrap for several hours.)

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE PUDDING
recipes.description: Almond milk and cocoa simmer with agar flakes until fully dissolved, then a kuzu slurry thickens the pot into a glossy dairy-free pudding finished with maple syrup, vanilla, and cashew butter.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, over medium heat, simmer together milk, cocoa, agar, and sea salt for about 20-25 minutes, whisking to fully dissolve agar.
In small bowl, dissolve kuzu in water. Pour into saucepan with cocoa mixture, stirring until liquid returns to boil. Continue to cook one minute more until mixture is thicker.
Add maple syrup and vanilla to taste. Cook 2 to 3 minutes more.
Remove pot from heat and mix some of cocoa mixture with cashew butter until cashew butter is thinner, smooth, and creamy. Whisk tempered cashew butter into cocoa mixture.
Pour cocoa mixture into shallow pan and cool until firm. In food processor, blend mixture until smooth and creamy. Spoon pudding into ramekins and chill until set (about 30 minutes).

recipes.name: SHIITAKE BROTH WITH SHRIMP, SOBA, AND BABY BOK CHOY
recipes.description: Dried shiitakes, kombu, star anise, lemongrass, and arbol chilies steep in a tamari-seasoned simmer, building a deep broth for shrimp, soba noodles, and baby bok choy with ginger juice and lime.

ingredients.name: baby bok choy
ingredients.notes: stems and leaves separated, both thinly sliced

ingredients.name: soba noodles
ingredients.notes: boiled, rinsed in cold water, and drained in a colander

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onions, carrots, garlic, and peppercorns with salt until onions are translucent.
Add stock, star anise, chilies, lemongrass, kombu, dried shiitakes, and tamari. Cover pot and simmer for 25 minutes.
Remove and discard star anise, chilies, and lemongrass. Remove kombu and shiitakes from pot. Slice kombu and shiitakes (removing shiitake stems first) into very thin strips and add back to soup pot.
Add bok choy stems. Simmer until tender. Add bok choy leaves, shrimp, and ginger juice. Simmer until bok choy leaves wilt and shrimp just turns opaque.
Add lime juice and season to taste.
Place small portion of noodles in bowl. Pour soup over noodles and serve.

recipes.name: BLUEBERRY PUREE
recipes.description: Fresh or thawed blueberries meet a pour of agave nectar in the blender and whirl until completely smooth — a deep violet puree that comes together in one effortless step.

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen and thawed blueberries

instructions: Puree blueberries and agave nectar in blender until smooth.

recipes.name: Spelt Bread
recipes.description: Yeast blooms in warm water sweetened with maple syrup before olive oil, sea salt, and spelt flour come together into a dough kneaded a full ten to fifteen minutes, then baked at 375°F into a hearty loaf.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In small bowl, combine water, maple syrup, and yeast. Allow mixture to sit about 10 minutes until mixture is foamy.
Add oil, salt, and just enough flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough on table about 10-15 minutes using remaining flour as needed until smooth dough has been created.
Place dough in large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in a warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare 2 bread pans or sheet trays with parchment.

Punch down dough. If time permits, place dough back in bowl, rise, and punch down 1 to 2 times more. Cut dough into two equal-sized portions. Form dough into loaves and place in prepared loaf pans or on sheet trays.
Loosely cover dough with damp towel and set aside in warm place. Allow to rise for about 40 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
Bake bread approximately 40-50 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch. Internal dough temperature should register between 190° and 205°.

recipes.name: CRÊPES SUZETTE
recipes.description: Butter, fresh orange juice, maple crystals, and orange zest reduce to a glossy syrup spiked with Grand Marnier and brandy; each crepe gets coated, folded into quarters, and flambeed to order.
instructions: In 12-inch sauté pan, over medium heat, bring butter, orange juice, maple crystals, lemon juice, and zest to boil. Cook until thickened, about 3-4 minutes and stir in Grand Marnier and brandy. Bring again to boil for 30 seconds. Transfer syrup to bowl and set aside.

In separate 10-inch sauté pan, over medium-low heat, pour in small ladle full of syrup and heat to simmer. Place one crêpe (browned side down) in pan. Coat crêpe in warmed syrup then flip crêpe over with tongs to coat other side. Fold crêpe in quarters (fold in half then half again) to form triangle.
Pour 1 tablespoon of Grand Marnier per crêpe over top of folded crepe. Ignite by tilting pan toward burner. Allow alcohol to burn off before removing to plate and serving. Repeat to order.

recipes.name: Zucchini Bread
recipes.description: Zucchini and pecans stir into a flax and vanilla batter with rice vinegar, then meet sifted coconut sugar, cinnamon, and a blend of all-purpose and whole wheat pastry flours in a parchment-lined loaf.
instructions: Heat convection oven to 350° F. Line a 4 1/2 x 9-inch loaf pan with parchment.
Whisk together flax mixture, canola oil, vanilla, and rice vinegar in bowl. Stir in zucchini and pecans. Set aside.
In separate bowl, sift together coconut sugar, cinnamon, salt, baking soda, baking powder, all-purpose flour and whole wheat pastry flour.
Whisk wet ingredients into dry. Pour batter into loaf pan and bake for 55 minutes.
Let bread cool completely before slicing and serving.

recipes.name: Broiled Arctic Char Over Black Quinoa, Rapini, and Capers
recipes.description: Seasoned simply with salt and black pepper, arctic char broils hot and fast until just cooked through, then lands on a bed of black quinoa tangled with capers and rapini, brightened by lemon juice and olive oil.

ingredients.name: skinless arctic char filets
ingredients.notes: 3-ounce; 12 ounces; butterflied and pounded to 1/4 inch between parchment

ingredients.name: black quinoa with capers and rapini

instructions: Heat salamander and set rack on highest setting.
Combine salt and pepper, and sprinkle over char.
Lightly coat sizzle platter with oil and arrange fish on top.
Sprinkle remaining oil and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice atop each portion of fish.
Broil char under salamander for approximately 3 minutes.
Serve over Black Quinoa (recipe below).

recipes.name: ZUCCHINI LATKES WITH CRÈME FRAÎCHE AND HERBS
recipes.description: Shredded zucchini, minced red onion, and plenty of dill bind with egg and rice flour into little latkes, fried golden in a hot pan and finished with a cool dollop of crème fraîche and a sprig of dill.
instructions: In medium bowl, combine zucchini, onions, dill, egg, flour, salt, and pepper. Drain in colander for 10 minutes and squeeze out excess liquid.
Form latkes using tablespoon measure.

In 8-inch, non-stick sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high flame. Fry latkes in batches until golden on each side, about 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels and serve with dollop of crème fraîche and sprig of dill.

recipes.name: LOCRO (ARGENTINE VEGETABLE STEW)
recipes.description: Navy beans, wheat berries, and barley simmer low and slow with butternut squash, potato, and corn until the squash collapses into a thick Argentine-style stew, finished with sofrito topping and chopped scallions.
instructions: Drain beans, wheat berries, and barley. In 4-quart pot, combine beans, wheat berries, and barley with 3 cups water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes.

Add vegetables to simmering beans and grains. Add remaining 1 cup water, bay leaves and salt. Continue simmering for 1 hour, covered, over low heat. Stir occasionally, and add more water if needed. Vegetables should be soft; squash will disintegrate, making thick stew. Add corn and cook another 10 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with Sofrito Topping (recipe below) and chopped scallions.

recipes.name: Polenta, Goat Cheese, and Black Bean Terrine
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked black beans purée with cumin, oregano, and cayenne bloomed in butter, while polenta whisks up rich with coriander and white pepper — the two layer with goat cheese and red peppers into a striking terrine.

ingredients.name: red peppers
ingredients.notes: 10 ounces; roasted, peeled, seeded, and pureed in blender

instructions: Combine beans in small pressure cooker with water, bay leaves, garlic, and salt. Bring to pressure, lower heat, and cook 15 minutes. Bring down pressure, remove bay leaf, and drain beans in colander. Transfer beans to food processor.

Melt butter in 8-inch sauté pan over low flame. Add cumin, salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, basil, and cayenne. When spices are fragrant (30 seconds), add them to beans. Puree beans in food processor. Stiffen mixture with breadcrumbs if needed to create texture in which spoon will stand.

In 2-quart saucepan, bring water and salt to boil. Slowly whisk in polenta. Exchange whisk for spoon and cook another 20 minutes, stirring frequently. Add in butter, coriander, white pepper, and cayenne and cook 5 minutes more. Adjust seasonings.
Line loaf pan with parchment paper.

Pour two-thirds polenta into terrine mold. Fold goat cheese and cilantro into remaining one-third polenta. Spread in mold as second layer. Spread bean puree in mold as third layer. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, about 1 hour.
Garnish with cilantro sprigs. Serve with crackers and roasted red pepper puree.

recipes.name: APPLE-OAT CRUMBLE
recipes.description: Tart Granny Smith apples get tossed with cinnamon, maple crystals, arrowroot, and apple juice, then baked under a rubbly topping of rolled oats, brown rice flour, and melted coconut oil.

ingredients.name: granny smith apples
ingredients.notes: peeled, cored, cut in into 1/8-inch slices

instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350°F. While cutting apples, soak slices in acidulated water (juice of 1/2 lemon and 4 cups water).
In large bowl, whisk together salt, arrowroot, cinnamon, maple crystals, and apple juice. Drain apples, and combine with cinnamon-maple mixture. Transfer to 9-inch square pan.
In medium bowl combine oats, flour, and cinnamon. Whisk to combine.
In separate bowl whisk oil, syrup, and salt.
Pour wet into over dry and toss until mixture is completely coated.
Spread topping over apples. Bake 45 to 55 minutes until topping is golden and apples and filling is bubbly. Serve garnished with drizzle of pomegranate reduction.

recipes.name: RASPBERRY PUREE
recipes.description: Ripe raspberries blend with maple syrup until completely smooth, then pass through a strainer to catch every seed, leaving a vivid, velvety puree with pure, concentrated berry intensity.
instructions: Puree raspberries and maple syrup in blender until smooth. Strain puree to remove seeds.

recipes.name: SCALLION, EDAMAME, AND LEEK DUMPLINGS
recipes.description: Blanched edamame and slow-sweated leeks puree into a creamy filling brightened with ginger juice, sesame oil, and fresh mint, cilantro, and chives, ready to be tucked into wonton wrappers and fried.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: 3 medium; washed, trimmed, cut into 1/8-inch half moons

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
fresh ginger
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into julienne (1 ounce)

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, bring 6 cups water and 1 tablespoon sea salt to boil. Blanch edamame until tender, about 5-7 minutes. Shock and drain in colander for about 5 minutes. Set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add leeks and sweat until tender. Add garlic and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Continue sweating a few minutes more. Transfer leeks and garlic to food processor and puree with edamame to form a creamy pipe-able consistency.
Transfer mixture from food processor to medium-size bowl. Add ginger juice, sesame oil, mirin, lemon juice, cilantro, chives, and mint. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Set aside.
In small bowl, slurry arrowroot and water to smooth consistency. Set aside.

Place 1 scant tablespoon filling in middle of wonton wrapper. Lightly brush outer edge of wonton wrapper with arrowroot mixture. Fold wrapper in half to form half moon, pinching edges together. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers and filling.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1/4 cup oil over medium-high flame. Add 6-7 wontons at a time and pan fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer with slotted spoon to paper towel to drain.
Combine and whisk all dipping sauce ingredients in small bowl and serve with dumplings.

recipes.name: ROMESCO SAUCE
recipes.description: Red peppers char over an open flame until blackened and blistered while ancho chili toasts in a cast iron skillet, building smoky depth for this romesco of tomatoes, hazelnuts, almonds, and sherry vinegar.
instructions: Combine tomatoes in small bowl and set aside.

Arrange peppers on stove top, over direct flame, turning often as peppers become blackened and blistered. Transfer peppers to small bowl and cover. Allow peppers steam for 10 minutes. When peppers are cool, remove skins and seeds.
Heat cast iron skillet over medium flame. Toast chili each side until flexible. Do not scorch.
Remove seeds and transfer chili to 2 1/2 quart pot with water to cover. Simmer until chili softens, about 5 minutes. Drain chilis and set them aside, reserving soaking water.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons oil over low flame, add garlic, and sweat until garlic has softened. Add tomatoes and peppers. Increase heat to medium-high and sauté until vegetables begin to caramelize.
In food processor, combine tomatoes, chili, hazelnuts, almonds, vinegar, and remaining 1/4 cup of oil. Blend until smooth. If sauce is too thick, add chili soaking water to processor to thin sauce.

recipes.name: FRISEE SALAD WITH GRILLED BABY CARROTS, CUCUMBER, AND RADISHES WITH AVOCADO DRESSING
recipes.description: Grilled baby carrots, marked from the flame, join radishes, English cucumber, and frisee, while avocado brightened with lime juice, dill, mint, and chives becomes a creamy, herb-flecked dressing.
instructions: Toss carrots in bowl with olive oil and salt. Heat grill. Grill carrots until grill marks are visible. Set aside.
In medium bowl, combine radishes, cucumber, frisee, and jalapeno.
Pour lime juice over avocado slices and set aside.
Combine dressing ingredients in blender until creamy.
Toss salad with dressing. Garnish with carrots and avocado slices.

recipes.name: Cream of Mushroom Soup
recipes.description: Shallots sauté in butter until translucent before whole-wheat flour toasts in the pot, then stock whisks in cup by cup and mushrooms simmer for a full half hour, finished with a splash of sherry vinegar.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat butter or olive oil. Add shallots and sauté until translucent. Add flour; stir 4-5 minutes, until toasted.
Add stock 1 cup at a time, whisking to blend. Bring soup to simmer, add salt.
Add mushrooms to soup. Simmer 30 minutes.
Puree soup in blender. Add sherry and black pepper. Adjust seasonings. Serve garnished with parsley sprig.

recipes.name: MEDITERRANEAN-INSPIRED PASTA SALAD
recipes.description: Roasted eggplant and broccoli rabe mingle with fusilli, sun-dried tomatoes, kalamata olives, and currants in this Mediterranean-inspired salad, coated in a creamy blended dressing of roasted garlic, lemon, and pine nuts.

ingredients.name: sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: rehydrated in hot water until soft, drained, chopped

instructions: In blender, combine all dressing ingredients until creamy. Set aside.
Heat oven to 350°F.
Toss eggplant in bowl with olive oil and salt. Transfer to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast in oven until eggplant is tender (about 20 minutes). Set aside.
Bring 1-gallon pot of salted water to boil. Add broccoli rabe and blanch about 2-3 minutes. Shock in ice water. Wring excess moisture from broccoli rabe and add to bowl with dressing.
In same pot, boil pasta for 8-10 minutes or until al dente. Drain and transfer to bowl with dressing and broccoli rabe; toss to combine.
Add eggplant, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, pine nuts, currants, and basil to pasta, broccoli rabe, and dressing. Toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Serve at room temperature.

recipes.name: COFFEE CUSTARD
recipes.description: Almond milk simmers with agar until dissolved, sweetens with maple syrup, and takes on instant coffee and kuzu for a softly set custard crowned with toasted pecans and maple crystals.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine milk and agar. Soak agar 5 minutes.
Bring mixture to boil, lower heat, and simmer uncovered for about 5 minutes or more, until agar is completely dissolved.
Add maple syrup and stir until combined.
Dissolve kuzu and coffee in water until there are no lumps. Add to milk mixture and simmer until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Lightly oil ramekins and sprinkle 2 teaspoons maple crystals in bottom of each ramekin.
Pour custard into ramekins. Refrigerate to set.
When custard is set, run paring knife around side of each ramekin to separate custard. Invert custard onto plate. Garnish with pecans.

recipes.name: Salted Pecan and Rosemary Brittle
recipes.description: Brown rice syrup, agave, and coconut oil boil to a precise 280 degrees with fresh rosemary swirled in along the way, then pecans and baking soda turn the molten candy into shattering, sea-salted brittle.
instructions: Line 2 half-sheet pans with Silpats and set aside. Have 2 more Silpats ready for use.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine brown rice syrup, water, coconut oil, agave, and salt. Set pot over medium flame, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to boil. Reduce heat to simmer.
Once mixture reaches 260°F as measured on candy thermometer, add rosemary. Do not stir mixture again but swirl pot occasionally and keep cooking until candy thermometer reads 280°F.
Stir in nuts and mix well. Remove mixture from heat and thoroughly stir in baking soda.

Quickly divide brittle mixture between 2 half-sheet pans, using lightly oiled spatula. Spread brittle into thin even layer. Place second large Silpat on top of brittle and roll more thinly with rolling pin.
Let brittle cool completely, about 30 minutes. If making brittle on hot, humid day in kitchen without air conditioning, then you may have to cool brittle in refrigerator.
When cooled, turn brittle upside down from Silpat onto parchment paper. Break brittle in 1/4-inch sized pieces.

recipes.name: Blackened Shrimp
recipes.description: Skewered jumbo shrimp roll through a bold blackening blend of paprika, cumin, coriander, and thyme before hitting a hot griddle grill, where the spice crust sears into smoky, fiery flavor.
instructions: In shallow pan or plate, distribute Blackening Spice Mix evenly.
Skewer shrimp, 3 to skewer.
Roll skewered shrimp in spice mix. Heat griddle grill.
Grill shrimp about 1 1/2-2 minutes on each side until shrimp is opaque.

recipes.name: Mushroom Consommé
recipes.description: Dried shiitakes, porcinis, and kombu steep into a deep stock while onion, carrot, and fennel roast until heavily caramelized; seared button mushrooms, madeira, and egg whites then refine it all into a crystal-clear consommé.
instructions: Combine shiitakes, porcinis, and kombu with water in 2-gallon pot. Simmer stock 20 minutes, strain and reserve stock, discarding mushrooms and kombu.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Toss onion, carrot and fennel with oil. Roast vegetables until well caramelized, approximately 20 to 30 minutes. Add tomatoes and garlic for last 10 minutes.
In 12-inch sauté pan, sauté button mushrooms in oil until well caramelized, stirring often. Deglaze pan over high heat with some reserved stock.

Transfer sautéed mushrooms, their deglazing liquid, and roasted vegetables to 1-gallon pot. Add bouquet garni and remaining stock. Simmer 45 minutes, skimming surface. Strain and reserve broth, discarding bouquet garni and vegetables.
In 1-gallon pot, reduce broth to about 8 cups. Chill broth in ice bath to room temperature.

Add clarification to pot, mixing well. Heat broth to simmer, stirring occasionally. When simmer is reached, cease stirring. Clarification will rise to top, forming “raft.” Simmer uncovered another 20 minutes. Strain resulting “consommé” (clarified broth) through chinois lined with many layers of cheesecloth.
Degrease surface of consommé with paper towels, if necessary. Season with salt and pepper. Ladle soup in bowls and garnish with chives.

recipes.name: Phyllo Triangles with Feta and Kale
recipes.description: Blanched lacinato kale folds into sweated onion and garlic spiked with nutmeg and red pepper flakes, then feta and ricotta bind the filling inside crisp, butter-brushed whole wheat phyllo triangles.

ingredients.name: ricotta cheese
ingredients.notes: strained 30 minutes in strainer lined with wet cheesecloth

instructions: Heat convection oven to 350°F. Line half sheet tray with parchment. Set aside.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onion, garlic, ½ teaspoon salt, nutmeg, and red pepper flakes until onions are translucent. Set aside.

In 2-gallon pot, bring 1 gallon water to boil with remaining 1 tablespoon salt. Prepare an ice bath. Blanch kale until tender, about 3-5 minutes. Shock in ice water and drain in colander. Squeeze excess moisture from kale and finely chop.
Return pan with onions to burner over medium flame and add kale. Sauté mixture until kale is heated through.
When mixture has cooled, transfer to medium bowl. Add feta and ricotta cheeses and mix to combine. Season to taste.
Unwrap phyllo and lay one sheet on parchment paper horizontally. Cover remaining sheets with damp towel. Brush phyllo with butter.

Spoon seven 1-tablespoon dollops of mixture across bottom edge of phyllo at equal distances. Cut phyllo into strips between each dollop, and fold up “flag” style (see diagram) to make triangular shape. Transfer finished phyllo triangles to prepared sheet pan. Brush tops with more butter. Repeat with remaining phyllo.
Just before baking, brush all triangles with butter again. Bake 20 minutes or until evenly golden.

recipes.name: MANGO SALSA FOR CRUSTED FLOUNDER
recipes.description: Ripe mango, red onion, cucumber, and jalapeno toss with cilantro, mint, and olive oil into a bright, no-cook salsa made to be spooned generously over crusted flounder.
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve atop crusted flounder.

recipes.name: ROSEMARY AND GARLIC PIZZELLE (FOR WHITE BEAN SPREAD)
recipes.description: Chickpea and all-purpose flours whisk into a cream-thin batter flecked with minced rosemary, garlic, and scallion, then crisp in an oiled pizzelle maker — savory wafers made to carry white bean spread.

ingredients.name: small amount of olive oil to grease pizzelle maker

instructions: In small bowl, sift together dry ingredients.
In separate small bowl, whisk together wet ingredients.
Using whisk, mix wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Mixture should be consistency of heavy cream. Add extra water, if necessary.
Lightly brush or spray small amount of oil on cooking surface of pizzelle maker. Plug in machine and wait until light turns red. When machine is ready, ladle 1/4 teaspoon of batter for each pizzelle.
After pouring mixture, close cover of machine and cook 1 1/2 minutes until pizzelles are lightly browned and crisp. Remove from machine with an offset spatula.

recipes.name: TEMPEH SCALOPPINI
recipes.description: Tempeh simmers first in shoyu with ginger and kombu, then slices thin, dredges in flour, and pan-fries golden before braising in white wine with shiitake and cremini mushrooms, garlic, and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: sliced fresh shiitake and/or cremini mushrooms

instructions: In medium saucepan, combine shoyu, ginger, kombu, sea salt, and tempeh and water. Cover pan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 25 minutes. Drain tempeh.
Slice tempeh on diagonal into 6-8 thin slices. Dredge each slice in flour. Shake off excess flour.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high heat and fry tempeh until golden on both sides. Drain any excess oil. Add water or stock and wine to tempeh. Cover and bring to boil.
Add sliced mushrooms and garlic, reduce heat to low, and cook covered until mushrooms release juices and become tender.
Add fresh herbs; simmer until liquid thickens (needs to be saucy).
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice and salt to taste.
Garnish with parsley and serve.
Note: Serve with rice, noodles or sautéed greens.

recipes.name: Velouté
recipes.description: Butter and flour cook into a roux before chicken stock whisks in half a cup at a time, each addition thickening before the next, then the sauce simmers 35 to 40 minutes to a silky nappé consistency.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 12-inch sauté pan, melt butter over medium-low flame. Sprinkle in flour and stir for about 3-4 minutes.
Slowly whisk in stock 1/2 cup at a time, waiting for sauce to thicken between each addition, until sauce is smooth.
Lower heat and simmer about 35-40 minutes or until sauce achieves nappé consistency.
Adjust seasonings to taste.
Note: Reserve 2 cups of this sauce for Sauce Supreme (see below).

recipes.name: Curry Marinade
recipes.description: Whole coriander, cumin, mustard, cardamom, and fenugreek seeds fry with garlic in coconut oil just until fragrant, then blend into a deeply aromatic marinade carrying turmeric, paprika, and cayenne.
instructions: In 8-inch sauté pan, heat oil and fry garlic and spices until fragrant (30 to 60 seconds), taking care not to burn them.
Cool for approximately 10 minutes. Puree mixture in blender.

recipes.name: HERBED QUINOA
recipes.description: Quinoa toasts dry in the saucepan until it smells nutty and browns lightly, then simmers covered in boiling salted water until every drop absorbs, finished with a fork-fluff and fresh tarragon.
instructions: Toast quinoa in 2 1/2 quart saucepan over high heat, stirring constantly until it smells nutty and browns lightly (5-7 minutes).
Remove quinoa from heat. Add boiling water and salt. Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until quinoa is cooked and all liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with fork and add tarragon before serving.

recipes.name: PITA
recipes.description: Yeast proofed in warm water and maple syrup anchors a dough of white all-purpose, whole wheat bread, and pastry flours, kneaded ten to fifteen minutes until smooth and baked on a hot pizza stone.
instructions: Preheat convection oven to 400°F with a pizza stone inside. In bowl, combine water, maple syrup, and yeast. Proof for about 10 minutes or until mixture is foamy.
Add oil, salt, all-purpose flour, bread flour, and enough whole wheat pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough about 10-15 minutes, using remaining pastry flour, until smooth dough has been created.
Transfer dough to clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for approximately 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare 6 pizza peels dusted with cornmeal or semolina.
Fold/turn dough. Rise dough again.
Divide dough into 16 equal-sized balls. Using rolling pin, roll each ball of dough into 1/8-inch thick, 6-inch circle and transfer to pizza peels.
Loosely cover dough with damp towels and set aside in warm place. Rise for about 15 minutes.
Bake pita for approximately 3-4 minutes or until puffed. Don’t let pita brown, as that makes them too crisp.

recipes.name: PHYLLO CUPS WITH SAUTÉED APPLES
recipes.description: Sheets of phyllo brushed with melted butter and dusted with maple crystals and cinnamon get layered, cut into squares, and baked into crisp cups for sautéed apples, finished with toasted nuts and fresh mint.

ingredients.name: sticks melted butter or 1 cup no taste oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F degrees. Oil muffin tins (3 tins, 6 muffins each).
Layer 6 sheets of phyllo, brushing each layer with either melted butter or oil. Sprinkle each layer with pinch of maple crystals and pinch of cinnamon.
Cut layered phyllo into six equal pieces, making six 4-inch by 4-inch squares. Repeat process until all phyllo is used.
When all 18 squares are complete, carefully press them into muffin tins. Bake for 7-10 minutes or until phyllo cups are golden.
Remove cups from tins and cool. Fill with sautéed apples (recipe following) and ice cream. Garnish plate with cinnamon, toasted nuts, and fresh mint.
Heat clarified butter in 8-inch sauté pan until hot. Add apples and brown 3-5 minutes. With slotted spoon, transfer apples to warm plate.
Pour off clarified butter and deglaze with juice, then add syrup and vanilla or rum. Reduce by little more than half, or until bubbles cover surface of pan.
Cool sauce for minute or two. Mount with cold butter.
Transfer apples to phyllo cup. Coat apples with 1 to 2 tablespoons of sauce and dust with cinnamon and nuts. Top with ice cream. Use remaining sauce as underliner for phyllo cups.

recipes.name: ROSEMARY, SQUASH, AND LEEK DUMPLINGS
recipes.description: Butternut squash roasts with rosemary and olive oil until tender, blends silky-smooth, and joins leeks and garlic sweated with ginger juice — a fragrant filling for wonton wrappers with a tamari-balsamic dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: butternut squash
ingredients.notes: 1 large; peeled, seeded, cut into 1-inch cubes

ingredients.name: salt and freshly ground black pepper
leeks
ingredients.notes: 1 large; washed, trimmed, cut into 1/8-inch half moons

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. In medium bowl, combine the squash, 2 tablespoons olive oil, rosemary, salt and pepper to taste. Toss to coat. Transfer squash to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast 20 minutes or until tender. Set aside.
When cool, transfer squash to food processor and blend until smooth. Set aside.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in 12-inch sauté pan over medium flame. Sweat leeks and garlic until tender, about 3-5 minutes. Add ginger juice.
Transfer vegetables to medium bowl and add sesame oil, mirin, lemon juice, and pureed squash. Mix to combine and season to taste.
In small bowl, slurry arrowroot and water to smooth consistency. Set aside.

Spoon 1 tablespoon filling in middle of wonton skin. Lightly brush outer edge of wonton wrapper with arrowroot mixture. Fold wrapper in half to form half moon, pinching edges together. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers and filling.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 1/4 cup oil over medium-high flame. Add 6-7 wontons at a time and pan fry each side until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes a side. Whisk and combine all dipping sauce ingredients in small bowl and serve with dumplings.

recipes.name: Gravad Lax
recipes.description: Scored salmon filet sits skin side down while sea salt, maple crystals, black pepper, dill, basil, red onion, vodka, and lemon mix into the cure that will transform the fish without any heat.

ingredients.name: boneless salmon or arctic char filet

instructions: Score salmon by making two, 2-3-inch-long and 1/4 inch deep cuts into each side of fish.
Transfer salmon to shallow pan skin side down.
In bowl, mix all remaining ingredients.
Place mixture directly over salmon, packing ingredients down.

Wrap salmon tightly in plastic and refrigerate for 3 days to cure. After end of each day, drain any liquid that has been extracted from salmon. If necessary, add another cup of maple crystals and sea salt to salmon.
On last day, rinse off salmon. Color of flesh should have darkened, and texture should be firmer.

recipes.name: QUICK TOFU TERIYAKI
recipes.description: Firm tofu slabs simmer for a full 35 minutes in a blended marinade of grated ginger juice, garlic, shoyu, maple syrup, and umeboshi paste, soaking up deep sweet-salty teriyaki flavor right in the pot.

ingredients.name: juice from 1/4 cup peeled and grated ginger

instructions: In blender, combine marinade ingredients. Blend until smooth.
Slice tofu into four slabs of equal thickness.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine tofu with marinade. Bring to boil and reduce to simmer, covered, for 35 minutes.
Drain tofu (reserving marinade) and blot with paper towels to absorb excess moisture.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil and pan-fry tofu over medium-high heat until golden on both sides.
After tofu is cooked, drain any excess oil out of pan and place tofu in warm oven.
Transfer marinade to blender with kuzu and process until smooth.
Pour blended mixture into pan and cook for about two minutes, until liquid is thickened, stirring constantly.
Add tofu to sauce, stirring until well coated.
Serve with rice and steamed vegetables.

recipes.name: BEET KVASS
recipes.description: Organic beets are submerged in salted filtered water — with optional whey or sauerkraut juice to kick-start the culture — then left under cheesecloth in a cool, dark spot to ferment for two to three days.

ingredients.name: medium organic beets
ingredients.notes: 2-3; 3/4 pound; scrubbed (not peeled), chopped in 1-inch pieces

ingredients.name: sea salt
ingredients.notes: or 1 1/2 tablespoons if not using whey/juice

instructions: Place beets in bottom of jar, add whey/juice (if using), and salt as needed.
Cover beets with water, place cheesecloth over mouth of jar and secure with string.
Set in cool dark spot for 2 days to ferment if using whey/juice or 3 days without.
Strain beets from liquid, and discard beets. Return liquid to jar and refrigerate.

recipes.name: TOFU "SOUR CREAM"
recipes.description: Soft tofu whips up in the food processor with chickpea miso, dijon mustard, umeboshi paste, and scallions until smooth and creamy — a tangy, dairy-free stand-in for sour cream, seasoned entirely to taste.
instructions: In food processor, combine all ingredients; process until smooth and creamy. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: WHOLE WHEAT POPPYSEED BREAD
recipes.description: Yeast blooms into a thick sponge with whole wheat flours and warm water before olive oil, sea salt, and poppy seeds are worked in; the dough is then kneaded a full 10 to 15 minutes until supple and smooth.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F. In large bowl, combine yeast, water, rice syrup, whole wheat bread flour, and 1 cup whole wheat pastry flour and stir until thick like batter. Cover sponge with plastic wrap and set aside in warm place for 30-45 minutes.
Add oil, salt, poppy seeds, and just enough of remaining whole wheat pastry flour to create dough that pulls away from sides of bowl.
Knead dough on table for about 10-15 minutes or until smooth dough has been created.
Transfer dough to large, clean, lightly oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap. Proof in warm place for 45-60 minutes or until dough has doubled in size.
While dough is proofing, prepare bread pans or sheet pans with parchment.
When dough doubles in size, gently fold and turn dough. Cover with plastic and rise again.
Divide dough into two. Form dough into loaves and transfer to prepared loaf pans or on sheet trays. Cover dough with wet towel and rise one final time (approximately 15-30 minutes).
Bake approximately 30-45 minutes or until dough is golden and firm to touch.

recipes.name: Basic Tempeh
recipes.description: Tempeh simmers for 20 to 25 minutes in a broth of shoyu, ginger, and kombu, drinking in savory depth; the strained cooking liquid gets reserved for Tempeh Scaloppini, so nothing goes to waste.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine shoyu, ginger, kombu, sea salt, and tempeh. Pour in enough water to cover tempeh (about 3 cups). Cover pan and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer about 20-25 minutes.
Drain tempeh and set aside. Reserve cooking liquid for use in Tempeh Scaloppini.

recipes.name: Hollandaise
recipes.description: Egg yolks are whisked with lemon juice over a bain marie until thick enough for the whisk to leave tracks, then warm clarified butter goes in drop by drop, building a rich emulsion seasoned with salt and cayenne.
instructions: Using round-bottomed, straight-sided bowl over bain marie (double boiler), whisk yolks with lemon juice, salt and pepper until thick and creamy – until whisk leaves tracks in yolks.
Have butter warm but not hot. Add butter slowly, drop by drop first, whisking continuously.
Do not add more than egg yolks can hold. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
If sauce breaks, rescue by adding 1 teaspoon of cold water and beating vigorously. If this does not work, whisk 2 egg yolks into broken sauce as you would butter.
If necessary, thin with few drops of warm water.

recipes.name: KASHA VARNISHKES (KASHA WITH BOWTIES)
recipes.description: Caramelized onions and mushrooms anchor this bowtie pasta dish, tossed with egg-coated kasha simmered in stock, then finished with fresh parsley and ribbons of smoked salmon.
instructions: Melt butter or oil in 10-inch sauté pan. Over medium-high heat, cook onions and mushrooms until caramelized, adding garlic toward end of cooking. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer to large bowl.
In large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta until al dente. Drain pasta and toss with onion mixture.
In small bowl, beat egg and add kasha. Stir until grains are well coated.
Wipe out sauté pan and heat again over high heat. Transfer kasha mixture to pan and cook, stirring, until grains are toasted and separate, 2 to 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and add stock. Stir, cover, and simmer until stock is absorbed and kasha is tender but not mushy, 7 to 8 minutes.
Stir in pasta mixture. Taste and adjust seasonings. Garnish with parsley and salmon.

recipes.name: Phyllo Triangles with Tofu and Spinach
recipes.description: Crumbled pressed tofu joins shallots sweated with fennel, cumin, and smoked paprika, then gets folded with spinach, chickpea miso, and umeboshi into crisp whole wheat phyllo triangles.

ingredients.name: spinach
ingredients.notes: stemmed, steamed, and wrung of excess moisture

instructions: Heat convection oven to 350°F. Line half sheet tray with parchment. Set aside.
Press tofu between paper towels on sheet pan with weighted plate for amount 30 minutes. Transfer tofu to medium bowl and crumble it with fingertips. Set aside.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat shallots, salt, fennel, cumin, and paprika until shallots are translucent. Transfer mixture to bowl with tofu. Add miso and umeboshi. Mix to combine. Chop spinach and combine with tofu mixture. Season to taste.
Unwrap phyllo and lay one sheet on parchment paper horizontally. Cover remaining sheets with damp towel. Brush phyllo with oil.

Spoon seven 1-tablespoon dollops of mixture across bottom edge of phyllo at equal distances. Cut phyllo into strips between each dollop, and fold up “flag” style (see diagram) to make triangular shape. Transfer finished phyllo triangles to prepared sheet pan. Brush tops with more oil. Repeat with remaining phyllo.
Just before baking, brush all triangles with butter again. Bake 20 minutes or until evenly golden.

recipes.name: Hibiscus-Mint Cooler
recipes.description: A visually striking, ruby-red infusion uniting the tart, fiery nature of hibiscus flowers with the crisp, ethereal cooling effect of fresh mint. This harmonizing cooler acts as a powerful botanical reset during transitional seasons.
instructions: Combine water and hibiscus tea in stockpot. Bring to boil, turn off tea, and steep for 20 minutes. Chill tea in ice bath.
Combine agave and mint leaves in suribachi with 2 cups of cooled tea. Muddle (crush) mint leaves with agave and tea using surikogi (pestle) until well combined.
Add mint mixture to remaining tea and strain.
Serve over ice and garnish with mint sprig.

recipes.name: Big Chewy Oatmeal-Raisin Cookies
recipes.description: Creamed butter and brown sugar carry rolled oats, plump raisins, and freshly grated nutmeg through a classic drop-cookie method, baking into big bakery-style rounds with a satisfying chew.
instructions: Heat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection oven). Prepare 2 half sheet trays with parchment paper.
In stand mixer, beat butter with sugars until creamy, approximately 3 minutes. Beat in egg.
Separately whisk flour, salt, baking powder, and nutmeg together. Add dry ingredients into butter-sugar mixture. Stir in oats and optional raisins.
Form dough into 24 (1-inch) balls using 1-ounce scoop, placing each cookie every 2 inches apart on sheet trays.
Bake until cookie edges turn golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes. Halfway during baking, rotate trays front to back and switch them from top to bottom.
Slide cookies cooling rack and let cool at least 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: PINTO BEAN STEW
recipes.description: Cumin and garlic sweat with onion before pinto beans simmer alongside a dried chipotle, red peppers, and plum tomatoes; the softened chile is minced and stirred back in for smoky heat under fresh cilantro.

ingredients.name: medium red peppers
ingredients.notes: roasted, seeded, and cut into medium dice

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil on medium-low flame. Add onion, salt, garlic, and cumin. Sweat until onion becomes translucent. Add beans, salt, bay leaf, chipotle, and water. Cover pot and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 35-40 minutes, or until beans are tender. Remove chipotle from pot, mince, and set aside.
Add peppers and tomatoes; continue simmering for 5 minutes more.
Add minced chipotle and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

recipes.name: Vegan and Gluten-Free Spiced Fruit Muffins
recipes.description: Almond flour, flax, ground quinoa, and oats form the base of these vegan, gluten-free muffins, warmly spiced with cinnamon, cardamom, and allspice and studded with diced pear and cranberries.

ingredients.name: flax seed
ingredients.notes: ground to powder in a coffee grinder
