ingredients.name: red quinoa
ingredients.notes: ground to powder in a coffee grinder

ingredients.name: diced pear
ingredients.notes: or may use diced Granny Smith apples

ingredients.name: frozen or fresh cranberries
ingredients.notes: could use blueberries or cherries, instead

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Line muffin tins with muffin papers or use silicon baking molds.
Whisk together almond meal, flax meal, ground quinoa, oats, baking powder, salt, pepper, spices, and orange zest in bowl; set aside.
Whisk together applesauce, oil, and maple syrup in separate bowl.
Make well in dry ingredients and pour in wet mixture; stir to combine. Mix in pear and cranberries (or apples and blueberries).
Fill each muffin chamber 2/3 full. Bake 20-25 minutes or until skewer inserted in center of a muffin comes out clean.
Leave muffins in chambers for 10 minutes before inverting onto a cooling rack. Allow muffins to cool completely before serving.

recipes.name: SPICE LOAF RING
recipes.description: Butter and maple crystals cream together in the food processor before eggs and almond extract join sorghum and gluten-free flours spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice, baked in a bundt pan.

ingredients.name: softened butter
ingredients.notes: 3 sticks; + 1-2 teaspoons butter for greasing pan

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease and flour 9 or 10-inch non-stick Bundt pan.
In food processor, combine butter and maple crystals. Process 2-3 minutes. Add eggs one at a time. Add almond extract. Continue to blend 2-3 minutes longer. Transfer to medium bowl.
In separate medium bowl, sift together flours, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, and salt.
Fold flour mixture into butter egg mixture (batter will be slightly thick).
Pour batter into Bundt pan (should be about 2/3 full).
Bake for 25-30 minutes. Cool in pan about 10 minutes. Run knife around edge to loosen cake from pan. Cool completely on rack.

recipes.name: PORCINI MUSHROOM STOCK
recipes.description: Button mushrooms and onion brown deeply in olive oil for a full fifteen minutes before dried porcini, their soaking water, and aromatics of bay, thyme, and peppercorns simmer into a dark, savory stock.

ingredients.name: dried porcini mushrooms
ingredients.notes: soaked 20 minutes in water (reserve soaking water)

instructions: Heat oil in 1-gallon stockpot. Add fresh mushrooms and onion to cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until well browned, about 15 minutes.
Add water, garlic, porcini mushrooms, reserved soaking water, celery, carrots, bay leaves, peppercorns, parsley stems, and thyme and bring to boil, covered.
Lower heat and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove dried mushrooms and discard or save for another use.
Strain stock through double layer of cheesecloth. Press vegetables firmly to get out as much liquid as possible.
Measure volume of stock. Return to stove and reduce to 3 cups.

recipes.name: Basic Home-Fried Potatoes
recipes.description: Idaho baking potatoes roast whole until fork tender, setting them up for a skillet finish with olive oil, large onions, kosher salt, and coarsely ground black pepper in this straightforward home-fry standby.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350°F.
Wash potatoes and pat dry. Prick with fork.
Combine potatoes on sheet pan and bake for one hour (or until fork tender).
When potatoes are cool, peel them and cut them into large dice.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat 2-3 tablespoons oil. Add onions in batches, cooking over medium-high heat, until they are wilted and lightly browned (about 10-15 minutes), adding more oil as necessary. Transfer each batch of onions to bowl, and continue until all onions are caramelized. Add baked potatoes to onions and stir to combine.
Add potato-onion mixture, in batches, back to pan with more oil, as necessary, turning potatoes with spatula until they are crisp and brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Zesty Lemon Cake
recipes.description: Lemon arrives four ways here, as zest, juice, extract, and oil, in a maple-sweetened layer cake whisked together with whole wheat pastry flour, almond milk, and melted coconut oil before baking in two pans.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection). Oil and flour two 8-inch cake pans and line bottoms with parchment.
Sift together dry ingredients in medium bowl and whisk together to combine. Set aside.
In separate bowl, whisk together wet ingredients and pour into dry. Mix well.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake for about 15-20 minutes until cakes are springy to touch and pull away from sides of pans.
Cool in pans on wire rack for 10-15 minutes. Remove from pans and completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: SMOKED TROUT TERRINE
recipes.description: Saffron-infused cream is blended with smoked trout, lemon juice, and egg whites into a delicate base, joined by shrimp, scallops, and fresh herbs in a plastic-lined terrine mold and gently baked at 300°F.
instructions: Heat oven to 300°F. Line terrine mold with plastic. Prepare an ice bath.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, heat cream to 160°F and add pinch of saffron. Transfer pot to ice bath and cool cream to room temperature.
Combine trout, lemon juice, salt, pepper, egg whites, and infused cream in food processor.

Puree until smooth and fully combined. Transfer puree to bowl. Fold in shrimp, scallops, parsley, and basil. Transfer mixture to terrine mold. Fold ends of plastic wrap or parchment over top of terrine.
Poach terrine in 170°F water bath for about 35 minutes.
Remove terrine from water bath and cool before refrigerating at least 3-4 hours.

recipes.name: Pomegranate, Blueberry, and Ginger Elixir
recipes.description: A vibrant, antioxidant-rich tonic balancing the earthy sweetness of dark berries with the fiery, kinetic bite of fresh ginger. This intensely restorative elixir promotes energetic circulation and grounds the body while stimulating the senses.
instructions: Combine pomegranate juice, blueberries, ginger juice, and agave in VitaMix and puree. Do not strain. Serve over ice.

recipes.name: GREEN JUICE
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber, zucchini, and kale run through the juicer with pineapple, lemon, and a knob of ginger, finishing on celery stalks for a clean, bracing green glass meant to be poured and sipped immediately.

ingredients.name: bunch parsley
ingredients.notes: 1 ounce; washed and spun dry, 1/4-inch stems trimmed and discarded

instructions: Cut produce to fit juicer feed tube. Juice produce in order of ingredient listing, ending with celery stalks.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Beet and Apple Juice
recipes.description: Earthy beets and tart Granny Smith apples run through the juicer in alternating batches with lemon; a brief chill in the refrigerator settles the foam before the ruby-red glass is served.
instructions: Cut produce to fit juicer feed tube.
Alternate juicing beets and apples, finishing with beets. Refrigerate juice 5-10 minutes for foam to settle.
Scrape off any excess foam and serve immediately.

recipes.name: SWEET BREW WITH CITRUS FRUIT
recipes.description: Kukicha and mint tea bags steep with fresh lemon and orange in just-boiled water, then a pour of organic apple juice sweetens the whole pot into a bright, citrus-laced brew.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, bring water to boil.
Turn off flame. Steep tea bags and fruit in water, covered, for 5 minutes.
Add apple juice to pot, stir and serve.

recipes.name: Lemon-Cayenne Tea
recipes.description: Sharp, warming, and ready in seconds, this bracing tea stirs the juice of a whole lemon into water with a jolt of cayenne, meant to be sipped in the morning a half hour before breakfast for a fiery wake-up call.
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and drink in morning 1/2 hour before breakfast.

recipes.name: CORNMEAL PANCAKES (JOHNNY CAKES)
recipes.description: Boiling water blooms the yellow cornmeal before egg, milk, and melted butter enrich the batter; lemon zest and blueberries fold in last for tender, golden johnny cakes.
instructions: In large bowl, whisk cornmeal, salt and maple crystals. Slowly add boiling water. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
In separate bowl, beat together egg, milk and melted butter. Add to cornmeal mixture.
In separate bowl, whisk together flour and baking powder and stir into batter with few swift strokes. Add lemon zest and blueberries, if using.
Using 1-ounce ladle, pour batter onto griddle. Cook cakes until bubbles in batter break on surface; flip and cook until browned.

recipes.name: RICE FLOUR GRIDDLE CAKES
recipes.description: Brown rice flour and ground flax seed form the base of these griddle cakes, sweetened with maple crystals, spiced with cinnamon and nutmeg, and bound with blended almond milk and coconut oil.
instructions: Whisk together flour, baking powder, maple crystals, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and ground flax seed.
In blender combine almond milk, and butter or oil.
Combine liquid ingredients and dry ingredients.
Using 1-ounce ladle, pour batter onto griddle. Cook cakes until bubbles in batter break on surface; flip and cook until browned.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Five flours—sorghum, buckwheat, tapioca, brown rice, and sweet white rice—whisk together as the base of these chocolate chip cookies, with butter creamed into maple crystals for a rich, tender dough.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375° F. Line 2 half-sheet pans with parchment paper.
In medium bowl whisk sorghum flour, buckwheat flour, tapioca starch flour, brown rice flour, white sweet rice flour, and baking powder together. Set aside.
Cream butter and maple crystals with paddle attachment in stand mixer.
Add egg, vanilla, and salt to butter/maple crystal mixture, and salt. Beat on slow speed for 30-60 seconds more.
Stop mixer and add flour mixture to other ingredients. Mix to combine. (Mixture will be stickier than type of “drop” batter prepared with wheat flour.) Add chocolate chips.
Using 1-ounce scoop, portion dough onto baking sheets. Place approximately dozen cookies per sheet with good distance between, as cookies spread.
Cook for about 7-10 minutes or until cookies are nicely golden (do not under-bake).
Transfer to racks until cooled and firmed up.

recipes.name: BLUEBERRY CORN MUFFINS
recipes.description: Corn flour and a gluten-free blend anchor these muffins, sweetened with maple crystals and maple syrup, studded generously with blueberries, and baked hot at 400 degrees for a golden, tender crumb.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 400°F. Grease muffin pan with butter.
In medium bowl, combine dry ingredients.
In separate small bowl, combine wet ingredients: butter, milk, maple syrup, and eggs.
Mix wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Add blueberries. Mix carefully to incorporate.
Using standard ice cream scoop, fill muffin tins 3/4 full.
Bake 15-18 minutes. Best served warm.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE CRISP GINGER COOKIE
recipes.description: Almond meal, sorghum, and arrowroot flours are whisked with ginger and a pinch of black pepper, then bound with rice and maple syrups and coconut oil before a slow 300-degree bake to full crispness.
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F. Line 3 half-sheet trays with Silpats.
In medium bowl whisk almond meal, sorghum flour, arrowroot flour, ground ginger, and black pepper.
In separate small bowl, whisk together oil, rice syrup, maple syrup, vanilla, water, and salt.
Pour syrup mixture into nut/flour mixture. Batter should be consistency of heavy cream. If it is too thick, add more water, 1 tablespoon at a time, until you have proper consistency.

Using teaspoon measure, drop batter onto sheets (5-6 cookies a sheet). Decorate each cookie with one sliced almond. Bake 15-20 minutes or until cookies are golden. Cool before removing from sheet pan.
Note: Cookies hold shape better on Silpat.

recipes.name: Carrot Cake
recipes.description: Grated carrot and crushed pineapple keep this batter lush, warmed with cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg and studded with raisins and walnuts — whisked together in two bowls and baked in miniature muffin tins.

ingredients.name: crushed pineapple
ingredients.notes: 4 oz.; drained and squeezed to extract all liquid

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection oven). Prepare miniature muffin tins with muffin papers.
Whisk dry ingredients together in large bowl.
Whisk together wet ingredients. Add raisins and walnuts.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix. Using 1-ounce ice cream scoop, fill muffin papers 2/3 full and bake for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

recipes.name: MANGO SAUCE (FOR CHICKPEA CRÊPE)
recipes.description: Ripe mango and plum tomatoes blend with shallot and lime juice into a creamy, tangy-sweet sauce made for chickpea crêpes, brightened at the end with a jalapeño and cilantro garnish.

ingredients.name: ripe plum tomatoes
ingredients.notes: concassé (peeled, seeded, and chopped), reserve juices

instructions: In blender, combine mango, tomatoes, tomato juices, shallot, canola oil, lime juice, and salt. Blend until creamy.
Adjust seasonings. Garnish sauce with jalapeño and cilantro.

recipes.name: GOAT CHEESE, BEET, AND WALNUT SALAD
recipes.description: Romaine, watercress, frisée, and endive toss together and get plated with beets, toasted walnuts, soft goat cheese, and red onion, each salad dressed with creamy fresh horseradish dressing just before serving.

ingredients.name: small beets
ingredients.notes: roasted, peeled and cut into bite size pieces

instructions: In large bowl, toss all greens together and put on individual plates.
Assemble each plate with endive, onion, beets, walnuts, goat cheese, and baguettes.
Dress each salad immediately prior to service.

recipes.name: Fried Tempeh (for Tempeh Reuben Sandwich)
recipes.description: Slices of tempeh simmer for a full half hour in a shoyu, garlic, and bay leaf marinade, soaking up savory depth before being drained, patted dry, and fried in coconut oil.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine marinade ingredients. Cover pan, bring to boil.
Add tempeh slices, lower heat, and simmer uncovered 30-40 minutes.
Drain tempeh and pat dry.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Brown tempeh slices on both sides. Drain on paper towel.

recipes.name: Spelt Bread (for Tempeh Reuben Sandwich)
recipes.description: Yeast blooms in maple-sweetened water before spelt flour and sea salt are worked into a sturdy, pliable dough, kneaded by hand and left to rise until doubled—the foundation for a tempeh reuben sandwich.
instructions: In small bowl, combine water and maple syrup then gently sprinkle yeast on top. Allow to sit until foamy.
Stir in oil, some of the flour, and salt until well combined. Gradually add more flour while stirring until dough is firm and workable.

Turn out dough onto lightly floured surface and knead to form sturdy and pliable dough. Transfer to large, lightly oiled bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place until doubled in size (about 1 hour).

Fold and turn dough, and rise again (about 30 minutes). Divide into two balls. Shape dough and transfer to lightly oiled loaf pans, score if desired. Cover with damp towels and rise again in warm place (about 20 minutes).
While bread is rising, pre-heat oven to 375° F. Bake bread until well-browned and finished (inner temp of 200° F). Remove from pan and cool on racks before slicing.

recipes.name: Tempeh Reuben Sandwich
recipes.description: Fried tempeh stacks onto spelt bread slathered with avocado spread, then tangy sauerkraut, sliced tomato, mustard, and ketchup pile on to build a hefty sandwich served right away with pickles.
instructions: Fried Tempeh (recipe follows):
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine marinade ingredients. Cover pan, bring to boil.
Add tempeh slices, lower heat, and simmer uncovered 30-40 minutes.
Drain tempeh and pat dry.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil. Brown tempeh slices on both sides. Drain on paper towel.
Spelt Bread (recipe follows):
In small bowl, combine water and maple syrup then gently sprinkle yeast on top. Allow to sit until foamy.
Stir in oil, some of the flour, and salt until well combined. Gradually add more flour while stirring until dough is firm and workable.

Turn out dough onto lightly floured surface and knead to form sturdy and pliable dough. Transfer to large, lightly oiled bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap. Let rise in warm place until doubled in size (about 1 hour).

Fold and turn dough, and rise again (about 30 minutes). Divide into two balls. Shape dough and transfer to lightly oiled loaf pans, score if desired. Cover with damp towels and rise again in warm place (about 20 minutes).
While bread is rising, pre-heat oven to 375° F. Bake bread until well-browned and finished (inner temp of 200° F). Remove from pan and cool on racks before slicing.
Ketchup (recipe below):
In blender, combine raisins (with soaking liquid), tomato puree, garlic, water, paprika, cayenne, cinnamon, and salt. Blend until all ingredients are combined.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, on high heat, heat oil. Slowly add tomato mixture. Lower heat and simmer 40 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Simmer 5 minutes more. Adjust seasonings.

recipes.name: CRANBERRY PEAR PIE
recipes.description: Fresh cranberries simmer with maple syrup and orange juice until they pop, then meet sliced pears inside chilled pie dough, topped with strips of the second crust and baked in a moderate oven.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Roll out first pie dough and line pie plate. After dough rests in refrigerator for 15 minutes, trim edges, cover, and chill for at least 30 minutes more. Roll out second dough and cut into 1/2 inch x 10 inch strips. Transfer strips to baking sheet, cover, and chill until ready to use.
In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, combine cranberries, syrup, and orange juice. Bring to boil and reduce to simmer for 5 minutes or until all cranberries have popped. Add pears or apples.
Stir in arrowroot slurry and cook until mixture loses chalky appearance and thickens, about 1 minute. Transfer mixture to bowl to cool.
Spoon cooled filling into chilled pie shell. Arrange lattice strips on top. Trim ends of strips flush with overhang of shell and form edge.
Loosely cover crust with tented foil to keep edges from browning too quickly.
Bake for 35-40 minutes. Remove foil from edges 10 minutes before removing from oven.
Cool and set pie before serving (at least 30 minutes).

recipes.name: Basic Waffles (with Butter and Milk)
recipes.description: Whole wheat pastry flour and maple crystals form the base of this waffle batter, brought together with beaten egg yolks, melted butter, and organic milk in a few swift strokes for a pebbled, tender mix.
instructions: In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and maple crystals.
In separate bowl, beat egg yolks well; add butter, milk, and salt.
Make well in center of dry ingredients. Pour in liquid ingredients and combine with a few swift strokes. Batter should have pebbled look, similar to muffin batter.
Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry, fold into batter with rubber spatula just to combine.
Heat waffle iron. Ladle in 3/4 cups batter.
Cook each waffle 4 minutes or until indicator light on machine goes on.

recipes.name: CHICKPEA CRÊPE
recipes.description: Chickpea and white flours whisk together with chopped chives, cilantro, and oil into a batter the texture of light cream; a thirty-minute rest readies it for tender, savory crêpes.
instructions: In large bowl, sift flours, salt, and pepper.
Add water, herbs and oil to flour mixture and blend with whisk until smooth. (May also be processed in blender.)
Let batter rest at room temperature at least 30 minutes. If necessary, thin batter with more water to maintain consistency of light cream.

Prepare crêpe pan by oiling lightly. Pour approximately 1/4 cup of batter into pan, tipping pan so batter thins covers pan. Cook 30 seconds, until crêpe is golden brown on bottom. Flip, cook another 30 seconds.

recipes.name: Jerk Seitan Sloppy Joe's
recipes.description: Seitan and onions are sautéed until deeply caramelized, then simmered with crushed tomatoes, maple syrup, and Dijon mustard into a stewy, allspice-spiked filling piled onto corn tortillas with avocado and cilantro.

ingredients.name: seitan
ingredients.notes: pulsed in food processor to texture of ground beef

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.notes: sliced into 12 wedges, tossed with 1 tablespoon lime juice (1 lime)

instructions: In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil on medium-high flame. Add onions and sauté until slightly caramelized.
Add seitan and sauté until caramelized, lower heat, and add garlic, thyme, paprika, salt, allspice, red pepper flakes, cinnamon, and black pepper. Sweat until onions are tender.
Add tomatoes, maple syrup, and mustard. Simmer 5-10 minutes or until desired 'stewy' consistency.
Season to taste with lime and ginger juices.
Heat cast iron pan or griddle on medium-low flame. Place tortillas on pan or griddle and heat until softened and flexible.
Dollop 1/4 cup of seitan mixture into each tortilla. Garnish with 1 slice of avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: RICH ALMOND MILK
recipes.description: Blanched almonds steep in just-boiled water before a long blend renders them completely smooth; strained through layers of cheesecloth, the result is a rich, clean milk with the pulp reserved for later.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, bring water to boil. Add almonds and remove pot from flame. Let sit covered for 20-30 minutes.
Transfer almonds and water to Vitamix. Process for few minutes until well homogenized.
Strain milk through nut bag or chinois lined with 2 layers of moistened cheesecloth. Reserve almond pulp and set aside.
Add vanilla and salt. Whisk to combine.
Note: Save any pulp from almond milk for Nut Pulp Crisps recipe.

recipes.name: PLAIN CRÊPES (CLASSIC)
recipes.description: Eggs whisk into a well of sifted flour with milk, melted butter, and a splash of brandy or rum, and the batter strains through a fine chinois and rests until it pours like thin cream for delicate crêpes.
instructions: In mixing bowl, sift flour with salt. Make well in center of dry ingredients. Break eggs into well and whisk until thoroughly incorporated. Immediately add 2 cups of milk, melted butter and brandy or rum (if using). Whisk together until incorporated.
Strain mixture through fine chinois to remove any lumps. Add more milk, if necessary, to achieve consistency of thin cream.
Refrigerate mixture for 30 minutes.

In 7-inch crêpe pan, fry crêpes. If storing, layer with parchment paper and wrap tightly so they do not dry out. If using immediately, pile cooked crêpes on plate, one on top of the other to keep them moist.

recipes.name: CARAMELIZED ONION TART
recipes.description: Onions cook slowly in butter for a good twenty minutes until deeply caramelized, then settle into a twice-chilled crust under a custard of milk, cream, and eggs for a savory tart with real depth.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter or oil 9-inch tart pan with removable bottom.
Roll crust between parchment; chill for 15 minutes. Transfer crust to prepared pan and rest in fridge again for 30 minutes more.
Heat butter or oil in 12-inch sauté pan over medium/low heat. Add onions and cook over (stirring occasionally) until caramelized, about 20 minutes.
While onions cook, half blind bake tart crust (with pie weights) for approximately 10-12 minutes (or until lightly golden).
Remove crust from oven; turn temperature down to 335°F.
Spread caramelized onions into tart shell (do not pat down).
Whisk together custard ingredients and pour over onions.
Bake until custard is set and crust is golden brown, approximately 12-15 minutes.

recipes.name: CANNELLINI BEAN SALAD
recipes.description: Cannellini beans simmer with a bay leaf until tender, then get dressed while still warm in a dijon-lemon vinaigrette with roasted red pepper, kalamata olives, red onion, and basil chiffonade.

ingredients.name: roasted red pepper
ingredients.notes: peeled, seeded, and cut into small dice (1/4 inch)

instructions: Combine beans, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and bay leaf in 1-gallon pot and bring to boil over high heat.
Lower heat and simmer, uncovered, for about 25-30 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove bay leaf and drain beans in colander.
Whisk together remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt, black pepper, mustard, lemon juice, and olive oil. Pour over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with red peppers, red onion, olives, and basil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Seasonal variation: In Winter/Fall, substitute 1/4 teaspoon freshly chopped rosemary for basil.

recipes.name: VEGETABLE AND TEMPEH WRAPS WITH AVOCADO-CILANTRO CREAM
recipes.description: Tempeh browns with cumin and coriander before joining red onion, zucchini, cucumber, and carrot inside soft rice paper wraps, each one paired with a rich avocado-cilantro cream.

ingredients.name: tempeh
ingredients.notes: 8-ounce; grated to texture of ground beef

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.notes: 6 ounces; 1/8-inch salad slice, soaked in water for 10 minutes, drained

ingredients.name: red pepper
ingredients.notes: 8 ounces; seeded, pith removed, and cut into 1/8-inch strips

ingredients.name: english cucumber
ingredients.notes: 12 ounces; peel, seed, cut into 3-inch julienne

ingredients.name: carrot cut
ingredients.notes: 6-8 ounces; cut into 3-inch julienne, blanched for 1 1/2 minutes and shocked

instructions: In non-stick pan, heat oil and lightly brown tempeh for 4-5 minutes. Add cumin and coriander, cooking 3 minutes more. Set mixture aside in bowl to cool.
Drain onion and combine with red pepper, zucchini, cucumber, carrot, and tempeh mixture. Mix well.
Rehydrate each rice paper wrap in bowl of warm water until soft. Transfer wrap to clean dry towel.

Spoon 1 cup of vegetable-tempeh filling on lower part of wrap in sausage shape. Fold bottom of wrap over mixture, then left and right sides to meet in middle. Finish rolling wrap forward to form shape of spring roll. Repeat with remaining rolls.
In bowl of food processor puree avocado, cilantro, olive oil, brown rice vinegar, pepper, and salt until smooth.
Slice each wrap in half on diagonal and top with dollop of avocado cream.

recipes.name: BABY BOK CHOY AND RED CABBAGE SLAW (FOR SEAFOOD SAUSAGE)
recipes.description: Blanched baby bok choy keeps its snap alongside shredded red cabbage, carrot, and scallions, all tossed in a whisked dressing of brown rice vinegar, dijon mustard, and agave.

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.notes: 6 ounces; cut into 4-inch long, thin matchsticks

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.notes: trimmed and cut into thin, 1-inch long diagonals

instructions: Blanch bok choy stalks in small pot of lightly salted, boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain and shock in ice water. Cut into 1/2-inch diagonals. Blanch leaves for 10 seconds. Drain and shock in ice water. Wring out excess water from leaves and finely slice.
Combine bok choy stems in bowl with cabbage, carrots, and scallions.
Whisk dressing ingredients together and combine with slaw.
Arrange 1 cup slaw mixture in middle of large plate.
Top with 2 pieces of Seafood Sausage and dollop of Honey-Mustard Yogurt.

recipes.name: Warm Pinto Bean Salad with Shiitake
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked pinto beans, tender from a strip of kombu, meet lightly sautéed shiitake mushrooms, red onion, and crisp radishes, dressed with shoyu, dijon, and rice syrup for a warm, tangy salad.
instructions: Bring beans, kombu, and water to cover beans (plus 3 inches above) to full pressure in pressure cooker. Lower flame, cook 15 minutes.
In 10-inch sauté pan, lightly sauté fresh shiitake mushrooms in oil. Set aside.
Combine shiitakes, onion and radishes in medium mixing bowl.
In small bowl, combine shoyu, mustard, rice syrup, and vinegars. Slowly whisk in olive oil until emulsified. Pour dressing over vegetables.
Drain beans, add to vegetables, and toss until well mixed.
Gently mix in chives and watercress right before serving.

recipes.name: HORSERADISH AND LEMON CONDIMENT
recipes.description: Freshly grated horseradish steeps in lemon juice for ten minutes, letting its heat bloom into a sharp, bracing two-ingredient condiment meant to be stirred into water, stock, or soup.
instructions: Grate horseradish on box grater using fine holes.
Combine horseradish with lemon juice and set aside for ten minutes at room temperature.
Serve cold or room temperature mixed into water, stock or soup.

recipes.name: CRUCIFEROUS SALAD
recipes.description: Broccoli, cauliflower, and Brussels sprouts blanch briefly and shock in an ice bath to keep their bite, then meet cashews, white miso, umeboshi paste, and dijon mustard with a scatter of sesame seeds.

ingredients.name: broccoli
ingredients.notes: bite-size florets (and stems trimmed and cut to bite-size pieces)

instructions: Bring 1-gallon water to boil with 1 tablespoon salt. Prepare an ice bath.
Blanch broccoli, broccoli stems, and cauliflower separately – broccoli for 30 seconds, cauliflower for 1 minute. Shock blanched vegetables in ice water.
Drain and transfer broccoli, broccoli stems, and cauliflower to bowl and add Brussels sprouts.
In Vitamix, combine dressing ingredients. Process until creamy and smooth, and more water if needed.
Toss vegetables in dressing and serve garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: VEGAN SCONES
recipes.description: Currants soaked in apple juice with lemon zest and juice join a cinnamon-laced whole wheat pastry dough enriched with coconut oil and almond milk, each scone finished with a maple syrup glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and line one half-sheet tray with parchment paper.
Sift flour, sea salt, baking soda, baking powder, and cinnamon together in medium bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
In small bowl, combine apple juice, currants, lemon zest, lemon juice, almond milk, and maple syrup. Whisk to emulsify and set aside.
Cut chilled coconut oil into flour mixture until fat is crumbly and coated in flour. Crumbles should be about size of small peas or smaller.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and gently mix with rubber spatula just until combined, being careful to not over-mix.
Transfer dough to lightly floured table and gently roll to about 3/4 inch thick. Using cookie cutter, cut shapes and place on parchment-lined baking sheet.

Bake for about 6 minutes and rotate pan in oven to ensure even browning. Glaze with maple syrup at this point, if desired. Continue to bake another 6-8 minutes or until golden on top and somewhat firm to touch.
Transfer scones to cooling rack. Serve warm with jam or cool and store in tightly sealed container for up to four days.

recipes.name: ARUGULA, OLIVE OIL, BALSAMIC REDUCTION
recipes.description: Balsamic vinegar simmers with vanilla until it coats the back of a spoon, then drizzles over peppery arugula tossed with olive oil and salt, finished with shavings of Reggiano parmesan.
instructions: Combine balsamic vinegar and vanilla in medium pan. Bring mixture to simmer, and cook down to approximately 1/2 cup or until mixture thickens enough to coat back of spoon. Set mixture aside to cool.
Toss arugula, oil, and salt together in bowl. Drizzle balsamic reduction to taste over greens. Add Reggiano parmesan, if using.

recipes.name: TRADITIONAL CAESAR SALAD
recipes.description: Garlic poached slowly in olive oil flavors both the crisp oven-baked whole grain croutons and the anchovy-lemon dressing that coats crisp romaine leaves under grated parmesan.

ingredients.name: poached garlic cloves from crouton recipe

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat oil and garlic on low heat. Poach until garlic just begins to turn golden. Remove garlic and reserve for dressing.
Toss bread cubes in flavored oil and bake on half sheet pan in oven for about 10 minutes or until crisp. Set aside.
In blender, combine all dressing ingredients except for oil. Slowly drizzle oil into blender until dressing is creamy.
Combine dressing with romaine lettuce. Garnish with Parmesan and croutons.

recipes.name: Kabocha Salad
recipes.description: Roasted kabocha squash meets baby arugula, pomegranate seeds, and crumbled feta, showered with cumin-toasted pumpkin seeds and tossed in a creamy blended pomegranate-sherry vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: kabocha squash
ingredients.notes: 1 medium; peeled, seeded, and bite-size chunks

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Toss squash with oil, salt, and pepper in medium-size bowl. Arrange squash on parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and tender. Remove from oven and set aside.
Toss pumpkin seeds in small bowl with cumin, salt, ginger, and oil. Bake in oven until seeds are lightly toasted, 5-7 minutes.
Combine all dressing ingredients in blender until creamy. Toss arugula with dressing.
Place about 3/4 cup of squash on plate.
Arrange arugula on atop or alongside squash. Garnish arugula with nuts, pomegranate seeds and feta.

recipes.name: ALMOND “CREAM” SAUCE
recipes.description: Blanched almonds are soaked, blended, and strained into silky homemade almond milk, then whirled with slowly sweated onion, garlic, and mellow white miso until the sauce turns velvety, savory, and smooth.
instructions: In blender, soak almonds in 1 cup hot water for at least 15 minutes. Process until smooth, gradually adding remaining cup of water. Strain through fine mesh sieve and return almond milk to blender.
In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, sweat onion in oil with salt until completely soft. Add garlic and cook a few minutes longer, being careful not to brown vegetables.
Add sweated vegetables and miso to almond milk. Process until very smooth, adding salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer sauce back to sauce pan and heat slowly, whisking to break up lumps. Stir in lemon juice and serve immediately.
Note: For tangier flavor, blend 1/2 small clove minced raw garlic into sauce, omitting garlic from step two.
Serving suggestion: Almond "Cream" Sauce is delicious served over pasta with lemon zest and freshly cracked pepper.

recipes.name: LEMON WAFER COOKIES
recipes.description: Blanched almonds grind to a fine meal with sorghum flour and arrowroot, then meet melted coconut oil, maple crystals, and the zest and juice of two lemons for bright, delicate wafer cookies.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 350°F. Line 2 sheet trays with parchment paper.
In food processor, grind almonds to fine meal with flours, baking soda, and salt.
In separate smaller bowl, whisk together wet ingredients.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients in processor (mixture will be loose). Chill dough in refrigerator for 10-15 minutes.
Using 1-ounce ice cream scoop, scoop batter onto sheet tray, leaving room between each cookie as batter spreads.
Sprinkle each cookie with few almond slices.
Cook 15 minutes or until cookies are slightly golden. Cool before removing from parchment paper.

recipes.name: BUTTER-POPPYSEED SAUCE
recipes.description: Two ingredients do all the work here: butter warmed in a sauté pan and ground poppy seeds stirred through it, poured hot over just-cooked ravioli and finished with grated parmesan.
instructions: Heat butter in 8-inch sauté pan and stir in ground poppy seeds.
As soon as ravioli are cooked, remove them with slotted spoon to pre-warmed plates. Pour poppy seed butter over them and sprinkle with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: PRESSED NUT CRUST
recipes.description: Almonds ground to a fine meal and coarsely ground oats combine with oat flour, cinnamon, and maple syrup, then press into an oiled pie pan for a toasty, wholesome crust baked at 350 degrees.

ingredients.name: canola oil or 2 tablespoons melted coconut oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil 9-inch pie or tart pan.
Grind almonds in food processor to form fine almond meal.
Grind oats coarsely in food processor.
In medium bowl, combine almonds, oats, oat flour, cinnamon and salt; mix well.
In separate bowl, whisk together maple syrup, and canola or melted coconut oil.
Mix wet ingredients into dry ingredients.
With wet fingertips, press crust into oiled pie or tart pan.
Bake crust 20 to 25 minutes or until golden and completely baked.

recipes.name: POACHED CHICKEN AND ROASTED ASPARAGUS
recipes.description: Chicken breasts poach gently in a curried coconut-milk broth with bay leaves and thyme while asparagus roasts until just tender, all destined for a bed of fennel, mesclun, and red endive with a honey-curry yogurt dressing.

ingredients.name: fennel bulbs
ingredients.notes: 1 small; cored, thinly sliced, soaked bowl of cold water

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Toss asparagus with oil, salt, 1/4 teaspoon curry powder, and pepper. Transfer asparagus to parchment-lined half sheet pan. Roast until just tender and slightly browned. Set aside.

In 1-gallon pot, bring poach ingredients – chicken stock, coconut milk, bay leaves, thyme, cilantro, salt, remaining 1/2 teaspoon curry powder, and pepper – to simmer. Add chicken, lower heat, cover pot, and poach 15 minutes or until chicken is tender and flesh is opaque.
Remove pot from heat; let chicken remain in stock 20 to 25 minutes. Remove chicken from stock, cool, and cut into 1/3-inch thick diagonal slices. Set aside.
In blender, combine dressing ingredients until creamy. Drain fennel and toss with 2-3 tablespoons of dressing.
On large plate, arrange mesclun, poached chicken, fennel, endive, onion, and asparagus. Drizzle dressing over salad ingredients and chicken. Garnish with cilantro.
Seasonal variation: In Fall/Winter, substitute 1 small head of cauliflower for asparagus.

recipes.name: WATERCRESS AND DANDELION GREENS WITH BABY ARTICHOKES
recipes.description: Baby artichokes steam until just tender, then hit the grill for char marks before joining peppery watercress, dandelion greens, and radishes under a creamy artichoke dressing.

ingredients.name: baby artichokes
ingredients.notes: 6; trimmed, cleaned, tossed in 2 tablespoons lemon juice (1 lemon)

ingredients.name: radishes
ingredients.notes: 1 bunch; stemmed, sliced into thin rounds

instructions: Arrange baby artichokes in steamer basket set in 1-gallon pot filled with 2 cups water. Steam artichokes until just tender when pierced with a toothpick. Cool and cut in half lengthwise. Toss with olive oil and salt. Set aside.
Heat grill. Grill artichoke hearts until grill marks are visible. Remove from grill and set aside.
Combine watercress and dandelion greens in large bowl.
Toss watercress and dandelion greens with dressing (see below). Garnish with radishes and artichokes.

recipes.name: CREAMY ARTICHOKE DRESSING
recipes.description: Steamed artichoke hearts blend with garlic, lemon juice, rice syrup, chives, and olive oil, thinned with their own reserved cooking liquid until the dressing turns luxuriously creamy.

ingredients.name: artichoke cooking liquid or vegetable stock

instructions: Arrange artichokes in steamer basket (see technique above) and steam until tender, about 20 minutes. Set artichokes aside to cool. Reserve any extra steaming liquid.

Remove leaves and choke from cooled artichokes, leaving just heart and stem. Peel outer layer of stem. Cut each artichoke heart into 4 pieces an remove any fibrous material. Blend artichoke hearts with garlic, lemon juice, rice syrup, chives, salt, pepper, and olive oil, adding artichoke water as necessary for desired creamy consistency.

recipes.name: WILTED BITTER GREENS WITH CIPOLLINI ONIONS
recipes.description: Cipollini onions roast in balsamic vinegar and olive oil until tender, ready to crown wilted radicchio, romaine, and chicory finished with sweet currants and crunchy pistachios for bite and contrast.

ingredients.name: cipollini onions
ingredients.notes: root end trimmed and outer skins removed

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F.
Toss onions with olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper in medium-size bowl.
Transfer onions to parchment-lined half sheet pan and roast until tender. Set aside.
Combine radicchio, romaine, and chicory in medium bowl.
In separate small bowl, whisk together balsamic vinegar and rice syrup until well combined.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over low flame and sweat garlic with salt until garlic begins to turn golden.
Add salad greens to pan; sauté until just wilted. Remove pan from heat. Plate greens and lightly drizzle balsamic vinegar-rice syrup mixture over them.
Garnish salad with onions, currants, and pistachios. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Wild Watercress Salad with Citrus
recipes.description: Supremes of navel orange, blood orange, and pink grapefruit meet crisped fennel, red onion, and oil-cured black olives over wild watercress, dressed in a blend of citrus juice, chickpea miso, and tahini.

ingredients.name: fennel bulb
ingredients.notes: 1 medium; stalks and core removed, thinly sliced

instructions: Combine citrus supreme in bowl. Set aside.
Combine juices from citrus supreme in separate bowl. Set aside 1/2 cup for use in dressing.
Cover sliced fennel with cold water in separate bowl. Set aside.
Combine dressing ingredients except for oil in blender. Slowly drizzle oil in blender until creamy and emulsified.
Drain fennel well. Combine fennel and watercress in medium bowl. Toss with dressing. Garnish with citrus supreme, red onion, olives, and watercress.

recipes.name: SMOKY GREEN SPLIT PEA SOUP
recipes.description: Steeped lapsang souchong tea lends this split pea soup its smoke, while onion, carrot, and parsnip sweat slowly before a long simmer renders the peas tender alongside collard greens and cauliflower.

ingredients.name: collard greens
ingredients.notes: 6 leaves; stemmed, and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.notes: 1/4 small head; cut into bite-sized florets

instructions: Combine water and tea in 2-quart pot. Bring to boil, cover, and remove from heat. Steep 5 minutes, strain leaves from tea, and set aside.

Heat oil in separate 1-gallon pot over medium-low flame, and add onion, carrots, parsnip, celery, garlic, and salt. Sweat vegetables, covered, stirring occasionally until they begin to soften, about 7 minutes.
Add bay leaf, split peas, and stock. Bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer with pot partially covered until split peas are tender, about 45-60 minutes.
Remove bay leaf. Add collard leaves and cauliflower. Continue to simmer until greens and cauliflower are tender.
Remove 2 cups of soup and purée in blender until creamy. Add blended ingredients back to pot.
Add vinegar and tea, bring to simmer again, remove from heat, and season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: BEET SALAD WITH GREENS AND PISTACHIO-CRUSTED GOAT CHEESE MEDALLIONS
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked beets sliced paper-thin on a mandolin toss with a creamy blended dressing of orange juice, balsamic vinegar, and dijon mustard, joined by watercress, red endive, and pistachio-crusted goat cheese medallions.
instructions: In medium-size pressure cooker, combine beets with salt and water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to full pressure, lower heat, and cook beets until just tender when pierced with a sharp knife (large beets – 30 minutes; medium beets – 20 minutes; small beets – 15 minutes).
Drain, cool, and peel beets. Cut into thin 1/8-inch rounds with a mandolin. Set aside.
Puree all dressing ingredients in blender until creamy. Pour half of the dressing over the cooked beets and toss.
Roll edges of cheese rounds in pistachios. Transfer rounds to refrigerator until service.
Toss watercress with remaining dressing.
Arrange plate with endive, watercress, beets, orange supreme, and cheese rounds.

recipes.name: WHITE BEAN SPREAD WITH SUNDRIED TOMATO/KALAMATA TAPENADE ON ROSEMARY-GARLIC PIZZELLE
recipes.description: Cannellini beans simmer with bay leaf, sage, and rosemary until tender, then meet slow-sweated garlic for a silky spread, topped with sundried tomato and kalamata olive tapenade on crisp rosemary-garlic pizzelles.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, bring beans, stock, bay leaf, sage leaf, rosemary sprig, and salt to boil. Lower heat and simmer partially covered until beans are tender, about 40 minutes.
Drain beans and remove bay leaf, sage leaf, and rosemary sprig. Reserve any remaining bean liquid.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat olive oil over low flame. Add garlic and sweat until garlic just begins to turn golden in color. Remove from heat immediately.

In food processor, combine beans, garlic, and lemon juice. Blend to creamy, pipe-able consistency, using reserved cooking liquid if necessary. Transfer from processor to small bowl. Season to taste and set aside.
Combine sun-dried tomatoes, olives, and parsley in small bowl. Use about 1/4 teaspoon to garnish each pizzelle.
Toss sage leaves in arrowroot. In small sauté pan heat canola oil on medium-high heat. Fry each sage leaf and drain on paper towels.
Transfer bean paste to small pastry bag with small star tip. Pipe onto pizzelle (recipe following). Garnish with tapenade and sage leaf.

recipes.name: CURRIED CHICKEN SALAD ON PAPADAM WITH YOGURT RAITA
recipes.description: Chicken thighs braise in curry-spiced stock until tender, then toss with red onion, cilantro, and pistachios in a dressing built on the reduced, syrupy braising liquid, served on mini papadam with a cucumber-yogurt raita.

ingredients.name: sachet
ingredients.notes: 3 sprigs thyme, 1/2 teaspoon coriander seeds, 1/2 teaspoon peppercorns, 1 bay leaf, 1 cinnamon stick

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, braise chicken thighs with stock, sachet, spices (ginger, curry, cumin, and cayenne, and cinnamon stick), and salt for 45 minutes. Remove chicken from pan. When cooled, remove skin and bones. Chop chicken into small pieces, set aside.
Reduce braising liquid until you have about 1/4 cup syrupy liquid. Remove sachet. Reserve syrupy liquid for dressing.
In bowl, combine chicken, red onion, cilantro, and pistachios.
In small bowl, whisk together yogurt, reduced braising liquid, lime, salt and pepper. Add dressing to chicken salad.
Place approximately 2 teaspoons chicken salad on fried papadam. Garnish with dab of yogurt, slice of cucumber, and sprig of cilantro.

recipes.name: SWEET POTATO LATKES WITH PEAR-FENNEL MARMALADE
recipes.description: Grated sweet potato and scallion latkes crisp in hot canola oil, paired with a marmalade of slowly sweated fennel and bosc pears sharpened by apple cider vinegar and ground coriander, then finished with fresh chives.

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled, grated (large hole side of grater)

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add fennel and salt. Sweat until fennel is translucent. Add pears and sweat for an additional 3-5 minutes or until fennel and pears are barely tender.

Add garlic and coriander; continue to sweat for another minute. Add vinegar and water. Simmer for about 5 minutes or until liquid has been absorbed. Season to taste. When cool, add chives and mix to combine. Set aside.

In medium bowl, combine grated sweet potatoes, scallions, flour, arrowroot, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Mix to combine. Form latkes using tablespoon measure. Heat canola oil in 12-inch straight-sided sauté pan over medium-high heat.

Fry latkes in batches until golden, about 2 minutes on each side. Drain on paper-lined half sheet pan to absorb any excess oil. Season with additional salt to taste. Serve topped with marmalade, cashew cream and fennel fronds.

recipes.name: Fig-Thyme Preserves (for Portobello Mousse)
recipes.description: Dried figs simmer in apple juice with thyme and a splash of apple cider vinegar until soft, then an immersion blender coaxes them into a chunky, sweet-savory preserve built to pair with portobello mousse.
instructions: Combine figs, thyme, apple juice, salt, pepper, and apple cider vinegar in 2-quart saucepan.
Bring mixture to simmer and cook for 20 minutes with lid slightly ajar.
Use immersion blender to roughly puree mixture slightly (mixture can be chunky).
Chill preserves before serving.
Serve fig-thyme preserves with Portobello mousse and sliced baguette (see previous recipe).

recipes.name: Green Bean and Walnut Pâté
recipes.description: Blanched green beans meet onions caramelized low and slow, then deglazed with madeira until nearly dry, coming together with walnuts, white miso, and sherry vinegar in a rich, spreadable pate with deep savory undertones.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Prepare an ice bath. In 1-gallon pot, bring 3 quarts of water to boil with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Add green beans and blanch until tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Shock beans in ice water and drain in colander. Slice 8 beans thinly on diagonal for garnish. Cut remaining beans into 1-inch pieces. Set aside.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and remaining 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Cover and sweat onions over low heat until very soft, about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Uncover pan and continue cooking and stirring often until onions are caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add wine to onions and continue cooking until wine is reduced and mixture is almost dry.
Puree 1 cup of walnuts with green beans, onions, miso, and vinegar in food processor until smooth. Season to taste. Chop remaining 1/4 cup of walnuts for garnish.
Present pâté garnished with string beans and chopped walnuts.

recipes.name: OATMEAL DULSE CRACKERS
recipes.description: Ground rolled oats and sunflower seeds form a rustic cracker dough seasoned with garlicky dulse granules, bound by coconut oil and brown rice syrup, and finished with sesame, poppy, and caraway seeds.

ingredients.name: sea seasonings dulse granules with garlic

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In food processor, finely grind oats, sunflower seeds, and flour together. Add dulse granules and salt.
In separate small bowl, whisk together coconut oil and rice syrup.
Add oil-syrup mixture to dry ingredients in food processor, adding in water as needed. (Dough should be stiff, yet pliable.)
Between parchments sheets, roll out dough with rolling pin to uniform thickness, 1/8 inch. Remove top sheet of parchment.
Mix together equal amounts of sesame, poppy and caraway seeds and sprinkle liberally over rolled dough. Cover with top sheet of parchment again and roll seeds into dough.

Remove top sheet of parchment again. Score dough all the way through using pizza cutter or knife at 2-inch intervals vertically and horizontally to create squares. Score diagonally to make triangles. Slide dough with bottom parchment onto half sheet pan.
Bake until lightly browned, about 15 to 20 minutes. (Caution: crackers on outer edges may brown more quickly than those in center.)

recipes.name: Croutons for Vegan Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Year-Round

ingredients.name: loaf french or italian whole wheat bread

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F.
In deep bowl, toss bread cubes with oil and salt until each cube is well covered.
Spread croutons in single layer on parchment-lined sheet tray. Bake until croutons are crisp and evenly brown (20-30 minutes), turning often.

recipes.name: KIDNEY BEAN SALAD
recipes.description: Kidney beans simmer slowly until perfectly tender, then soak up a warm vinaigrette of dijon mustard, lime juice, and cider vinegar whisked with olive oil, finished with crisp radishes, scallions, and fresh parsley.
instructions: Combine beans with water and bring to boil over high heat. Add pinch of sea salt.
Lower heat and simmer until beans are tender (about 45 to 60 minutes). Drain beans.
Whisk together mustard, lime juice, apple cider vinegar, and salt. Slowly whisk in olive oil. Pour dressing over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with radishes, scallions and parsley.

recipes.name: Tapenade
recipes.description: Kalamata or niçoise olives pulse in the food processor with capers, pine nuts, garlic, and a sheet of nori, brightened by lemon juice, thyme, and basil into a coarse, spreadable, deeply savory paste.

ingredients.name: rinsed and pitted niçoise or kalamata olives

instructions: Combine all ingredients in food processor. Pulse to spreadable paste-like consistency.
Note: Tapenade may be prepared without anchovies or nori.

recipes.name: CREAMY CARROT SOUP WITH POTATO
recipes.description: Onions sweat in olive oil until soft, then carrots and potato simmer in stock a full twenty-five minutes before lemon juice, ginger juice, and dill lift this velvety carrot soup.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium-low heat. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened (about 5-8 minutes). Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot and sweat carrots over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and potatoes to pot. Raise heat and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer 25 minutes, covered, until carrots are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Add lemon and ginger juice. Readjust seasonings.
Garnish with dill and serve.

recipes.name: CURRIED RED LENTIL SOUP WITH COCONUT MILK (VEGAN)
recipes.description: Red lentils simmer with curry-sweated onion, garlic, and carrot until broken down, then cauliflower, coconut milk, ginger, and lime join in; a partial blend gives this vegan soup its creamy body.

ingredients.name: cauliflower
ingredients.notes: 1/4 small head; cut into bit-sized florets

instructions: Heat coconut oil in 3-quart pot over medium-low flame. Add onion, salt, garlic, carrot, and curry powder. Sweat vegetables covered, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 10 minutes.
Add lentils, stock, and bay leaf. Cover and bring to boil over high heat. Reduce heat to simmer, and cook partially covered until lentils are broken down, approximately 30 minutes. Remove bay leaf.
Add cauliflower florets, and simmer until tender. Remove 2 cups of soup and purée in blender until creamy. Add blended ingredients back to pot.
Add coconut milk, ginger juice, and lime juice.
Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with cilantro and shredded coconut.

recipes.name: LACINATA KALE WITH MATCHSTICK CARROTS
recipes.description: Matchstick carrots and lacinata kale each take a quick blanch and an ice-water shock to lock in color and bite, then meet garlic and extra-virgin olive oil with a final hit of sea salt and pepper.

ingredients.name: large carrots
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1/8-inch wide matchsticks

ingredients.name: lacinata kale
ingredients.notes: washed and chopped into bite sized pieces

instructions: In 2-gallon stockpot bring about 6 quarts of water to boil. Add salt. Prepare ice bath.
Blanch carrots in water for about 30 to 40 seconds; shock in ice water and drain. Set aside.
In same pot, blanch kale for 3 to 4 minutes until tender but not mushy. Shock in ice water, drain and set aside.
In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil, add garlic slices and sauté until garlic slices are just golden. Do not burn! Add kale and carrots. Cook until heated through.

recipes.name: GLAZED SEITAN STIR FRY
recipes.description: Seitan caramelizes in a hot wok before snow peas, carrots, ginger, and garlic join for a crisp-tender stir-fry, all glossed in a maple-orange-shoyu glaze thickened with arrowroot and finished with cashews and scallions.

ingredients.name: seitan
ingredients.notes: cut into 1/2-inch wide strips and patted dry

ingredients.name: arrowroot dissolved in 2 tablespoons cold water

instructions: In wok, heat oil over medium-high flame. Add seitan and stir-fry until caramelized.

Add onions and stir-fry until lightly caramelized. Add carrots and continue stir-frying until carrots are just tender. Add garlic, ginger, snow peas, and red pepper flakes. Continue to stir-fry until all vegetables are tender but crisp.
In small bowl, combine all glaze ingredients and whisk to combine. Pour glaze over vegetables and seitan. Mix to combine, cooking until mixture thickens and all ingredients are evenly coated.
Drizzle with toasted sesame oil and garnish with cashews and scallions.

recipes.name: SWISS BURNT PECAN TART
recipes.description: Pecans roast low and slow for a full forty minutes before meeting a deep, sticky filling of rice syrup, maple syrup, and barley malt thickened with arrowroot and scented with vanilla, all baked in a 9-inch pie shell.

ingredients.name: barley malt syrup dissolved in 2 teaspoons water

instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F.
Roast pecans for about 40 minutes. Remove from pan and allow to completely cool.
Raise oven temperature to 350°F.
Roll out half the dough and transfer to tart pan. Chill 15 minutes. Trim edges, allowing 1-inch overhang. Chill rolled dough for another 15 minutes.
Roll out other half of dough and transfer to sheet pan. Cover and chill until ready to use.
In bowl of food processor, grind pecans to coarse flour. Add syrups, arrowroot, and vanilla. Mix to combine.
Pour filling into tart shell. Place top dough over filling, trim and seal edges. Cut a few steam vents.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until crust is firm. Brush top with glaze 10 minutes before removing from oven.
Cool and set before serving (about 30 minutes).

recipes.name: DILL PICKLES
recipes.description: Kirby cucumbers settle into a fermentation crock layered with garlic, black peppercorns, mustard seed, and fresh dill, then a simple sea salt brine submerges everything for a slow, tangy transformation.
instructions: Combine salt and water in pitcher and stir until the salt has dissolved.
Rinse cucumbers thoroughly and snip off the blossom end stem. Set aside.

Place half peppercorns, garlic, mustard seed, and fresh dill into clean half-gallon fermentation jar or crock. Add cucumbers to crock on top of aromatics. Add the remainder of peppercorns, seeds, garlic, and dill. Pour brine mixture over cucumbers to cover them completely.

If using crock or jar without airlock lid, pour remaining water into 1-gallon zip-top plastic bag and seal. Place bag on top of pickles ensuring all of them are completely submerged in brine. Store in cool, dry place, OR if using a fermentation jar, fill airlock and secure lid.
Check ferment every day. Fermentation has begun if you see bubbles rising to top of crock. Skim off any scum that forms. If scum forms on plastic bag, rinse it off and return to top of crock.

Fermentation is complete when pickles taste sour and bubbles have stopped rising; this should take approximately 6 to 7 days. Once this happens, cover the crock loosely and place in refrigerator for 3 days, skimming daily or as needed.
Store for up to 2 months in refrigerator.

recipes.name: Brandade
recipes.description: Russet potatoes and salt cod simmer together in milk and cream until completely tender, then get whipped with sizzled garlic oil in a stand mixer, making a rich brandade for slices of whole-wheat baguette.
instructions: Combine potatoes, milk, and cream in large sautoir. Bring mixture to scald, and simmer until potatoes are almost tender. Add rinsed salt cod and continue to cook until potatoes and cod are completely tender. Remove from heat.
In small sauté pan, heat oil and garlic together. As soon as garlic begins to sizzle, remove from heat and set aside.
Carefully strain potatoes and fish from milk/cream mixture and transfer to stand mixer set up with paddle attachment. Retain milk/cream mixture for next step.
Add in 1 cup of milk/cream mixture, garlic/oil mixture, and lemon juice. Mix until thoroughly combined.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve on toasted baguette.

recipes.name: DIPPING SAUCE
recipes.description: Tamari, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, and ginger juice are simply stirred together in a small bowl, yielding a salty-tangy dipping sauce with nutty depth and a clean, gingery bite.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in small bowl.

recipes.name: Fried Calamari
recipes.description: Squid gets a quick dredge through salt-and-pepper seasoned flour before plunging into 350°F oil for a crackling deep-fry, ready for a shower of chopped mint and a generous squeeze of lemon.
instructions: In small mixing bowl, combine salt, pepper and flour.
In wok, heat oil to 350°F-375°F.
Dredge squid in flour mixture, coating well. Shake off excess flour.
Deep-fry squid in small batches until golden (this helps to maintain constant oil temperature to produce crispy squid).
Drain fried calamari on paper towels.
Sprinkle with salt; garnish with mint and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: THREE-CITRUS MARINADE
recipes.description: Lime, lemon, and orange juices blend with olive oil, garlic, black pepper, bay leaves, and cilantro, then rest for thirty minutes so the triple-citrus flavors deepen before the marinade goes to work.
instructions: Combine lime juice, lemon juice, orange juice, olive oil, garlic, black pepper, bay leaves and cilantro in blender.
Let stand 30 minutes to allow flavors to develop before using.

recipes.name: BALINESE CHILE MARINADE
recipes.description: Blended to a thin, pourable paste, this Balinese chile marinade grinds macadamia nuts with garlic, ginger juice, jalapeño, and turmeric, brightened by tomato puree and a squeeze of fresh lime.
instructions: Combine olive oil, water, garlic, red onion, tomato puree, ginger juice, macadamia nuts, jalapeno pepper, turmeric, red pepper flakes, salt and lime juice in blender. Process to make thin paste. Add water to thin if necessary.

recipes.name: Barbecue-Style Rub
recipes.description: Paprika, chili powder, cumin, and maple sugar meet cayenne and oregano in this whisked rub, made to coat tempeh, tofu, chicken, or fish for a thirty-minute marinade before grilling.
instructions: Whisk together all ingredients.
Toss food being grilled in rub (tempeh, tofu, chicken, or fish) in spice mixture. Let food marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour before grilling.

recipes.name: Fresh Herb Marinade
recipes.description: Rosemary and a whole bunch of parsley steep in extra virgin olive oil with salt and black pepper, a quick-mix marinade built to soak vegetables for twenty to thirty minutes before grilling.
instructions: In small bowl, combine all ingredients.
Let vegetables soak in marinade for 20 to 30 minutes before grilling.

recipes.name: CHICKEN BREASTS IN MUSHROOM SAUCE
recipes.description: Dredged in oat flour and browned three minutes per side in hot olive oil, these chicken breasts pair with a sauce of shiitake and portobello mushrooms, minced shallots, white wine, and chicken stock.
instructions: In shallow bowl, dredge chicken in flour. Shake off excess flour.
In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 3 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken in oil until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove chicken from pan, season immediately with salt and pepper, cover to keep warm, and let rest for 10 minutes.

Add remaining oil to pan and heat over medium-high flame. Add mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Add shallots and garlic and continue cooking until mushrooms turn golden brown (2 to 3 minutes), stirring often to prevent garlic and shallots from burning.
Pour wine into pan and cook over high heat until almost evaporated, scraping browned bits from bottom of pan. Add stock and cook until reduced by half.
Remove pan from heat and whisk in butter. Season to taste with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
Slice chicken thinly on bias and arrange by fanning slices.

recipes.name: ASIAN FLAVORS MARINADE
recipes.description: Freshly squeezed orange juice, rice vinegar, shoyu, and dark sesame oil blend with garlic, ginger, scallion, and cilantro—everything goes into the blender and whirls into a bright, punchy marinade in seconds.
instructions: In blender, combine all ingredients.

recipes.name: SPICY KIDNEY BEAN PURÉE
recipes.description: Kidney beans pressure-cook with chili powder and bay leaf, then whip in the food processor with garlic, olive oil, lime juice, and cayenne into a thick, fiery purée built for scooping with corn chips.
instructions: Combine beans in pressure cooker with salt, chili powder, and bay leaf. Add enough water to cover by 1 inch. Cover and bring to full pressure. Lower heat and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid and drain beans, reserving cooking liquid.
Discard bay leaf, and transfer beans to food processor.
Add garlic, oil, lime juice, and cayenne. Process until smooth, adding bean liquid as necessary to form smooth, thick purée. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer purée to bowl and fold in cilantro. Serve with corn chips.

recipes.name: Refried Soba with Vegetables
recipes.description: Ginger and garlic hit a hot wok first, followed by bok choy, red pepper, scallions, and bean sprouts, before soba noodles get tossed through with shoyu and toasted sesame oil for a quick, glossy finish.

ingredients.name: leaves bok choy
ingredients.notes: leaves and stems; cut into chiffonade

instructions: Heat large wok; add sesame oil, ginger and garlic. Cook 1 minute.
Add bok choy stems, then add leaves, red pepper and scallions. Cook until pepper is just tender. Add sprouts and jalapeno.
Add shoyu and toasted sesame oil. Season with salt to taste. Add noodles. Mix well and serve.

recipes.name: ICHIBAN DASHI
recipes.description: Traditional Japanese Broth
instructions: Wipe kombu with towel, if it has salty residue. Place it in pot and cover with cold water. Let stand 30 minutes.
Bring to boil, add bonito flakes and remove from heat.
Wait till bonito flakes sink to bottom of pot and strain through cheesecloth.
Note: Kombu and bonito flakes can be re-used once: just simmer 4-5 minutes and discard. This is called niban-dashi.

recipes.name: BLACK-EYED PEA SALAD
recipes.description: Black-eyed peas simmered with kombu drink up a cider vinegar, olive oil, and red pepper flake dressing while still warm, then meet celery, plum tomatoes, kalamata olives, and sliced scallions.
instructions: Combine beans, water, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and kombu in 1-gallon pot and bring to boil over high heat.
Lower heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until beans are tender. Remove kombu and drain beans in colander.
Whisk together remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt, pepper, vinegar, red pepper flakes, and olive oil. Pour over warm beans.
When beans have cooled, toss together with celery, tomatoes, olives, scallions, and parsley.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: ROASTED RED PEPPER CHICKPEA PURÉE
recipes.description: Cumin-scented chickpeas from the pressure cooker whirl through the food processor with roasted red bell pepper, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice until silky, then take a dusting of smoked paprika alongside warm pita.

ingredients.name: pita
ingredients.notes: 6 pieces; cut into triangles and oven toasted

instructions: Combine chickpeas in pressure cooker with salt, cumin, and bay leaf. Add enough water to cover by 1 inch. Cover and bring to full pressure. Lower heat and cook for 15 minutes. Release pressure by running cold water over lid and drain beans, reserving cooking liquid.
Discard bay leaf, and transfer beans to food processor.
Add garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, bell pepper, and tahini. Process until smooth, adding bean liquid as necessary to form smooth, thick puree. Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with paprika and serve with pita.
Seasonal variation: In Winter/Fall, substitute two heads roasted garlic for roasted red pepper and remove chopped garlic.

recipes.name: BAKED MILLET CROQUETTES
recipes.description: Millet dry-roasts in the pot until it smells like popcorn, then simmers to fluffy tenderness and folds together with sunflower seeds, scallions, parsley, carrot, and shoyu before baking into savory croquettes.

ingredients.name: sunflower seeds
ingredients.notes: toasted and ground in food processor

instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In sauce pot, dry roast millet over medium heat, stirring constantly for about 10 minutes or until it smells like popcorn.
Add water and salt to millet and bring to boil. Simmer covered 30 minutes or until water is absorbed. Transfer millet to large bowl and cool.
Add sunflower seeds, scallions, parsley and carrots to millet. Add shoyu to taste, and squeeze mixture together with hands until soft and sticky.
Using 1/4 cup measure, form croquettes and bake on parchment-lined sheet tray until golden brown, about 30 minutes.

recipes.name: ROASTED GARLIC SAUCE
recipes.description: Whole garlic roasts to a sweet, spreadable paste before joining caramelized onions, carrots, and celery deglazed with red wine and brown rice vinegar, reduced nearly dry for deep, savory concentration.

ingredients.name: sachet d'epices
ingredients.notes: 3 bay leaves, 6 parsley stems, 5 sprigs thyme, 6 black peppercorns tied in cheesecloth

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Roast garlic (wrapped in foil) in 400°F oven for approximately 35 minutes. When cool, squeeze out garlic paste from skin. Blend with small amount of stock until consistency is creamy.
In 1-gallon pot, over medium-high flame, heat remaining tablespoon oil. Sauté onions, carrots, and celery until lightly caramelized.
Deglaze over high heat with red wine and brown rice vinegar. Reduce liquid until almost dry (au sec).
Add 3 1/2 cups stock, sachet d'epices, and mushrooms. Cover sauce and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 to 20 minutes. Skim occasionally. Discard sachet.
In small bowl, whisk remaining 1/2 cup stock to roux. Add to stock pot and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Strain sauce through chinois and return sauce to pot.
Add garlic paste mixture to pot to and simmer another 5 minutes or until nappé consistency is achieved. Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: CHICKEN STOCK
recipes.description: Chicken bones simmer for up to four hours with mirepoix, a bouquet garni, and a splash of brown rice or cider vinegar, slowly coaxing out a clean, deeply savory stock that anchors countless dishes.

ingredients.name: brown rice vinegar or cider vinegar

instructions: Simmer 1 1/2 to 4 hours.

recipes.name: WHITE VEAL STOCK
recipes.description: Veal bones simmer gently for four to five hours with mirepoix, a bouquet garni, and a splash of lemon juice or cider vinegar, coaxing out a pale, clean-flavored stock built on patience.

ingredients.name: water or enough to cover by 2 inches

instructions: Simmer 4 to 5 hours.

recipes.name: Classic Béchamel
recipes.description: Milk infuses gently with an onion piqué before meeting a roux of flour and clarified butter stirred patiently in the pan, yielding a classic béchamel seasoned with white pepper and a pinch of nutmeg.

ingredients.name: sea salt and ground white pepper

instructions: Add onion piqué to milk in 2 1/2 quart saucepan and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring often to avoid scorching.
Remove piqué onion from pot. Set milk aside to cool.
In 10-inch sauté pan, combine flour and butter. Stir with wooden spoon for 2-3 minutes. Let roux cool.
Slowly and gradually whisk 4 cups cooled milk into warm roux.
Simmer sauce for approximately 20-25 minutes until thickened and reduced to nappé consistency.
Strain sauce through fine chinois. Add additional 1 cup milk on low flame, if needed.
Note: Piqué is a bay leaf tacked with whole clove on peeled halved onion.

recipes.name: Creole Sauce
recipes.description: Garlic sweated slowly in olive oil sets the base for this Creole sauce, where scallions, celery, and red pepper flakes soften gently before blended tomatoes hit the pan and sauté to a deep caramelized edge.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Strain whole tomatoes from juice. Reserve juice and set aside. Blend whole tomatoes in food processor.

In 12-inch sauté pan, heat oil over low heat. Add garlic and salt. Sweat until garlic softens (do not burn garlic). Add scallions, celery, red pepper flakes, and pepper. Sweat until vegetables are tender.
Raise heat to medium-high and add blended tomatoes to pan. Sauté until tomatoes begin to caramelize.
Lower heat and add agave and reserved tomato juice. Simmer until sauce thickens, about 10 minutes.
Adjust seasoning to taste.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Pepper Coulis
recipes.description: Red peppers roast until blistered and steam until their skins slip off, then join onions and garlic sweated in olive oil, brightened with lemon juice and a dash of hot sauce.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Heat oven to 375°F.

Arrange peppers on half sheet pan, and roast in oven until blistered, about 20-30 minutes. Transfer peppers to covered, small bowl to steam for 10 minutes. When peppers are cool, remove skins and seeds.
In 8-inch sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over a medium flame and sweat onions with garlic until onions are translucent.
Combine peppers with onion-garlic mixture in VitaMix and blend until creamy. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil through feed tube, slowly while machine is running.
Add warm vegetable stock as needed for desired consistency. Add lemon juice to taste. Adjust seasonings with salt, pepper, and hot sauce.

recipes.name: Sticky Buns
recipes.description: Yeasted dough proofed with warm maple syrup wraps a cinnamon raisin and toasted walnut filling, all crowned with a whisked syrup of rice syrup, coconut oil, vanilla, and a splash of rum.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Whisk together syrup ingredients, combine raisin-walnut filling; set both aside.
In large bowl, combine warm water, maple syrup, and yeast. Proof for 5-10 minutes, or until yeast is activated (foamy). Add melted coconut oil.
In separate large bowl, whisk together flours and salt.
Add enough flour mixture to yeast mixture to create dough that pulls away from sides.
Knead dough about 10 minutes to form soft, smooth dough, using flour as necessary.
Transfer dough to clean, large bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, and rise until doubled in size (about 30 minutes to 1 hour).
Fold/turn dough. Rise one more time.

Cut dough in half and roll each half to 1/4-inch thick rectangle. Spread 1/3 syrup mixture over dough. Sprinkle 1/2 raisins and walnuts on top. Roll dough into cylinder. Repeat process with second dough.
Cut rolled dough into 2-inch rounds and arrange nestled in two oiled 9-inch cake pans lined with parchment.
Rise dough until doubled in size, approximately 15-20 minutes.
Bake for 25 minutes. Brush remaining 1/3 syrup mixture on top, rotate pans, and bake for 10-15 minutes more or until firm to touch and golden. Cool and unmold.

recipes.name: Vegan Béchamel
recipes.description: Shallots sweat in coconut oil before oat flour toasts into a gentle roux; fresh almond milk then whisks in slowly with thyme, bay leaf, and a pinch of nutmeg for a silky dairy-free béchamel.

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: In 2 1/2 quart sauce pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat shallots until translucent.
Add flour and cook over low heat, stirring constantly for about 5 minutes.
Slowly whisk in almond milk with thyme, bay leaf, and nutmeg.
Increase heat to simmer and continue cooking for about 20-25 minutes, stirring often until sauce thickens.
Strain sauce through chinois. Add lemon juice. Season to taste.

recipes.name: ZUCCHINI PEANUT NOODLE BOWL W/ SRIRACHA STRING BEANS & LEMONGRASS TOFU
recipes.description: Spiralized zucchini noodles carry a peanut sauce blended smooth with coconut milk, lime, garlic, and cayenne, served alongside sriracha-glazed steamed string beans and lemongrass-marinated tofu.
instructions: Cut zucchinis in half crosswise, and position on spiralizer. Turn to create zucchini noodles, trimming them with scissors if they are too long. Toss with cilantro before serving.
Add peanuts, water, garlic, sesame oil, maple syrup, lime juice, cayenne, coconut milk and salt to Vitamix, or high-speed blender, and puree until smooth.
Bring medium pot with steamer basket, filled with 2 inches of water to boil. Steam string beans 3 minutes, or until bright green and slightly tender. Cut in half on diagonal.
Heat coconut oil over medium heat in large sauté pan. Cook beans with salt for 2 minutes, stirring often. Add sriracha, syrup, and sesame seeds and cook for additional 30 seconds.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Arrange tofu in single layer in baking dish.

In medium bowl whisk together sesame oil, vinegar, apple juice, tamari, garlic and ginger. Pour over tofu, add lemongrass, and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. Bake uncovered for 30 to 40 minutes, or until tofu is golden and has absorbed most of liquid. Discard lemongrass.
Combine turmeric and sesame in small saucepan. Warm for 30 seconds, remove from heat, strain out turmeric before using.
Arrange noodles in bowl. Top with string beans, tofu, turmeric oil, microgreens, cabbage, and peanut sauce.

recipes.name: CLASSIC BARBEQUE SAUCE
recipes.description: Ketchup, apple cider vinegar, and maple syrup simmer with chili powder, cumin, cinnamon, and vegan Worcestershire sauce, stirred often over medium-low heat until the sauce thickens to a glossy nappé consistency.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine all ingredients and simmer on medium-low heat, stirring often, until nappé consistency is achieved.

recipes.name: Carrot-Beet Sauce
recipes.description: Pressure-cooked carrots and beets are blended with sweated onion, garlic, and fennel seed, then deepened with red miso, umeboshi paste, and balsamic vinegar into a velvety, savory-sweet sauce.

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.notes: 8 medium; peeled and cut into large chunks

ingredients.name: beets
ingredients.notes: scrubbed, peeled, and cut into chunks

ingredients.name: red miso
ingredients.notes: 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon; dissolved in 1/4 cup liquid

ingredients.name: sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Combine carrots and beets with water to cover in a medium pressure cooker and cook until vegetables are tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain vegetables and let cool. Reserve cooking liquid.
In 1-gallon sauce pan, heat oil over medium flame, sweat onion with salt and garlic until onions are translucent. Add oregano, basil, and fennel. Continue to sweat a few minutes longer.
Puree carrots and beets in blender with half of onion-garlic mixture, 2 cups reserved cooking liquid, miso, umeboshi paste, and balsamic vinegar.
Return sauce to sauce pan and add remaining onions and garlic. Add remaining 1/2 cup cooking liquid to achieve proper consistency, if needed.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Almond Sauce
recipes.description: Whole garlic roasts in foil until its cloves turn soft and sweet, then joins a white wine and shallot reduction cooked nearly dry, blanched almonds, and vegetable stock in a mellow sauce seasoned simply with sea salt.

ingredients.name: blanched almonds
ingredients.notes: soaked 10 minutes in warm water and strained

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.

Peel off papery outer layers from garlic head, cut off top third of head, rub cut surface with 1 tablespoon olive oil, and wrap garlic in aluminum foil. Roast garlic for 45-60 minutes or until cloves are soft. When cool enough to handle, extract paste from garlic head and set aside.
In 8-inch sauté pan, over medium-high flame, reduce white wine with shallots until almost dry (au sec).
In blender combine shallots, roasted garlic paste, almonds and vegetable stock. Through feed tube, slowly add remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil. Blend until creamy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: WAKAME, SEITAN, AND TOASTED WALNUT CASSEROLE
