recipes.description: Caramelized onions and cremini mushrooms build the base for this baked casserole of wakame, seitan, and whole wheat elbows, bound with a tahini-shoyu sauce and topped with toasted walnuts and panko.

ingredients.name: loosely packed wakame
ingredients.notes: 1 ounce; rinsed, soaked in 1/4 cup water for 10 minutes, drained, coarsely chopped

ingredients.name: freshly ground cracked black pepper taste

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.

In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oils over medium flame and sweat onions with salt until translucent. Lower heat and continue to sweat until onions begin to soften and color, stirring often to prevent burning. Continue until onions are caramelized (brown and soft), about 20 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add wakame and seitan. Stir well. Add water and shoyu. Cover pan and bring to boil. Lower flame and remove lid. Simmer until mixture is almost dry, about 15-20 minutes.
In small bowl, whisk tahini, shoyu, and water. Set aside.
Transfer cooked pasta to large bowl and combine with sauté mixture, walnuts, and tahini sauce. Transfer mixture to lightly oiled Dutch oven.
Combine breadcrumbs, olive oil, fresh thyme, and black pepper in small bowl. Top casserole with mixture. Bake 20 minutes.

recipes.name: SWEET AND SOUR MANGO BARBEQUE SAUCE
recipes.description: Onions sweat with chili powder, smoked paprika, and cumin before garlic and jalapeno join in; a surprising hit of ground instant coffee and coconut sugar simmers into the base of this mango-sweetened barbecue sauce.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil on medium flame. Add onions, salt, chili powder, paprika, and cumin. Sweat until onions become translucent.
Add garlic and jalapeno and continue sweating until all vegetables are tender.
Reduce flame to low and add coffee and coconut sugar to pot and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a blender, combine the Worcestershire sauce, mangos, water and orange juice. Blend until creamy.
Add blended mixture to pot along with ketchup and maple syrup.
Simmer sauce 10-15 minutes or to desired consistency. Season to taste.

recipes.name: BUTTERNUT MINESTRONE
recipes.description: Onions, leeks, carrots, and garlic sweat in olive oil before white beans, tomatoes, rosemary, and sage simmer for forty minutes; butternut squash goes in last, breaking down to thicken this hearty vegetable soup.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onions with salt and red pepper flakes until onions are translucent. Add leeks, carrots, celery, and garlic. Continue sweating until vegetables begin to soften, about 5-7 minutes.
Add white beans, tomatoes, stock, rosemary, and sage to pot with vegetables. Simmer with lid ajar, until beans become just about tender, about 40 minutes.
Add butternut squash to pot and continue to simmer until squash begins to break down and soup thickens.
Add green beans and cook until tender, 4-5 minutes.
When beans are tender, season soup with vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Garnish soup with parsley and parmesan (if using).

recipes.name: Seitan Kebabs with Yellow Rice
recipes.description: Seitan, crimini mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, and red onion marinate for thirty minutes in a shoyu, lemon, and brown rice syrup blend, then thread onto skewers for a hot griddle grill alongside turmeric-golden brown rice.

ingredients.name: kuzu dissolved in 2 tablespoons water for thickening marinade

instructions: Soak 25 skewers in cold water for 30 minutes.

In large bowl, combine seitan, onions, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes with marinade ingredients for 30 minutes. Strain seitan and vegetables from marinade, but reserve marinade to make sauce (step 5).
Heat griddle grill. Make skewers with 2 pieces seitan, 2 pieces mushrooms, 2 pieces tomato, and red onion, alternating seitan and vegetables.
Grill kebabs 3-5 minutes on each side or until grill marks appear. Set aside.
Bring marinade to simmer. Whisk in kuzu slurry, stirring constantly, until marinade thickens to sauce consistency (approximately 5 minutes).
Serve atop or alongside Yellow Rice. Pour marinade sauce over kebabs or serve alongside.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine rice, water, salt, and turmeric. Bring rice to boil, cover pot, reduce heat, and simmer for approximately 40-50 minutes or until all water is absorbed.
Remove rice from heat, and set rice aside covered to steam 10 minutes more.
Fluff rice lightly with fork. Add parsley and mix to combine. Serve alongside or underneath Seitan Kebabs.

recipes.name: CREAM OF BROCCOLI SOUP
recipes.description: Sweated onions simmer with arborio rice and soaked cashews in stock until the rice turns tender, building a naturally creamy, dairy-free base for broccoli stems and florets, finished with a flurry of chopped dill.

ingredients.name: salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Peel and slice broccoli stems. Separate broccoli florets into bite-size pieces. Set aside.
In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onion and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Sweat until onions are translucent, about 10 minutes. Stir often to prevent browning.
Add stock, rice, and cashews to pot. Raise heat and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Set aside.

In separate 1-gallon pot, bring 2 quarts water to boil with remaining salt. Prepare ice bath. Blanch broccoli until tender, about 2 minutes. Drain broccoli and transfer immediately to ice bath. Drain broccoli again.
Combine onion-rice and broccoli in Vitamix. Blend until creamy.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: CREAM OF CARROT SOUP WITH OATS
recipes.description: Sweated onions and carrots simmer with stock and rolled oats until meltingly tender, creating a naturally creamy soup brightened at the end with lemon and ginger juices and a shower of fresh dill.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, heat oil over medium flame. Add onions and salt. Sweat until onions are softened, about 5-8 minutes. Stir often to prevent browning.
Add carrots, cover pot, and sweat over low heat for 5-6 minutes. Stir to prevent browning.
Add stock and oats to pot. Raise heat and bring soup to boil. Reduce heat and simmer with lid ajar 25 minutes, or until carrots are very tender.
Blend soup until creamy, adding additional stock to achieve desired consistency.
Return soup to pot. Re-heat and season to taste with lemon and ginger juices.
Garnish with dill.

recipes.name: ROASTED DULSE CONDIMENT
recipes.description: Roasted until crisp, dulse gets ground with toasted sesame seeds in a suribachi until most of the seeds crack open, making a savory two-ingredient condiment for scattering over bowls of cooked millet.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place dulse on half sheet pan with parchment and bake for 10 minutes.
Combine toasted sesame seeds with roasted dulse in suribachi and grind until most of seeds are broken.
Serve as a condiment over cooked millet.
Store excess in air-tight glass container.

recipes.name: PROCEDURE FOR EGG-THICKENED SAUCES - HOLLANDAISE
recipes.description: Egg yolks whisk with lemon juice over a gentle bain marie until thick enough to hold tracks, then warm clarified butter goes in drop by drop, building a classic hollandaise finished with salt and a whisper of cayenne.
instructions: Using round-bottomed, straight-sided bowl over bain marie (double boiler), whisk yolks with lemon juice, salt and pepper until thick and creamy – until whisk leaves tracks in yolks.
Have butter warm but not hot. Add butter slowly, drop by drop first, whisking continuously.
Do not add more than egg yolks can hold. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper to taste.
If sauce breaks, rescue by adding 1 teaspoon of cold water and beating vigorously. If this does not work, whisk 2 egg yolks into broken sauce as you would butter.
If necessary, thin with few drops of warm water.

recipes.name: BLENDER MAYONNAISE
recipes.description: Egg yolk, whole egg, and lemon juice whirl in the blender until completely smooth, then oil streams in slowly as the emulsion thickens into a silky homemade mayonnaise with an optional touch of dijon.
instructions: Combine all ingredients except oil in blender and process until completely smooth.
With motor running, add oil very slowly, in steady stream. As mixture starts to thicken, oil can be added a bit more quickly.

recipes.name: SEA PALM, WAKAME AND DULSE SEAWEED SALAD WITH CREAMY CARROT DRESSING
recipes.description: Carrots roast with garlic and rosemary until tender, then a reserved portion blends with brown rice vinegar, ginger juice, and olive oil into a creamy dressing for shoyu-simmered sea palm with wakame and dulse.

ingredients.name: loosely packed sea palm
ingredients.notes: 1 ounce; soaked in cold water for 10 minutes, drained, chopped, set aside

ingredients.name: loosely packed wakame
ingredients.notes: .03 ounces; soaked in cold water to cover for 10 minutes, drained, chopped, set aside

ingredients.name: loosely packed dulse
ingredients.notes: .04 ounces; soaked in cold water to cover for 1 minute, drained, chopped, set aside

instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss carrots with olive oil, garlic, and rosemary. Transfer carrots to parchment-lined half sheet tray. Roast carrots until tender (about 20-30 minutes). Set aside to cool, reserving 1/4 pound carrots for dressing.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, bring sea palm, with enough water to cover, and shoyu to boil. Lower flame and simmer 20 minutes uncovered. Drain sea palm and set aside.
Transfer reserved 1/4 pound roasted carrots to Vitamix. Add rice vinegar, ginger juice, salt, olive oil, and water. Blend until very smooth, adding more water as necessary.
Arrange lettuce on plates. Arrange cauliflower, remaining roasted carrots, sea palm, wakame, and dulse on top of lettuce. Drizzle carrot dressing over salad. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds.

recipes.name: TOASTED NORI
recipes.description: Nori sheets pass quickly back and forth over an open flame, shifting to a brighter shade of green as they toast — a one-ingredient technique that rewards a careful hand and constant motion.
instructions: With tongs, wave nori back and forth over flame several times, until nori turns brighter shade of green. Pass nori through flame carefully and quickly.

recipes.name: SAUTÉED CHICKEN BREAST MARSALA WITH CRIMINI MUSHROOMS
recipes.description: Flour-dusted chicken breasts sauté to a golden crust before cremini mushrooms sear hard until caramelized; marsala wine and chicken stock then build a glossy pan sauce finished with chilled butter and parsley.
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then lightly dust with flour and shake off excess.
Heat olive oil over medium-high flame in 12-inch sauté pan. Cook breasts on each side for approximately 3-4 minutes. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. Add shallots to pan and sauté for 1 minute.
Add mushrooms to pan and sear until caramelized. Sear in batches, if necessary. Do not crowd pan.
Remove pan from heat, add chicken back to pan, and pour Marsala wine over chicken. Place pan over flame again and tilt pan carefully toward flame to flambé.
When flames subside, add stock and simmer over medium to high heat to reduce stock au sec (almost dry), about 2 to 4 minutes.
Add cold butter cubes to pan one at a time and swirl until dissolved.
Garnish with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: ARAME WITH VEGETABLES
recipes.description: Sweated onions and carrots mingle with arame sea vegetable, then simmer with shoyu, mirin, and brown rice syrup until every drop of liquid is absorbed, leaving glossy, savory-sweet strands to serve with bok choy.

ingredients.name: arame
ingredients.notes: loosely packed (1.5 ounces), soaked in water to cover for 10 minutes, drained

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat oil over medium flame. Sweat onion for 5 minutes or until translucent. Add carrot and sweat another 5 minutes.
Add arame to onions and carrots. Stir well. Sweat for another minute until arame is heated through.
Add water to cover arame halfway. Bring water to boil. Add shoyu, brown rice syrup, and mirin. Simmer for 20-30 minutes or until all liquid has evaporated.
Add bok choy stems and sweat until stems just become tender. Add leaves and sweat until leaves wilt.

recipes.name: MEDITERRANEAN ROASTED BLACK COD WITH MUHAMMARA
recipes.description: Toasted fennel and cumin seed, ground with sumac and allspice, crust this Mediterranean black cod, roasted in a hot oven and paired with a muhammara of red peppers, walnuts, and tangy pomegranate molasses.
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F.
In small sauté pan over low heat lightly toast fennel and cumin. Remove from heat.
When spices are cool, powder them in coffee grinder and add allspice and sumac.
Divide black cod into six portions and sprinkle spice mixture on both sides of fish. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer fish to parchment-lined half sheet pan. Lightly brush fish with oil.
Roast fish for about 7-8 minutes or until inside of fish is opaque. Remove from oven and set aside. Serve with Muhammara (recipe below).

recipes.name: WHOLE STEAMED FISH
recipes.description: Scored and seasoned whole fish gets its cavity packed with cilantro, scallions, garlic, and ginger, then steams gently until just done, ready for tamari and toasted sesame oil to finish.

ingredients.name: whole dressed fish
ingredients.notes: 2 1/2-3; head and tail intact, gills removed

instructions: Rinse fish, removing any remaining scales or blood. Score fish by making two, 3-inch long/1/4-inch deep cuts into each side of fish.
Season outside and cavity of fish with salt and pepper.
In bowl, toss cilantro, scallion, garlic, and ginger together. Stuff half of mixture into cavity of fish.

Combine remaining herb/spice mixture with water, tamari, and sesame oil. Transfer mixture to deep hotel pan. Place lightly oiled perforated pan over mixture. Bring mixture to boil over high flame and reduce heat to simmer. Transfer fish to perforated pan. Cover pan with lid or aluminum foil. Steam fish for 15-20 minutes.
When fish is fully cooked and tender, gently transfer to platter. Ladle steaming liquid, herbs, and toasted sesame oil over fish.

recipes.name: ROASTED ROOT VEGETABLES WITH TOASTED HAZELNUTS, CILANTRO, AND GARLIC
recipes.description: Carrots, sweet potatoes, parsnips, and shallots roast until evenly caramelized, then get tossed with toasted hazelnuts, garlic, and a fresh flurry of cilantro and parsley.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Toast hazelnuts until fragrant, approximately 6-7 minutes. Set hazelnuts aside to cool.
Toss carrots, sweet potatoes, parsnips, and shallots in large bowl with olive oil and salt.
Transfer vegetables to sheet tray lined with parchment. Roast vegetables in oven until evenly caramelized, approximately 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Skin hazelnuts by wrapping in towel and vigorously rubbing them. Roughly chop hazelnuts and transfer them to large bowl.
Add vegetables to bowl and toss with parsley, cilantro, and garlic just before serving.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE FLOUR BLEND
recipes.description: Three pantry staples — white rice flour, potato starch, and tapioca starch flour — combine into a versatile gluten-free blend; note that only two cups are needed when mixing it into crepe batter.
instructions: Note: Use only 2 cups of this flour for crepe batter.

recipes.name: White Bean with Garlic, Rosemary, and Tomatoes
recipes.description: Grape tomatoes roast low and slow until deeply caramelized while white beans pressure-cook with sizzling garlic, rosemary, and oregano, the two coming together in one rustic, herb-perfumed dish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°F. Toss grape tomatoes in bowl with 2 tablespoons olive oil. Spread tomatoes on parchment-lined sheet tray and roast until well caramelized, an hour or more. Set aside.

While tomatoes are roasting, heat remaining 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium flame in pressure cooker. Add garlic. The moment garlic sizzles, add rosemary and oregano and stir. Add white beans, salt, and water.
Secure lid to pressure cooker, bring cooker up to pressure, lower heat, and cook beans for 25 minutes.
Bring down pressure by running cold water on lid of cooker. Drain beans, transfer to bowl and add roasted tomatoes. Season with additional salt and pepper, as needed.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE BANANA BREAD
recipes.description: Mashed banana, buttermilk, and maple crystals whisk into a spiced batter of gluten-free flour, cinnamon, and freshly grated nutmeg, baked with a buttery topping of maple crystals and whole rolled oats.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In large bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
In separate medium bowl, whisk together butter, maple crystals, egg, mashed bananas, vanilla extract, and buttermilk.
Whisk wet ingredients into dry. Fold together, making sure to scrape bottom of bowl to mix well. Pour dough into prepared muffin molds.
In small saucepan, melt butter for crumble. Combine butter, maple crystals, and rolled oats in bowl. Transfer crumble to top of bread.
Bake for 30-45 minutes, or until toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean. Remove from oven and allow to rest in pan for 15 minutes, before inverting onto wire rack to cool completely.

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Feta-Dill Quick Bread
recipes.description: Feta cheese and chopped dill fold through a simple gluten-free batter of flour blend, olive oil, whole milk, and eggs, mixed in two quick bowls and baked into a savory, herb-flecked quick bread.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix together flour, baking powder, and salt in large bowl.
In separate bowl, combine olive oil, milk, egg, and feta cheese. Add wet mixture to dry, and mix dough to combine. Add dill.
Pour batter into muffin molds and immediately transfer back to oven to bake.
Bake for at least 30-40 minutes. Bread is ready when toothpick inserted in bread comes out clean.

recipes.name: Pizza Dough #2
recipes.description: Yeast blooms in a quick sponge sweetened with rice syrup, resting warm before sea salt, olive oil, and gradual additions of cake and all-purpose flour knead into a supple, stretchable pizza dough.

ingredients.name: rice syrup or honey or maple syrup

instructions: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients together with whisk.
Let sponge sit 20-30 minutes covered with plastic wrap in warm place.
Add salt, oil and water to sponge, then add flours in 1/2 cup increments until incorporated.
Knead about ten minutes. Let pizza dough sit 40 minutes covered with plastic wrap in warm place.
Preheat oven to 475°F.
Place pizza stone in oven to heat up at least 30-40 minutes before baking.
Transfer pizza to peel before adding sauce and topping.
Bake on stone 8-10 minutes, turning once at half-way point.

recipes.name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: Bittersweet chocolate grinds to a fine meal with date sugar, then melts under a stream of hot coffee right in the food processor, the base of a dense cake with butter, cocoa powder, and eggs baked in a springform pan.

ingredients.name: boiling water mixed 1 heaping tablespoon instant coffee
sticks butter
ingredients.notes: 8 ounces; room temperature, cut into pieces

instructions: Heat convection oven to 325°F. Brush 9-inch spring-form pan with oil. Line bottom with parchment paper and outside, bottom of pan with tin foil.
Grind chocolate in food processor to fine meal, add date sugar, and continue to grind until well combined.
Slowly pour hot coffee into food processor through feeder tube and pulse until chocolate is melted.
Add butter pieces and cocoa powder. Pulse to combine. Add eggs, salt, and vanilla. Process until smooth. Batter should be pourable and creamy.
Pour batter into spring-form pan. Bake on half-sheet pan as a little batter may seep out.
Bake about 45 minutes or until puffed and lightly cracked. Use toothpick to check for doneness.

recipes.name: Spinach Pasta
recipes.description: Squeezed-dry spinach and eggs work into flour in the food processor until a rough ball forms, then a brief knead and a covered rest yield a smooth, verdant pasta dough with real spring to it.

ingredients.name: large bunch spinach
ingredients.notes: 3/4 pound; washed, stemmed, cooked until tender, drained, and finely chopped

ingredients.name: unbleached all-purpose flour or half all-purpose flour/half whole wheat bread flour

instructions: Press spinach with your hand to squeeze out any excess liquid. Mix spinach with eggs and set aside.

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add spinach/egg mixture; process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to side of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough ball onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat Pizza
recipes.description: Whole wheat pizza dough starts as a yeasted sponge sweetened with rice syrup, left to rise until lively, then built up with olive oil, sea salt, and pastry flour worked in a half cup at a time.

ingredients.name: rice syrup or honey or maple syrup

instructions: In medium bowl, mix sponge ingredients with whisk.
Cover with plastic wrap and rise for 20-30 minutes in warm place.
Add water, salt and oil to sponge. Mix together with wooden spoon. Add flour in 1/2 cup increments.
Remove dough from bowl, form into ball and knead on floured work surface. Dough should be soft and pliable. Knead for about 8-10 minutes.
Place dough in lightly-oiled bowl, cover with plastic and place in warm spot until doubled in size about 40 minutes. Punch down, shape dough and bake.
Preheat oven to 475°F. Place pizza stone in oven to heat up at least 30-40 minutes before baking.
Transfer pizza to peel before adding sauce and toppings.
Bake on pizza stone from 8-10 minutes, turning once at half-way point.

recipes.name: TOMATO PASTA
recipes.description: Tomato paste stirs straight into eggs before meeting unbleached flour, tinting a fresh pasta dough that comes together in the food processor with deep color and gentle savory sweetness.
instructions: Stir tomato paste into eggs.
Follow one of the below methods.
Method - Food Processor:

Pulse flour in food processor to evenly distribute and aerate. Add tomato-egg mixture, process until dough forms rough ball, about 30 seconds. If dough resembles small pebbles, add water, 1/2 teaspoon at a time; if dough sticks to sides of bowl, add flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, and process until dough forms rough ball.
Turn dough onto work surface; knead until dough is smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours to relax.
Method - By Hand:
Sift flour onto work surface (or bowl) in mound and make hollow in middle. Pour tomato-egg mixture into hollow. With fork, start to mix in flour from edge.

Gradually incorporate most of flour until viscous paste begins to form. Put fork to one side and, using both hands, heap remaining flour from outside over paste in middle. Work flour into paste. If paste does not absorb all flour, and if ingredients cannot be easily worked, add a little water.

Work in water with both thumbs, then press dough into ball and work in rest of flour. Knead dough by pushing out dough with heels of hands, then form it into ball again. Repeat this kneading action until dough has firm but slightly elastic consistency and no longer changes shape when you remove your hands. Cover with plastic wrap and rest minimum of fifteen minutes.

recipes.name: VEGAN PASTA DOUGH
recipes.description: Silken tofu blends smooth with olive oil and water, then works into aerated flour in the food processor; a one-minute knead and a short rest yield a supple egg-free pasta dough.

ingredients.name: unbleached all-purpose flour or 1 cup unbleached all-purpose flour and 1 cup whole wheat bread flour

instructions: Blend tofu, olive oil, water, and salt in blender under smooth.

In food processor, pulse flour for few seconds to aerate it. Add tofu mixture and process 30 seconds. Squeeze dough into ball. Remove dough to lightly floured work surface and knead for 1 minute, or until smooth. Wrap in plastic wrap and let sit at least 15 minutes.

Variations: Add 1/4 cup of fresh chopped herbs to flour; add chili paste instead of water and/or color olive oil with annatto seeds to produce a red dough; warm water and mix in 1/4 teaspoon of saffron threads; add 1/4 cup well-wrung spinach puree instead of water; add 1/4 cup beet puree instead of water.

recipes.name: CHOCOLATE CHERRY PECAN BARS
recipes.description: Buttery shortbread scented with vanilla, date sugar, and maple crystals bakes into a golden base for a rich layer of pecans, dried cherries, orange zest, and semisweet chocolate chips.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F. Oil, flour, and parchment line 9-inch by 9-inch square baking pan.

In stand mixer, beat butter, date sugar, maple crystals, and vanilla until fluffy. In bowl, whisk together all-purpose and whole wheat pastry flours. Slowly sift flours into butter mixture until combined.
Press dough in even layer in prepared pan. Bake for about 10 minutes (rotate pan half way through cooking to ensure even baking) or until edges are lightly browned. Set aside to cool.
In stand mixer, beat date sugar, maple crystals, flour, salt, vanilla, and eggs until smooth. Stir in pecans, cherries, orange zest, and chocolate chips and mix just to combine.
Spread filling over crust to create even layer. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until edges are golden brown and filling is set.
Cool in pan for 15 minutes before unmolding onto cooling rack. Transfer to freezer to cool completely before cutting into bars.

recipes.name: COCONUT-CASHEW FROSTING
recipes.description: Coconut milk and agar flakes simmer gently until fully dissolved, then meet maple syrup, vanilla, and cashew butter for a thick, spreadable frosting with a double hit of coconut.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk and agar flakes. Let sit for 10 minutes. Add salt, vanilla, and maple syrup.
Over medium-high heat, bring coconut milk mixture to boil, stirring often, while scraping agar from sides and bottom of pot.
Reduce heat to very low and simmer, partially covered, stirring and scraping often, until agar is dissolved, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Pour coconut mixture into shallow pan and chill until set (about 15 minutes in freezer or 30-40 minutes in refrigerator).
In food processor, combine coconut milk-agar mixture with cashew butter and coconut extract. Process until very smooth.

recipes.name: TOFU BURGERS
recipes.description: Pressed firm tofu meets shoyu-roasted sunflower seeds, cooked millet, and arame in hearty patties seasoned with curry powder, umeboshi paste, and tahini, then dredged in cornmeal for a crisp exterior.

ingredients.name: cooked millet or rice or bread crumbs
extra virgin olive oil or sesame oil
curry powder or other spice blend

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix seeds and shoyu together. Roast on parchment paper until dried and toasted.
Prepare millet (2 cups water to 1 cup millet for 30 minutes) or brown rice (2 1/2 cups water to 1 cup rice for 55 minutes).
Press tofu to remove excess water by placing tofu between paper towels and putting weighted plate on top. Let sit at least 5-10 minutes.
Soak arame in water 10-15 minutes. Drain and chop finely.
Heat oil, sauté garlic, onion, spices, carrot and celery for 2-3 minutes.

Grind sunflower seeds halfway in food processor. In a separate bowl, mash tofu, add sautéed vegetables, 1 cup cooked grain, ground sunflower seeds, arame, ume, tahini, and salt and pepper to taste. Adjust salt if needed. Mix well.
Form 1/2" thick burgers with about 1/2 cup mixture.
Bake burgers at 350°F until set (about 15-20 minutes) or pan fry (dredge in corn meal first) on each side, only turning once until golden (drain on paper towels).
Serve on whole wheat burger bun with lettuce, red onion slice, and mustard.

recipes.name: Miso-Marinated Tofu
recipes.description: Tofu slices simmer low and slow directly in their miso marinade before finishing under a hot salamander, the savory glaze reducing and clinging to every golden surface.
instructions: Turn salamander on high heat.
Pour marinade in 12-inch sauté pan. Place tofu slices in pan.
Bring marinade to boil then reduce to low simmer.
Simmer tofu for 15 minutes on one side, then gently flip tofu and simmer for another 15 minutes on other side. As tofu simmers, marinade should reduce considerably and become thick.
Remove tofu from marinade. Spread any remaining marinade on top of tofu.
Broil tofu under salamander for approximately 5-7 minutes or until it begins to caramelize.

recipes.name: TEMPEH SAUSAGE
recipes.description: Steamed and grated tempeh gets seasoned with sage, fennel seeds, paprika, and tamari, then formed into patties, dredged in cornmeal, and fried into savory, sausage-style rounds.
instructions: Cut tempeh into 2-inch pieces and steam for 20 minutes in steamer basket over simmering water. Cool to room temperature.
Grate tempeh on large holes on box grater. Combine grated tempeh with garlic, water, olive oil, tamari, sage, marjoram, thyme, paprika, cayenne, fennel seeds, pepper, and oat flour. Mix well.
Form mixture into walnut-sized balls using 1-ounce ice cream scoop and press into patties. Dredge in cornmeal or flour.
Prepare plate with paper towel for draining. In sauté pan, heat oil and fry patties until well browned on both sides. Drain tempeh.

recipes.name: Barbecue Tofu
recipes.description: Pressed firm tofu grills over a hot, oiled griddle until char marks appear, ready for a smoky-sweet barbecue coat built on barley malt syrup, maple syrup, pureed tomatoes, chipotle chile, and stone-ground mustard.
instructions: Cut tofu in half horizontally (about 3/4” thick). Press fifteen minutes between paper towels.
Slice tofu into finger-sized pieces (about 1 inch wide).
Heat grill, brush with canola or coconut oil. Place tofu on griddle. Grill on each side about 2-3 minutes or until grill marks appear.
In large sauté pan, combine all marinade ingredients. Transfer tofu to marinade and simmer gently 25-30 minutes or place sauté pan in 350° oven for 20 minutes.
Remove tofu from pan. Reduce sauce to desired consistency.

recipes.name: Family Style Bean Curd
recipes.description: Triangles of firm tofu are deep-fried in a wok until golden and crisp, then joined by dried shiitake mushrooms, water chestnuts, and carrot in a ginger-scallion sauce built on shoyu, mirin, and brown rice syrup.

ingredients.name: dried shiitake mushrooms
ingredients.notes: rehydrated in hot water until completely tender; cut into paper thin slices

instructions: Cut tofu into 6 (1/2-inch) slices, then into triangles.
Heat wok and add coconut oil. Prepare plate with paper towel for draining. Deep fry tofu until golden brown.
Transfer fried tofu to paper towel to drain. Let oil cool completely before removing from wok.
Place deep fried tofu in small pot with water to cover. Add shoyu and ginger juice.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Heat wok and add sesame oil. Add scallions and ginger root. When their aroma is imparted, add carrots, mushrooms, water chestnuts, and fried tofu to wok.
Add hot stock, shoyu, mirin, and brown rice syrup and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Dissolve kuzu in cold water and add to wok. Simmer 1 minute. Adjust ginger juice and shoyu or tamari if necessary.
Serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with scallions.

recipes.name: BRAISED CHICKEN WITH VEGETABLES AND TARRAGON
recipes.description: Chicken legs tossed in seasoned whole wheat flour sear in hot olive oil, then braise gently with carrot, celery, onion, fingerling potatoes, white wine, and stock under a shower of chopped tarragon.

ingredients.name: sachet of 2 bay leaves
ingredients.notes: 10 black peppercorns, 6 sprigs thyme, 6 parsley sprigs, 1/2 ounce tarragon

instructions: Heat oven to 325°F.
Toss chicken legs in bowl with flour, salt, and pepper to thoroughly coat.
Heat oil in 12-inch sauté pan on medium-high flame.
When oil is hot, lower heat and sear chicken on both sides, being careful not to burn it.
Add carrots, celery, onion, and flour; sauté for 1 minute. Add potatoes, salt, pepper, and sachet. Stir in white wine to deglaze. Add stock, cover pot, and bring braise to boil.
Transfer pan to oven and cook for 40-45 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked and vegetables are tender but not mushy.
Garnish with tarragon. Season to taste and serve.

recipes.name: CHICKEN KOTLETKY (CHICKEN BURGERS)
recipes.description: Milk-soaked breadcrumbs keep these ground chicken burgers tender, mixed with onion, dried dill, salt, and pepper, portioned by the quarter cup and destined for a finish of sour cream and fresh dill.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F.
Toss bread crumbs and milk in medium-size bowl until bread has soaked up all milk. Combine bread crumb mixture with ground chicken, onions, dill weed, salt, and pepper.
Using 1/4 cup measure, portion chicken burgers.
Heat oil in 12-inch sauté pan over medium-high flame, and lightly brown patties on both sides.
Transfer burgers from sauté pan to half sheet tray lined with parchment.
Transfer burgers to oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Garnish with sour cream and fresh dill sprigs.

recipes.name: Seitan Croquettes
recipes.description: Ground seitan binds with caramelized onion, fresh sage, fennel seeds, and toasted sunflower seeds before the patties are dredged in whole wheat flour and pan-seared for several minutes per side until crusty and golden.

ingredients.name: flax
ingredients.notes: ground, and mixed with 3 tablespoons water

instructions: In 10-inch sauté pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high flame. Sauté onion until caramelized. Transfer to medium bowl and set aside.

Squeeze all excess liquid from seitan. In food processor, pulse seitan to texture of ground beef. Transfer seitan to bowl with onions. Mix in flax mixture, salt, sage, fennel seeds, and sunflower seeds to combine.

Form seitan mixture into small patties using 1/4 cup measure. Dredge in flour. Heat remaining 3 tablespoons oil in same 10-inch sauté pan used to caramelize onions. Pan-sear croquettes for several minutes on both sides.
Combine red onion in small bowl with vinegar, agave, and salt. Mix to combine.
Garnish croquettes with mustard, red onion and chives.

recipes.name: HAZELNUT-CRUSTED FLOUNDER
recipes.description: Flounder filets get a triple dredge through flour, egg, and a food-processor crumb of hazelnuts and panko, then bake to a toasty, nut-crisp crust that pairs beautifully with a bright spoonful of mango salsa.
instructions: Preheat conventional oven to 375°F.
Combine hazelnuts and breadcrumbs in food processor. Pulse mixture until uniformly crumb-sized. Transfer mixture to half-hotel pan. Transfer flour and eggs, each to separate half hotel pans.
Dredge fish filet in flour, shaking off excess. Transfer filets to egg mixture, making sure to coat entire filet. Press breading onto filet, completely to coat.

Heat canola oil in large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add filets to pan, careful not to crowd them. Cook each side until golden brown, approximately 1-2 minutes per side. If fish is not cooked through, can pace onto parchment-lined sheet tray and place into oven for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: POTATO-CRUSTED BASS FILETS
recipes.description: Bass filets get wrapped in a crust of squeezed-dry russet potato, dipped through thyme-seasoned flour and whisked egg, then pan-fried until the shell turns crisp and golden around the tender fish.

ingredients.name: russet potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled, grated, soaked for 15 minutes in water

ingredients.name: bass filets
ingredients.notes: skin removed, seasoned with salt and pepper

instructions: Drain potatoes, squeeze as much excess water from potatoes as possible with cheesecloth. Set aside.
Combine flour, salt, pepper, and thyme in bowl. Set aside.
Combine and whisk eggs in large bowl.
Liberally season filets with salt and pepper.
Dredge fish filet with flour, shaking off excess.
Transfer filets to egg mixture, making sure to coat entire filet.
Press potatoes onto filet, completely coating them.
Heat non-stick sauté pan over medium heat with 1/4-inch canola oil.
Transfer filets to pan and brown on both sides. If filets are thick, transfer browned filets to 375°F oven to finish cooking.

recipes.name: SALT-CRUSTED BAKED BASS
recipes.description: Whole bass gets stuffed with fresh thyme, then sealed under a kosher salt and egg white crust and baked at 450°F, emerging moist and delicately seasoned beneath a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

ingredients.name: whole bass
ingredients.notes: 3-4 pound; gills, fins, and viscera removed

instructions: Preheat oven to 450° F.
Wash fish in cold water and pat dry.
Insert thyme into cavity of fish.
In mixing bowl, whip egg whites until they form soft peaks.
Fold salt into egg whites to combine.
On large, ovenproof platter suitable for serving and presentation, place 1/4 of egg white mixture.
Place fish atop egg white mixture, then cover fish with remaining mixture.
Transfer platter in oven and bake approximately 35 to 40 minutes.
Crack crust with sharp knife and carefully remove.

recipes.name: Flounder en Papillote
recipes.description: Flounder filets are sealed inside parchment hearts with carrot, leek, zucchini, fresh dill, and tarragon, then baked hot so the fish steams gently in its own aromatic packet with a splash of white wine.

ingredients.name: stemmed and chopped fresh dill and tarragon

instructions: Preheat convection oven to 425°F.
In large bowl mix carrot, leeks, zucchini, peppers, shallots, garlic, salt, pepper, and fresh herbs.
Fold each sheet of parchment paper in half. Starting at folded edge, cut into half of heart shape (when fold is open it should be full heart shape).

Place 1 filet on one half of each of 4 parchment “hearts.” Divide vegetable mixture into 4 even portions, placing one portion atop each fish filet. Add 1 tablespoon wine or stock and 1 tablespoon olive atop each vegetable stack.

Seal papillotes by folding over edges of packet and crimping edges tight. Place each papillote on sheet pan and bake in oven for 10 minutes (depending how cold ingredients are) or until parchment is puffed and turning golden brown on top.

recipes.name: BOILED NOODLES – SHOCK METHOD
recipes.description: Soba noodles tumble into salted boiling water, stirred loose, then interrupted at the rolling boil with a half cup of cold water — the shock method that coaxes each strand to cook through evenly.
instructions: Bring water to boil over medium heat. Add salt if needed.
Add noodles and stir to separate them.
Cover pot. Bring to rolling boil. Add 1/2 cup cold water and stir noodles.

Bring to rolling boil again. Add 1/2 cup cold water and stir noodles. Bring to rolling boil a third time. Add 1/2 cup cold water and stir noodles. Bring to rolling boil again. Remove from heat and let stand 2 to 3 minutes. Noodles are done when they are the same color inside and out.
Drain and rinse in cold water until noodles are cooled.

Note: This method of shocking noodles involves bringing noodles to rolling boil (noodles almost foam out of the pan) and adding cold water three times. The cold water temporarily halts cooking of outside of noodles so inside of noodles can become soft (without overcooking outside). Noodles cooked by shocking will be cooked uniformly throughout.

recipes.name: ADZUKI BEAN STEW
recipes.description: Aduki beans simmer with kombu, sweated onions, and garlic in vegetable stock until nearly tender, then chunks of butternut squash melt in before a final seasoning of fresh ginger juice and tamari deepens the pot.

ingredients.name: butternut squash
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into large dice

instructions: In 1-gallon pot on medium-low flame, heat oil. Add onion, salt, and garlic. Sweat until onions become translucent. Add aduki beans, kombu, and stock. Cover and bring to boil over high heat, reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for 30 minutes or until beans are almost tender.
Add butternut squash, cover, and continue simmering 20 minutes or until beans, onions, and squash are tender.
Remove kombu. Add ginger juice and tamari. Season to taste.
Garnish with scallions and serve.

recipes.name: Grilled Seitan
recipes.description: Seitan marinates in cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil, then hits a hot cast iron griddle until grill marks form, returning to its marinade to stay juicy before serving with chimichurri sauce.

ingredients.name: seitan
ingredients.notes: 12-ounce; cut into six 2-ounce slabs (reserve liquid from package)

instructions: Combine seitan in medium bowl with liquid from package, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, olive oil, and salt. Marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat cast iron griddle. Grill seitan on each side until grill marks form. Return seitan to bowl with marinade until ready to serve. Serve with Chimichurri Sauce.

recipes.name: BANANA CAKE
recipes.description: Mashed banana, maple syrup, and melted coconut oil process until smooth, then fold into sifted flours, coconut sugar, and leaveners, with banana and vanilla extracts deepening two tender cake layers.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection). Oil and flour two 8-inch cake pans and line bottom of pans with parchment.
In medium bowl, sift together dry ingredients. Whisk to combine.
In food processor, combine wet ingredient and process until smooth.
Using rubber spatula, transfer wet ingredients from food processor to bowl with dry ingredients. Mix to combine.
Pour batter into two prepared pans. Bake about 20-25 minutes or until top are golden brown, and cakes are springy to touch.
Cool on wire rack for 10-15 minutes. Remove from pans and completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: WHOLE GRAIN CROUTONS
recipes.description: Whole grain bread tosses with extra virgin olive oil, fresh thyme, sea salt, and a pinch of black pepper, then bakes at 350°F until golden and crisp — croutons built to crown a bowl of soup.

ingredients.name: good quality whole grain bread
ingredients.notes: about 1/4 loaf; crust removed, medium dice

instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line half-sheet with parchment paper.
Toss bread in bowl with oil, thyme, salt, and pepper. Transfer croutons to sheet tray.
Bake until bread is golden in color and crisp in texture. Serve over soup.

recipes.name: APRICOT PARFAIT
recipes.description: Apricot juice simmers with agar flakes and vanilla until it sets into a glossy kanten, the foundation of a parfait finished with rich cashew butter, crunchy almonds, and fresh mint leaves.
instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine juice, agar flakes and vanilla extract. Let sit for 10 minutes to help agar dissolve.
Bring mixture to boil, and reduce to simmer, covered, until agar is completely dissolved, stirring and scraping bottom and sides of pot with wooden spoon to avoid sticking.
Pour juice mixture into hotel pan to cool quickly. Once steam has stopped rising, place in refrigerator to set up and harden into kanten.
Blend 3/4 kanten briefly in processor. Pour in serving bowls.
Blend remaining 1/4 kanten briefly with cashew butter. Serve as topping. Garnish with almonds and mint leaf.

recipes.name: Skewered Fruit with Chocolate Fondue
recipes.description: Banana, kiwi, pineapple, strawberry, and orange line up in a deliberate sequence on skewers, ready for dunking into chocolate fondue — a playful, hands-on finish built entirely from fresh fruit.

ingredients.name: kiwi
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 12 (1/3-inch thick) rounds

ingredients.name: oranges
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 3 (1-inch thick) rounds, then cut in half again

ingredients.name: bananas
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 12 (1/2-inch thick) diagonal slices

instructions: Skewer fruit as follows: banana-kiwi-pineapple-strawberry-orange-strawberry-pineapple-kiwi-banana. Serve with Chocolate Fondue (recipe below).

recipes.name: Fresh Strawberries and Bananas
recipes.description: Strawberries macerate in maple crystals for a full half hour, drawing out their syrupy juices, before joining bananas tossed in lemon juice for a simple, glistening fruit dessert.
instructions: In bowl, toss strawberries with maple crystals. Set aside to macerate for 30 minutes.
In separate bowl, combine bananas with lemon juice. When strawberries are done macerating, add bananas to strawberries.

recipes.name: Whipped Cream
recipes.description: Heavy cream whipped in a chilled bowl until it holds stiff, billowy peaks, perfumed with vanilla and sweetened with maple crystals for a topping that stays light, airy, and quietly luxurious.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in stand mixer fitted with chilled bowl and whip until stiff peaks form.

recipes.name: GLUTEN-FREE CHOCOLATE MACAROONS
recipes.description: Melted semi-sweet chocolate folds into egg whites beaten to soft peaks with maple crystals, while shredded coconut and cocoa powder give these gluten-free macaroons their chewy, cocoa-rich body.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line half sheet tray with parchment paper.
Melt chocolate in double boiler, and set aside to cool.
In medium bowl, add salt to egg whites and beat with hand mixer or whisk to soft peaks. Slowly add maple crystals, spoonful by spoonful, to form until incorporated.
Using spatula, fold in vanilla and coconut.
Fold in cocoa powder and cooled melted chocolate. Gently fold to incorporate all ingredients.
Using 1-ounce ice cream scoop, transfer cookie dough to sheet tray, leaving space between for slight spread.
Bake 15-20 minutes. Cool and serve.

recipes.name: LIGHT LEMON TART
recipes.description: Agar dissolves into simmering apple juice with rice syrup, maple syrup, and a sunny pinch of turmeric; a kuzu slurry then thickens the filling from cloudy to clear before lemon juice and zest sharpen it.

ingredients.name: apple juice or white grape juice

instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, simmer agar in apple juice until agar is completely dissolved.
Add rice syrup, maple syrup, turmeric and pinch of salt.
Combine kuzu slurry with vanilla; add to agar-juice mixture. Cook until kuzu begins to thicken and goes from cloudy to clear.
Add lemon juice and zest.
Pour mixture into shallow bowl or pan and cool completely. Whisk frequently so that it does not 'set up.'
When mixture is cooled, pour into pre-baked and cooled tart crust.
Refrigerate tart to set filling.
Note: There may be lemon filling left after filling tart. Let it set totally and blend it in food processor for creamy smooth pudding.

recipes.name: AMARETTI COOKIES
recipes.description: Egg whites whip to soft peaks and take in maple crystals one spoonful at a time before almond extract and almond flour join the meringue, with pignoli nuts studding these delicate cookies ahead of a gentle bake.
instructions: Pre-heat oven to 325°F. Line 2 half-sheet pans with Silpats.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks; add maple crystals one tablespoon at a time and continue whipping until incorporated.
Add extracts and salt; whip 10 seconds more.
Using rubber spatula, fold almond flour into egg white mixture. Mixture will be soft and 'meringue-like' in consistency.
Scoop dough onto sheet tray with 1-ounce ice cream scoop. Top each cookie with 8-10 pignoli nuts.
Bake 18-20 minutes or until cookies are golden. Cool cookies before carefully removing from pan with metal offset spatula.

recipes.name: TRI-COLOR FRUIT TERRINE
recipes.description: Frozen pineapple, strawberries, and banana pass through a juicer into sorbet-like purees, layered one at a time in a parchment-lined mold with a freeze between each, brightened with lemon juice and maple syrup.

ingredients.name: stemmed
ingredients.notes: frozen strawberries (8 ounces) OR 1/2 bag (10-ounce) frozen strawberries

ingredients.name: pitted frozen cherries or 1 bag frozen cherries

instructions: Lightly brush terrine mold with oil and line with parchment paper, making sure inside of pan is covered entirely.

For first layer of terrine, process pineapple and one banana (broken into pieces) through Champion juicer using blank screen. Spoon pineapple-banana mixture into terrine mold and spread with offset spatula until surface is flat and even. Transfer terrine to freezer while preparing next layer.

For second layer, process frozen strawberries and remaining banana (broken into pieces) through Champion juicer using blank screen. Adjust flavor of blended fruit with lemon juice and maple syrup to taste, stirring well to combine. Spoon and smooth strawberry-banana mixture atop pineapple-banana mixture. Transfer terrine to freezer while preparing next layer.

For final layer, repeat previous step with frozen cherries. Add maple syrup to cherry puree and spoon atop strawberry-banana mixture. Cover terrine with plastic wrap, and freeze entire terrine until firm to touch (1 1/2 to 2 hours).
To serve, turn terrine out of mold and remove parchment. Allow terrine to thaw slightly (about 2 minutes) before slicing.

recipes.name: SHORTBREAD COOKIES
recipes.description: Butter creamed with powdered maple crystals, vanilla, and sea salt takes a gradual sift of whole wheat pastry flour, baking low and slow at 300 degrees into tender, melt-away shortbread.
instructions: Preheat oven to 300° F and line half sheet tray with parchment paper.
Cream butter, sugar, vanilla and salt in stand mixer.
Gradually sift in flour until well mixed.

Firmly press dough into flattened 6-inch oval in center of sheet tray. Cut dough into 16 equal-sized slices and pierce each slice with fork in decorative design (be sure to pierce through to pan to allow excess steam to escape).
Bake about 45-50 minutes or until entire dough is golden brown and firm to touch.
Remove from oven and cool on wire rack. Retrace cuts in dough to loosen cookies but allow to remain on sheet tray to fully cool (do not move cookies as they are very fragile at this stage).

recipes.name: Orange Cake
recipes.description: Orange juice, zest, and extract perfume a tender batter of whole wheat pastry flour, maple syrup, and melted coconut oil, whisked together and baked into two citrus-bright eight-inch layers.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection). Oil and flour two 8-inch cake pans and line bottoms with parchment.
Sift together dry ingredients in medium bowl and whisk together to combine. Set aside.
In separate bowl, whisk together wet ingredients and pour into dry. Mix well.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake for about 15-20 minutes until cakes are springy to touch and pull away from sides of pan.
Cool in pans on wire rack for 10-15 minutes. Remove from pans and completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.description: Butter creams with brown and white sugars until light and fluffy before peanut butter, egg, and vanilla join the bowl, yielding a classic cookie dough baked on parchment-lined trays at 350°F.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° F (300° F in convection oven). Prepare 2 sheet trays with parchment paper.
Cream sugars and butter in stand mixer until light and fluffy.
Add egg, peanut butter, and vanilla to butter-sugar mixture.
Whisk together flour, salt, and soda and add to mixer until dough is smooth.
Using 1-ounce ice cream scoop, place dough balls every 2 inches on half-sheet trays.
Press cookies flat with fork. Bake 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Spiced Carrot Cake
recipes.description: Cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and cardamom spice this two-layer carrot cake, where apple sauce and melted coconut oil moisten a maple-crystal batter folded through with carrots and walnuts.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (300°F in convection). Oil and flour two 8-inch cake pans and line bottoms with parchment.
Sift together dry ingredients in large bowl and whisk together to combine. Set aside.
In separate bowl, whisk together wet ingredients and pour into dry. Mix well. Add additional ingredients and mix to combine.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake for about 45-50 minutes until cakes are springy to touch and pull away from sides of pans.
Cool in pans on wire rack for about 10-15 minutes. Remove from pans and allow to completely cool on rack.

recipes.name: ORANGE WHIPPED COCONUT CREAM
recipes.description: Coconut milk simmers with agar until fully dissolved while coconut cream, agave syrup, and fresh orange zest and juice blend to silk, chilling over an ice bath into an airy, citrus-perfumed whipped cream.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk and agar. Set aside for at least 5 minutes.
Prepare ice bath. In Vitamix, combine melted coconut cream, agave syrup, orange zest, orange juice, and salt. Blend until smooth. Slowly add coconut butter and blend to combine.
Bring coconut-agar mixture to simmer. Simmer until all agar powder has dissolved, stirring constantly to avoid scorching.
Slowly add boiling coconut-agar mixture to Vitamix with other ingredients and blend to combine.
Using spatula, transfer mixture to medium bowl and set over ice bath until chilled.
Process frosting in food processor until smooth.

recipes.name: FRENCH VANILLA ICE CREAM
recipes.description: Whole vanilla bean steeps in milk and maple syrup while egg yolk whips to pale, ribboning thickness, the two uniting as a gently heated custard enriched with heavy cream for French vanilla ice cream.
instructions: Prepare ice bath.

In 2-quart saucepan, combine milk, 1/4 cup of maple syrup, sea salt, vanilla pulp, and vanilla pod. Whisk mixture to combine. Heat mixture on medium flame over flame tamer, stirring occasionally, until temperature reaches 175°F. Remove from heat.

While milk mixture is warming, combine remaining 1/4 cup maple syrup, rice syrup, egg yolk, and vanilla extract in medium-sized bowl. Beat with electric hand mixer until contents turn pale yellow and form semi-thick ribbons (about 5 minutes).

Slowly and gradually whisk 1/2 cup of hot milk mixture into beaten egg mixture, being careful not to cook yolks. Then carefully whisk milk and egg combination back into pot with remaining milk mixture. Heat over medium flame, stirring constantly, until temperature reaches 180°F (remove from heat to accurately take temperature).
Remove vanilla pod. Strain mixture into non-reactive bowl. Whisk in heavy cream.
Cool mixture in ice bath. Pour mixture into ice cream machine and freeze to scoop-able consistency.

recipes.name: Mocha Frosting
recipes.description: Instant coffee steeped in boiling water simmers with coconut milk, agar, and coconut cream until fully dissolved, setting the stage for cashew butter, maple crystals, and bittersweet chocolate in this deeply mocha frosting.
instructions: Prepare coffee by combining instant coffee, salt, and boiling water. Set aside.
In 2 1/2 quart pot, combine coconut milk, prepared coffee, agar powder, and coconut cream. Set aside for 5 minutes.
Bring coconut milk-coffee mixture to boil. Lower heat and simmer until all agar powder has dissolved. Transfer to ice bath.
In food processor combine cashew butter and maple crystals. Add coconut-coffee mixture. Blend well until smooth.
Add melted chocolate and mix to combine. Transfer mixture to small bowl.
Place bowl over ice bath until mixture is firm.
Blend frosting in food processor until smooth and pipe-able.

recipes.name: OLIVE OIL CRUST
recipes.description: Ice-cold olive oil is tossed, never mixed, through sifted whole wheat pastry and white flours until the fat forms little coated balls; just enough ice water then pulls it into a tender, light-handed crust dough.
instructions: In medium bowl, sift together flour, salt and baking powder.

Cut oil into flour mixture all at once but do not mix. Toss flour around lightly coating fat to create little balls of flour coated fat. A light touch is important here. Final blending will take place on pastry board in rolling.
Add just enough water (one tablespoon at a time) to form ball, being careful not over-mix and create too much gluten.
Flatten dough into disc, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for 15 minutes to relax the dough. Roll to desired shape. Transfer rolled dough to pie or tart pan and chill for 30 minutes or more.
Heat oven to 375°F, fill crust and bake.

recipes.name: BUTTER CRUST
recipes.description: Cold butter is cut into whole wheat pastry flour until coarse and pebbly, then ice water is tossed in a tablespoon at a time until the dough just comes together — chilled, then rolled out on lightly floured parchment.
instructions: Sift then mix flour and salt into bowl. Using two knives or pastry cutter, cut butter into flour to form very coarse meal.
With rubber spatula, lightly toss flour while sprinkling water in mixture 1 tablespoon at a time until dough forms. Wrap in plastic and chill 20 to 30 minutes.
Roll on lightly floured parchment to desired shape.

recipes.name: Orange Sorbet
recipes.description: Orange juice whisked with maple and rice syrups, lemon juice, and a splash of vodka churns in the ice cream machine until scoopable, with finely grated zest folded in for bright citrus perfume.
instructions: In medium bowl, whisk together orange juice, maple syrup, rice syrup, lemon juice, vodka, and sea salt.

Pour mixture into ice cream machine and freeze until scoop-able consistency is achieved. When mixture starts to firm up, add zest and continue to churn until incorporated. Transfer sorbet to freezer to firm consistency.

recipes.name: Avocado and Coconut Terrine
recipes.description: Avocados blend with lime juice, coconut cream, and agave syrup into a silky layer that firms in the freezer, paired in a terrine with a coconut milk layer whisked with vanilla and maple syrup.
instructions: Avocado layer: Blend avocados, lime juice, salt, coconut milk, coconut cream, and agave syrup in Vitamix until creamy.

Transfer mixture to ice cream machine and freeze until scoop-able consistency is achieved. Transfer mixture to half hotel pan and freeze for 20 minutes or until mixture firms to scoop-able consistency.
Coconut layer: In medium bowl, whisk together coconut milk, salt, vanilla extract, coconut extract, and maple syrup.
Transfer to ice cream machine and freeze until scoop-able consistency is achieved. Transfer to half hotel pan and freeze until mixture firms to scoop-able consistency.

Brush terrine mold lightly with oil and line with parchment paper. Spread avocado sorbet evenly in bottom of terrine mold. Swirl in coconut sorbet. Smooth surface of terrine and transfer to freezer to set until firm.

recipes.name: Tapioca Pudding
recipes.description: Large pearl tapioca simmers gently in rich almond milk with rice and maple syrups, stirred until just translucent, then perfumed with vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon zest before chilling.

ingredients.name: large pearl tapioca
ingredients.notes: soaked in 2 cups water for 30 minutes, drained

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine soaked and drained tapioca, almond milk, salt, rice syrup, and maple syrup. Whisk together. Bring mixture to simmer over burner with flame tamer, stirring constantly to keep tapioca from sticking to bottom of pot.
Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture starts to thicken, and tapioca just becomes translucent, about 10-15 minutes. Do not overcook or mixture will become glue-like.
Stir in vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Remove from heat. Let mixture cool down, and chill further in refrigerator.

recipes.name: Orange Blossom Panna Cotta
recipes.description: Heavy cream and maple syrup simmer gently before dissolved agar sets the base, perfumed with orange blossom water and orange zest and rounded out with tangy buttermilk, with oranges, honey, and pistachios to finish.

ingredients.name: agar flakes
ingredients.notes: 3 tablespoons + 1 teaspoon; combined with 1 1/2 cups water (soaked for 10 minutes)

instructions: In 1-gallon pot, combine heavy cream, maple syrup, and salt. Cook uncovered on low simmer, stirring constantly for about 5-7 minutes. Turn off heat and set aside.

Pour soaked agar and water mixture into separate 2 1/2 quart pot. Bring to boil, cover pot, lower heat, and simmer until all agar is completely dissolved, about 5 minutes. Add to pot with heavy cream mixture and cook 2-3 minutes longer. Add orange blossom water and orange zest.
Add buttermilk to heavy cream/agar mixture.
Ladle mixture into 4-ounce ramekins. Refrigerate until set.
Combine orange supreme with rice syrup and serve as garnish with nuts.

recipes.name: WATERMELON GRANITA
recipes.description: Watermelon blends and strains into pure juice, brightened with lime, agave, and a pinch of sea salt, then freezes in a shallow pan into icy, spoonable crystals garnished with sprigs of mint.

ingredients.name: watermelon
ingredients.notes: about 2 pounds; seeded and cut into chunks

instructions: Blend watermelon in Vitamix and strain out excess pulp with nut bag or chinois lined with 2 layers of moistened cheesecloth.
Transfer watermelon juice to medium bowl and add lime juice, agave, and salt.
Pour mixture into half hotel pan (mixture should be about 1/4 inch up side of pan) and transfer to freezer for about 1 hour.
Remove pan from freezer and use fork to scrape any ice crystals that have formed on side or bottom of pan. Return to freezer and repeat scraping every 30 minutes for 3-4 hours.
Once mixture is thoroughly frozen, scrape once more with fork, returning granita to “dry” in freezer for another half hour before serving.
Garnish granita with mint sprigs and serve.

recipes.name: GREEN APPLE SORBET
recipes.description: Thyme leaves simmer into an agave syrup that gets pureed, strained, and sharpened with fresh lemon juice before meeting tart granny smith apples in a bracing, herb-tinged sorbet.

ingredients.name: medium granny smith apples
ingredients.notes: 4 pounds; chopped to fit through feeding tube juicer

instructions: In 2 1/2 quart pot over medium flame, simmer thyme leaves, agave, water, and salt for 15 minutes.
Remove pot from flame. Pour mixture into blender and puree to combine. Strain and set aside in medium bowl.
In separate bowl, combine juiced lemons with agave-thyme mixture.
Juice apples in Champion juicer and combine with lemon juice and agave-thyme mixture.
Transfer mixture to ice cream machines and freeze until scoop-able consistency is achieved. Transfer sorbet to 9-pan and freeze forty minutes to one hour or until sorbet firms up.

recipes.name: Pecan Tuiles
recipes.description: Chopped pecans whisked with whole wheat pastry flour and arrowroot meet a blend of rice syrup, maple syrup, vanilla, and sea salt; after a fifteen-minute rest, the batter bakes into thin, crisp wafers.

ingredients.name: pecans
ingredients.notes: toasted in oven and coarsely chopped

ingredients.name: melted coconut oil or canola oil

instructions: Preheat convection oven to 300° F (350° F in conventional oven). Line 5 half-sheet trays with Silpats.
Transfer chopped pecans to medium bowl and add flour and arrowroot. Whisk to combine.
In separate bowl, whisk oil, rice syrup, maple syrup, vanilla, and salt until thoroughly combined. Add to pecan/flour mixture, mixing until combined. Let batter sit for 15 minutes.

Use teaspoon measure to drop batter onto Silpat-lined baking sheets. Place only 5 cookies per sheet – one in each corner and one in middle. Bake one sheet at a time for 10 minutes until cookies are bubbly.

Cool cookies for approximately 30 seconds before removing from Silpats. Working quickly (because cookies cool and set hard very fast), remove tuiles from sheet tray using small offset spatula and wrap around cannoli molds. Repeat procedure with remaining sheet trays until all batter is used.

recipes.name: POMEGRANATE GRANITA
recipes.description: Pomegranate and orange juices simmer with maple crystals until dissolved, then freeze in a shallow pan; patient scraping with a fork every half hour builds flaky, ruby ice crystals.
instructions: In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, over low flame, simmer pomegranate and orange juices with maple crystals until crystals dissolve.
Pour mixture in half hotel pan (mixture should be 1/4 inch up side of pan) and transfer to freezer for about 1 hour.
Remove pan from freezer and use fork to scrape any ice crystals that have formed on side or bottom of pan. Return to freezer and repeat scraping every 30 minutes for 3-4 hours.
Once mixture is thoroughly frozen, scrape once more with fork, returning granita to 'dry' in freezer for another half hour before serving.

recipes.name: Lime-Sea Salt Chocolate Ganache Truffles
recipes.description: Coconut milk simmers with lime zest and sea salt before semisweet chocolate melts in; the ganache chills firm in the freezer, ready to scoop into truffles finished with a chocolate coating and Maldon salt.
instructions: Bring coconut milk, 1/4 tsp lime zest, and 1/4 tsp salt to simmer in 2-quart pot.
Remove coconut milk from heat. Add chocolate. Stir with spatula until smooth.
Pour chocolate mixture into shallow baking pan and chill in freezer for 30 minutes, or until firm enough to scoop.
Form 1-inch diameter truffles using small half-ounce scoop or teaspoon.
Return truffles to freezer to firm.
Dip truffles in Chocolate Coating (recipe following) and garnish with lime zest and sea salt. Serve truffles at room temperature.

recipes.name: Salted Almond and Thyme Brittle
recipes.description: Hot sugar work defines this brittle: brown rice syrup, coconut oil, and agave simmer to a precise 280°F on the candy thermometer, chopped thyme swirled in along the way, blanched almonds and coarse sea salt bringing the salty crunch.
instructions: Line 2 half-sheet pans with Silpat and set aside. Have 2 more Silpats ready for use.
In 2 1/2 quart saucepan, combine brown rice syrup, water, coconut oil, agave, and salt. Set pot over medium flame, stirring occasionally, until mixture comes to boil. Reduce heat to simmer.
Once mixture reaches 260°F as measured on candy thermometer, add thyme. Do not stir mixture again but swirl pot occasionally and keep cooking until candy thermometer reads 280°F.
Stir in nuts and mix well. Remove mixture from heat and thoroughly stir in baking soda.

Quickly divide brittle mixture between 2 half-sheet pans, using lightly oiled spatula. Spread brittle into thin even layer. Place second large Silpat on top of brittle and roll more thinly with rolling pin.
Let brittle cool completely, about 30 minutes. If making brittle on hot, humid day in kitchen without air conditioning, then you may have to cool brittle in refrigerator.
When cooled, turn brittle upside down from Silpat to parchment paper. Break brittle in 1/4-inch sized pieces.

recipes.name: ROLLED FIG COOKIES
recipes.description: Almond-flecked dough comes together in the food processor with maple syrup and coconut oil, made to be rolled around a dried-fig filling scented with apple juice, cinnamon, and cloves.

ingredients.name: blanched almonds
ingredients.notes: 1/4 cup + 2 tablespoons; ground to fine meal (measure then grind)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two half-sheet trays with parchment paper and set aside.
In food processor, sift together flours, almond meal, and cinnamon. In small bowl, whisk together salt, syrup, and oil.
Add wet mixture to dry in food processor. Pulse to combine.
Divide dough evenly in half. Flatten dough into 2 discs and wrap each in plastic wrap. Refrigerate 10-15 minutes to firm.
In 2-quart pot, combine figs, apple juice, vanilla, cinnamon, cloves, and salt. Simmer 5-7 minutes or until figs are softened. Drain figs, reserving cooking liquid.
Puree fig mixture in food processor, adding cooking liquid as necessary, to make smooth, spreadable paste. Set aside to cool.
Roll each dough separately on parchment paper (dough should be about 1/8 inch thick. Trim excess dough so that dough roughly measures 10” by 6” rectangle.

Spread cooled or room temperature filling over rolled out dough. Roll dough jelly roll style as tightly as possible. Wrap dough in parchment paper and transfer to freezer for 15-20 minutes until hard.
Using bread knife, slice dough into ¼-inch rounds. Transfer to sheet trays and bake 10-15 minutes or until lightly golden. Cool and serve.

recipes.name: COCONUT MACAROONS
recipes.description: Maple crystals boil with water to the softball stage, then meet egg whites whipped by hand with vanilla to stiff peaks — the sweet backbone for shredded coconut and chopped pistachios baked into macaroons.

ingredients.name: shredded coconut
ingredients.notes: pulsed in food processor to fine powder

instructions: Preheat oven to 325° F. Line 2 half-sheet pans with parchment and lightly oil or use Silpats.

In 2 ½ quart pot, combine maple crystals, water, and salt. Bring to boil and reduce to simmer. Cook until mixture thickens and reaches softball stage (about 20-25 minutes/234-240°F). Soft ball stage is reached when small droplet of syrup poured into ice water and forms soft, pliable ball. Remove from heat, cover mixture, and set aside to cool to about 155°F before combining with beaten eggs.
Combine egg whites and vanilla in medium bowl and beat with whisk by hand to form stiff peaks.
Very gradually, fold beaten egg whites into slightly cooled syrup mixture just until combined. Carefully fold in pulsed coconut. Refrigerate dough 10-15 minutes to let set before scooping.

Form cookies with 1-ounce scoop, rounding each into a ball, and then rolling them in crushed pistachios. Transfer cookies to lightly oiled, parchment lined baking sheets. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until firm and bottoms of cookies are slightly golden.

recipes.name: Truffled Portobello Mousse
recipes.description: Roasted portobello mushrooms and pressure-cooked navy beans form a silky mousse set with agar and deepened with sherry, thyme, and truffle salt, served alongside fig-thyme preserves.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Combine navy beans and bay leaf in pressure cooker. Add water to cover by 2 inches. Cover cooker and bring beans to pressure. Reduce heat and cook for 20 minutes. Release pressure by placing pressure cooker under cold water and drain beans, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid.
Toss 2 tablespoons of olive oil with sliced mushrooms and 1/2 teaspoon sea salt. Spread mushrooms on parchment-lined sheet tray and roast 15 minutes, or until golden.
In large sauté pan, heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil. Add onions and remaining 1/2 teaspoon of salt and cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until onions are golden. Deglaze pan with sherry.

Combine agar flakes and reserved cup of bean cooking liquid in 2-quart saucepan. Bring mixture to a simmer, cook for 8 to 10 minutes (with lid ajar) or until the agar is completely dissolved, stirring occasionally.
Combine navy beans, Portobello mushrooms, onions, dissolved agar mixture and truffle salt in Vitamix. Using tamper, blend mixture for 3 to 5 minutes, or until completely smooth.
Pour mixture into silicone molds and refrigerate for 30 to 60 minutes to set.
Coat sides of unmolded mousse with thyme leaves before serving.
Serve chilled atop sliced baguette with fig-thyme preserves (see below for recipe).

recipes.name: BERRIES AND CREAM TERRINE
recipes.description: Soaked cashews blend with coconut milk, agave, and vanilla bean into a silky cream layered into molds and frozen firm, met by a blueberry layer and a finish of blackberries and fresh mint.
instructions: For vanilla layer: In a high-speed blender, combine soaked cashews, coconut milk, agave syrup, coconut oil, vanilla extract, lemon juice, scraped vanilla bean and sea salt.
Blend on high for a few minutes until mixture is completely smooth.
Transfer filling into rectangular 6 x 4-inch silicone molds, filling them halfway up (approximately 1 cup per mold) and place in the freezer.
For blueberry layer: Add frozen blueberries, coconut milk and agave syrup into a small saucepan.
Bring mixture to a simmer over high heat. Reduce for 10 to 15 minutes, stirring frequently, until mixture is reduced to 1 1/2 cups. Cool over ice bath.
Pour cooled mixture into high-speed blender. Add soaked cashews, coconut oil, lemon juice, and salt.
Blend on high for a few minutes until the mixture is completely smooth.
Gently spoon mixture on top of vanilla layer already setting in silicone molds.
Freeze for one hour, or until firm.
To serve: Let terrines sit for 5 to 10 minutes at room temperature before serving.
Place terrines on a serving plate. Top with cut blackberries and mint.
Store any leftover terrines in the freezer.

recipes.name: Golden Turmeric 'Panna Cotta' with Ginger-Pepper Lace Cookies
recipes.description: Agar flakes set a hemp-coconut milk cream simmered with turmeric, cardamom, ginger, and vanilla bean, strained silky-smooth into molds and paired with pecan-studded ginger-pepper lace cookies.
instructions: Grease inside of small silicone molds with oil.

Combine agar flakes and milk in medium saucepan and simmer over medium heat until agar flakes have dissolved. Add cardamom, turmeric, ginger, maple syrup, vanilla bean, and salt. Simmer an additional 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Strain mixture through chinois and pour into silicone molds. Cool until firm.
In blender, puree blackberries and maple syrup. Strain coulis and transfer to squeeze bottle.
Preheat convection oven to 300°F. Line 5 half-sheet trays with Silpats.
Transfer pecans to medium bowl. Add flour and arrowroot. Whisk to combine.
In separate bowl, whisk oil, rice syrup, maple syrup, vanilla, ginger, black pepper, and salt. Add to pecan/flour mixture, mixing until combined. Let batter sit for 15 minutes.
Use teaspoon to drop batter onto Silpat-lined baking sheets. Place only 5 cookies per sheet – one in each corner and one in middle. Bake one sheet at a time for 10 minutes until cookies are bubbly.

Cool cookies for approximately 30 seconds before removing from Silpats. Working quickly (because cookies cool and set hard very fast), remove tuiles from sheet tray using small offset spatula and wrap around cannoli molds. Repeat procedure with remaining sheet trays until all batter is used.
Invert panna cotta onto plate. Garnish with tuile, blackberries, gold dust, blackberry coulis and mint sprigs.

recipes.name: RUGELACH
recipes.description: Cream cheese and butter whirl into a rich, tender dough that chills until firm before being wrapped around fruit preserves, currants, walnuts, and cinnamon and brushed with egg wash.
instructions: In food processor, combine cream cheese and butter. Process until smooth and creamy. Add maple crystals and vanilla; process until incorporated, scraping sides of bowl as necessary.
In small bowl, whisk together flour and salt. Add to food processor. Pulse until dough starts to clump together and form ball.
Remove dough from food processor. Separate dough equally in two and wrap each piece in plastic and flatten to disc shape. Refrigerate for at least one and one half hours until firm.
In medium bowl, combine currants, walnuts, maple crystals, and cinnamon. Set aside. Place preserves into separate small bowl. Set aside.
Pre-heat oven to 350°F, line 2 half sheet pans with parchment paper.

Work with one dough at a time, leaving other in refrigerator. Liberally dust dough with flour. Roll between 2 pieces of plastic wrap to 9-inch circle. Thickness should be 1/8 inch. Use inverted nine-inch cake pan to trim edges.
Using offset spatula, spread dough with half of preserves. Sprinkle with 1/2 of filling. Divide circle into 16 even “slices” (using bench knife, pizza cutter, or sharp knife).
Starting at wide end of triangle, roll each slice tightly as possible. Transfer to sheet tray and refrigerate 15-20 minutes more. Repeat steps 7-10 with remaining dough.
Before baking, brush each cookie with egg wash. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden.

recipes.name: Baked Meringue Shells
recipes.description: Egg whites whip to soft peaks, then maple crystals stream in a spoonful at a time until the meringue stands stiff — piped into shells and baked low and slow for hours until shatteringly crisp.
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°F and line sheet tray with parchment paper.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks, then add sweetener one tablespoon at a time until incorporated and meringue is stiff.
Using pastry bag or spoon, pipe or spoon meringue on sheet tray. Bake until crisp (minimum 2 hours).
Cool shells completely and remove from parchment.

recipes.name: KANTEN
recipes.description: Agar flakes soak and then simmer in apple juice until completely dissolved while sliced strawberries wait in the baking dish, everything setting up into a clean, fruit-sweetened kanten gel.
instructions: Soak agar flakes in juice for 10 minutes in 2 1/2 quart saucepan.
Bring mixture to boil. Watch carefully to prevent liquid from boiling over. Reduce heat to simmer and cook until agar is completely dissolved, whisking frequently.
Place sliced strawberries in an 8-inch square baking dish.
Slowly pour agar and juice mixture over berries. Set aside until no steam is rising from mixture.
Place in refrigerator until firmed up, about 45 minutes. Can either be served cut into cubes or blended in food processor for 'pudding.'

recipes.name: PAN-FRIED POLENTA CAKES
recipes.description: Hot polenta spreads across a sheet tray to set firm, then gets cut into shapes, dredged through cornmeal for a gritty crust, and pan-fried until the exterior crisps against the tender interior.
instructions: Pour hot polenta onto parchment-lined half-sheet tray, and spread with lightly oiled spatula to 1/2 inch thickness. Let set until firm, 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Cut into desired shapes using cookie cutters.
Spread cornmeal on plate and dredge polenta. Prepare another plate with paper towel for draining.
Heat 1/4 inch oil in sauté pan, and fry polenta cakes over medium high heat until golden and crisp. Flip once and fry other side.
Drain on paper and serve hot.

recipes.name: Bánh Flan
recipes.description: The Vietnamese interpretation of caramel custard. It is distinct from its Mexican cousin due to the incorporation of dark coffee over the caramel, resulting in a bitter, complex edge that balances the dense, sweet egg matrix.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Plus 2 extra yolks for extreme richness.

ingredients.name: strong vietnamese coffee
ingredients.notes: Poured over the flan before serving.

ingredients.name: crushed ice
ingredients.notes: Served underneath or around the flan.

instructions: Step 1: The Glass. Melt the sugar in a dry saucepan until it reaches a dark, smoking amber. Immediately pour a thin layer into the bottom of individual ramekins, swirling to coat before it solidifies into glass.
Step 2: The Egg Matrix. In a bowl, gently whisk the whole eggs and extra yolks. Do not beat violently; incorporating air bubbles will ruin the silken texture.

Step 3: The Emulsion. Whisk the warm milk and condensed milk together, then slowly pour this hot mixture into the eggs, whisking continuously (tempering). Strain the entire mixture through a fine sieve to remove any unmixed chalazae.

Step 4: The Steam. Pour the strained matrix into the caramel-lined ramekins. Cover each tightly with foil. Steam gently over barely simmering water for 30-40 minutes until set but trembling. Chill completely.

Step 5: The Bitter Finish. Invert the cold flan onto a plate of crushed ice. The caramel will have liquefied into a sauce. Pour a shot of dark, bitter Vietnamese espresso directly over the flan, letting it mix with the sweet caramel.

recipes.name: Chè Chuối
